summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to use external and domain-specific knowledge, but its reliability depends on the interaction between the generative model, embedding model, retrieval mechanism, and prompt construction strategy. We present RagTester, an automated end-to-end testing approach for RAG systems. RagTester generates retrieval documents, test inputs, and expected outputs; executes the tests; and evaluates the resulting answers using an LLM as a judge. Its test-generation strategy targets complex passages, unsupported queries, and document-coverage criteria. We evaluate RagTester using eight LLMs and six embedding models, yielding 24 compatible configurations, and compare it with a baseline test-input generator. Across 72,000 test executions, RagTester detected 21,633 failures, 6.6% more than the baseline, and outperformed it in 20 of the 24 configurations. The detected failures include inaccurate retrieval, unsupported answers, incomplete use of retrieved context, and difficulties interpreting complex passages. These results show that coverage-oriented test generation can effectively expose failures caused by the interaction between retrieval and generation components and support the assessment of RAG configurations before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAG-Tester，一个针对检索增强生成(RAG)系统的自动化端到端测试框架，通过覆盖导向的测试生成策略(包括复杂段落、不支持查询和文档覆盖率)，自动生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出，并使用LLM作为评判器来评估结果。在24种LLM-嵌入组合上进行72,000次测试执行，检测到21,633个失败，比基线高出6.6%。
AI.motivation: RAG系统的可靠性取决于生成模型、嵌入模型、检索机制和提示构建策略等多个组件的交互作用。现有评估方法主要依赖基准测试或特定场景框架，覆盖范围有限，难以暴露由检索与生成组件交互引起的各种失败模式，缺乏端到端的自动化测试机制。
AI.method: RAG-Tester是一个四阶段自动化测试框架：(1) 测试文件生成器，使用GPT-5 Nano自动生成PDF文档；(2) 测试输入生成器，采用三种策略——基于Flesch可读性评分选择复杂段落、生成不支持的负面拒绝查询、基于文档覆盖率选择未充分测试的部分；(3) 测试执行器，使用LangChain构建RAG链和Chroma向量存储，支持OpenAI和Ollama模型；(4) 测试预言机，使用LLM-as-a-Judge（GPT-4.1 Nano）从忠实性、相关性、完整性、清晰度和关键词匹配五个维度评估输出。评估采用8个LLM（4个闭源+4个开源）和6个嵌入模型，形成24种配置，生成3,000个测试用例，与简化基线对比。
AI.result: 在72,000次测试执行中，RAG-Tester检测到21,633个失败，相比基线的20,293个高出6.6%，在24种配置中的20种上优于基线。具体而言，闭源模型组表现更优（+19.68%），开源组略低（-3.10%）。检测到的失败类型包括检索不准确、不支持的幻觉回答、不完整的上下文利用以及对复杂段落的理解困难。真实PDF文档比AI生成文档触发更多失败（高出64.4%）。测试预言机精度达80.6%（假发现率19.4%），按多数投票由四个更强的LLM验证。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖导向的自动测试生成能有效暴露RAG系统中由检索与生成组件交互引起的失败，支持部署前对LLM-嵌入配置进行可靠性评估。RAG-Tester提供了端到端的测试机制，但在文档格式、查询复杂度（如多文档、多跳、对抗性用例）以及测试预言机精度方面仍有改进空间。未来工作将整合Chunk Coverage等检索充分性度量，并改进文档生成策略以更接近真实文档的复杂性。

title: H+ Embedding: Harmonizing Global and Token-Level Retrieval with Context-Dependent Phrases
summary: Terminology-intensive retrieval, especially in medical settings, depends on preserving multi-word entities, abbreviations, numerical constraints, and compositional concepts. However, existing representations lie at two extremes: single-vector retrievers often over-compress local relevance signals, while token-level late interaction retains every tokenizer subword at substantial indexing, storage, and scoring cost. This mismatch raises a natural question: can context-dependent phrases provide a useful retrieval unit between global vectors and tokens? We introduce H+ Embedding, a unified multi-granularity retriever that predicts variable-length phrase partitions, preserves uncovered tokens as singletons, and applies importance-guided unit selection with weighted MaxSim interaction. Across 16 scientific, medical, and bilingual tasks, its phrase retrieval branch exceeds the global retrieval branch by 6.91 macro nDCG@10. It also nearly matches Token while using 13.7% fewer document vectors and outperforms content-independent grouping rules under moderate vector budgets. Context-dependent phrase interaction therefore provides an intermediate quality-cost point between global compression and token-level interaction for practical retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出H+ Embedding，一种统一的多粒度检索器，通过CRF学习上下文相关的短语边界作为介于全局单向量和token级交互之间的中间检索单元，在16个科学/医学/双语任务上短语分支以少13.7%的文档向量接近token级效果，并比全局分支高出6.91个宏观nDCG@10。
AI.motivation: 术语密集型检索（尤其医学领域）需要保留多词实体、缩写、数值约束等局部结构信号。现有方法存在粒度鸿沟：单向量检索过度压缩局部相关性信号，而token级late interaction保留每个子词但索引、存储和评分成本高昂。因此需要一种介于全局压缩和token级交互之间的中间检索粒度。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3-0.6B-Base的双向编码器共享骨干：(1) CRF预测BIO标签以学习上下文相关的短语分区，未覆盖token保留为单例单元；(2) 共享重要性头输出softplus正分数，单元内求和得到短语权重；(3) 加权短语MaxSim评分（公式9）结合TopB预算选择；(4) 辅助词法视图通过token-ID最大池化实现精确匹配；(5) 两阶段训练：Stage1用MRL对比学习适应全局嵌入，Stage2联合优化全局/token交互/词法三个检索头并辅以教师蒸馏和CRF分割损失。
AI.result: 16任务宏观nDCG@10：Phrase为41.19 vs Global 34.28（+6.91），15/16任务胜出。共享候选池下Phrase以62.94 vs Token的62.95（13.7%更少文档向量）几乎匹配。在19任务精确计数对比中，B≥32时Phrase显著优于Bigram和Random。B=128时Phrase相对Token/Bigram/Random分别+1.24/+1.27/+1.25。1千万文档规模上Phrase nDCG@100为0.8777 vs Global 0.8617。消融显示查询端重要性加权是关键机制（+1.66点），边界位置超越长度/计数起作用。CRF边界F1=0.900。
AI.conclusion: 检索能力不仅取决于表示宽度，还取决于交互粒度——两者互补而非可互换。上下文相关短语交互提供了一个介于全局压缩与token级交互之间的实用质量-成本操作点；该工作将检索粒度本身变为可学习对象，并为实际检索系统中候选深度、交互粒度与向量预算的联合调优提供了新视角。局限在于短语边界依赖教师BIO标签且使用固定每文本预算，未来工作将探索检索驱动的短语归纳、自适应预算和全语料短语索引。

title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
summary: AI coding agents like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of this workload using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June 2026, comprising 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, and 95T tokens. Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with important systems implications. For example, agentic coding sessions consist of sparse user-initiated turns, each unfolding into an autonomous agent loop of LLM calls almost always coupled with tool execution. This structure yields KV cache hit rates averaging 90% within a turn, but falling to 55\% across turn boundaries and drastically invalidated after events like model switches or context compaction. Diverse workflows and user behaviors are observed with variable and long-tailed token consumption, time span, and tool calls. We highlight the difference between quick agentic turnaround times and the minutes-long user idle periods at turn boundaries, and design a lightweight idle-time predictor that captures 86-90\% of total idle time, enabling proactive decisions for efficient resource orchestration. These findings challenge assumptions underlying current LLM-serving systems and provide an empirical foundation for agent-native infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 这是首个针对生产环境中AI编程代理工作负载的大规模表征研究，基于GitHub Copilot 2026年6月一周内13M会话、3.2M用户、761M次LLM调用和95T tokens的采样追踪数据，揭示了编程代理负载在执行结构、KV缓存生命周期、上下文压缩、工具调用和用户行为等方面显著区别于聊天机器人的结构性特征。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM服务系统（如vLLM、SGLang）原本为独立、短时、无状态的请求设计，而AI编程代理（GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、Codex）通过将多步骤LLM推理与工具执行交织，形成了本质不同的工作负载。现有优化方案（如Pythia、Parrot、SAGA、Sutradhara）主要基于SWE-bench等合成基准进行评估与设计，缺乏对生产环境中编程代理实际行为特征的理解，亟需基于真实负载的经验性表征来指导"代理原生（agent-native）"基础设施的设计。
AI.method: 对GitHub Copilot编码代理在VS和VS Code中2026年6月第一周的匿名遥测数据进行采样分析（涵盖3.2M用户、13.5M会话、760.5M次LLM调用、774.7M次工具调用、44.9T prompt tokens、39.3B completion tokens，涉及27+模型和45+工具）。采用三层次级结构（Session → User-Turn → Step）进行分解分析；通过聚类识别6种工作流原型和5种用户原型；利用LightGBM分位回归（12个分位、每分位400棵树、共约2MB）训练生存曲线形式的空闲时间预测器；特征涵盖轮次级、会话级和时间特征三类。
AI.result: （1）代理循环呈严格1:1的LLM↔工具耦合，87%的LLM调用由代理自主发起；（2）轮内KV缓存命中率约90%，但轮边界处降至55%（下降26%），模型切换后仅剩8%（下降67%），上下文压缩触发后命中率下降66%；（3）上下文压缩影响7.8%的会话但承担44.2%的总token；（4）9%的轮次发生工具失败，失败驱动的重试循环可使计算量放大4倍；（5）5种用户原型每轮token消耗差异达50倍（23K到1.1M）；（6）空闲时间呈双峰分布：轮内短（容器5.8s、KV缓存1.2s），跨轮长（容器243s≈4.1min、KV缓存172s≈2.9min）；（7）空闲时间预测器在30秒评估点处准确率80–88%，但对总空闲时间的捕获率稳定维持在86–90%，推理仅需<3ms/次。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了当前LLM服务系统基于请求级独立性的基本假设，提出了面向"代理原生"基础设施的多项设计原则：(1) 会话级调度取代请求级调度；(2) KV缓存作为会话感知的一级可调度资源，需针对轮边界、模型切换、上下文压缩三类结构性失效事件进行专门管理；(3) 工具可靠性直接影响服务效率；(4) 应采用分层SLO模型，针对Deep-loop用户延长缓存保留、对Chat-only/Reader用户激进回收；(5) 轮边界是容器休眠与KV缓存卸载/调度的最有效信号。该研究为AI编程代理生产系统设计提供了首个可量化的经验基础。

title: Can LLM Agents Price Competitively? A Dynamic Multi-Attribute Auction Benchmark for Agentic Commerce
summary: Agentic commerce is moving from concept to deployed infrastructure: payment networks, retailers, and AI platforms are setting the stage for agents to transact on behalf of merchants and consumers. Yet whether the LLMs behind these agents can price competently in real markets, where customer preferences are hidden, competitors adapt in real time, and demand can shift without warning, has not been systematically tested. We introduce Bazaar, a dynamic sealed-bid benchmark for multi-attribute auction under these conditions. Despite its dynamics, the benchmark is grounded in closed-form customer utilities, enabling exact evaluation. Across 11 frontier LLMs from four providers, the leading agents on customer acquisition (e.g. Gemini 3.1 Pro) are often not the leading agents on profit (e.g. Opus 4.6). The ranking shifts again under demand shocks: agents that learned fastest pre-shock are typically the slowest to revise their beliefs afterwards, while Gemini 3.1 Pro recovers fastest despite not leading on profit. However, even the strongest agent captures less than a third of hindsight-optimal profit, suggesting current LLMs are progressing in agentic commerce but leave substantial headroom.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Bazaar，一个动态密封投标多属性拍卖基准测试，用于评估LLM智能体在真实市场竞争环境中的定价能力。通过对来自4家供应商的11个前沿LLM进行测试，发现利润主要由每胜利润率驱动而非胜率，思维预算对性能有巨大影响，且存在"强学习者/弱适应者"的权衡悖论。即使最强的智能体也只获得了后视最优利润的三分之一，表明当前LLM在代理商务中仍有显著提升空间。
AI.motivation: 随着Anthropic Project Vend、Microsoft Magentic Marketplace、Alibaba Shopping Companion等代理商务系统从概念走向部署，LLM智能体需要代表商家和消费者进行交易。然而，LLM是否能在真实市场中——客户偏好隐藏、竞争对手实时适应、需求突然变化——进行有竞争力的定价，尚未得到系统性测试。现有基准测试要么关注电商的产品知识与推荐质量（买方侧），要么研究博弈论基准中的拍卖与谈判（静态环境），但未能同时结合学习、定价和重复非平稳竞争中的信念修正这三个关键能力。
AI.method: 本文提出Bazaar框架，核心方法包括：(1) 重复密封投标多属性拍卖协议——智能体同时选择产品配置（K=3个属性，各L=5个级别，共125种配置）和价格；(2) 隐藏偏好的异质客户群体——24个客户分为4个单一属性型、12个双重属性型、8个三重属性型；(3) 适应性对手——3个专业机器人，每个在特定属性上有成本优势，价格自适应调整；(4) 中途偏好冲击——12个客户在第31-40轮之间经历属性价值交换；(5) 精确诊断指标——基于闭式客户效用和商家成本的精确评估，分离为超额利润、损失遗憾（输掉本可赢的拍卖）和低价遗憾（赢得但定价过低）。对比Thompson Sampling和EXP4赌博基线，评估11个来自Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI的前沿LLM，每个模型在10个随机种子下运行。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 总利润范围从Opus 4.6 (adaptive, xhigh)的$2,976到GPT-5.4 (none)的$266，相差11倍；(2) 利润与每胜利润率高度相关(r=0.99)，与胜率相关性较低(r=0.88)——Gemini 3.1 Pro胜率77.9%但利润低于Opus 4.6；(3) 思维预算影响巨大——GPT-5.4从默认的$266跃升至high effort的$1,936（7.3倍增长）；(4) 存在"强学习者/弱适应者"权衡——GPT-5.3和Opus 4.5在冲击前学习最快（+46pp和+40pp），但冲击后适应最差（平均-19pp）；(5) 发现两种失败原型——Losers（输掉本可赢的拍卖）和Underpricers（赢得但低价），思维预算增加使模型从Loser转变为Underpricer；(6) 即使最强模型也只获得后视最优利润的32.1%（η=0.321），远未达到最优。Gemini 3.1 Pro是性价比最高的顶级表现者，API成本仅为Opus 4.6的1/4.8。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出三个主要结论：(1) Bazaar提供了一个诊断框架——通过超额利润和Oracle遗憾诊断指标，可将性能分解为偏好学习、利润提取和冲击后修正，并分类失败原型；(2) 利润纪律（margin discipline）是区分性技能，思维预算沿二维失败面移动模型——降低损失遗憾但增加低价遗憾，使同一基础模型从Loser转变为Underpricer；(3) 排行榜存在两条不同路径——Opus 4.6通过利润纪律领跑利润，Gemini 3.1 Pro领跑胜率且恢复最快；同时揭示了冲击下的"强学习者/弱适应者"反转现象。文章强调当前LLM在代理商务方面正在进步但仍有显著提升空间，并从伦理角度指出所测量的定价行为是基于产品偏好而非身份特征的个性化，与基于人口统计学的价格歧视有本质区别。

title: Shared Organizational Memory for Enterprise Coding Agents: System Design and Deployment Snapshot
summary: Enterprise coding agents rely on tools and retrieval, yet enterprise knowledge often remains outside public training data and formal documentation: internal DSLs, proprietary platforms, local conventions, recent fixes, and tacit workflows. Existing knowledge interfaces expose stored resources but still depend on agents recognizing and explicitly recording lessons worth reusing, disconnecting capture from the coding workflow and leaving development experience repeatedly rediscovered. We report an ongoing production deployment of a shared organizational memory system that makes capture a platform-level part of coding work: it collects task-adjacent experience with contributor approval, curates it into reusable question-answer memories, gates obvious security and privacy risks, and retrieves memories for future agents. This short paper describes the deployed lifecycle and an operational snapshot. Effects on retrieval and coding tasks remain under evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了 SAP SE 内部正在生产环境中部署的一套面向企业编码代理的"共享组织记忆"系统。该系统通过三阶段架构（采集、策展、消费）将任务相关的私有开发经验自动捕获并转化为可检索、可治理的问答式记忆单元，弥补了现有知识接口将捕获与编码工作流割裂的不足。
AI.motivation: 企业编码代理面临的关键挑战是大量知识（内部 DSL、专有平台、本地约定、最新修复、隐性工作流）不在公共训练数据或正式文档中。现有知识接口（如 MCP、Skills、Context7、CQ）虽能暴露资源，但依赖于代理主动识别并显式记录有复用价值的经验，使捕获与编码工作流脱节，导致开发经验被反复重新发现。需要一种将捕获变为编码工作流平台级一部分的机制。
AI.method: 采用三阶段生命周期架构：1) **Contributor Client**：通过 Claude Code 的 PostToolUse 和 Stop 钩子事件检测本地知识库 Markdown 文件的变更，使用 Diff Match Patch 生成差异并附加上下文（上下五行、标题层级），仅在用户批准后通过 API 发送候选（"fly-on-the-wall" 设计哲学）。2) **Curation Pipeline**：包含 Enrichment Agent（将 hunks 转化为自含式 Q-A 记忆）、Bucketing Agent（打标签）、Security Scan Agent（六类检查：依赖、密钥、代码、PII/内部、命令、grounding）、Collision Checker Agent（去重与链接）、Trust Score Initialization（0-10 启发式评分，含贝叶斯反馈项）。3) **Consumer Client**：通过 MCP 提供 Fast/Normal/Deep Research 三级检索（混合 BM25+向量+reranker），问答双向量分别嵌入，支持图遍历。记忆格式为结构化 Q-A 单元（含问题、答案、工作示例、注意事项、标签、信任分数、链接）。
AI.result: 2026 年 7 月 22 日部署快照：处理 900 条贡献学习，483 条（53.7%）产出至少 1 条持久化记忆，417 条（46.3%）无产出，共生成 1,144 条策展记忆（每产出学习 2.37 条）；其中 1,100 条（96.2%）含至少一条语义链接，共 7,863 条链接覆盖 35 种工具/框架。安全门离线功能健全性检查（56 个合成案例 × 3 次运行 = 168 次执行）：135 次（80.4%）行为适当，32 次（19.0%）谨慎但非阻塞，1 次（0.6%）过度谨慎，0 次不安全接受。检索相关性、下游效用、记忆新鲜度、信任分数校准仍在评估中。
AI.conclusion: 现有共享记忆系统使代理学习可复用，但贡献依赖于代理主动识别并显式记录有用经验，将知识捕获与编码工作流脱节。本文通过三阶段组织记忆底层弥补了这一差距：Contributor Client 在用户批准下发起任务相关捕获，Curation Pipeline 将接受贡献转化为受治理、信任感知的 Q-A 记忆，Consumer Client 通过 MCP 在未来代理需要时检索。共同将私有开发经验转变为可管理、可复用的知识库；对检索相关性、下游编码任务效用、记忆新鲜度及启发式信任分数校准的评估仍在进行中。论文还讨论了局限性（配置依赖、反馈依赖、策展与原任务脱节、安全检查合成案例的循环性、记忆注入风险无法完全消除）及伦理考量（数据敏感性、记忆投毒防护、贡献者隐私与同意）。

title: AgentStream: How Well Do Self-Evolving LLM Agents Perform Under Streaming Tasks?
comment: Code is available at this https URL
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve by continually improving from their own accumulated experience. However, existing studies predominantly adopt independent evaluation. Consequently, the behavior of self-evolving agents in realistic streaming settings, where agents adapt to diverse and complex task streams, remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce AgentStream, a unified framework that evaluates self-evolving agents spanning diverse evolution components by organizing agentic benchmarks into a configurable task stream and instantiating the \texttt{Isolated}, \texttt{Sequential}, and \texttt{Interleaved} streaming scenarios at test time, which progressively vary the scope and domain composition of the stream. Over these scenarios, we combinatorially evaluate five representative self-evolving methods across three frontier foundation models, disentangling how model capability, method architecture, and streaming scenario jointly shape self-evolution. Our results show that self-evolution reliability varies across streaming scenarios, the benefit of self-evolution is gated by model capability and non-monotonic in model strength, and no single method dominates across models and scenarios. These findings offer concrete guidance for selecting self-evolving methods across models and streaming scenarios. Overall, we advocate that self-evolving agents should be evaluated under realistic task streams rather than isolated single-task settings.

AI.tldr: AgentStream 是一个统一的流式评估框架,用于系统评估自演化 LLM 智能体在真实流式任务场景下的表现,揭示了自演化的可靠性因流式场景、模型能力和方法架构而异。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化智能体研究普遍采用独立(单任务隔离)评估范式,无法反映真实部署中任务跨域、流式到达且无明确边界的场景,导致自演化方法在真实流式设置中的有效性未知。需要一种能够联合考虑基础模型、自演化方法和任务流结构的系统评估框架。
AI.method: 提出 AgentStream 框架,将多个智能体基准(AppWorld、BFCL、BrowseComp-Plus、HLE、SWE-bench-Verified、Tau2)组织为可配置的任务流,并在测试时实例化三种渐进式流式场景:Isolated(每个基准独立演化)、Sequential(按固定顺序跨基准传递演化状态)和 Interleaved(多基准任务随机混洗共享演化状态)。在三种前沿基础模型(GPT-5.4-medium、Gemini 3.1 Pro-medium、Claude Opus 4.7-high)上组合评估五种代表性自演化方法(ACE、A-Mem、ReasoningBank、AutoSkill、Harness),分解模型能力、方法架构与流式结构对自演化的联合影响。
AI.result: 三项核心发现:(1) 自演化并非普遍有益,其可靠性随流式场景变化——Isolated 最可靠(正向率 75.7%,平均增益 +1.37%),而 Interleaved 意外优于 Sequential;(2) 自演化收益受模型能力门控——最弱模型(GPT-5.4)在所有场景下均为负增益,而中能力模型(Gemini 3.1 Pro)增益最大(+2.37%)且超过最强模型(Claude Opus 4.7 的 +1.23%),呈非单调关系;(3) 无单一方法在所有模型和场景中占优——上下文集成方法(ACE、Harness)偏好 Isolated,而基于检索的方法(ReasoningBank、AutoSkill、A-Mem)偏好 Interleaved;最优方法随模型而异。
AI.conclusion: AgentStream 是首个将智能体基准统一为可配置流式评估并沿流式场景、方法和模型维度系统评估自演化的框架。研究呼吁未来应在真实任务流而非孤立单任务设置下评估自演化智能体,并给出实践指导:仅对足够能力的模型应用自演化,在域内流中使用上下文集成方法,在跨域流中使用基于检索的方法,并按模型选择方法而非假设通用最优解。

title: TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding
summary: Wearable sensors capture fine-grained motion patterns that support rich behavioral understanding, yet most existing methods reduce these signals to activity labels. Recent LM-based approaches generate natural-language explanations for sensor data, but their reasoning is weakly grounded in the underlying signal, leading to fluent yet unverifiable explanations. We introduce TRACE-TS (Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence), a framework for structured and signal-grounded reasoning over wearable time series. TRACE-TS uses attribution from an expert classifier to identify salient spatio-temporal sensor regions, uses them to construct DAG reasoning traces with explicit evidence provenance, and trains a compact language model to generate these traces through gated cross-attention over sensor memory tokens. At inference, the adapted model jointly outputs the activity prediction and its reasoning trace, without requiring attribution computation or teacher guidance. We introduce Semantic Node Match(SNM), an LLM-as-judge metric that diagnoses reasoning fidelity at the observation, inference, and synthesis levels, localizing hallucinated observations and broken evidence chains missed by standard NLG metrics. Across seven wearable benchmarks, TRACE-TS achieves the best average accuracy and F1 among all evaluated methods (84.43%/81.24%), and outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 17.96% in F1. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TRACE-TS提出了一种基于可穿戴传感器时间序列的可追溯推理框架，通过归因机制定位关键时空区域，构建DAG推理轨迹，并利用门控跨注意力机制训练紧凑语言模型，实现信号感知的活动预测与推理同步输出。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语言模型的可穿戴传感器分析方法主要依赖高层语义描述生成自然语言解释，但推理过程与底层传感器信号弱相关，导致生成的解释"流利但不可验证"，存在幻觉问题，难以支撑高风险行为理解场景。
AI.method: 1. 利用专家分类器的归因方法定位时空显著的传感器区域；2. 基于显著区域构建带显式证据溯源（explicit evidence provenance）的DAG推理轨迹；3. 通过传感器记忆令牌和门控跨注意力训练紧凑语言模型；4. 推理时无需归因计算或教师指导即可联合输出活动预测与推理轨迹；5. 提出SNM（Semantic Node Match）LLM-as-judge评估指标，从观察、推理、综合三个层面诊断推理保真度。
AI.result: 在7个可穿戴传感器基准测试上，TRACE-TS平均准确率达84.43%、F1达81.24%，均优于所有对比方法；F1指标相对最佳LLM基线提升17.96%。SNM指标可有效识别标准NLG指标难以发现的幻觉观察和断裂证据链。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-TS通过将推理严格锚定在传感器信号证据上，实现了可追溯、可验证的结构化时间序列推理，为可穿戴行为理解提供了兼具高性能与可解释性的解决方案，并开源了诊断细粒度推理错误的SNM评估工具。

title: Personalizing Large Language Model Agents with Small Policy Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can retrieve memory, call tools, ask clarifying questions, and vary response style, yet adapting these execution decisions to an individual user remains difficult. Fine-tuning a separate LLM is costly or impossible for proprietary systems, while prompts and memory primarily expose user information to the agent rather than adapt its execution decisions from feedback. We formulate personalization of a frozen agent as online learning of a per-user execution policy from scalar feedback observed only for the executed action. We propose FABLE (Factorized Adaptive Bandit Layer for Execution), a lightweight policy layer outside a potentially black-box host agent. FABLE factorizes memory, information-acquisition, and response decisions so feedback updates related choices; filters actions through an externally specified feasible set before exploration; and learns user-specific residual preferences relative to a fixed default-and-cost score via Bayesian contextual Thompson sampling. Under a linear residual-reward model, a calibrated variant inherits an expected-regret bound against the best feasible action. We also characterize preferences unidentifiable under persistent feasibility constraints and provide anytime-valid false-promotion control. Across personalized-reasoning, controlled-feedback, and executable tool-use evaluations, FABLE improves several preference-sensitive behaviors relative to rule-only control while remaining competitive on end-to-end task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FABLE（Factorized Adaptive Bandit Layer for Execution），一种轻量级策略层，部署在冻结的LLM智能体外部，将个性化问题形式化为约束上下文老虎机，通过因子化残差偏好模型与贝叶斯上下文Thompson采样，从仅对执行动作可观测的标量反馈中学习每用户的执行策略，并证明其具有Õ(d^{3/2}√n)的可行Oracle遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的个性化方法存在三大局限：(1)针对每个用户微调LLM成本高昂，且对专有模型不可行；(2)提示词与记忆系统主要向智能体暴露用户信息，但从不根据用户后续反馈修订规则，也无法决定何时调用记忆、工具或询问；(3)现有学习决策层要么学习共享策略而非每用户策略，要么依赖智能体的隐藏状态（黑盒API不可获取），或仅孤立地适应单一机制（如解码、记忆或工具选择），但无法将单一用户反馈信号在多个执行决策间归因。核心困难在于：每次交互仅揭示完整执行选择的一个标量结果，反馈频繁但单次对大部分动作空间信息量不足。
AI.method: FABLE的核心方法包含以下组件：(1)将执行动作分解为记忆模式(m)、信息获取模式(τ)和响应行为(s)三部分的因子化动作空间，并采用块结构特征映射（主效应+上下文×分量交互+分量×分量交互）；(2)残差偏好模型：期望反馈 = 固定默认分b(c,a) + φ(c,a)^T θ* - λ·cost(c,a)，仅学习用户相对参考行为的残差偏好θ*；(3)可修订的Onboarding机制：通过有限精度的伪观测将用户偏好初始化为同一高斯后验状态，使在线反馈能直接修正冷启动偏差；(4)可行性约束过滤：外部系统在探索前提供可行动作集A_t，确保权限、工具可用性等硬约束；(5)校准的Bayesian上下文Thompson采样：仅对残差参数θ进行采样，加权尺度ν_t = √(9d·log(t/δ))；(6)理论分析：在线性残差奖励模型下证明Õ(d^{3/2}√n)的高概率遗憾界；刻画持续可行性约束下偏好方向的可识别性（安全特征张成空间S_safe）；提供任意时刻有效的虚假促进控制（置信序列规则）。附录还提出FABLE-SPCA子因子化变体，通过坐标稀疏PCA目标在冷启动时选择特征子集。
AI.result: 主要实验结果：(1)在tau2-bench四域可执行评测中，FABLE(full)获得最高的个性化奖励(0.640±0.036)和合成冗长度对齐(0.717±0.013)，并与FABLE(frozen)并列最高的任务成功率(0.625±0.043)；相对宿主基线，奖励提升+0.077(95% CI [0.027, 0.127])，对齐提升+0.281([0.210, 0.354])，任务成功提升+0.017([-0.046, 0.079]，含零)；(2)匹配对照分析支持因子化（对齐+0.022）、在线适应（对齐+0.024）和Onboarding（对齐+0.163、奖励+0.071）的作用，但不支持任务成功的统计显著改善；(3)PAHF两个环境上FABLE(full)均优于Rule-Only；(4)Math500上FABLE(full)与FABLE(no onboarding)并列最高准确率0.972，但Baseline(Known Preference)对齐最高；(5)受控双方向DeepSeek工具校准实验表明在线策略从14/20提升至18/20的目标动作选择准确率。
AI.conclusion: FABLE构成围绕冻结宿主的统一受限策略：因子化残差共享稀疏联合反馈、可修订Onboarding初始化同一坐标、后验采样在可行性过滤后进行。定理1界定可行Oracle遗憾界Õ(d^{3/2}√n)，并刻画持续约束下偏好的可识别性。tau2匹配对照在偏好敏感指标上支持这些环节，但既不支持任务成功改善，也不支持跨域一致增益。方法适用于固定语义、稳定反馈和有效约束的设置，未来可探索子因子化变体（FABLE-SPCA）的样本效率优势与潜在稀疏PCA方法的关系。局限：实验仅支持特定基准的对比，不构成对算法各组件因果效应的一般性主张。

title: More Debate, Same Evidence: Structural Limits of Homogeneous Multi-Agent Groundedness
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly organized as multi-agent panels under the assumption that exchanging critiques improves judgment quality. We test this assumption for \emph{groundedness verification}, where a judge must determine whether a claim is supported by the supplied evidence. We evaluate a homogeneous three-agent panel on six public fact-verification and hallucination-detection benchmarks. Relative to a fixed single-agent reference, the panel's system-level accuracy difference ranges from $+8.5$ to $-4.4$ percentage points: two datasets show reliable gains, one shows a reliable loss, and three are statistically inconclusive. Because the reference and panel use different model variants, these differences characterize the complete systems rather than isolate a causal debate effect.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了同质多智能体辩论小组（三个GPT-5.5 Chat角色：怀疑者、倡导者、领域专家）在事实核查任务上的表现，发现在六个公开基准上系统级准确率差异为+8.5至-4.4个百分点，呈任务依赖性；机制分析表明辩论主要起"再校准"作用而非引入新证据，提示词优化仅能带来有限收益，错误高度相关，揭示了同质辩论的结构性局限。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）被广泛用作评判者，多智能体辩论小组（通过交换批判意见来提高判断质量）越来越流行。然而，同质辩论（即所有智能体共享同一模型、同一证据）在基础性核查（groundedness verification，即判断声明是否有证据支持）任务中的有效性尚未得到系统验证。本文旨在检验同质辩论小组是否真正优于单一智能体基准，并探究其工作机制是"证据扩展"还是"阈值再校准"。
AI.method: 构建同质三智能体辩论小组（GPT-5.5 Chat，角色：怀疑者/倡导者/领域专家），进行两轮辩论，采用确定性规则聚合器。在六个公开基准（VitaminC、RAGTruth、WiCE、HaluEval、SciFact、Composed，共1950个样本，类别平衡）上进行评估，参照系统为GPT-5 mini单一智能体。采用聚类自助法（cluster bootstrap）计算置信区间。分析手段包括：(1) 类别召回率分解；(2) 第二轮语义新颖度（基于MiniLM嵌入）；(3) ROSCOE推理质量指标；(4) 置信度校准（AUROC）；(5) 说话顺序消融实验；(6) 选择性路由；(7) GEPA风格反射式提示词优化（含七种候选配置）；(8) 角色错误相关性（phi系数）。
AI.result: 1. 系统级差异呈任务依赖：VitaminC +8.5pp、Composed +2.0pp、RAGTruth +2.0pp（不显著）、HaluEval +0.5pp（不显著）、WiCE -2.0pp（不显著）、SciFact -4.4pp。2. 标签翻转并非均匀正确（RAGTruth 54.3%、Composed 50.2%、WiCE 29.6%）。3. 准确率变化主要由类别召回率方向性偏移驱动（属于再校准）。4. 第二轮新颖度低（中位数0.068）。5. 置信度与正确性相关性弱（AUROC=0.606），且可靠性曲线非单调。6. 怀疑者优先的提示词改写在主实验中提升5.83pp，在复现中提升5.00pp，但经Bonferroni校正后不显著，且模型随机性量级相近。7. 120个保留样本中49个在所有提示词配置下均错误。8. 倡导者与领域专家角色错误高度相关（φ=0.671–0.927），怀疑者在WiCE和SciFact上解耦但因聚合规则（多数票先于怀疑者否决权生效）而难以发挥作用。9. 评估的提示词家族无集成提升空间（oracle等于最佳单一配置seqA）。
AI.conclusion: 同质多智能体辩论并非普遍可靠的核查评判者。其机制主要是基于共享信息的阈值再校准，而非证据扩展。提示词优化可发现一处有前景的怀疑者改写，但留有大量持久错误且候选间缺乏互补性。当智能体共享模型和证据池时，改进依赖于错误是否真正互补以及聚合器能否利用这种互补性。更强的核查评判者可能需要：异质模型且错误可互补、不同智能体使用不同证据窗口或工具、基于校准角色可靠性的聚合规则，以及基于证据充分性的显式弃权策略。研究的主要局限在于单一智能体参照使用了不同的模型变体（GPT-5 mini vs GPT-5.5 Chat），因此报告的差异混合了模型与系统效应，未能纯化辩论的因果效应。

title: Geometric Self-Supervised Pre-training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) techniques have emerged as a highly efficient alternative to traditional exact algorithms for solving routing problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). However, the generalization capabilities of these Reinforcement Learning-based models are severely hindered when scaling to high-dimensional instances. This issue has been mitigated in other domains, like computer vision and natural language processing, by adopting a self-supervised pre-training strategy. Nevertheless, its application to routing graphs, which lack complex topological attributes beyond 2D spatial coordinates, remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose a geometric self-supervised pre-training framework specifically designed to capture spatial invariance and global relative distance distributions. By applying isometric transformations, such as rotations and axial reflections, the model learns robust structural representations prior to the policy optimization phase. Empirical results demonstrate that this strategy consistently outperforms models trained from scratch (baselines), achieving a 7.23\% improvement in tour length for massive zero-shot extrapolation scenarios (TSP1,000). Furthermore, the proposed model exhibits remarkable computational efficiency, delivering speedups of up to two orders of magnitude over the exact solver Concorde at massive scales. The source code and pre-trained models are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对神经组合优化（NCO）的几何自监督预训练框架，通过对TSP实例应用等距变换（旋转、轴反射、平移）进行对比学习预训练，以解决NCO模型在零样本外推到大规模实例时泛化能力差的问题。实验表明，旋转+反射的组合预训练策略在TSP1000上实现了7.23%的路径长度改善，并比精确求解器Concorde快两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 基于深度强化学习的神经组合优化（NCO）模型在求解TSP等NP-hard路由问题时展现出高效性，但存在严重的泛化瓶颈：当训练规模（如50节点）与测试规模（如1000节点）差异较大时，模型性能急剧下降。现有自监督预训练方法（如GraphMAE、DGI、GraphCL）主要针对属性丰富的稀疏图设计（如分子图、社交网络），通过预测缺失属性或丢弃边进行增强，不适用于仅含2D空间坐标、完全连接且无附加属性的TSP实例。因此亟需一种专为几何路由问题设计的预训练框架。
AI.method: 1. **网络架构**：编码器采用GatedGCN（门控图卷积网络），通过k-NN稀疏化处理完全图，使用各向异性消息传递与MAX聚合以保证尺度外推能力；解码器为基于多头注意力（MHA）的自回归解码器，使用单头指针注意力选择下一个节点，并采用Greedy Rollout Baseline的REINFORCE算法进行策略优化。2. **几何自监督预训练**：在[0,1]²坐标空间内对节点施加三种等距变换——中心旋转（绕中心c=[0.5,0.5]的任意角度θ∈U[0,2π)）、轴反射（Householder变换，轴向ϕ∈U[0,π)）、空间平移（位移δ限制在15%范围内）。采用随机混合策略（每种变换以p=0.5独立Bernoulli采样启用）。3. **对比学习目标**：使用InfoNCE损失最大化同一实例不同增强视图的全局图嵌入的一致性，通过两层MLP投影头映射到潜在空间，预训练完成后丢弃MLP头进入RL微调阶段。
AI.result: 1. **消融实验**（表1）：旋转+反射组合为最优策略，在TSP1000上最优性差距为55.1%（基线为67.2%），相对基线提升7.23个百分点；纯平移预训练在大规模下严重恶化（TSP1000为76.2%），因平移使模型错误地将微小位移的坐标视为等价，在高密度图中破坏局部辨别能力。2. **SOTA对比**（表2）：在TSP20/50/100/200/500/1000上的最优性差距分别为3.7%/5.9%/11.6%/21.5%/38.4%/55.1%，推理时间约为0.0003-0.5秒，相比Concorde（最高175.19秒）实现高达两个数量级的加速；LKH-3和Google OR-Tools在质量上更优但推理时间显著更长。3. **尺度变异性分析**（表3）：预训练与训练阶段均引入节点数动态采样（如N~U(20,50)）可作为强结构正则化器，在中等外推尺度下效果最佳；但在极端高密度场景（TSP1000），固定尺度的"过度专业化"反而更具竞争力，揭示了通用尺度灵活性与峰值性能之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过几何自监督预训练框架有效缓解了NCO模型在零样本外推至大规模TSP实例时的结构崩溃问题。精心选择保距等距变换（旋转+反射）的组合能迫使编码器学习尺度不变的空间表征。规模变异性训练作为正则化机制适用于中等规模外推，但在超密集场景中需权衡与结构专业化的关系。所提出的神经求解器保持了准即时推理速度，比精确求解器Concorde快两个数量级，为实时大规模工业路由应用提供了高可扩展性的解决方案。代码与预训练模型已开源。

title: RF-HOI: Recognize Human-Object Interaction with Radio Frequency Signals
summary: Recognizing Human-Object Interactions (HOI) is essential for intelligent systems, underpinning applications in virtual and augmented reality, embodied AI, and assistive robotics. However, vision-based HOI methods face challenges in privacy concerns and poor light conditions. In this work, we introduce RF-HOI, the first framework that only uses radio frequency (RF) signals for HOI recognition. A key challenge of RF-HOI is that single-modality RF sensing is insufficient to recognize both actions and the objects being interacted with. RF-HOI addresses this through a novel modality fusion that combines mmWave radar and RFID, enabling simultaneous action recognition and target identification. Another challenge is limited training data across diverse setups, which impairs the generalizability of the recognition model. To overcome this, we develop a simulator that synthesizes multimodal RF data for diverse HOIs at scale, allowing us to fine-tune with only a small amount of real-world data. Experiment results show that RF-HOI outperforms all baselines, approaching vision model performance, and that our diverse synthetic training data can significantly boost our system's performance on real-world scenarios. These results highlight the potential of multimodal RF sensing for robust and privacy-preserving HOI recognition as well as the effectiveness of our RF data synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RF-HOI，这是首个仅使用射频（RF）信号进行人-物交互（HOI）识别的框架。通过融合mmWave雷达和RFID两种模态，RF-HOI能够在保护隐私的前提下同时识别人体动作和交互目标对象。为解决RF数据采集成本高的问题，作者还开发了一个物理基模拟器，可基于3D网格数据合成大规模多模态RF数据，用于预训练并显著减少真实数据需求。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的HOI识别面临隐私问题和光照条件差的挑战。虽然RF信号在无线感知领域已有应用，但现有单一模态的RF感知方法（仅mmWave或仅RFID）无法同时完成动作识别和目标物体识别两个HOI子任务。此外，RF-HOI的组合特性导致数据采集和标注成本极高，亟需一种能够降低数据收集负担的方法。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 多模态数据预处理——mmWave数据通过Range-FFT、Doppler-FFT和MUSIC算法生成RT/RD/AoA热图，RFID数据提取相位差Δφ并结合spaCy对象名称嵌入；(2) 模态融合网络——使用专用编码器提取各模态的时空特征，采用Transformer处理变长序列，将动作分类和目标识别解耦为两个独立输出分支以提高泛化性和可解释性；(3) 物理基RF模拟器——基于TRUMANS数据集的3D网格数据，使用光线追踪合成mmWave数据，并通过手部位置代理计算对象运动相位差来合成RFID数据，支持对象类别扩展以实现组合泛化。
AI.result: RF-HOI在真实数据上达到96.97%的HOI准确率，仅比视觉基线低1.96%，显著优于所有RF基线（比无融合版本高21.29%，比仅RFID高32.90%，比仅mmWave高73.20%）。合成数据预训练带来平均12.00%的HOI准确率提升（训练数据少时可达30.74%）。在未见过对象类别上将准确率从71.3%提升至93.1%。系统对人手遮挡、身体遮挡和动态多径干扰均具有鲁棒性（>90%准确率），在RTX 4050笔记本上端到端延迟仅1.79秒，支持实时部署。在30个HOI-目标对的LLM目标推断任务中，RF-HOI输入比仅动作输入高68.18%、比仅对象输入高22.72%。
AI.conclusion: RF-HOI证明了多模态RF感知（mmWave+RFID融合）在保护隐私的HOI识别中的巨大潜力，其性能可接近视觉模型。物理基模拟器生成的合成数据能显著减少对真实数据的需求并支持未见对象类别的组合泛化。该工作为RF-based HOI识别设立了首个基线，将促进未来更大规模的社区基准构建，并可应用于VR/AR、辅助机器人、目标推断等下游任务。

title: WM-Cov: Test Adequacy for Interactive World-Model-Style Autonomous Driving Simulation
summary: World models and generative simulators are emerging as interactive testing infrastructure for autonomous driving because they can react to the ego planner and produce counterfactual, rare, and safety-critical rollouts. This changes a test scenario from a fixed replayed trajectory into an interactive scenario family whose realized evolution depends on the planner under test. The unresolved question is therefore not only whether dangerous rollouts can be generated, but what valid closed-loop evidence is enough to support a specified testing intent and stopping decision. This paper formulates interactive world-model-style testing adequacy and introduces WM-Cov, a provider-agnostic evaluation layer that converts raw provider outputs into requested, realized, and valid evidence. WM-Cov reports adequacy through coverage growth, valid-failure discovery, failure-mode diversity, realism, artifact suppression, duplicate accounting, and valid-evidence precision. Studies on executed TeraSim/SUMO events, WM-like mixed trace pools, and a real DriveArena TrafficManager--WorldDreamer matrix show that dangerous-looking events can include valid ADS failures, duplicates, partial realizations, and artifacts. The DriveArena matrix evaluates two planners, two horizons, six prompt conditions, and 360 ego-route requests; 304 attempts become fully realized evidence and 56 remain partial. A disjoint 80-request route-slice check yields 74 fully realized and 6 partial attempts. The results support evaluating world-model-style testing by convergence of valid interactive evidence under budget, rather than by raw generated failures or prompt coverage alone.

AI.tldr: WM-Cov是一个面向交互式世界模型自动驾驶仿真的、提供商无关的测试充分性评估层。它通过追溯适配器将原始生成器输出转化为"请求—实现—有效"三类证据，借助有效性审计剔除重复、伪迹和条件失败，并在固定预算下基于有效覆盖率增长、新增失效模式发现和不确定性收敛给出可停止的充分性报告。
AI.motivation: 世界模型与生成式仿真将自动驾驶测试从固定场景回放转变为由自车规划器影响的交互式场景族：相同提示在不同规划器下可能产生完全不同的演化轨迹。传统基于场景库的覆盖率与充分性准则难以直接适用，因为生成器输出中混杂着有效ADS失效、重复、伪迹和部分实现。仅凭"能否生成危险回放"已不足以回答测试充分性问题，亟需一个将请求条件、实现交互与证据有效性解耦的审计层。
AI.method: 1. 将测试意图q建模为交互式场景族F(q)={m, ρ, x₀, e, π_bg, p, Z}，并在固定规划器π_e下生成闭环轨迹τ_i；2. 定义三级覆盖率C_{req→real}、C_{real→valid}、C_{valid}，并建立特征向量φ(τ)=(o, u, r, b, f, v)；3. 设计提供商无关的追溯适配器模式（trace_id、family_id、requested_condition、realized_interaction、outcome、scores、audit_note等）；4. 构建有效性账本，区分有效ADS失效、有效安全关键、有效安全、重复失效、条件失败、伪迹/无效六类；5. 给出预算化选择评分函数s(τ|T)=β_r R + β_q Q + β_c ΔC_valid − β_m M − β_a A；6. 基于窗口化规则（ΔC_valid、ΔF_valid、width(p̂_fail)）定义停止导向的充分性准则，并输出包含C_valid、VF、FM、AI、R̄、Q̄、Π_v的充分性报告。
AI.result: 在执行过的TeraSim/SUMO事件池（1219条，含230个有效ADS失效、299个安全关键、690个伪迹）中，WM-Cov在B=100下选出99个有效失效、零伪迹，有效证据精度1.00，而覆盖优先法仅17有效+58伪迹（精度0.23）。在WM-like混合池中，WM-Cov选出76个有效失效、覆盖全部6个失效模式、零伪迹；16组权重敏感性分析下保持稳定；在伪迹比例0.10→0.55的污染压力测试中始终保持零伪迹选择。DriveArena TrafficManager–WorldDreamer–UniAD/VAD矩阵（360次请求）中304次完全实现、56次部分实现，0次完全未实现；实现率随规划器、时域和提示条件而异（VAD 5.0s全部实现，UniAD 7.5s默认阴天完全未实现）；独立80条路径切片检查得到74次完全实现，结果稳健。141行作者盲样审计的伪迹精确率与召回率均为1.00。
AI.conclusion: WM-Cov将世界模型/生成式仿真器从"测试预言机"重新定位为"交互式测试基础设施"，主张以"在预算下有效交互证据的收敛"而非"生成危险回放数量"来判定测试充分性。证据按三级支撑：TeraSim/SUMO与WM-like压力池验证账目逻辑，作者验证审计支撑有效性标签，360次DriveArena闭环矩阵加80次路径切片验证真实提供商链的可审计性。当前结果尚不足以确立跨地图、跨规划器的通用充分性门槛或安全充分性主张，但明确了在做出此类声明前必须测量的对象：请求-实现覆盖、有效性、重复控制、部分实现核算与停止导向的证据报告。

title: CrystalMem: Elastic Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Knowledge Crystallization
summary: Memory for self-evolving large language model (LLM) agents is often provisioned as if its byte budget only grows. Cloud platforms, however, adjust quotas with load and cost, and we show that capability does not follow the budget back up: after a squeeze-and-recover cycle, the agent settles below its pre-squeeze level, a gap we call memory hysteresis. The cause is structural. Deletion and one-way compression discard the material needed for later rebuilding, and we prove that any policy that only keeps or drops entries carries a residual-deficit floor. We propose CrystalMem (Crystallized Memory), an elastic memory sidecar that demotes entries across four fidelity states under a crystallization-energy schedule, orders demotions by advantage-weighted influence with dependency coupling, and recovers capability through verified recrystallization under explicit compute and byte caps. Across seven environments, seventeen methods, and six backbones, with multi-tenant serving and a physical edge-cloud deployment, CrystalMem achieves the highest restored capability in every setting and closes the loop left open by every baseline. From a 50% byte budget, CrystalMem matches the strongest budgeted baseline at full provision on every environment; at equal budgets, it leads by +4.6 pp on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CrystalMem，一种弹性记忆外挂系统，用于解决自演化 LLM 智能体在云端弹性内存预算下的"记忆滞后"问题。通过四态保真度阶梯、基于结晶能量的调度、优势加权影响估计与依赖耦合、以及验证再结晶机制，实现在预算压缩-恢复循环后能力几乎完全恢复，残差缺失仅为 0.5 pp。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化 LLM 智能体的外部记忆通常按"字节预算只增不减"的方式配置，但云平台会根据负载和成本动态调整配额。作者发现，智能体在经历一次"压缩-恢复"周期后，即使配额完全恢复，其能力仍会停留在压缩前水平以下——这一现象被称为"记忆滞后"（memory hysteresis）。其根源在于删除和单向压缩丢弃了重建所需的信息，且作者证明了任何仅保留或丢弃条目的策略都存在残留缺失下界。
AI.method: CrystalMem 包含三大机制：(1) 知识结晶——将每条记忆分配到四个保真度状态（full→compressed→skeletal→trace），通过结晶能量调度（η_e(k) = ṽ_e(1-r_k) + τc_k）在预算变化时进行水填充式降级；(2) 影响驱动赋值——使用优势加权影响估计（基于检索权重和查询结果的归因）配合依赖图耦合来排序降级；(3) 验证再结晶——预算恢复时从残留物重建条目，并通过不变量验证门（键跨度、实体元组、结果事实）控制幻觉，在显式计算和字节上限内进行推广。三个阶段（Monitor/Crystallize/Recrystallize）在每个阶段内 O(|M|log|M|) 内完成一次排序扫描。
AI.result: 在 7 个环境、17 种方法、6 个骨干网络上的实验中，CrystalMem 在所有环境下均取得最高的恢复能力（平均 57.4 vs 最强基线 R³Mem 52.8），平均领先 +4.6 pp；滞回面积降至 0.013（基线范围 0.044–0.216），残差缺失降至 0.5 pp；在 50% 字节预算下匹配最强基线满配表现。在多租户场景（N=8）下违反 SLO 仅 6%（CURATOR-fair 为 47%）。在物理边缘-云部署（Jetson Orin/Thor）中，恢复 1 点能力耗能仅为重经历的 0.21 倍，同步流量降低 4.8–5.0 倍。消融实验表明验证门节省 2.8 pp，调度方式节省 1.8–3.0 pp，保真度阶梯超过 4 态后边际收益消失。
AI.conclusion: CrystalMem 通过将记忆管理从二元保留策略转变为可逆状态赋值，成功闭合了弹性预算下的能力环路。理论保证包括可行性不变量（Proposition 4）、水填充调度的近似最优性（Proposition 5）及环路闭合（Proposition 6）。该系统证明了可逆性是首要杠杆、阶梯深度是次要杠杆，对云端和边缘部署的自演化智能体具有实用价值。

title: Trust and Its Betrayal under Three Representational Strategies
summary: Trust is a propositional attitude of a distinctive kind: to trust is to rely on another under conditions where reliance could be disappointed, and the disappointment of trust---betrayal---differs qualitatively from the disappointment of a prediction. We treat trust as a \emph{subjunctive} epistemic state: $A$ trusts $B$'s competence when $A$ believes that \emph{were $P$ true, $B$ would know it}, and $B$'s integrity when $A$ believes that \emph{were $B$ to know $P$, he would disclose it to $A$}. We develop three representations of this state---as lexicographic \emph{assumption} as \emph{ordinal closeness} in a Lewis--Stalnaker sphere system , and as \emph{strong belief} in a conditional probability system and for each we ask whether the Brandenburger--Keisler impossibility on common belief survives when the assumption of rationality is replaced by an assumption of trustworthiness. The three representations agree that every \emph{finite} depth of common trust is realizable while the \emph{completed} common-trust fixed point is the locus of difficulty, but they differ sharply in \emph{how} the difficulty manifests, and---our organizing finding---in how each survives a concrete betrayal. W show that the same betrayal refutes an agent's \emph{level ordering} under the lexicographic representation, contaminates her \emph{closeness ordering} in proportion to the betrayer's deliberateness under the ordinal representation, and merely \emph{shifts her operative conditioning hypothesis} while leaving her belief structure coherent under the strong-belief representation.

AI.tldr: 论文将"信任"形式化为反事实认知态度，并发展了三种精确表征——词典序概率系统的假设、Lewis–Stalnaker球系统的序数邻近性、条件概率系统的强信念——证明三者一致认可共同信任的有限深度可实现，但在共同信任的完成（Brandenburger–Keisler不可能性是否存续）以及具体背叛的承袭方式上分道扬镳：策略I推翻水平排序并触发"重新分箱"灾变，策略II按背叛者的蓄意程度按比例污染邻近性排序（可能得到"阈限性"结局），策略III仅平移操作性条件假设，信念结构保持一致。
AI.motivation: 信任在经济与社会生活中至关重要却形式化不足；既有哲学（Baier、Holton、Jones）与组织学（Mayer-Davis-Schoorman）论述虽然一致认为"背叛的可能性标志着信任之存在"，却对信任的形式持有分歧，且不同形式对"什么算作背叛"给出不同答案。论文借此切入：将信任的反事实态度形式化，考察其与Brandenburger–Keisler关于共同信念的不可能性定理相遇时的命运，并将其纳入作者提出的认知网络（epinet）研究纲领——在统一形式主义中同时容纳信任的节点层"反思架构"与边层"不动点结构"。
AI.method: （1）将信任分解为能力反事实$P\boxrightarrow K_BP$与诚信反事实$K_BP\boxrightarrow\mathrm{Tell}_{B,A}P$两条反事实链；（2）分别用三类数学对象承载同一反事实态度：①有限水平的LPS（Blume et al. 1991；Brandenburger et al. 2008），②Lewis–Stalnaker嵌套球系统（Lewis 1973；Stalnaker 1968），③带固定条件族的CPS及其强信念算子（Battigalli & Siniscalchi 2002）；（3）设定三个层次递增的背叛案例（被路由的信心、能干者的沉默、诚实无能者），并构造一个六状态工作模型同时承载三种更新；（4）运用假设算子定义、coalgebraic模态逻辑的自然性（Proposition 2）、终序列收敛理论（Worrell 2005）与Lambek不动点引理证明functorial完成不可能（Theorem 2）；（5）对CPS部分建立"反复信任"的序贯理性表征（Theorem 3），并通过柱集引理（Proposition 7）证明在典范框架下Brandenburger–Keisler对角线不可关闭（Theorem 4、Corollary 2）；（6）在附录A中证明两侧交替构造的有限深度相干性，并将其完成相干性归结为同一义务的三种面孔（Theorem 5）。
AI.result: 策略I（词典序假设）：水平-深度刻画定理（Theorem 1）表明LPS假设Tw^(k) for all k≤d当且仅当至少n_d水平，谨慎LPS必为二值（Proposition 1）；其完成由Brandenburger–Keisler直接继承；背叛引致"重新分箱"——认知属性相同的背叛世界b揭示分箱规则本身被推翻，水平计数可上升至2n_d+1。策略II（序数邻近性）：引入第三种状态"阈限的"——共同信任在每一有限深度非空但极限为空（Definition 1）；Theorem 2证明谨慎的profligate巢函子无终余积，故在任何序数阶段皆不可完成；非谨慎情形在ω+ω步收敛；背叛按属性重叠度等比污染，蓄意背叛可能使再信任落为阈限。策略III（强信念）：Theorem 3将反复信任刻画为序贯理性+公开合规，附以封装残差τ≤qv（Corollary 1，硬币-利益账户的精确化）；Theorem 4与Proposition 7证明条件完备性下B-K对角线失效；Corollary 2断言典范框架下共同强信念信任无附加条件地逃逸B-K——背叛仅将操作性条件假设从H_2∪H_3切换至H_2，信念对象保持一致。附录Theorem 5将两侧完成相干性归结为单一义务。
AI.conclusion: 三种表征沿同一坐标轴分野——反事实条件的承载方式（有限水平排序 / 原始邻近性排序 / 给定条件族），而正是使每种态度成为个体信任忠实模型的结构特征，同样决定了共同信任完成的命运与背叛的承袭方式：水平排序的有限性→二值且可能重建，邻近排序的非良基性→可能阈限，强信念条件族的给定性→优雅平移。若Baier正确——背叛而非失望是信任的标识——则信任以三种方式被辨识，因其可被三种方式所破；若Holton正确——信任是姿态而非信念——则其形式对应物（区分假设与信念的"穷尽条款"、构成待机姿态的潜存条件式）恰为定理的承重构件。表征的选择不仅是技术的，更关乎背叛之为"推翻"、"污染"抑或"更新"，并决定信任破碎后须重建、仅可趋近、或可优雅重构于残存基础之上。此项工作亦为epinet纲领之贡献：在统一形式主义中安放信任的双重面相——节点的反思架构与边的不动点结构。

title: Learning to Coordinate Symbolic Tools: LLM Agents for Verified Sum-of-Squares Certificates
summary: Tool calling allows large language models (LLMs) to invoke external computation during problem solving, a useful capability in various fields including AI for mathematics. We study this setting through weighted sum-of-squares (SOS) decomposition, a machine-checkable route to proving polynomial nonnegativity and hence polynomial inequalities. A candidate decomposition can be checked exactly, but finding one requires choosing among non-unique regroupings and coordinating multiple symbolic transformations. We develop an agent that combines algebraic task training, symbolic tools, and verifier-grounded optimization for this task. Rather than training only on the composite SOS task, we construct 1.35 million synthetic examples covering eight supporting polynomial tasks together with weighted-SOS decomposition. We first apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to direct algebra problems and simulated symbolic traces, and then use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-specific symbolic rewards. The SFT corpus contains no native tool-calling messages; at evaluation, the agent uses native SymPy calls for expansion, collection, reordering, and factorization. Every final SOS answer is checked by exact expansion and coefficient comparison. On held-out, same-generator synthetic problems, the full SFT+GRPO+tools system is the strongest of four evaluated configurations, reaching 78.96% verified success on weighted SOS, compared with 44.73% for the base model with the same tools, and 91.75% macro accuracy across nine polynomial tasks. Within this controlled setting, our work provides a case study of combining domain-specific skill training, executable tools, and verifier feedback, and may inform the design of tool-calling agents in other domains with exactly checkable outputs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于LLM的智能体方法，结合代数任务训练、符号工具调用和验证器反馈，用于自动发现多项式的加权平方和（SOS）分解证书。通过在Phi-4-reasoning-plus上进行监督微调（SFT）和基于验证器的GRPO强化学习，并在评估时使用原生SymPy工具调用，在合成测试集上达到78.96%的加权SOS验证成功率（基线仅44.73%），九项多项式任务宏平均准确率达91.75%。
AI.motivation: 工具调用使LLM能执行精确的局部符号运算，但如何协调这些操作进行全局搜索仍是难题。加权SOS分解作为多项式非负性的机器可验证证明，其候选分解可精确检查，但寻找分解需要非唯一地选择分组并协调多种符号变换。该研究将加权SOS作为受控测试平台，探究"以代数为基础的后训练能否使LLM在多步符号搜索中协调精确的符号操作，而非仅执行孤立的代数变换"。
AI.method: 1) 构建135万条合成数据（9个任务×15万条），涵盖8个支持性多项式任务（字典序、收集、展开、Horner形式、对称化简、商/余式、扩展GCD、因式分解）和加权SOS复合任务；2) 对Phi-4-reasoning-plus进行QLoRA SFT（秩32，4比特权重），使用直接代数问题与模拟符号轨迹（不包含原生工具调用消息），仅对assistant token计算损失；3) 使用任务特定符号奖励进行GRPO优化（奖励=0.1×格式+0.9×精确任务得分，对SOS使用结构门控的系数残差）；4) 评估时Base+Tools和Full使用4个原生SymPy函数（expand_polynomial, collect_terms, reorder_polynomial, factorize_polynomial），受限至10次调用、3次分解尝试、5秒/调用、60秒/回合；5) 最终证书通过结构验证（正有理权重、多项式平方）+精确系数比较进行验证。
AI.result: 在10,000个同分布测试实例上：1) 八个支持性任务宏平均：Base=42.01%，SFT=78.08%，Full=93.35%；2) 加权SOS验证成功率：Base=7.63%，SFT=51.82%，Base+Tools=44.73%，Full=78.96%（Full比Base+Tools高出34.23个百分点）；3) 九任务系统宏平均：Full达91.75%；4) 任务族分析显示Full相对SFT在局部操作、广义结构代数、加权SOS上分别提升12.46/18.08/27.14个百分点；5) 通用数学能力保留：Full在AIME-90上avg@16为38.89%，GSM-8K为96.29%，无明显退化；6) 成功SOS回合平均仅使用3.8次工具调用；7) 终端失败分为三类：过早终止/弃权、结构性失败、恒等式失败。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明：1) 精确工具执行不能消除协调错误（Base+Tools仅44.73%证明工具≠正确策略）；2) 代数基础训练与工具访问可互补（Full显著超越Base+Tools），即训练工具背后的操作与表示可能比仅学习其接口更有价值；3) 发现、交互和验证需被区分，报告成功率是证书搜索产出而非SOS识别；4) 实验受限于同分布合成问题、单一骨干网络、每阶段单次训练运行，无法因果隔离SFT、GRPO、工具或各支持任务的单独贡献；5) 未来工作包括自然不等式基准、更大多项式、非SOS分类、约束证书、多随机种子和跨骨干迁移。

title: RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, and 6 tables. Includes appendices
summary: Compact web agents can reduce deployment cost, but training them poses challenges in both data collection and post-SFT reinforcement learning (RL). Successful trajectories are expensive to collect and often contain inefficient detours. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), full trajectory corpora are dominated by routine states; moreover, when group-relative RL is applied to web actions, inadequately designed action-level rewards can yield weak or misleading relative updates, while groups rejected as unsuitable for such updates receive no fallback learning signal. We present RMSWeb, a three-part recipe for Qwen3-VL-Instruct at 8B and 32B. Reflection-conditioned retries increase collection yield and shorten successful trajectories; failure-mode mining concentrates offline RL on critical states exposed by the SFT policy; and Salvage-DS combines an action-semantic polarized reward, contrast-and-competence-gated dynamic sampling, and an action-only anchor for rejected groups. Policies trained with reflection-collected data use up to 19.7% fewer action steps on solved tasks. On WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and WebTailBench, RMSWeb improves over SFT by 2.4-7.0 points at 8B and 1.2-7.7 points at 32B. Our 8B model also achieves the strongest reported Online-Mind2Web result among similarly sized open-weight models in our comparison and a leading reported accuracy-cost trade-off on WebVoyager and WebTailBench, with the caveat that external evaluation protocols differ.

AI.tldr: RMSWeb提出了一种三阶段训练方法（反射式数据收集、失败模式挖掘、Salvage-DS离线强化学习），用于训练紧凑型视觉-语言网页智能体，在Qwen3-VL-Instruct 8B和32B模型上显著优于纯SFT基线，并在三个实时网页基准上取得了领先的精度-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 训练紧凑型网页智能体面临两大挑战：（1）数据收集方面，成功轨迹昂贵且常含冗余绕路；（2）后SFT强化学习方面，全轨迹语料以常规状态为主，而面向网页动作的群体相对RL存在奖励对比失真、无可信正样本、被拒群体无回退信号三类病态。作者旨在通过更高效的轨迹收集与针对失败关键状态的离线RL来同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 方法由三部分组成：(1) 反射式多轮轨迹收集——教师模型GPT-5.1失败后由反思处理器生成指导ρ_N注入下一轮状态，提高成功率并缩短轨迹长度；(2) 失败模式挖掘——对比同一任务的成功轨迹与失败/低效轨迹，在状态对齐、动作分歧且失败模式证据支持的条件下定位最后的"关键分叉点"，仅保留成功侧决策作为4.5k条RL数据；(3) Salvage-DS离线RL——结合动作语义极化奖励（按动作类型给出1.0/0.7/0.3/0.0四级评分）、对比度与能力门控动态采样（要求组内std≥ε_σ且至少一个competent rollout）以及动作级salvage锚（对被拒群体施加仅作用于动作token的ground-truth NLL），三者联合优化以PPO-clip为代理损失。
AI.result: 在WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web、WebTailBench三个实时网页基准上：8B模型相比SFT分别提升3.7/7.0/2.4分，32B模型提升1.2/2.0/7.7分；8B模型在Online-Mind2Web上以66.44%的成绩在同类开源权重模型中取得最强结果，在WebVoyager和WebTailBench上达到领先的精度-成本权衡；反射式收集使训练策略在已解决任务上动作步数减少最多19.7%；消融实验表明全语料RL、anchor-free RL和DAPO基线均劣于完整配方。
AI.conclusion: RMSWeb验证了"选择失败关键状态"与"在群体相对更新不适用的被拒群体上保留监督信号"在SFT后离线RL中的互补价值；失败模式挖掘提供精准课程，Salvage-DS通过极化奖励、能力感知动态采样和动作级锚定修复了群体相对RL的三类病态；未来工作将转向真实浏览器中的在线结果型RL以突破离线代理奖励的天花板。

title: Bayesian and Motivated Reasoning in AI Agents
summary: AI agents increasingly perform open-ended tasks in settings where their conclusions can guide consequential decisions. We provide evidence that AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical data when the substantive framing changes. We demonstrate this behavior in high-stakes domains in medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting by holding the evidence fixed while changing the scenario in which the evidence appears. Across twelve agent-domain comparisons, agents' conclusions are strongly influenced by their prior beliefs. They are more likely to reach an affirmative conclusion when it is framed around a proposition they already regard as likely, while the reverse holds when the framing conflicts with their prior. The framing also changes how some agents work: they search more extensively, choose different analytical specifications, and evaluate the same evidence differently. These results identify a particular risk of delegating decision-making to AI agents, as their decisions may depend on prior beliefs that are neither specified in the task nor visible in the decision record.

AI.tldr: AI agents produce systematically different conclusions from identical numerical evidence depending on how a task is framed, driven by their prior beliefs—a risk for delegating consequential decisions to them.
AI.motivation: As AI agents are increasingly deployed for open-ended, high-stakes decision support (e.g., medicine, elections, geopolitics), there is a need to rigorously test whether their conclusions are driven by evidence or by implicit priors introduced via framing. The paper is motivated by the concern that, if agents' outputs depend on hidden prior beliefs, delegating consequential decisions to them becomes risky and unaccountable.
AI.method: The authors conduct controlled experiments in which the underlying numerical evidence is held fixed while the substantive framing (scenario context) is varied. The study covers three high-stakes domains—medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting—and aggregates twelve agent-domain comparisons. They compare agents' conclusions and intermediate behaviors (search effort, choice of analytical specifications, and evaluation of evidence) across framings that are either congruent or incongruent with the agents' prior beliefs.
AI.result: Across all twelve comparisons, agents' conclusions are strongly shaped by framing: they are more likely to reach an affirmative conclusion when the framing aligns with their prior beliefs, and less likely to do so when it conflicts. Beyond final answers, framing also alters agents' working processes—they search more extensively, select different analytical specifications, and weigh the same evidence differently depending on the scenario.
AI.conclusion: The findings identify a specific and underappreciated risk of AI-agent-driven decision-making: agents' decisions can depend on prior beliefs that are neither specified in the task nor visible in the decision record. This undermines the reliability and auditability of agent outputs in consequential settings, calling for greater scrutiny of how framing and priors interact in deployed AI agents.

title: Gene Ontology-Guided Hierarchical Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathology Images
comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. Code: this https URL
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from histopathology images enables large-scale transcriptomic profiling without the cost of direct measurement. Existing methods decode the target gene set as a flat, unstructured vector, ignoring the inter-gene dependencies arising from shared biological pathways and regulatory programs. Without explicit structural guidance, models must infer these dependencies entirely from limited paired data, constraining prediction quality. We propose MSGR (Multi-Scale Gene Refiner), which bridges this gap by incorporating the Gene Ontology (GO), a curated functional hierarchy of genes, as an explicit structural prior. MSGR organizes target genes into a four-level GO tree. Its GO-guided decoder then progressively refines predictions from coarse functional domains to fine individual genes via residual corrections under scale-weighted supervision. Operating solely on the gene side, the GO-guided decoder serves as a seamless plug-in replacement that consistently improves existing architectures without requiring any image-side modifications. Extensive experiments on nine datasets from the HEST-1k benchmark provide empirical evidence for two central claims: GO-structured decoding consistently outperforms flat decoding, even against a state-of-the-art generative baseline, and the gain is attributable to biological ontology structure rather than hierarchical decomposition per se, as confirmed by a +0.027 margin over a structurally equivalent random hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSGR（Multi-Scale Gene Refiner），首次将基因本体论（GO）作为显式结构先验引入从组织病理图像预测空间基因表达的任务。MSGR将目标基因组织成四层GO树（虚拟根→GO领域→GO术语→基因），通过残差修正和跨尺度潜变量通道，从粗到细逐步优化预测。该GO引导解码器作为即插即用模块，在九个HEST-1k数据集上全面优于现有方法（包括生成式基线STFlow），平均PCC-200达到0.517；并通过对比随机层级结构（+0.027的优势）证明增益源于生物学本体结构而非层级分解本身。
AI.motivation: 现有的从组织病理图像预测空间基因表达的方法均采用扁平解码方式，将所有目标基因视为无结构向量，忽略了共享生物通路和调控程序所导致的基因间依赖关系。这种设计存在两大局限：①存在跨模态语义鸿沟（组织形态学表型与分子水平表达）；②模型必须从有限的配对数据中隐式学习数百个基因间复杂的功能与表达依赖关系。引入生物学知识作为中间表征，将扁平单步解码转变为由粗到细的预测过程，可显式协调功能相关基因的预测，缓解上述问题。
AI.method: MSGR框架包含三个核心组件：①条件获取与处理——使用冻结的UNI编码器提取斑块嵌入，通过E(2)等变空间Transformer聚合邻域上下文并融合空间坐标；②GO层级构建——通过g:Profiler检索注释，将GO有向无环图简化为四层树（虚拟根→GO领域→GO术语→基因），并通过路径压缩和代理节点处理未注释基因；③GO引导分层解码——通过共享Transformer骨干在四个尺度上逐步进行残差修正，配合跨尺度潜变量通道（latent highway）实现父尺度到子尺度的上下文传递，采用AdaLN调节的多尺度解码块和ReLU非负约束。最终通过多尺度加权MSE损失进行训练，损失权重为[0,1,2,4]。
AI.result: 在九个HEST-1k数据集上：①MSGR平均PCC-200达0.517，全面优于STFlow（0.503）等基线，在8/9个数据集上获胜，最大增益出现在KIDNEY（+0.051）、READ（+0.044）和HCC（+0.021）；②即插即用兼容性验证——将GO解码器集成到STFlow、EGN和ST-Net中，分别带来+0.019、+0.017、+0.018的平均提升，且在8/9个数据集上获得改进；③消融实验表明GO结构优于随机层级（+0.027）、通路、PPI和共表达层级；④空间表达可视化显示MSGR更好地恢复了MLANA基因的局部变异（PCC=0.935）；⑤超参数分析表明最佳配置为L=2、n∈{4,8}。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了基因本体论作为结构先验在从组织病理图像预测空间基因表达任务中的有效性。MSGR通过分层解码将扁平输出转化为由粗到细的生物对齐预测过程，不仅提升了预测准确性，还增强了模型的可解释性——中间尺度预测与MSigDB Hallmark通路活性高度相关（平均Pearson r=0.896）。该方法展示了生物学本体作为知识引导生物医学预测结构先验的潜力。未来工作方向包括：处理GO注释不完整（采用基于聚类的层级构建）、亚斑点分辨率建模细胞类型异质性，以及通过多树投影集成解码保留GO DAG的丰富拓扑信息。

title: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
summary: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., 'bank' or 'palm') carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses are produced over many samples. We find a clear multimodal gap, where within every model family, generated images settle on far fewer senses than generated sentences (normalized entropy 0.10 vs. 0.25), and both are far less varied than what people imagine for the same words (normalized entropy 0.47). However, when we instead ask a model to list how often it would generate outputs corresponding to each possible meaning of a word, it predicts distributions that are more diverse than the actual space of outputs. These results reveal a multimodal gap in how foundation models express meaning, and how their understanding may not transfer faithfully nor equally across modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态基础模型（17个文生图模型 + 15个文本生成模型）如何处理多义词（polysemous words）。在无语境条件下，图像模型产生的义项数量显著少于文本模型（归一化熵 0.10 vs 0.25），二者均远低于人类（0.47）。但当要求模型预测义项分布时，它们却预测出比实际生成更接近人类水平的多样性，揭示了模型"所知"与"所表达"之间的多模态鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 生成式模型存在同质化（homogenization）/模式坍缩问题，导致输出窄化，但此前研究几乎完全集中在文本生成上。多义词的义项选择分布恰好提供了一种"干净的探针"：给定无语境的歧义词，模型必须从先验中做出选择，这一选择分布可跨模态、跨模型、跨人类基线进行直接比较，从而揭示意义是否在不同模态间忠实迁移。
AI.method: 刺激集：100个英语多义词（每个有闭集义项清单），另含25个土耳其语和25个法语词用于跨语言验证。给模型呈现裸词（无语境），每个词-模型组合采样30次。用GPT-5.4作为评判器对每个输出分配义项标签（含 multiple / unclear / other 后备标签）。在文本条件下用同一评判器评分人类基线（Prolific收集，540人，2782份回应）。度量指标：(1) 归一化 Shannon 熵 H̃ 衡量义项多样性；(2) Jensen-Shannon 相似度衡量模型间一致性；(3) PCA 可视化模型在义项选择空间中的聚类。此外进行偏好调优消融（SDXL+Diffusion-DPO, SimpleAR+GRPO）和迭代跨模态传输"电话游戏"实验。
AI.result: (1) 多模态鸿沟：在所有模型家族中，图像模型的义项多样性（H̃=0.10）显著低于文本模型（H̃=0.25，p<10⁻⁶），且二者均远低于人类（H̃=0.47 想象 / 0.50 造句）。该模式在土耳其语和法语中也成立。(2) 图像模型之间的义项选择一致性（JSS=0.78）高于文本模型（JSS=0.69）；PCA 显示沿第一主成分分裂的是模态而非家族（轮廓系数 +0.27 vs -0.04）。(3) 文本模型多样性随版本迭代单调下降（ρ=-0.59, p=0.02），图像模型则始终偏低无趋势。(4) 扩散型 FLUX 模型独特地将多个义项叠加在同一图像中（6.6% vs 其他 0.9%）而非坍缩到单一义项。(5) 已知 vs 所表达的差距：当被要求预测义项分布时，模型预测 H̃≈0.73（高于人类实际 0.47），远高于自己实际生成的 0.10/0.25。(6) 偏好调优（DPO）会显著降低多样性（SDXL: 0.25→0.18），但不能完全解释模态鸿沟。(7) 跨模态迭代传输不加剧坍缩（5轮后 ΔH̃≈-0.03），说明坍缩是单次生成的属性。
AI.conclusion: 表征歧义与表达歧义是两种不同的能力，且都受到微调（如 RLHF）实践的强烈塑造。模型"知道"bank 有多个义项，却每次只画河岸。随着多模态系统日益影响人们所读、所见、所想象的内容，弥合这种意义窄化是构建跨模态忠实迁移的 AI 系统的具体一步。研究强调：意义在跨模态传递中的忠实性是一个独立于语言、架构和提示的关键失败维度。

title: SymboUQ: Symbolic Uncertainty Quantification for Spatial Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) can produce fluent spatial reasoning traces, their intermediate relations may fail to support the final conclusion, making token-level confidence insufficient for final-answer reliability estimation. Existing formal verifiers provide stronger semantic evidence, but their applicability is partial: a parsed claim need not yield a definite semantic verdict. To address this issue, we introduce SymboUQ, a symbolic uncertainty quantification framework that estimates final-answer reliability from reasoning traces by distinguishing symbolizability, whether a claim can be represented in the verifier's formal language, from semantic determinacy, whether its execution yields an entailed or contradicted verdict rather than an unknown or not-evaluable outcome. SymboUQ comprises (i) a Layout Auditor that executes ordered spatial claims and extracts feasibility, conflict, and repair evidence; (ii) a label-free Determinacy Profile that characterizes effective executable coverage; and (iii) a Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer that integrates constraint-based, representation-based, and decoding-based scores according to verifier applicability. Extensive experiments on five spatial reasoning benchmarks with four frozen LLM backbones show that SymboUQ achieves approximately an 8% relative improvement in AUROC and a 7% relative reduction in class-balanced Brier loss over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: SymboUQ 提出了一种用于空间推理的不确定性量化框架，通过区分"可符号化性"(symbolizability，即声明能否被翻译为验证器的形式语言)与"语义确定性"(semantic determinacy，即执行后是否得到确定的语义判定)，将约束证据与表示/解码证据通过适用性感知的方式进行融合。该框架由空间布局审计器、无标签适用性档案和确定性感知可靠性合成器三个组件构成，在 5 个空间推理基准、4 个冻结 LLM 主干上相较最强基线平均提升约 8% 的 AUROC 并降低约 7% 的类均衡 Brier 损失。
AI.motivation: LLM 在空间推理中可能生成流畅但推理链无效的痕迹，token 级置信度不足以估计最终答案可靠性；现有形式验证器虽提供更强语义证据，但其适用性是不完整的——被解析的声明未必能得到确定的语义判定。因此需要一个能精确刻画验证器适用性的框架来估计最终答案可靠性。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) Layout Auditor 将场景描述与有序推理链编译为空间约束程序，利用方向差分约束（Bellman-Ford 负环检测）与关系闭包（逆、对称、传递、不相容等规则）求解可行性，将每条声明标记为 entailed/contradicted/unknown/not-evaluable 四种状态，并提取可行性、冲突和有界修复代价证据；(2) Determinacy Profile 基于符号化率 π(r)、未知率 ν(r) 和语义确定性 d(r) 定义无标签的适用性档案 δ(r)=π(r)·d(r)，刻画有效可执行覆盖率；(3) Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer (DARC) 用目标域验证集对候选分数进行筛选与方向对齐，并通过 π(r)·s̃(r) 和 δ(r)·s̃(r) 的适用性条件交互将约束、表示、解码三类证据融合。
AI.result: 在 StepGame、SpaRTQA、SpaRTUN、SpaceNLI、SpaRP 五个基准上使用 Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B、Qwen3-8B 四个冻结主干进行实验。SymboUQ 在所有 20 个主干-数据集组合中均优于 scores-only stacking，其中 19 组统计显著（p<0.05）；相对最强外部基线平均提升约 8% AUROC 和降低约 7% 类均衡 Brier 损失。审计器的 entail 精度为 0.81–0.87，contradict 精度为 0.64–0.74；约 128 个目标域标签即可产生有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作核心贡献在于概念上首次分离可符号化性与语义确定性，为何时验证器证据可用提供了原则性判断；技术上提出的 SymboUQ 框架将空间布局审计、无标签执行覆盖率档案和适用性感知证据合成三者整合；实证上验证了在 5 个基准、4 个 LLM 家族上一致的领先表现。局限性包括：受限于审计器本体与解析器；假设上下文语义使得部分判定依赖于未验证的前提；DARC 需要少量目标域标注数据；增量本体扩展、前提溯源追踪与无验证合成是未来方向。

title: Mask-Based Priors Are More Persistent than Query-Key Initializations
summary: Transformers do not merely lack data on some Boolean extrapolation tasks; they generalize in a systematically wrong way. Recent work on generalization on the unseen has shown that, despite fitting the observed domain, Transformers often extrapolate according to a simpler minimum-degree interpolator rather than the true target function. These Boolean tasks are not practical applications, but controlled stress tests for understanding Transformer inductive bias. We ask whether this failure mode can be corrected by injecting explicit structural priors into attention. Existing structured-initialization methods alter Transformer inductive bias indirectly, by choosing query and key projections whose similarity scores approximate a desired attention pattern. However, we find that when applied to Boolean extrapolation, these QK-based priors can be rapidly overwritten during training and fail to change the learned extrapolation rule. We propose a simpler alternative: initialize the additive attention mask directly. Unlike standard hard masks used for causality or locality attention, our mask is a finite, learnable attention-logit bias initialized from task-level interaction structure. This separates the structural prior from content-dependent attention scores, allowing it to persist throughout optimization. On Boolean reasoning tasks, mask-based initialization achieves near-perfect extrapolation where vanilla and QK-initialized Transformers remain trapped by the default inductive bias. The same mechanism also improves low-data arithmetic performance and remains competitive on vision and language benchmarks. These results show that attention masks can serve not only as architectural constraints, but as a simple substrate for encoding persistent inductive bias in Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用可学习的加性注意力掩码（而非QK矩阵）注入结构先验。相比现有的QK结构化初始化方法，掩码先验在训练中更持久，能在布尔推理任务上实现近乎完美的外推，并显著提升低数据算术任务的性能。
AI.motivation: Transformer在布尔任务上存在系统性外推失败：模型能拟合训练数据，却倾向于学习更简单的最小阶插值器（MDI）而非真实目标函数。现有的结构化初始化方法通过求解QK矩阵间接编码先验，但该先验与内容相关的查询-键表示纠缠，容易在训练中被覆盖或重新利用，无法可靠改变外推行为。
AI.method: 提出基于可学习加性掩码的结构化初始化方法。将任务级交互结构直接编码为可学习的注意力logit偏置M，通过 log σ(M) ≤ 0 选择性地抑制不期望的交互，公式为 softmax(XW_Q W_K^T X^T/√d + log σ(M))。该方法不修改架构，仅使用Transformer中已有的加性掩码接口，但区别于因果掩码——它是有限、可学习的偏置而非硬性架构约束。理论分析（定理1及推论1）证明：掩码梯度独立于特征范数，被σ(-m)≤1调节，比与‖q‖_2、‖k‖_2成比例的QK梯度更稳定，因此先验更不易被覆盖。
AI.result: 1. 布尔GOTU任务：2Parity准确率从75%提升至100%，3-Bit Majority从87.4%提升至100%，Cyclic3从87.5%提升至99.98%，ThreeSym损失从7.6降至2.97，均显著优于默认和QK初始化。2. 算术任务：乘法序列准确率在3%训练数据下达69.49%（最优QK方法仅27.82%），加法在0.4%数据下达77.49%（最优QK仅49.87%），低数据场景优势最为明显。3. 视觉任务：在CIFAR10（95.66%）、CIFAR100（77.95%）、ImageNet100（85.92%）上均取得最高Top-1准确率。4. NLP任务：在TinyStories和WikiText-2上有适度提升。5. 消融实验证实增益来自结构化先验本身，而非额外参数。
AI.conclusion: 先验在注意力中的"存放位置"决定其持久性。QK初始化间接编码结构，易被训练覆盖；掩码初始化直接编码为logit偏置，与内容相似度解耦，因而能在优化中保持稳定。实验证明加性掩码不仅是架构约束，也可作为注入持久归纳偏置的简洁载体，使Transformer摆脱最小阶外推陷阱。该方法的局限在于依赖"先知"假设——需要任务级交互结构知识，在缺乏明确先验的领域（如通用语言建模）应用受限，未来工作应探索从数据或预训练模型中自动学习此类先验。

title: TrAC: Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent reasoning traces that nevertheless lead to incorrect answers, making response-level uncertainty estimation important for abstention, human review, and adaptive compute allocation. Existing approaches generally fall into three categories: passive single-trace methods use token-level confidence signals, sampling-based methods compare multiple complete traces at higher generation cost, and active prefix-based methods probe partial traces to study answer stabilization or preference transitions. However, none actively re-elicits an answer from a completed reasoning trace to measure its consistency with and support for the original answer. To address this gap, we introduce Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency (TrAC), a correctness-supervised uncertainty quantification framework that combines active and passive signals anchored to one completed reasoning trace. Its active component, Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation (PCE), re-elicits a short answer conditioned on the completed trace and represents both its consistency with the original answer and its token-level probabilistic support. Its passive component, Trace Uncertainty Profile (TUP), summarizes how token-level uncertainty evolves throughout the original generation without additional decoding. A lightweight head then integrates the two representations into a response-correctness score. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three LLM families, TrAC improves macro AUROC by 1.8% and reduces AURC by 3.4% relative to eight-sample self-consistency, while using one complete reasoning trace and a short cached answer probe. When eight samples are already available, augmenting sample consensus with re-elicitation further improves macro AUROC by 4.3% and reduces AURC by 8.3%, without additional full-trace generation.

AI.tldr: TrAC提出了一种新的LLM不确定性量化框架,通过"轨迹条件化的答案一致性"信号——即在已完成推理轨迹上重新引出一个短答案,测量其与原答案的一致性与概率支持度——结合主动(PCE)与被动(TUP)两类信号,仅用1条完整推理轨迹+1次短答案缓存解码,即可在5个数学推理基准上以1.02×延迟超越8样本自一致性(Macro AUROC +1.8%,AURC -3.4%);在已有8样本时融入重引出可进一步提升AUROC +4.3%、AURC -8.3%,且在投票一致时仍能识别错误。
AI.motivation: LLM可生成流畅但结论错误的推理链,响应级不确定性估计对弃答、人工复核、自适应计算分配至关重要。现有方法分三类:(1)被动单轨迹法(仅用token置信度);(2)采样投票法(多轨迹成本高且答案一致时丧失区分力);(3)主动前缀法(仅用于早停)。核心空白:缺少一种在已完成轨迹上重新引出答案、检验模型是否仍支持原结论的低开销主动探针。
AI.method: TrAC融合两个互补视图:(1) PCE(主动):缓存已完成轨迹的前缀,追加固定线索"The final answer is",贪心解码出再引出答案ã,提取一致性指标e=1[ã≡a]、长度归一化对数似然ℓ、最小token似然ℓ_min、答案头似然ℓ_head、首token置信c₁;(2) TUP(被动):从原始生成的token log-prob λ_t与top-k熵η_t出发,按归一化位置分箱(2J个bin)刻画轨迹形状,并附加全局统计(均值、最小、标准差、趋势斜率、尾窗口、低置信占比)。两者拼接后送入ℓ₂正则化逻辑回归头,输出响应正确性概率。当多轨迹可用时,可选Consensus Fusion再融合投票分数q_K与答案熵h_K。
AI.result: 在5个数学基准(GSM8K、MATH500、Minerva、OlympiadBench、AIME)与3个模型家族(Qwen3、Phi-4-reasoning、Ministral-3)共30对配置上:(1) TrAC单轨迹Macro AUROC达0.894,优于8样本自一致性(0.878),AURC降至0.198,而延迟仅1.02×;(2) TrAC(+CF@8)Macro AUROC达0.916,优于SC@8(+0.038,p<0.001);(3) 消融证实PCE与TUP互补(PCE 0.834 + TUP 0.789 → TrAC 0.894);(4) 重引出信号在一致投票(≥1.0)的243个错误中AUROC仍达0.839,而SC仅为0.500;(5) Leave-one-dataset-out下Macro AUROC 0.897,跨模型LOMO 0.884;(6) PCE与P(True)互补,合并后达0.859;(7) 缓存关闭时延迟升至1.16×,验证缓存关键性。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹条件化答案一致性是一种低成本、互补于token置信度与跨样本投票的不确定性信号,在被动置信误导或多样本收敛于错误时仍具信息量;TrAC以1.02×延迟实现超过8样本自一致性的排序质量,并能在已有8样本预算下进一步突破投票盲区,为选择性预测、弃答与计算分配提供了实用方案。局限:需访问token分数与前缀解码能力,不适用于隐藏log-prob的API;域外校准失效;分数非正确性保证,部署需目标域验证。

title: Diagnose Before You Compress: Prediction-Independent Bottleneck Witness Refinement for LLM Serving Traces
summary: Production LLM serving generates millions of diverse requests, making full-trace replay across serving configurations increasingly expensive. Existing trace reduction methods mainly preserve workload distributions or representative requests, but bottleneck-revealing workloads may be rare and non-representative. Moreover, evidence for one component cannot compensate for missing evidence in another, while using predicted bottlenecks as target truth creates circular evaluation. These limitations make it necessary to preserve evidence for every bottleneck component rather than rely on workload representativeness alone. We propose Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing (BPW), a quality-constrained framework for compact and diagnostically reliable LLM serving replay suites. BPW first performs Workload Candidate Nomination using response-blind workload features and closed source-side measurements. This stage identifies workloads that may expose scheduler, prefill, decode, or KV-cache bottlenecks. Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction then organizes multi-component proposals as reusable hyperedges and prioritizes weak and uncovered dimensions. Finally, Bottleneck Truth Verification derives prediction-independent labels solely from direct target-system measurements. The verified results determine the earliest prefix satisfying the direct two-witness requirement for every component. Experiments on BurstGPT, ServeGen, and Mooncake show that BPW reaches the verified gate with a compact workload set and outperforms 16 policies, achieving relative improvements of 2.3% and 16.3% in Mean prefix Macro-F1 and WBRC-AUC, respectively. Stage-resolved and sensitivity analyses confirm the distinct contributions and local stability of its three stages. Our code is publicly available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出BPW（Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing，瓶颈保留见证）框架，用于构建紧凑且诊断可靠的LLM推理回放套件。该框架通过三阶段流程——候选负载提名、覆盖优先序列构建、瓶颈真实验证——解决了现有trace缩减方法仅保留负载分布但可能遗漏稀有瓶颈证据的问题。在BurstGPT、ServeGen、Mooncake三个公开trace上，BPW在16种基线策略中表现最优，平均Mean prefix Macro-F1提升2.3%，WBRC-AUC提升16.3%。
AI.motivation: 生产LLM服务每秒产生数百万多样化请求，全量trace在不同推理配置间回放成本极高。现有trace缩减方法主要保留负载分布或代表性请求，但存在三个关键缺陷：(1) 暴露瓶颈的负载可能稀少且不具代表性，分布保留不能保证发现它们；(2) 一个组件的证据无法补偿另一组件的缺失证据（类似worst-group问题，组件级证据不可替代）；(3) 用预测瓶颈作为目标真值会导致循环评估，预测与验证未分离。因此，trace缩减应从"分布保留"转向"证据保留"，优先为每个瓶颈组件保留直接验证的证据。
AI.method: BPW是一个质量约束框架，包含三个核心阶段：(1) 工作负载候选提名（Workload Candidate Nomination）：基于响应盲（response-blind）的压力特征（并发度、输入/输出token、前缀复用率）和封闭源端测量，训练浅层Extra-Trees分类器预测四维瓶颈（scheduler、prefill、decode、KV-cache）的多标签超边。(2) 覆盖优先序列构建（Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction）：将多组件预测组织为可复用超边，使用最弱组件优先、弱覆盖维度增益、可复用超边增益的字典序评分Ψ_t，并结合执行成本和索引作为确定性平局打破项，迭代选择下一负载。(3) 瓶颈真实验证（Bottleneck Truth Verification）：仅依据目标系统直接测量，使用与目标锚点相对ECDF差距阈值δ_tar判断瓶颈，并采用多数重启投票聚合目标标签。设计质量门控Q(S_t)=Q_pred·Q_evid，要求Macro-F1≥η_M、最差维度召回≥η_R、双见证G_rob=1、重启稳定性≥η_A，返回满足约束的最早前缀。
AI.result: 在BurstGPT、ServeGen、Mooncake三个数据集、16种参考策略（含PKH-inspired、AEA-inspired、SubLIME-inspired等）的对比实验中，BPW在所有trace上均取得最高Mean prefix Macro-F1（0.8553/0.8790/0.8915）和WBRC-AUC（0.9266/0.8763/0.9002），相对最强基线Macro-F1增益0.0252/0.0139/0.0185，WBRC-AUC增益0.2009/0.0428/0.0424。在相同负载预算下，BPW是唯一在所有trace上为四个组件都提供至少两个直接正例见证的策略；代表性基线在ServeGen上遗漏3个组件、Mooncake上遗漏2个组件。阶段消融表明移除组件提议或替换覆盖优先排序均增加所需负载数量；源提议虽达到高Macro-F1（0.884/0.912/0.914），但23.3%~40.0%的候选仍包含错误组件指派，证明三阶段均不可替代。稳定性分析显示BurstGPT在极端源条件下存在轻微排序敏感性（Jaccard 0.667~1.000），ServeGen与Mooncake在参数、配置、重启变化下均完全稳定（Jaccard=1.000）。
AI.conclusion: BPW提供了一种紧凑可靠的瓶颈诊断机制，支持成本感知的LLM推理评估。其核心贡献在于揭示了一个重要认识：代表性负载选择不足以满足机制级诊断需求，当瓶颈证据具有不可补偿性时，必须为每个组件保留直接验证的证据。BPW将trace缩减从分布保留范式转向证据保留范式，为多样部署场景下的高效可靠服务系统评估提供了通用视角。论文将代码开源，推动后续工作采用"诊断先于压缩"的设计原则。

title: Ekova: A Personality-Support Agent for Self-Discovery Dialogue
comment: Accepted to the COLM 2026 Lifelong Agents Workshop
summary: Emotional Support (ES) systems have long optimized a single objective: alleviating the user's emotional distress in the moment. We argue that a complementary need, helping users see themselves more clearly, defines a distinct paradigm we call Personality Support (PS). PS is not counseling or clinical intervention: it targets cognitive clarity and self-articulation, not symptom relief or diagnosis. We instantiate this paradigm in three layers. First, we present DSD, a Chinese self-discovery PS Dataset of 8,590 samples collected through real longitudinal interaction across five minimal units, Coach, Warm, Tsukkomi, Real, and Gonzo. Second, we build DeepSupport, a multi-persona PS system trained with OrthoTune, a PS-tailored framework with style-specific adapters and a style-consistency regularizer. Third, we unify the five DeepSupport personas into Ekova, a persistent personality-support agent with a unified cross-session memory layer, supporting both adaptive routing and user-customized persona selection. Experiments show that OrthoTune-trained models outperform all baselines with an average relative gain of 16.3% across all metrics over the strongest prompt-based baseline. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种区别于传统情感支持（ES）的"人格支持"（Personality Support, PS）新范式，旨在帮助用户获得认知清晰度和自我理解，而非仅缓解即时情绪困扰。作者构建了三层体系：DSD中文自发现数据集（8,590样本，涵盖Coach、Warm、Tsukkomi、Real、Gonzo五种最小单元）、基于OrthoTune框架训练的DeepSupport多人格系统，以及统一跨会话记忆的持久化代理Ekova。实验表明OrthoTune相对最强基线在所有指标上平均提升16.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有情感支持（ES）系统仅优化"即时缓解用户情绪困扰"这一单一目标，忽视了一个互补且更具持久价值的需求——帮助用户更清晰地认识自身（认知清晰度与自我表达）。作者将这一新范式命名为Personality Support（PS），强调其反思性而非反应性、追求持久的自我理解而非短时的情绪调节，并明确区分于心理咨询或临床干预。
AI.method: 三层次构建：（1）**DSD数据集**——通过单一参与者纵向交互收集的8,590条中文样本，覆盖五种功能独立的最小单元风格（Coach结构化行动计划、Warm情感安顿、Tsukkomi反讽解构、Real事实锚定、Gonzo跨域类比）；（2）**DeepSupport系统**——基于Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct底座，使用OrthoTune框架（含风格特异性LoRA适配器和风格一致性正则化项SCR，利用冻结的Kimi K2.5作为风格判别器p_φ）训练四种风格适配器（Coach使用少样本检索无需微调）；（3）**Ekova代理层**——统一五种人格，通过跨会话记忆层实现自适应路由和用户自定义人格选择，支持情感记忆缓冲、讽刺寄存器守卫和跨域类比输出过滤等推理时约束。
AI.result: 在DeepSupport测试集上的主实验显示：OrthoTune在所有指标上均显著优于所有基线（p<0.01），相对最强提示工程基线平均相对提升16.3%，SA绝对提升9.5个百分点（83.1% vs 73.6%）；跨风格评估显示对角线与均值偏差达63.0个百分点，强力验证最小单元假设；消融实验表明记忆模块对Warm的SDI贡献最大，输出守卫使Gonzo漂移率从35.8%降至10.2%，SCR移除对所有人格均产生显著退化；人工评估中自动PS指标与人工帮助性相关性达0.907–0.946；案例研究显示基线模型均收敛于通用建议，而五种DeepSupport人格在相同输入下呈现显著功能分化。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功确立了Personality Support（PS）作为ES互补范式的可行性，通过DSD数据集、OrthoTune训练框架和Ekova持久化代理三层实例化，实现了"参数级风格特化"而非仅靠提示工程的风格控制。主要局限在于单参与者设计限制了泛化性、DeepSupport为中文原生系统，以及PS与临床咨询的边界问题（需明确Ekova非心理咨询替代品）。未来工作应拓展至多参与者评估并开发适用于持久化代理的跨会话基准。

title: F-WANDA: Fisher-Reweighted Post-Training Pruning for Sustainable Deployment of Large Language Models
summary: One-shot post-training pruning is the most energy-frugal compression strategy for largelanguage models (LLMs), yet existing approaches trade either quality (WANDA) or compute cost (SPARSEGPT). We introduce F-WANDA, a drop-in modification of WANDA that reallocates the per-row keep budget across output neurons in proportion to the empirical Fisher information of the pre-activation. The Fisher signal is collected in a single additional backward pass over the same calibration corpus WANDA already uses; no weights are updated. On LLAMA-2-7B at 50 % unstructured sparsity, F-WANDA attains WikiText-2 perplexity of 6.85, matches WANDA fluency, and improves 5-shot MMLU by +1.6 pp over WANDA and +1.1 pp over SPARSEGPT, while incurring only one-third of SPARSEGPT pruning wall-clock and energy. The headline trade-off is achieved without extra calibration data or fine-tuning, placing F-WANDA on the Pareto frontier of quality versus pruning cost for sustainable LLM compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 F-WANDA，一种针对大型语言模型的一次性后训练剪枝方法。该方法作为 WANDA 的"即插即用"改进，通过单次额外反向传播计算每个输出神经元的经验 Fisher 信息，并据此重新分配每行的稀疏保留预算。在 LLaMA-2-7B/13B 上以 50% 非结构化稀疏率实现最优质量-能耗帕累托前沿：MMLU 较 WANDA 提升 1.4–1.6 pp，同时剪枝能耗仅为 SparseGPT 的约三分之一。
AI.motivation: 现有的一次性后训练剪枝方法存在质量与计算成本之间的权衡：WANDA 计算极其高效但对所有输出神经元采用统一的每行稀疏预算，会损失对损失敏感、承载事实知识的神经元；SparseGPT 通过层间 Hessian 反演实现更高质量，但计算开销高出一个数量级。因此亟需一种能同时兼顾质量与能耗的方法。此外，针对 LLM 推理能耗的关注往往忽略剪枝本身的开销，缺少对压缩成本的可持续性核算。
AI.method: F-WANDA 的核心思路是利用经验 Fisher 信息作为每行保留预算的重新分配信号，而非权重级显著性。具体地：(1) 在 WANDA 原有校准数据上进行一次额外反向传播，计算每个输出神经元预激活的梯度平方均值 ω̄_i；(2) 保留 WANDA 原有显著性分数 S_ij = |W_ij|·‖X_j‖_2；(3) 将每行保留数量 k_i 按 k_i ∝ √ω̄_i 进行分配，总预算 ∑k_i = K 严格保持；(4) 通过迭代"灌水"算法结合最大余数法（largest-remainder rounding）实现整数分配，保证层间稀疏率精确。方法无需权重更新、无需额外校准数据，计算复杂度为 O(N·|θ|)，远低于 SparseGPT 的 O(∑d_in³)；采用梯度检查点控制峰值显存。在硬件限定的 N:M 稀疏（如 2:4）下自动退化为标准 WANDA。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA-2-7B、13B 上的 50% 非结构化稀疏实验中：F-WANDA 在两个模型上均取得最低 WikiText-2 困惑度（6.85 与 5.93）以及最高的零样本任务平均与 5-shot MMLU 准确率；MMLU 较 WANDA 分别提升 +1.6 pp 与 +1.4 pp，较 SparseGPT 分别提升 +1.1 pp 与 +1.1 pp。可持续性方面：剪枝能耗降至 SparseGPT 的约 1/2.6–1/2.9，剪枝时间 12 min（7B）/ 28 min（13B），峰值显存可控于单卡 H100 80GB。消融实验显示：经验 Fisher E[g²] 不可替换为 (E[g])²（否则退化为 WANDA），校准样本量 N≥128 后性能趋于平稳；与 WANDA 差异最大的层集中在网络中段的 MLP 下投影层，符合事实知识主要存储于中层 MLP 的既有发现。2:4 稀疏下 F-WANDA 因设计退化为 WANDA。
AI.conclusion: F-WANDA 证明：仅凭一次额外的反向传播，即可在不更新权重、不增加校准数据的前提下，将 WANDA 的均匀预算转化为 Fisher 信息驱动的差异化分配，从而在 LLaMA-2 系列上以远低于 SparseGPT 的能耗获得更优的知识保留能力。研究同时指出，经验 Fisher 作为权重级分数修正因子在每行 top-k 选择下是退化的，但作为每行预算信号却具有非平凡效力，这是该方法与 WANDA 成功结合的关键。论文配套严谨的剪枝能耗核算，呼吁社区在评估剪枝方法时同步报告压缩成本与推理成本。局限性包括：仅在 LLaMA-2 上验证、对其他解码器家族的泛化待研究、反向传播使峰值显存近乎翻倍、严格 N:M 模式下方法失效。

title: The Bayesian Reflex: A Predictive Coding Engine for Artificial Intelligence
comment: From the Bayesian Brain to Artificial Intelligence
summary: Predictive coding offers a powerful theory of cortical computation, but corresponding scalable algorithmic implementations for artificial intelligence have remained elusive. This paper introduces the Bayesian reflex, a computational framework that directly instantiates predictive coding through three pillars: belief maintenance via hierarchical generative models, sequential Bayesian updating via prediction-error minimization, and uncertainty-driven action via active inference. We show that recent breakthroughs---ellipsoidal decomposition for exact $i.i.d.$ sampling, recursive Gaussian processes for deep hierarchical inference, and derivative-aware Bayesian optimization---provide the missing algorithmic ingredients. The resulting framework enables mathematically principled, scalable, and brain-inspired continual learning, perception, and decision-making. We illustrate its versatility through applications ranging from climate model evaluation to prime number discovery, offering a blueprint for truly adaptive artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"贝叶斯反射"(Bayesian Reflex)框架,旨在将预测编码(predictive coding)理论转化为可扩展的AI算法引擎。该框架通过三个支柱——分层生成模型的信念维护、基于预测误差最小化的序贯贝叶斯更新、以及不确定性驱动的主动推理——直接实例化预测编码原理,并融合椭球分解精确采样、递归高斯过程分层推断、以及导数感知贝叶斯优化三大算法创新,实现数学严谨、可扩展且脑启发的持续学习、感知与决策。
AI.motivation: 预测编码作为皮层计算的有影响力的理论,虽能解释视觉感受野、注意力调制、运动控制乃至精神疾病等多种神经现象,但其在高维非平稳环境中的可扩展且精确的算法实现长期缺失——具体表现为:非线性分层模型精确推断难以实现、在线流式学习缺乏理论保证。本文旨在弥合预测编码理论优雅性与算法可实现性之间的鸿沟,提供一个统一的、具备理论收敛保证的脑启发AI计算框架。
AI.method: 框架建立在三大算法支柱之上:(1) 椭球分解框架(Ellipsoidal Decomposition):将目标分布分解为同心椭球壳层,通过耦合-分裂链表示实现近乎精确的i.i.d.采样,可处理数千维空间;(2) 递归高斯过程(RGP):采用层级特异性GP激活、spike-and-slab先验实现自动变量选择、以及"查找表"(look-up table)近似,使分层推断在条件于查找表时变得精确且可扩展,具备后验一致性、近最优收敛速率、对模型误设的稳健性及万能逼近性等理论保证;(3) 导数感知贝叶斯优化:利用高斯导数过程,通过转换MCMC采样静止点后验,配合椭球采样,实现生成模型参数的在线学习与连续动作空间中的主动推理(等价于Thompson采样)。三者的协同构成了信念维护、序贯更新、不确定性驱动行动的完整闭环。
AI.result: 论文通过四类应用验证框架的多功能性:(1) 气候模型评估——使用分层GP模拟器对GCM投影与历史温度数据进行逆回归推断,发现多数GCM投影对实际历史记录的后验概率极低;(2) 素数发现——将素数序列建模为非齐次泊松过程,采用序贯贝叶斯更新与主动推理搜索,发现259个超过1.4亿的新素数(含184个强Mersenne素数候选);(3) 平稳性检测——通过Beta-二项递归更新检测随机过程的平稳性,具备理论收敛保证;(4) RGP超参数学习——利用导数感知优化自动学习GP核参数与噪声方差,实现自调优预测编码引擎。椭球分解框架已在160维空间模型和4776维标准化流上验证可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯反射成功将预测编码与贝叶斯大脑假说从理论愿景转化为数学严谨、计算可行的AI架构。该框架通过精确i.i.d.采样、分层递归推断与导数感知优化的协同,首次为长期困扰贝叶斯大脑模型的推断难题提供了实用解决方案,并具备理论收敛保证、跨领域应用的通用性、以及适应动态环境、量化深度不确定性、执行最优行动的能力,标志着"预测性人工大脑"时代的开启。然而,对于数十亿参数规模的基础模型,仍需稀疏椭球近似、分层椭球分解或变分-精确混合方法等进一步创新。

title: TaPR: Test-Aware Policy Refinement for Feedback-Conditioned Code Generation
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Aofan Liu and Jingxiang Meng contributed equally; Fangxin Liu and Yongbiao Chen are corresponding authors
summary: Multi-turn code agents rely on execution feedback to repair incorrect programs, yet standard reinforcement learning paradigms optimize and evaluate policy performance primarily using single-shot outcome rewards. This misalignment conflates initial code generation with feedback-driven refinement, discards granular execution signals across intermediate turns, and fails to evaluate whether the policy actually acquires self-repair capabilities. We propose Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR), a framework that transforms execution feedback into a dense per-turn test-pass-ratio reward under a consistent multi-turn interaction protocol. Across six models on 219 code-generation problems from LiveCodeBench, TaPR improves the pooled three-turn success rate (Pass@3) by 2.44 percentage points. In the predefined 7B/8B high-headroom slice, pooled accuracy increases from 30.25% to 33.56% (+3.31 pp), with 42 improvements and 13 regressions in paired trials. On a matched Qwen3-8B ablation, the dense reward supplies nonzero feedback in all of the first ten steps and reaches a higher Hard-subset peak than outcome-only GRPO within the tested budget, although GRPO nearly matches pooled Pass@3 by step 300. Our primary contribution is a reward-decomposition framework and a turn-aware evaluation protocol that decouple first-shot generation quality from multi-turn repair competence.

AI.tldr: TaPR提出了一种测试感知的策略精炼框架，将代码执行反馈转化为稠密的逐轮测试通过率奖励，解决了多轮代码生成强化学习中单次结果奖励与多轮交互评估之间的优化-评估失配问题。在6个模型、219个LiveCodeBench问题上的实验表明，该方法在7B/8B高提升空间区间内将Pass@3提升+3.31个百分点（+10.9%相对增益），并发现了Pass@1/Pass@3解耦现象。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮代码智能体的强化学习范式存在三个核心缺陷：(1)将多轮交互简化为单次结果奖励，混淆了首次生成质量与反馈驱动的精炼能力；(2)丢弃了中间轮次的细粒度执行信号；(3)无法评估策略是否真正具备自我修复能力。标准Pass@k指标反映整体任务成功，但无法区分模型是依赖首轮运气还是利用反馈进行修复，导致优化目标与评估指标之间存在根本性失配。
AI.method: TaPR将多轮代码修复建模为MDP，在T轮交互中，策略π_θ基于历史候选代码和执行反馈生成新代码。核心方法是将隐藏测试用例的逐轮通过比例P_t = (1/m)∑s_{t,j}转化为稠密奖励：r_t = λ_Δ·ΔP_t + λ_done·𝟙[P_t=1]，其中ΔP_t = P_t - P_{t-1}为通过率增量（λ_Δ=1.0），完成奖励λ_done=0.5。差分奖励设计使策略在测试通过比例发生变化时即获得梯度反馈，而非仅在完全正确时才有信号；该奖励满足可伸缩性（∑ΔP_t = P_T），保证最终功能质量归因于改变它的修订步骤。训练使用TRL的GRPOTrainer配合LoRA（r=32, α=64），基于500个APPS问题构建约1300-1400条多轮轨迹。
AI.result: 在LiveCodeBench 219问题的配对评估中，TaPR使池化Pass@3提升+2.44个百分点（p=8.30×10⁻⁵），1314个模型-问题对中51个从失败转为通过、19个反向变化。预定义的7B/8B高提升空间区间（Qwen2.5-7B/Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B）池化准确率从30.25%提升至33.56%（+3.31 pp，+10.9%相对增益），876次配对试验中42胜13负。Qwen3-8B消融实验揭示关键发现：基线、纯结果GRPO和TaPR在Hard子集Pass@1上均为7/61，但Pass@3分别为7/61、8/61、10/61——Pass@1/Pass@3解耦现象。TaPR在前10步均提供非零奖励（vs GRPO的40%零信号），首步奖励均值高13×、梯度范数大10×。但TaPR在step 300达峰后于step 500回归基线，表明存在过拟合/检查点敏感性。两个14B模型变化仅+0.91和+0.46 pp，提示大模型上精炼空间有限。
AI.conclusion: TaPR的贡献在于：(1)形式化了Pass@1/Pass@3解耦现象，证明稠密奖励可在不改变首次生成准确率的前提下提升迭代修复能力；(2)提出利用确定性测试预言机提供非参数中间奖励的实用框架，规避了PRM依赖学习验证器的问题；(3)证实稠密执行奖励在测试预算内带来更早且更显著的精炼学习，但并非普遍优于稀疏奖励。论文强调评估多轮代码研究应同时报告首轮与反馈条件结果、配对胜负，并保留基准版本、划分和交互预算等协议细节以确保公平对比。稠密奖励的可靠性受限于测试本身的完备性——不充分的测试可能导致通过率提升但不反映真正的正确性或安全性。

title: BayesSeg: A Bayesian Optimization Framework for State Segmentation of Electricity Consumption Time Series
summary: In Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM), adaptive segmentation of electricity consumption time series is critical for appliance recognition. However, prevailing methods face challenges including heuristic parameter tuning, boundary sensitivity, and metric saturation. This paper proposes BayesSeg, a unified framework integrating time-series segmentation, multidimensional evaluation, and automatic parameter optimization. The segmentation layer employs a dual steady-state criterion based on the tail value and mean of preceding subsequences, combined with a sequential extraction and complement-set parsing strategy, to achieve precise unsupervised partitioning of steady-state and transition-state segments. The evaluation layer maps segmentation results to binary state sequences and formulates a composite metric integrating an event-level F1 score (event_F1) with Normalized Mutual Information (NMI). The event_F1 quantifies switching-event precision and recall via tolerance matching, while NMI captures global structural consistency, jointly overcoming the boundary sensitivity and limited discriminability of point-wise metrics.
