In the optimization layer, the composite score serves as the objective function for Bayesian optimization, which constructs a TPE surrogate model for efficient global parameter-space exploration. Experiments on the SustDataED2 dataset demonstrate that Bayesian optimization requires only ~100 objective evaluations to locate a parameter region within 0.35% deviation of the exhaustive grid-search optimum. The framework achieves a weighted composite score of 0.7149 and an event_F1 of 0.9340 while reducing optimization latency from ~5300 seconds to under 1 second, a speedup exceeding 5700x. BayesSeg automates segmentation configuration and provides a scalable, efficient solution for time-series analysis in NILM and related domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为BayesSeg的统一框架，用于非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）中的时序自适应分割。该框架整合了三层结构：基于双稳态准则的分割层、复合评估指标层以及基于TPE的贝叶斯优化层，在SustDataED2数据集上以极少评估次数（约100次）逼近网格搜索最优值，并将优化延迟从约5300秒降至1秒以内，实现了5700倍以上的加速。
AI.motivation: 在NILM中，电器识别的关键在于对电力消耗时间序列的自适应分割，但现有方法普遍存在启发式参数调优困难、对边界敏感以及点对点指标易饱和、判别力不足等问题，亟需一种无需人工调参、兼顾局部边界精度与全局结构一致性的自动化分割方案。
AI.method: 方法由三层组成：(1) 分割层：基于前序子序列尾值与均值的双稳态判据，结合序列抽取与补集解析策略，对稳态与过渡态段进行无监督精确划分；(2) 评估层：将分割结果映射为二值状态序列，构建融合事件级F1（基于容差匹配的事件边界精度与召回率）与归一化互信息（NMI）的复合指标，分别刻画切换事件精度与全局结构一致性；(3) 优化层：以复合得分为目标函数，采用基于TPE代理模型的贝叶斯优化实现参数空间的高效全局搜索。
AI.result: 在SustDataED2数据集上的实验表明，贝叶斯优化仅需约100次目标函数评估即可定位到与穷举网格搜索最优值偏差仅为0.35%的参数区域；最终框架获得0.7149的加权复合得分和0.9340的事件级F1值，同时优化延迟由约5300秒降低至1秒以内，加速比超过5700倍。
AI.conclusion: BayesSeg实现了分割参数配置的自动化，解决了边界敏感与度量饱和问题，为NILM及相关领域的时序分析提供了一种可扩展且高效的解决方案，同时显著提升了分割精度与调参效率。

title: CURE: Local Uncertainty Repair for Block-Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding mitigates the latency of sequential generation in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by interleaving draft generation with target verification. However, existing parallel drafting backends often suffer from rapid accuracy degradation over long horizons, leading to high rejection rates during verification and suboptimal wall-clock speedups. We observe that drafting errors are not uniformly distributed but typically stem from localized high-uncertainty tokens that destabilize downstream generation trajectories. Motivated by this token error pattern, we propose CURE, a budget-aware dynamic repair tree designed to repair errors at uncertainty focal points without incurring prohibitive tree-verification overheads. Specifically, our method uses predictive confidence margins to dynamically locate candidate error tokens within a block-parallel draft, expands bounded repair paths only at these fragile nodes, and employs a novel repair resynchronization mechanism to realign draft states post-verification. Evaluations on code-generation benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, and LiveCodeBench-lite) and mathematical reasoning benchmark (GSM8K) demonstrate that CURE increases the average accepted length by 4.2-7.5% over parallel baselines without repair, translating to an end-to-end speedup of $2.66-3.49\times$ over target-only decoding. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play repair module compatible with standard parallel drafting frameworks. We also characterize the trade-off between draft compute and verification efficiency.

AI.tldr: CURE 提出了一种基于局部不确定性修复的块并行推测解码框架，通过在置信度低的"不确定性焦点"处动态构建受限修复树并配合 KV-cache 重同步机制，将接受长度提升 4.2–7.5%，在 Qwen3-8B 上实现 2.66–3.49× 的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 块并行推测解码虽计算高效，但存在"误差传播级联"问题：局部低置信度 token 上的单次错误会导致整个后续草稿被拒绝，而现有的密集树扩展策略在所有位置均匀展开候选路径，验证开销过大。代码生成等任务中，草稿错误并非均匀分布，而是集中在少数局部高不确定性节点（标识符、API 调用、语法运算符处）。论文主张应"节俭且空间局部化"地进行候选树扩展。
AI.method: 方法包含三个阶段：(1) 不确定性焦点检测——利用草稿模型 top-1/top-2 logit 差值（预测置信度裕度 m_i）定位 UFP；(2) 预算感知动态树构建——仅在 UFP 处按归一化不确定性动态分配分支预算 b_i ∈ [1,5]，以原始草稿路径 π₀ 作为 Branch 0 锚定保证兜底；(3) 单遍 Tree Attention 验证与缓存重同步——目标模型一次性验证所有分支，当修复分支胜出时将其 token 重放至草稿模型的 KV-cache 以维持状态一致性。整个框架无训练、零参数、与现有块并行后端即插即用。
AI.result: 在 HumanEval/MBPP/LCB-lite/GSM8K 上：接受 token 数提升 4.2–7.5%（GSM8K 达 32.0%），端到端 TPOT 加速 2.66×–3.49× 相对目标 AR、4.38×–5.43× 相对朴素 SD；pass@1 与目标 AR 持平。消融实验显示移除 Branch 0 使接受长度下降 5.7%，移除缓存重同步则导致 40.1% 灾难性下降；离线分析证明仅 30% 的高优先级块即可恢复 71.6% 的额外 token，显示修复效用高度可预测且集中。
AI.conclusion: CURE 验证了局部不确定性修复在维持目标分布一致性的同时显著提升推测解码效率，但相比纯并行基线仍引入 1.40–1.61× 的树验证 TPOT 开销，存在固有的延迟–接受度权衡。未来工作应聚焦于低开销的静态候选预过滤与更高效的缓存重同步策略。

title: Through the LENS: Local Geometric Decomposition of Vision-Language Model Representations
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) process image patches and text tokens in a shared residual stream, but the local geometry through which the two modalities interact remains poorly understood. Most interpretability methods identify global linear directions, which may miss representations that are globally high-dimensional but locally low-dimensional. We introduce LENS (Local Explanation of Neighborhood Subspaces), a method that decomposes VLM activations into local low-rank Gaussian neighborhoods using a Mixture of Factor Analyzers. Applied to LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, LENS reveals distinct depth-dependent fusion trajectories consistent with each model's fusion mechanism: LLaVA progressively mixes modalities at later layers, whereas Qwen3-VL mixes them early, partially re-segregates them, and recombines them near the output. An automated multimodal labeling pipeline assigns concise semantic descriptions to these neighborhoods. Interpolating activations toward neighborhood centroids causally redirects generation within and across modalities and outperforms difference-in-means and VL-SAE in most evaluated conditions; in one LLaVA vision-to-vision setting, MFA achieves 5.7 times the VL-SAE score. Human evaluation finds MFA steering competitive with prompting and substantially stronger than the other intervention baselines. Finally, the MFA coefficient space improves Qwen3-VL image-to-rendered-text retrieval at the deepest evaluated layer from 14.9% to 48.6% R@1. Ablations show that the reported fusion trajectories are stable across component counts, local ranks, and modality-purity thresholds. These results support local geometric neighborhoods as useful interpretable and causal units for analyzing cross-modal representations in the evaluated VLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出 LENS（Local Explanation of Neighborhood Subspaces）方法，使用混合因子分析器（MFA）将视觉-语言模型的激活分解为局部低秩高斯邻域，用于分析跨模态融合的几何结构、因果干预与跨模态检索。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法主要识别全局线性方向，可能遗漏全局高维但局部低维的表征；视觉-语言模型中的跨模态融合机制（特别是局部几何层面）仍不清楚，且 VLM 已被广泛应用于医疗、遥感、工业质检等高风险场景，亟需理解其如何整合视觉与语言证据。
AI.method: 三阶段 LENS 流程：(1) 多模态激活提取——从 CC3M 图文对中按层抽取 LLaVA-1.5-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的残差流激活，采用分层模态采样平衡图文 token 比例，并记录空间 patch 索引与文本上下文；(2) 在每层独立训练 MFA（K=8192 个分量，局部秩 q=10），通过负对数似然优化拟合局部低秩高斯邻域；(3) 自动化跨模态标注——使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 作为判定器，根据最高响应度的图像块与文本片段生成语义标签。两种因果评估：(a) 作用域激活干预（针对视觉/文本/混合位置向邻域中心插值）；(b) 跨模态系数空间检索（基于职责向量与局部坐标构建跨模态共享表示），使用 ImageNet 1k 类标签进行检索。
AI.result: (1) 揭示架构相关的融合轨迹：LLaVA 呈渐进式晚融合（层 8/16/29 混合分量数 0→55→472，占比 0%/0.6%/5.7%）；Qwen3-VL 呈早期非单调融合（层 9/18/27 混合分量数 464→61→128，占比 5.7%/0.7%/1.5%），与 DeepStack 注入机制一致。(2) MFA 干预在多数条件下优于 DiffMeans 和 VL-SAE；在 LLaVA 视觉→视觉设定下得分达 VL-SAE 的 5.7 倍；支持模态间的概念跨域控制。(3) 人类评估：MFA 中位得分 1.64，优于提示（1.43）、VL-SAE（0.31）、DiffMeans（0.30），人机评分相关（Spearman ρ=0.727）。(4) Qwen3-VL 图像→渲染文本检索 R@1 在最深层从 14.9% 提升至 48.6%。(5) 消融实验表明融合轨迹在 K、q 与模态纯度阈值 τ 变化下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 局部低秩高斯邻域可作为分析 VLM 跨模态表征的可解释且因果有效的单元；LENS 揭示了架构差异（渐进晚融合 vs. 早期非单调融合）下的融合几何结构，并通过干预与检索验证了其因果效用与跨模态对齐能力，支持将局部几何分解作为全局线性方法的互补工具。未来工作应扩展至更多架构与任务，并追踪注意力/MLP 层中邻域的形成与合并机制以连接几何结构与具体电路。

title: Why Does the Future Branch? Identifiable Closure Tests for Stochastic Physical World Models
summary: Stochastic world models are usually evaluated by the accuracy and calibration of their predicted futures. These criteria leave a decision-relevant ambiguity: the same conditional future distribution can arise because an observation aliases different physical states, or because the dynamics remain random after the declared full state is fixed. We prove that this attribution is not identifiable from ordinary transition data, even with an optimal probabilistic predictor. We introduce ClosurePairs, an interventional evaluation protocol that crosses compatible microstates with repeated exogenous disturbances. A two-way variance decomposition identifies state aliasing, process noise, and their nonlinear interaction; an independent-repeat variant applies when disturbances cannot be reused. On likelihood-equivalent Gaussian systems, paired supervision reduces alias-fraction error 15.96-fold at identical test NLL. Across 18 nonlinear Langevin conditions, it reduces attribution MAE from 0.372 to 0.051 and sensing regret from 0.0138 to 0.0003 without changing NLL. On a pixel-conditioned recurrent model, a frozen shared-state probe reduces alias-fraction MAE against a deep ensemble from 0.584 to 0.130 in distribution and from 0.630 to 0.170 out of distribution over ten seeds. Finally, in a matched-total-variance REFINE/BRANCH test, a total-variance router reaches 66.48 percent plus or minus 1.06 percent accuracy, whereas ClosurePairs reaches 99.99 percent plus or minus 0.02 percent and improves selected NLL from -2.087 to -2.717 over five seeds. ClosurePairs therefore measures why futures branch, information that proper forecast scores cannot identify.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClosurePairs评估协议，通过配对干预（微状态交叉与噪声重复）将随机世界模型预测方差分解为状态混淆（state aliasing）、过程噪声及其非线性交互，解决了"观测上似然的预测分布为何发散"这一不可识别问题，无需改变NLL即可显著降低归因误差并改进下游决策。
AI.motivation: 随机世界模型通常以预测分布的准确性和校准度评估，但这存在决策关键性歧义：同一条件未来分布可能源于观测混淆不同物理状态，或源于在完整状态固定后动力学仍随机。两种环境的p(y|z,a)完全相同，正确干预却不同——前者应获取更精细观测，后者应保留多分支。此不确定性来源归因从普通转移数据中不可识别，作者将其形式化为识别问题。
AI.method: 作者提出ClosurePairs协议，包括两种估计器：(1) 独立嵌套重复——在固定(z,a)下采样M个兼容微状态，每状态做K次独立扰动，通过行内方差与行均值方差之差无偏估计V_proc和V_alias（带1/K修正）；(2) 交叉可重用扰动——利用模拟器种子控制，将M个微状态与K个扰动完全交叉，采用平衡双因素方差分析（functional-ANOVA分解F(X,E)=m+f_X+f_E+f_XE），通过均值方程E[MS_X]=KV_X+V_XE等求解三个正交方差分量，并将状态-噪声交互项正确归入过程分量。还证明了嵌套观测分辨率下别名方差的单调可约性定理。
AI.result: 在似然等价的Gaussian系统中，配对监督使别名分数误差降低15.96倍，测试NLL差为零；18个非线性Langevin条件下，归因MAE从0.372降至0.051，传感遗憾从0.0138降至0.0003（ID/OOD均显著）；像素条件循环模型中，对冻结共享状态的探测使分数MAE相对深集成从0.584降至0.130（ID）、0.630降至0.170（OOD），十种子均成立（Wilcoxon p=1.95e-3）；匹配总方差的REFINE/BRANCH路由测试中，总方差阈值路由器达66.48%±1.06%，而ClosurePairs达99.99%±0.02%，所选NLL从-2.087改善至-2.717。所有改进均在NLL不变的前提下实现。
AI.conclusion: 预测准确性和校准度无法判定未来为何发散——观测核中过程随机性与状态混淆完全不可识别。配对干预提供缺失信息，通过功能方差分析可获得非线性状态-噪声交互存在时仍无偏的估计器，揭示NLL不可见的传感决策错误。随机物理世界模型应同时报告未来分布的宽度及其是否随观测精细化而闭合。局限在于需要超越被动视频的微状态重置/采样访问，"过程"是相对于声明状态的相对量，匹配方差路由器为受控验证而非被动在线应用。

title: Escaping Confidence Trap: Evolutionary Decoding for Mathematical Reasoning in Diffusion LLMs
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, offering efficient generation through block-wise progressive unmasking. However, their strong general-purpose performance does not necessarily translate into reliable mathematical reasoning, where correctness depends on preserving coherent numerical-symbolic reasoning trajectories. In this work, we analyze the decoding trajectories of LLaDA 2.0 and identify a recurring diffusion confidence trap: local token confidence can become misaligned with global reasoning correctness during progressive block decoding. Our analysis reveals two representative failure regimes: sampling-sensitive failures, where correct paths exist but are unstable, and sampling-consistent failures, where repeated sampling converges to repetitive high-confidence but incorrect continuations. Motivated by this observation, we propose Evolutionary Decoding, a training-free test-time scaling framework that views diffusion decoding as an evolutionary process over candidate reasoning states. The framework combines step-wise selection, which preserves useful numerical-symbolic signals and suppresses repetitive patterns, with block-wise mutation, which introduces structured alternatives to escape incorrect high-confidence basins. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Evolutionary Decoding improves LLaDA 2.0 over confidence-based decoding, leading to more reliable mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散大语言模型（dLLM）在数学推理任务中出现的"置信度陷阱"问题，提出了一种无需训练的测试时解码框架——进化解码（Evolutionary Decoding, ED）。该框架将块级扩散解码视为推理状态的进化过程，通过步进选择（step-wise selection）保留数值-符号关键信号、抑制重复模式，以及块级变异（block-wise mutation）注入结构化替代分支以逃离高置信度错误吸引子，从而提升LLaDA 2.0在多个数学推理基准上的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散大语言模型（如LLaDA 2.0）在通用语言任务上表现优异，但在数学推理等需要精确数值-符号推理链的领域表现不可靠。作者通过对LLaDA 2.0解码轨迹的分析发现存在"扩散置信度陷阱"：局部token置信度与全局推理正确性脱节，导致两种典型失败模式——（1）采样敏感型失败：正确路径存在但不稳定；（2）采样一致型失败：反复采样收敛到高置信度但错误的重复续写。这表明问题不仅源于采样随机性，更源于置信度驱动的块级解码机制本身。
AI.method: 提出进化解码框架，包含两个互补机制：(1) 步进选择（Step-wise Selection）：在块内渐进式解掩码过程中，引入数值-符号增强项（基于token熵，奖励数值/符号token的适度不确定性）和块级重复惩罚项（抑制与前一块重复的模式），调整token释放评分，并设置惩罚触发的回退机制避免过度抑制；(2) 块级变异（Block-wise Mutation）：当块内数值-符号置信度低于变异阈值时，通过对logits添加全局数值/符号词汇偏置，生成多个变异分支（中性、数值、符号、混合），然后根据原始模型置信度选择最优候选。两个机制分别解决采样敏感型和采样一致型失败，且门控变异策略仅在选择轨迹可能失败时触发变异。
AI.result: 在六个数学推理基准（AIME 2024/2025/2026、AMC 2023、MATH500、GSM8K）上的实验表明，进化解码显著优于LLaDA 2.0的默认置信度解码。例如在LLaDA2.0-Flash上，AIME 2024从66.7%提升至70.0%，AIME 2025从56.7%提升至70.0%，AMC 2023从90.0%提升至95.0%；在LLaDA2.0-Mini上同样取得一致增益（AIME 2024: 53.3%→60.0%, AIME 2025: 30.0%→43.3%）。在8次随机采样设置下，ED同时提升pass@1和pass@8，表明其改善不局限于单一确定性轨迹。门控变异策略将AIME 2025解题率进一步提升至73.3%且几乎不增加步骤成本。消融实验验证了选择-变异机制的有效性及超参数的合理性。与其他开源dLLM推理方法（PRISM、BACD+TCCF、S³）相比，ED展现出竞争力的相对增益。代价是解码步骤增加2~3倍，对长推理链的竞赛级基准收益最显著。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了扩散LLM推理的一个关键瓶颈：失败并非仅由采样不足引起，而源于置信度驱动的块级解码的内在动力学特性。进化解码作为无需训练的轨迹级干预框架，通过在解码过程中选择保留关键推理信号并引入结构化替代分支，有效缓解了置信度陷阱问题，提升了数学推理的可靠性。这一工作表明，可靠的扩散LLM推理不仅需要更多样本，还需要更好地控制推理轨迹的形成、选择与多样化过程。未来方向包括扩展至代码生成、科学问答等更广泛推理任务，以及设计更高效的失败感知变异触发策略。

title: Slides2MindMap: Reconstructing Cognitively Efficient Knowledge Hierarchies from Lecture Slides
summary: Generating mind maps from lecture slides can help learners efficiently assimilate fragmented knowledge, promising substantial benefits for intelligent education. However, dedicated automatic generation and evaluation frameworks remain underexplored and challenging, requiring a global-local knowledge focus balance and handling large-scale, heterogeneous slides. We formulate the Slides2MindMap task, which aims to reconstruct cognitively efficient knowledge hierarchies from a course's slide deck collection. For systematic evaluation, we introduce S2M-Bench, a benchmark comprising 12,774 slide pages with expert-annotated mind maps spanning 24 university courses. S2M-Bench includes a cognitive-science-grounded evaluation framework that integrates ground-truth-based comparison, structure conformity analysis, and VLM-as-a-Judge. To address this task, we propose AutoMindMap, an agentic framework inspired by the Structure Building Framework. AutoMindMap comprises Skeleton Laying for global scaffold anchoring, Iterative Knowledge Integration augmented by context-aware summarization, and Dual-Stage Refinement with a local-global decoupling mechanism. The framework reconciles local knowledge faithfulness with global coherence, and adapts to slide-specific features. Experiments on S2M-Bench demonstrate that AutoMindMap outperforms baselines and achieves superior robustness across different models and scenarios, underscoring its pedagogical application value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Slides2MindMap任务，旨在从大规模异构的讲义幻灯片中自动重建认知高效的知识层次结构（思维导图）。为此构建了首个专用基准S2M-Bench（包含24门大学课程、12,774张幻灯片及专家标注的思维导图），并提出基于认知心理学"结构建构框架"（SBF）的智能体框架AutoMindMap，通过骨架铺设、迭代知识整合和双阶段精炼三个阶段，在局部知识忠实度与全局结构一致性之间取得平衡。实验表明AutoMindMap在各项指标上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 思维导图能直观呈现层级知识逻辑，有效降低学习者认知负荷，在教育中具有重要价值。然而从讲义幻灯片自动生成高质量思维导图面临独特挑战：1）讲义具有灵活组织、缺乏显式层级结构、内容碎片化等特点（系统性异质性）；2）每门课程的幻灯片规模庞大（约15万tokens），且概念关联隐晦交织；3）现有方法难以平衡局部知识忠实度与全局逻辑连贯性；4）缺乏针对幻灯片场景的专用生成与评估框架。亟需一个兼顾知识忠实性、结构合规性、任务开放性与认知高效性的系统性解决方案。
AI.method: 提出AutoMindMap智能体框架，受认知心理学"结构建构框架"（SBF）理论启发，将思维导图构建视为动态语篇理解过程，包含三阶段：1）**骨架铺设（Skeleton Laying）**：从各deck中提取显著元素，由LLM规划器生成二级骨架节点、deck-节点二部图关联、扩展指南和先修顺序，作为全局结构锚点；2）**迭代知识整合（Iterative Knowledge Integration）**：基于话语语义而非格式线索对页面分组，通过上下文感知摘要维护分支级记忆状态，采用推理增强的原子工具调用增量扩展思维导图，并执行跨分支关联（基于文本嵌入+Jaccard相似度检索候选节点）和局部结构修复；3）**双阶段精炼（Dual-Stage Refinement）**：解耦微级（各分支独立精炼，editor-critic框架）和宏级（结合渲染图像与文本列表进行整体平衡精炼），避免局部-全局相互破坏。前置使用MinerU将PDF解析为Markdown。
AI.result: 在S2M-Bench基准上，AutoMindMap在所有指标上均显著优于基线（Direct、Chunk-Merge、Highlights-only、BookRAG、PageIndex）。使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash+GPT-5.4-mini配置时，HN-F1达39.88、EC-F1达25.12、MEC-F1达74.34，Pass@1达100%，VLM-Judge平均分3.72（人类标注为3.89）。消融实验验证了视觉精炼、工具调用、精炼机制、上下文摘要和骨架铺设五个模块的必要性。框架在不同LLM和不同课程类别（数学编程、概念理解、综合应用；图像主导、文本主导、混合）上均表现出强鲁棒性，且在多次随机运行中保持低方差。VLM-Judge与人类评估的一致性达到Quadratic Weighted Kappa 0.807（人类-人类为0.845），消融后通过Qwen3.5-Plus验证排名一致性亦保持稳健。与人类重新标注对比表明AutoMindMap显著缩小了与专家水平的差距（HN-F1差距从20.93缩至10.00）。
AI.conclusion: 本文形式化了Slides2MindMap新任务，构建了首个专用基准S2M-Bench，提出了基于SBF认知理论的智能体框架AutoMindMap。该框架通过骨架-整合-精炼三阶段设计，有效平衡了局部知识忠实度与全局逻辑连贯性，克服了幻灯片特有的系统性异质性和大规模碎片化挑战。实验证明其在多个LLM和场景下均优于基线，并已部署于智能教育平台。局限性包括：基准仅涵盖计算机科学和数学、未在真实教育场景中收集人类反馈、生成成本效率非最优、未考虑视觉设计元素、依赖MinerU文档解析。未来工作将扩展多学科数据、引入自进化机制、纳入视觉渲染、构建端到端框架。

title: DASH: Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate - Acquisition Harness for Automated Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) relies on a surrogate model and an acquisition function, yet the most suitable choices vary across tasks and optimization stages. Automated Bayesian optimization (AutoBO) addresses this variability by adapting BO components online. However, existing AutoBO methods either adapt one component, leaving the other mismatched and creating a bottleneck, or jointly select surrogate--acquisition pairs under a shared criterion, overlooking their distinct roles: surrogate selection depends on predictive reliability, whereas acquisition adaptation should respond to campaign this http URL this paper, we propose DASH, a Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate--Acquisition Harness for large-language- model (LLM)-enhanced AutoBO. DASH selects surrogates by predictive reliability, uncertainty calibration, and ranking consistency; its two-stage acquisition controller periodically reallocates quotas across acquisition functions, builds a BO shortlist accordingly, and delegates final selection to an LLM. DASH also incorporates an integrated harness, consisting of knowledge-guided warm start and structured memory, to ground optimization in domain knowledge and accumulated feedback. Across four chemical optimization tasks, DASH outperforms the best AutoBO baseline by 12.51% in trajectory-level Acceleration Factor and 5.00% in endpoint Enhancement Factor. Results remain strong across LLM backbones, and ablations verify the complementary contributions of all components. Full-table and behavioral contamination checks find no detectable evidence that direct benchmark memorization or source-cell leakage explains these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DASH，一种用于自动贝叶斯优化（AutoBO）的解耦自适应代理-采集框架。其核心思想是将代理模型选择（数据驱动）和采集策略适应（上下文驱动）分离，由LLM负责采集侧的配额重分配与候选筛选，并辅以知识引导的初始化与结构化记忆。在四个化学优化基准上，AF相对最佳基线提升12.51%，EF提升5.00%，且无数据污染证据。
AI.motivation: 传统BO中代理模型与采集函数的选择往往固定，但最优组合因任务与优化阶段而异。现有AutoBO方法存在两大瓶颈：(1) 仅自适应单一组件，导致另一组件失配；(2) 联合选择代理-采集对时使用统一准则，忽视二者的本质差异——代理选择应基于预测可靠性（数据驱动），而采集适应应响应于优化进度、预算与领域知识等上下文（上下文驱动）。本文旨在通过解耦两条自适应路径并引入LLM增强，提升AutoBO的灵活性与可靠性。
AI.method: DASH框架包含两大核心模块：(1) 数据驱动的代理模型自适应——维持混合变量GP、CatBoost、深度集成等候选池，每k次迭代通过留一交叉验证（LOOCV）评估三项指标（预测可靠性f_seq、不确定性校准f_cal、排序一致性f_rank），标准化加权后择优切换，并设阈值δ避免不稳定切换。(2) 上下文驱动的采集策略自适应——两级控制器：第一阶段LLM周期性在qLogEI、qUCB、TS间重分配N个候选配额并构建候选池；第二阶段LLM结合记忆中的全局证据与候选级证据（预测均值/不确定度、采集源、跨函数共识）选择下一实验。(3) 集成Harness机制——知识引导的Warm Start由LLM基于领域假设生成M个初始点；结构化记忆分工作记忆、情景记忆、语义记忆三级，迭代更新假设状态与可复用知识。
AI.result: 在四个化学优化任务（OCM、DAR、OER、Suzuki）与四个HPO任务上，以DeepSeek-V4-Pro为后端、预算40次评估（10初始+30次BO）进行5种子实验。化学任务平均AF=1.3182±0.3816，EF=0.9538±0.0695，相对最强基线BOOST分别提升12.51%和5.00%；HPO任务上分别提升0.54%和0.09%（任务区分度有限）。消融实验中，移除Harness使AF下降22.31%、EF下降7.39%（影响最大，主要体现在OCM）；移除LLM采集控制器使AF下降1.91%、EF下降2.99%；移除代理切换使AF下降2.78%、EF下降0.97%。LLM后端敏感性测试（DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Kimi-K2.5、GLM-5.2）显示性能稳健。全表记忆审计（DCQ与源单元格猜测协议）在所有数据集上均未达检测阈值，行为污染检查亦未发现直接记忆证据。
AI.conclusion: DASH通过解耦代理适应（数据驱动）与采集适应（上下文驱动），并结合LLM推理与结构化记忆机制，有效解决了AutoBO中组件失配问题。实验证明其在化学优化任务上显著优于耦合选择方法，且各组件贡献互补；对LLM后端鲁棒，数据污染审计排除基准记忆解释。该工作表明将LLM作为AutoBO的上下文驱动决策器、而非统一评判器，是更合理的设计路径。

title: HetGPS: Scalable Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Physics-Anchored Adaptive Safety for EV Charging
summary: Safety interventions for large populations of network-coupled agents must protect shared constraints without unnecessarily overriding task-oriented policy decisions. We present HetGPS, a hybrid graph-control framework synergizing learned graph risk with physics-anchored correction by separating intervention magnitude from corrective direction. An action-conditioned graph residual model schedules state-dependent intervention authority, while a physics model determines its direction. For electric vehicle (EV) charging, we couple this filter with a parameter-shared heterogeneous graph soft actor-critic policy, enabling topology-aware coordination with a learned model size independent of fleet size. Across five nested distribution networks with 200--3,218 EVs and 100 evaluation days, Adaptive Authority reduces bus--step voltage violations from 3.93--7.74\% without filtering to 0.52--3.44\%, while maintaining 99.06--100\% departure success. Relative to the same physics-directed projection with fixed authority, it improves mean reward on all five networks and lowers the mean safety score on four. The deployed policy-and-risk model contains 383,702 learned parameters at every scale; at 3,218 EVs, a matched centralized SAC actor is about $170\times$ larger. A policy trained on the eight-transformer system transfers zero-shot to the 16- and 32-transformer systems, attaining 0.57--0.75\% violation rates and at least 99.99\% departure success. These results show that learned graph risk can allocate intervention authority at scale while feeder physics anchors corrective action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HetGPS，一种用于电动汽车充电的混合图-控制可扩展多智能体强化学习框架。其核心创新在于将安全干预的"幅度"与"方向"解耦：由学习的图风险模型调度状态依赖的干预权限（Δ_t），由配电网物理模型（LinDistFlow灵敏度）决定修正方向。框架结合参数共享的异构图软演员-评论家（SAC）策略与物理锚定的安全过滤器，在200至3,218辆EV的CRE21配电网及跨家族的IEEE测试网络上验证有效，且学习参数规模（383,702）独立于车队规模。
AI.motivation: 大规模电动汽车（EV）充电协调面临两个核心矛盾：（1）集中式控制因车队规模爆炸（维度灾难）而难以扩展；（2）无协调充电会引发配电网节点电压越限，危及共享约束。现有方法存在以下不足：训练时的奖励惩罚或期望成本约束无法保证每一步约束满足；预测型安全过滤器若使用固定干预权限，要么在高风险时不够用，要么在安全时过度干预、扭曲有用动作。因此需要一种既能随车队规模扩展、又能根据状态自适应调整干预强度的安全-性能权衡机制。
AI.method:
1) **问题建模**：将图耦合协同系统建模为受限Dec-POMDP，每辆EV是一个智能体，通过异构图（母线节点 + EV节点 + 电气边 + 挂接边）共享配电网拓扑上下文。
2) **图共享策略**：基于GraphGPS的共享SAC高斯策略，所有EV共用同一组参数；观测由本地私有状态（SoC、可用性、目标、电价历史等）与配电网侧图上下文（母线电压、净负荷）拼接而成。
3) **动作条件电压残差头**：在LinDistFlow物理预测基础上，叠加由图神经网络学习的残差项预测后置动作母线电压；采用钉板损失（pinball loss）训练中位数头与分位数头。
4) **风险到权限调度器**：综合学习风险与物理守卫风险，取两者的95%分位数最大值作为风险度量，通过单调映射转化为干预权限Δ_t ∈ [Δ_min, Δ_max]。
5) **物理锚定投影**：当物理守卫触发时，以LinDistFlow灵敏度J_t的方向作为约束法向量，通过序贯凸集投影扫描（10次扫描）求解最小加权范数修正，确保修正方向始终来自物理而非学习模型。
6) **训练机制**：双Q网络SAC + 平均场动作统计；PID更新的母线乘子λ_b自适应调整电压成本；训练时不包含部署投影，部署时插入a^proj于a^RL与服务映射之间。
AI.result:
1) **骨干对比**：在CRE21 K1–K32的五个嵌套规模上，HetGPS在所有五个场景均获得最高可行奖励；在3,218辆EV规模下，部署模型仅含383,702参数，约为同等条件集中式SAC演员（6,520万参数）的1/170。
2) **自适应权限效果**：母线-步长电压违规率从无过滤的3.93–7.74%降至0.52–3.44%，出发成功率维持99.06–100%；相较固定权限，自适应权限在全部5个CRE21网络上改善平均奖励，在4个网络上降低平均安全评分m_s。
3) **空间-时间干预分析**：在K=32代表日，候选权限范围0.259–0.285，24步中有9步触发过滤；自适应权限较无过滤降低89.7%违规数，较固定权限再降18.8%。
4) **拓扑迁移**：K=8训练的策略零样本迁移至K=16与K=32，违规率分别0.75%与0.57%，m_s为0.324与0.338，出发成功率≥99.99%；25个episode的K=32微调使奖励从-105.38提升至-97.45。
5) **物理方向验证**：与AC潮流有限差分导数对比，物理方向余弦相似度中位数达0.939–0.973，方向对齐优于学习残差雅可比（0.775–0.988）。
AI.conclusion: HetGPS证明了"学习的图风险可在大规模下分配干预权限，配电网物理锚定修正方向"这一原理的可行性。其参数共享架构实现了跨车队规模的可扩展性，零样本迁移能力进一步支持异构拓扑部署。然而证据仍为经验性的：平衡潮流假设与δ_m=0排除了逐点可行性声明，实际部署需要经过验证的模型误差余量。该学习的权限/物理方向分解范式可推广至逆变器/储能协调、区域供热、供水网络等具备一阶动作-约束灵敏度的图耦合系统；跨域验证与认证边界是重要未来方向。

title: Multi-Dimensional Assessment for AI Cognition (MAAC): A Theoretical Framework for Process-Oriented Cognitive Evaluation of Text-Based AI Systems
summary: Evaluating artificial intelligence systems has historically relied on outcome-based benchmarks that measure task accuracy, robustness, or fairness. While indispensable, these benchmarks provide limited diagnostic insight into the underlying cognitive processes that generate performance-leaving critical questions unanswered about how AI systems reason, integrate memory, manage complexity, or avoid generating false information. This paper introduces the Multi-Dimensional Assessment for AI Cognition (MAAC), a theoretically grounded framework for shifting evaluation from what text-based AI systems produce to how they think. MAAC defines nine cognitively motivated dimensions: Cognitive Load, Tool Execution, Content Quality, Memory Integration, Complexity Handling, Hallucination Control, Knowledge Transfer, Processing Efficiency, and Process-Outcome Alignment. Each dimension is grounded in established cognitive science theory-drawing on Marr's tri-level hypothesis, Baddeley's working memory model, Sweller's cognitive load theory, and unified theories of cognition. Five theoretical analyses provide initial support for the framework's coherence and empirical testability: dimension-to-theory mapping; a coverage matrix assessing breadth and non-redundancy; a formal gap analysis relative to current evaluation practice; a worked diagnostic illustration; and a set of a priori interdependency predictions for future empirical testing. MAAC provides a theoretical and operational framework for principled process-level cognitive assessment of text-based AI systems, complementing existing outcome-based benchmarks with cognitively grounded, multi-dimensional evaluation.

AI.tldr: MAAC是一个理论框架，提出九个认知维度来评估文本AI系统的认知过程，而非仅关注任务结果，旨在弥补现有基准测试在过程导向诊断上的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评估主要依赖结果导向的基准测试（如MMLU、BIG-bench、HELM），仅能判断系统"做什么"而无法揭示"如何做"。作者认为在高风险部署场景中，需要区分真正推理与模式匹配，因此构建一个基于认知科学理论的、可诊断AI认知过程的框架。
AI.method: 通过结构化范围综述（2025年1-6月，108篇文献）提炼构念；定义九个认知维度（CL、TE、CQ、MI、CH、HC、KT、PE、POA）并锚定到Marr算法层级；实施五项理论分析：维度-理论映射、覆盖矩阵、差距闭合分析、诊断示例工作流、先验互依预测（7个含阈值的有方向预测）。
AI.result: 框架在理论层面支持内容效度（H1）、覆盖完整性（H1c）、差距闭合（H3）、诊断效用（H1b）四项假设；结构效度（H2）以七个有方向的互依预测（六个正、一个负）形式明确提出，等待未来实证。所有九个构念类别被覆盖，无冗余；POA作为最独特贡献回应CoT忠实性问题。
AI.conclusion: MAAC将过程导向的AI认知评估确立为科学可证伪的研究纲领，引入九维认知剖面作为新分析单位；当前仅为理论框架，需未来实证验证LLM评判员评分架构、维度间相关结构及多系统比较，且应警惕博弈风险。

title: When Does LLM Orchestration Pay Off? A Controlled Evaluation of Accuracy, Cost, and Task Difficulty
summary: LLM orchestration is often assumed to improve reasoning by allocating additional inference-time computation, yet its gains may not justify its cost. Existing comparisons also frequently overlook differences in optimization effort, making it difficult to isolate the value of orchestration itself. We conduct a controlled evaluation of Self-Refine, Best-of-$N$, and Debate against task-only and chain-of-thought (CoT) single-call baselines across five LLM backbones and three domains: competitive programming, chess puzzles, and mathematics. For comparability, we optimize each method with GEPA under the same optimization budget and evaluate all methods on the same difficulty-stratified benchmark items. Orchestration yields moderate but benchmark-dependent gains: averaged across backbones within each benchmark, the largest improvement is 4.6 percentage points over optimized CoT inference and 4.5 points over task-only inference, while requiring approximately 2 to 4 times the mean total tokens of task-only inference. Human-derived difficulty is associated with lower absolute accuracy in all three benchmarks, but within-benchmark analyses do not indicate that orchestration effects increase with task difficulty. By contrast, exploratory mixed-effects analyses reveal strong interactions between orchestration method and backbone model across all three benchmarks, showing that orchestration effectiveness depends substantially on the underlying model. Our results suggest that orchestration decisions should be model-specific and account for whether moderate accuracy gains justify the additional inference cost. More broadly, evaluations of LLM orchestrations should control optimization effort and report model-specific accuracy--cost trade-offs rather than treating additional inference-time structure as uniformly beneficial.

AI.tldr: 本文对Self-Refine、Best-of-N和Debate三种LLM编排方法在5个开源LLM、3个领域(编程、国际象棋、数学)、统一GEPA优化预算下进行了配对控制评估,发现编排带来中等且依赖基准的精度提升(最高4.6个百分点),代价是token消耗增至2–4倍;人类难度预测绝对精度但不预测编排增益,而方法×骨干模型交互作用显著,说明编排效果高度依赖底层模型。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM编排(orchestration)研究通常假设额外的推理时计算能提升推理能力,但其增益是否值得开销缺乏控制性证据;且已有比较常混淆工作流结构、骨干模型、提示优化投入等因素,无法孤立评估编排本身的价值。此外,难度感知系统虽利用任务复杂度分配算力,但尚未证实固定编排的相对收益随人类难度单调递增。
AI.method: 采用配对控制设计:在Easy2Hard-Bench的Lichess、Codeforces、AMC三个基准(均含人类难度估计)的200项固定子集上,固定解码设置、评判规则与训练数据,用GEPA在750次metric调用+token预算(每基准统一)下自动优化每种方法的提示;评估5个开源LLM(DeepSeek V4 Flash、Gemma 4、GLM 4.7 Flash、Qwen 3.6、GPT-OSS Puzzle 88B)上的task-only、CoT、Self-Refine、Best-of-N、Debate;以加权token为资源度量,采用混合logit模型(M0–M3)检验方法主效应、方法×难度交互及方法×LLM交互,辅以9999次整项bootstrap与Holm校正。
AI.result: 编排在Codeforces和AMC上带来中等、依赖基准的精度提升:Self-Refine和BoN相对优化后CoT分别+4.6与+4.2点(Codeforces)、+1.9与+2.6点(AMC),但Lichess上无编排显著优于CoT,Debate在三个基准上均未显著超越CoT;编排平均消耗2–4倍task-only的加权token。人类难度与绝对精度强负相关(Spearman ρ=-0.485至-0.660),但方法×难度交互不显著(M2未改善拟合),即编排相对收益不随难度单调递增;而方法×LLM交互在三个基准均极显著(p<0.002),呈现强烈的骨干依赖性(如GLM上BoN在Codeforces获+18.0点,而DeepSeek上BoN反而-4.0点)。
AI.conclusion: 在统一优化预算下,LLM编排仅提供中等、基准依赖且模型依赖的精度增益,需要2–4倍的推理开销;Self-Refine和BoN在编程和数学上略优于CoT,但Debate未带来显著收益。人类难度虽能预测绝对精度,却无法指导编排选择,编排效果主要由骨干模型与工作流的具体能力匹配决定。因此,编排决策应模型特定,且必须报告受控优化下的精度–资源权衡,不应将额外推理时结构视为普遍有益。

title: Evolutionary Curriculum Learning Improves Biological Sequence Modeling
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) trained on multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) have emerged as powerful generative models for biological sequences, with applications ranging from disease variant prediction to functional RNA design. However, standard biological VAE training treats all sequences as exchangeable, ignoring the rich evolutionary structure that organizes homologous sequences from evolutionarily close to highly divergent. We propose Evolutionary Curriculum Learning (ECL), a training strategy that exploits this structure by progressively exposing the model to sequences of increasing evolutionary distance from sampled anchors, following a power-law expansion schedule. Applied to two architecturally distinct VAE models and two biological domains--protein variant effect prediction with EVE and RNA family sequence generation with RfamGen--ECL improves downstream task performance across five random seeds per configuration. Mean ClinVar classification AUROC rises from 0.981 to 0.989 for p53; for PTEN, ECL attains 1.000 in every seed whereas the baseline is unstable (mean 0.905, falling as low as 0.54). For RNA, ECL raises mean covariance-model bit scores on all three families tested and exceeds its seed-matched baseline in 12 of 15 training runs, though with only three families the effect cannot be established as significant at the family level. Ablation experiments show that progressively expanding the sampled sequences by evolutionary distance outperforms fixed-size neighborhood sampling in addition to uniform random sampling. Evolutionary distance is therefore a useful inductive bias for ordering the training curriculum in biological sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出进化课程学习（Evolutionary Curriculum Learning, ECL），一种基于进化距离由近及远渐进采样训练序列的即插即用训练策略，应用于基于多序列比对（MSA）的变分自编码器（VAE）。在蛋白质变体致病性预测（EVE）和RNA家族序列生成（RfamGen）两个模型、两类生物数据上，ECL均稳定提升下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 基于MSA训练的生物序列VAE（如EVE用于蛋白质变体致病性预测，RfamGen用于RNA家族序列生成）将所有序列视为可交换的（exchangeable），忽略了同源序列间丰富的进化结构——从进化距离近到高度分歧的连续谱。这构成了天然的学习难度层次：近邻序列提供局部一致的结构与功能约束，远缘序列引入更大变异，模型较难学习。标准随机梯度训练在形成minibatch时未能利用此结构，未能将进化距离作为无需标注的"难度代理"融入训练过程。
AI.method: ECL仅改变采样顺序，无需架构改动。具体而言：（1）预处理阶段一次性计算所有序列对之间的进化距离：蛋白质采用WAG+Γ（4类离散Gamma校正，α=1.0）模型估计配对进化时间；RNA采用协方差模型（CM）特征空间下的归一化ℓ2距离之和。（2）每个训练步t，先按系统发育权重π采样一个锚点序列a，再从a的k(t)-最近邻中按权重采样B-1个邻居组成批次。（3）邻域大小k(t)按幂律（对数线性）扩展：k(t)=⌈k₀·((N-1)/k₀)^s⌉，其中s=((t-1)/(T-1))^γ，γ=2.0。从初始k₀扩展至N-1。默认超参数：EVE中k₀=255（≈1×B），RfamGen中k₀=240（≈30×B）。该方法叠加于系统发育重加权（phylogenetic reweighting）之上。
AI.result: 在EVE蛋白质变体致病性分类（ClinVar AUROC）上：p53从0.981提升至0.989（4/5种子胜出，p=0.075）；PTEN上ECL在所有5个种子均达1.000，基线均值为0.905且极度不稳定（最低0.54），体现稳定性提升；SCN5A因评估集全为致病性变异（23/23）无法计算AUROC。在RfamGen RNA序列生成（CM bit score）上：ECL在3个RNA家族（RF00169: +3.7%, 5/5；RF00234: +7.5%, 3/5；RF00638: +0.9%, 4/5）上均提升均值；3家族15次种子匹配比较中ECL胜出12次（精确符号检验p=0.035）。消融实验显示：固定k的局部采样（无扩展）在p53上反而比基线差-0.0332（p=0.0001），证明渐进扩展是关键；KL退火策略解耦实验证明课程采样而非退火策略是改进主因。超参数扫描显示k₀与γ在较宽范围内结果稳健（p53上AUROC始终≥基线）。
AI.conclusion: ECL是一种简单有效的训练策略改进，能为基于MSA的生物序列VAE提供进化结构作为归纳偏置，且无需架构改动、几乎无额外计算开销。其核心价值在于将"从局部到全局"的幂律采样课程作为生物学上合理且无需标注的难度代理。在两个生物学模态（蛋白质与RNA）和两个架构迥异的模型上均观察到方向一致的改进。但论文坦承存在若干局限：效应量相对种子方差较小（多数单次比较p>0.05）；RNA聚合检验（12/15, p=0.035）的推断单元是训练运行而非家族，3家族不足以支持家族层面普适性；评估集小且不平衡（PTEN仅2个良性变体）；O(N²)距离预计算限制其在更深MSA上的可扩展性。未来工作应在更大基准上评估、探索替代进化距离度量，并检验该课程原则是否同样惠及非VAE序列模型。

title: DGA$_2$D: Directed Graph-Guided Automated Algorithm Design with Large Language Models
summary: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has opened new avenues for Automated Heuristic Design (AHD) for solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems (COPs). However, existing LLM-driven AHD methods are largely confined to rigid solver templates, relegating the search process to isolated module tuning. Transitioning to fully autonomous, system-level algorithm design is essential but fraught with low reliability of generated operators, extremely large search spaces, and ineffective credit assignment. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper proposes a Directed Graph-Guided Automated Algorithm Design framework, termed DGA$_2$D. It structures the open-ended program space as a directed graph, where each node represents a functional operator that can be instantiated using one of multiple candidate code implementations, while directed walks constitute complete algorithmic pipelines. A first-order path-dependent credit assignment mechanism is introduced to evaluate code variations strictly based on their topological context. Extensive experiments across 12 distinct COPs, ranging from complex scheduling to routing, demonstrate the consistent empirical advantages of DGA$_2$D. It reduces the average normalized gap by up to 10.96 percentage points compared to state-of-the-art LLM baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DGA2D 框架，将算法搜索空间建模为有向图（节点为功能算子，边为执行序列），结合一阶路径相关的信用分配机制，由 LLM 驱动实现系统级、自动化的启发式算法设计。在 12 类 NP-hard 组合优化问题上显著优于现有 LLM 驱动的 AHD 基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的自动启发式设计（AHD）方法局限于固定求解器模板，仅在孤立模块层面调优，难以实现系统级、自动化的算法设计。向完全自主的算法设计过渡面临三大挑战：(1) 生成算法可靠性低（编译错误、接口不匹配、逻辑失败）；(2) 开放程序空间极其庞大，高性能算法稀疏；(3) 信用分配无效（性能只能在完整算法评估后才能观测）。因此需要新的搜索空间表示和信用分配机制。
AI.method: DGA2D 包含四个核心组件：(1) 基于 LLM 的初始化——利用自然语言问题描述构建超参数空间和基础算子池；(2) 有向图引导的算法构建——将有向图 $\mathcal{D}_t=(\mathcal{O}_t,\mathcal{E}_t)$ 作为共享搜索空间，每个算子节点关联多个候选代码实现，有向游走构成完整算法流水线；(3) 多层次信用分配——算法级采用标准化归一化间隙作为终端奖励，流水线级通过 REINFORCE 优化采样策略，代码实现级采用一阶 Markov 近似的 $Q$ 值更新；(4) 信用引导的双层进化——基于聚合信用同时进化算子实现池（有界容量 $M$）和有向图边结构（替换负信用边）。完整算法流程在训练生成式 LLM 策略和局部信用诱导优化方面有严格的理论分析（Theorem 1-5）。
AI.result: 在 12 类 NP-hard 组合优化问题（涵盖调度、路由、空间分配、图优化四大类）上的实验表明：(1) 在四个代表性基准（FJSP、TSP、3D-CLP、MIS）上，DGA2D 一致优于 EoH、MCTS-AHD、MEoH、ReEvo 四种 LLM 基线，在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 下平均归一化间隙降低 9.67 个百分点，在 GPT-5.6 Sol 下降低 10.96 个百分点；(2) 消融实验表明，有向图（含环结构）优于固定/线性/DAG 结构，且一阶路径相关信用优于零阶、二阶及全路径信用；(3) 算子池容量敏感性分析表明 $K=15\sim20$ 较优；(4) 在八个额外基准（CVRP、JSP、OSSP、SALBP-1、3D-BPP、FSSP、RCPSP、Max-Cut）上均排名第一；(5) 资源消耗分析显示，相比 MCTS-AHD，总耗时减少 27.4%，总 token 消耗减少 24.1%；(6) 扩展实验显示，在 ODE 求解（平均分 13.79 vs Radau 7.56）、反馈控制、根求解等连续数值任务上同样有效。
AI.conclusion: DGA2D 将 LLM 驱动的 AHD 从孤立启发式优化拓展至系统级算法进化，通过有向图表示联合进化算子实现与连接结构，借助一阶上下文相关信用分配实现跨流水线反馈共享，避免全路径条件化的稀疏性。12 类问题的广泛实验与有向图表示、一阶实现转换评分等消融结果均验证了方法的有效性。其局限性在于生成算法的计算成本、对初始算子池的敏感性以及潜在的跨模块不一致问题，未来工作将聚焦更高效评估、自适应算子池构建及更强的程序不变性检查。

title: Tracing the Cascade: A Topology-Aware Evaluation Framework for Scientific Agent Hallucinations
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in scientific research, where reliability is critical and the underlying knowledge is densely interconnected. In such settings, hallucinations are particularly damaging: a single erroneous claim on a foundational concept can propagate through multi-step reasoning and corrupt entire trajectories. Existing hallucination benchmarks largely operate at the surface level, treating facts in isolation and relying on uniform accuracy metrics that ignore this topological structure. We address this gap with SCHEMA, the first evidence-grounded, topology-aware evaluation framework for hallucinations in scientific agents. SCHEMA automatically constructs scientific concept graphs from benchmark seeds and literature evidence, synthesizes graph-grounded tasks spanning claim verification, multi-hop reasoning, open-ended explanation, and experimental code generation, and evaluates agents with two complementary diagnostics. A trajectory hallucination pipeline audits intermediate reasoning at scale via a topology-weighted severity score, while a multi-agent counterfactual attribution module pinpoints the causal mechanism behind selected failures. SCHEMA reveals that hallucinations concentrate at a small set of highly connected knowledge hubs, and that final-answer accuracy decouples from trajectory honesty; models often reach correct conclusions through structurally flawed reasoning. These results indicate that for high-stakes scientific applications, terminal accuracy alone is an insufficient signal of agent reliability, motivating mechanism-level evaluation grounded in knowledge topology. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SCHEMA是首个面向科学领域LLM智能体的、基于证据且拓扑感知的幻觉评估框架，通过构建科学概念图谱来评估智能体推理轨迹中的幻觉问题，揭示了幻觉集中在高度连接的知识枢纽上，且最终答案准确性与推理轨迹的诚实性相互脱耦。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉评估基准主要在表层层面操作，将事实在孤立条件下处理，并依赖统一的准确性指标，忽略了科学知识密集互联的拓扑结构。在科学研究等高可靠性场景中，单个关于基础概念的错误声明可能通过多步推理传播并破坏整个推理轨迹，因此需要一种能够感知知识拓扑结构、进行机制级评估的方法。
AI.method: SCHEMA框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 自动从基准种子和文献证据构建科学概念图；(2) 综合生成基于图谱的任务，涵盖声明验证、多跳推理、开放式解释和实验代码生成四种类型；(3) 采用两种互补的诊断方法进行评估——通过拓扑加权严重性分数对中间推理进行大规模审计的轨迹幻觉流水线，以及定位特定失败因果机制的多智能体反事实归因模块。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：(1) 幻觉集中在少量高度连接的知识枢纽上；(2) 最终答案的准确性与推理轨迹的诚实性脱耦，即模型经常通过结构上有缺陷的推理得出正确结论。这些发现表明，仅靠终端准确性不足以衡量智能体在高风险科学应用中的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 在高风险科学应用中，仅依赖终端准确性作为智能体可靠性的信号是不充分的，研究结果强调了基于知识拓扑结构进行机制级评估的必要性。SCHEMA为此提供了首个系统化的解决方案，代码已开源。

title: AI-Based Thesis Assessment: An Empirical Study of Human Evaluation Priorities and Their Impact on Automated Assessment
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 7th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education Technology (AIET 2026), Zagreb, Croatia
summary: Rubric-based AI systems for thesis assessment use criterion weights to assign different levels of importance to evaluation criteria. These weights are typically defined through expert judgment, although little empirical evidence exists regarding how thesis supervisors actually prioritize evaluation criteria. Consequently, this study investigates supervisor-derived criterion weights in thesis assessment and evaluates their impact on AI-based assessment. We surveyed 84 thesis supervisors across four academic disciplines and collected weighting data for 35 thesis assessment criteria. Comparison with the default criterion weights of the AI assessment system RubiSCoT [1] revealed substantial divergences between supervisor-derived and default criterion weights. To evaluate the practical implications of these differences, the supervisor-derived weights were integrated into multiple calibration configurations and evaluated on a corpus of 80 German-language theses. The best-performing configuration reduced the mean relative deviation between AI-generated and supervisor-assigned evaluations from 11.18% to 10.85%, although the improvement was not statistically significant. Human supervisors showed substantially stronger agreement with each other, exhibiting a mean inter-supervisor relative deviation of 4.44%. The findings indicate that criterion-weight calibration alone does not substantially improve alignment between AI-generated and human assessments.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过调查84名论文导师获得35项评估标准的实证权重数据，并与AI评估系统RubiSCoT的默认权重进行比较，在80篇德语论文上测试了5种校准配置，发现权重校准仅将AI与人类评估的偏差从11.18%微降至10.85%（不具有统计显著性），远高于人类导师之间4.44%的互评偏差，表明仅靠标准权重校准不足以显著改善人机评估一致性。
AI.motivation: 基于评分量表的AI论文评估系统使用标准权重来衡量各评估维度的重要性，但这些权重通常由专家判断或实施假设定义，缺乏关于导师实际如何优先排序评估标准的实证证据。这种脱节可能导致AI评估在技术上保持一致的同时，与人类评估行为产生系统性偏差。
AI.method: 采用常数和分配法（constant-sum allocation）对84名来自商业经济、社会科学、STEM和人文4个学科的论文导师进行调查，收集其对5个论文章节（引言、文献综述、研究设计、结果与讨论、结论）下35个评估标准的权重分配。将聚合后的导师权重与RubiSCoT系统的默认权重进行MAE比较。在80篇德语论文（BA/B.Sc./MA/M.Sc.各20篇）上测试5种校准配置（默认、全局、学位层次、学科层次、组合），以AI与人类评分之间的平均相对偏差衡量一致性，并进行配对t检验和Cohen's d效应量分析。
AI.result: 人机权重差异最大的出现在引言（MAE=6.92%）和文献综述（MAE=6.72%）等解释性较强的章节，AI系统对学术定位和分析综合等高阶标准的权重远高于导师（差距达15.5%–16.0%），而研究设计等方法论章节差异较小（MAE=1.70%）。最佳配置（Combined）将整体平均相对偏差从11.18%降至10.85%（相对改善2.95%），但配对t检验不显著（t(79)=0.75, p=.458, d=0.08）。结果与讨论章节改善最大（10.91%→9.81%）。人类导师互评偏差仅为4.44%，远低于AI的最佳表现。
AI.conclusion: 仅调整标准权重不足以显著改善AI与人类评估之间的一致性。最大的权重分歧出现在需要解释性判断的章节（如引言、文献综述），而AI校准在评估标准定义明确、与分析任务紧密关联的章节（结果与讨论）效果最好。差异更多源于评分标准的解释、证据评估和评估推理，而非权重分配本身。未来校准应同时关注评分标准解读、证据评估和评估推理等因素，并探索动态权重方法。

title: Behavioral Grammar: Detecting Adaptive Malware via Tiny Language Model Priors and Second-Order Temporal Analysis
summary: Modern endpoint detection systems face a fundamental tension: signature-based approaches are trivially evaded by polymorphic or adaptive threats, while heavy deep-learning models resist auditability and deployment at scale. This paper presents Behavioral Grammar, a detection architecture that treats host runtime behavior as a structured language and learns its grammar with a compact 0.88M-parameter causal Transformer (TinyGPT). Each system event is discretized into an 8-token representation spanning event type, process, argument skeleton, path category, parent process, user, destination, and inter-event timing. The model learns the conditional distribution of normal behavior in a purely self-supervised manner, and anomaly scores are derived from per-slot negative log-likelihood (NLL) statistics, yielding a mathematically bounded false-positive rate. We augment this prior with prototype learning for known-attack attribution, second-order temporal analysis for cadence-based detection, self-learning pattern extraction, and a five-network fusion pipeline. Against an Adaptive Adversarial Agent (AAA)--a threat that learns survival strategies under defensive pressure, performs behavioral mimicry, and matches host event rates--our system achieves 93% detection at 3.84% onboarding false-positive rate. The strongest discriminative signal arises not from any single event but from the coefficient of variation of inter-event intervals: the AAA stepping cadence exhibits CV=0.310 versus 9.786 for benign sleep intervals, a 30x separation reflecting a fundamental stealth-functionality trade-off. We frame these findings within a coevolutionary economics model, arguing that behavior-grammar detection shifts the evasion cost from rule circumvention (cheap) to distribution matching (expensive), establishing a structural asymmetry favoring the defender.

AI.tldr: 提出"行为文法"（Behavioral Grammar）检测框架：将主机运行时行为视为结构化语言，使用仅0.88M参数的TinyGPT因果Transformer学习正常行为的条件分布，并通过8-token字段级离散化、逐槽位NLL异常评分、原型学习、二阶时间分析（CV节奏特征）和五网络融合实现端点检测。针对具备行为模仿、间接执行、时序跟随的自适应恶意代理（AAA），实现93%检测率与3.84%误报率；最关键的判别信号是事件间隔变异系数（AAA的CV=0.310 vs 良性9.786，30倍差异），揭示了隐身-功能性之间的结构性权衡。
AI.motivation: 现代端点检测面临根本矛盾：基于签名的方法可被多态/自适应威胁轻易规避，而深度学习模型难以审计且难以大规模部署。自适应恶意软件（能学习防御反馈、模仿宿主行为分布、匹配事件速率）进一步加剧了这一矛盾。本文论点是：主机运行时行为在字段层面具有高度"语法性"——进程名、父进程、参数形状、路径类别、用户上下文、网络目的地、事件时间间隔在正常操作中分布极窄；攻击者无论采用何种规避策略，其目标导向行为必然在某些维度违反这一语法。本文将异常检测重新框定为在小型词表上的条件概率估计问题，主张紧凑模型即可胜任，因为语法本身是紧凑的。
AI.method:
1. **遥测采集**：基于Tracee的eBPF管道，钩取sched_process_exec和security_socket_connect。
2. **8-token字段级离散化**（关键创新）：每个事件表示为[ET, PROC, ARGV(参数骨架), PC(路径类别), PARENT, UID, DST(目的地分类), DT(时间桶)]；ARGV只保留形状（参数计数、URL/IP/path/base64标志）以实现隐私保护；PC槽位在迭代中被加入，使三种持久化技术从对比损失3.0降至0（线性可分）。
3. **TinyGPT先验**：4层因果Transformer，d_model=128，4头注意力，FFN=512，128事件上下文，263词表，0.88M参数；纯自监督训练（116K事件，7台VM，AdamW，lr=3e-4，2 epoch），验证困惑度1.6。
4. **逐槽位阈值校准**：在每个8个槽位上独立按p99.5校准τ，并证明纯阈值调整无法同时降低FPR并提高检测裕度（结构性不可能结果）；只能通过更多数据改善。
5. **跨机器基线迁移**：多VM联合先验+目标机20分钟在线校准，将跨机器FPR从92.5%降至3.84%。
6. **原型学习**：冻结编码器嵌入，每种MITRE ATT&CK技术学习K=3个原型（约80KB码本），通过余弦距离+几何中点半径实现零FPR构造；留一法96.2%捕获率。
7. **二阶时间分析**（最强信号）：计算进程事件间隔的变异系数CV=σ/μ；良性过程CV>>1.5（突发驱动），AAA活跃进程CV<1.5（规则步进节奏）；CV=1.5处实现30倍分离。
8. **自适应事件检测**：滑动窗口模式匹配（SLEEP_STEPPING、RECON_UNIFORM、DISGUISE_C2、MORPH_TRANSFORM、SUID_PRIVESC）。
9. **五网络融合（P0-P5）**：优先级去重，自适应高危/原型/逐槽位上下文/稀有度/时间节奏/自适应低危；置信度分层响应策略。
10. **自学习模式提取**：嵌入→K-means（K=22，轮廓系数0.653）→人工审核→模式库。
11. **闭环对抗验证**：三轮红蓝对抗，证明父进程链假设被经验性证伪，时间节奏成为真正检测面。
12. **理论框架**：共同进化经济学模型——规则规避是O(1)操作，基线规避是O(d)操作；提出"指纹增量"、"数据吞吐量不对称（10^4-10^5倍）"、"暴露守恒"、"防御摊销"等结构性不对称原则。
AI.result:
**核心性能**：针对AAA实现93%检测率、3.84%上线FPR（7台未见VM的留一验证平均FPR=3.4%）。
**最强判别信号**：AAA步进节奏CV=0.310 vs 良性睡眠CV=9.786，30倍分离；时间层（P4）单独实现89.7%检测率与9.3% FPR（区分度+80.5%）。
**四代模型演进**：检测率稳定在93-94%，主要改进在误报降低（P2+P3 FPR从69%降至9.5%，下降86%）；时间检测从67%提升至92%。
**消融研究**：移除P4使检测率从93%降至73.9%（-19.1pp）；仅先验（P2/P3）对自适应威胁检测仅0.4%。
**原型网络**：14种ATT&CK技术留一法96.2%捕获率，技术级召回14/14，良性与原型零误报，码本约80KB。
**闭环修复**：11/11端到端攻击→检测→清理→验证全通过。
**经验性发现**：父进程链（PARENT）维度对AAA的间接执行免疫（sh -c产生大量良性伪阳性）；原型网络对模仿行为零命中（AAA是"反黑名单专家"）；AAA的v4对数正态步进策略将CV从接近0提升至约0.7，仍远低于良性1.5阈值。
**跨机器泛化**：v1主机先验92.5% FPR → 多VM联合先验9.5% → 加入在线校准后3.84%。
AI.conclusion:
**结论一：表示决定检测上限**。8-token字段级离散化（而非模型容量）是约束瓶颈；增加单个路径类别槽位即可使三种不可分的持久化技术线性可分；模型规模应服从语法复杂度，而非基准驱动的参数膨胀。
**结论二：自适应行为存在结构性极限**。隐身-功能性权衡通过事件间隔变异系数数学化表达，形成无法在不牺牲操作能力的前提下关闭的检测面；AAA的CV=0.310是目标导向自适应行为的结构属性，而非实现伪影。
**结论三：共同进化经济学有利于防御者**。规则规避代价为零；基线规避代价高昂；防御者离线批量学习，攻击者通过实时探测评估适应；每增加一种规避技术都开启新观察面；这些结构性不对称不会随算法进步而缩小——它们反映离线批量学习与在线序贯适应之间的根本差异。
**研究启示**：检测工作应聚焦于更好的表示、更多独立观察面和更快的基线更新周期，而非更大模型；行为文法框架紧凑、可审计、可在边缘设备部署，证明了该方向的实用可行性与理论基础。论文采用不对称披露策略：检测侧完全开源，威胁模型仅在抽象层描述。
**局限性**：分布漂移需要周期性基线重训练；内核级rootkit使eBPF失效不在范围内；shell内建命令不可见；极低速率攻击稀释EWMA；原型库仅覆盖Linux ATT&CK矩阵14/数百种技术；归因精度约60%限制了全自动化。

title: FinDeepIndicator: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in End-to-End Financial Indicator Construction
summary: Financial indicators are essential tools for transforming raw financial data into interpretable measures for various downstream tasks, such as valuation, risk assessment, and economic analysis. However, existing financial benchmarks largely focus on answer-level accuracy and often assume that relevant data are already provided, leaving the assessment of the intermediate process of indicator construction underexplored. In this work, we propose FinDeepIndicator, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating Deep Research (DR) agents in end-to-end financial indicator construction. Specifically, FinDeepIndicator evaluates DR agents across four stages in indicator construction: formula specification, data collection, indicator calculation, and answer generation, and covers fundamental, technical, and macroeconomic indicators organized into 21 fine-grained sub-categories. It contains 3,350 curated question-answer (QA) pairs derived from both U.S. and Chinese markets, 10 years of historical financial data, and 800 listed companies. Extensive experiments on search-equipped Large Language Models (LLMs) and DR agents show that, while LLMs generally perform well in formula specification, their accuracy drops substantially during data retrieval and numerical execution. DR agents consistently outperform search-equipped LLMs, yet remain unreliable in realistic financial analysis settings. These findings provide insights for developing more capable and trustworthy DR agents in finance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 FinDeepIndicator,首个专门用于评估深度研究(DR)智能体在端到端金融指标构建任务上的基准。该基准将指标构建过程分解为四个阶段(公式规范、数据收集、指标计算、答案生成),涵盖234个金融指标、3,350个QA对,跨越中美两国市场及800家上市公司10年历史数据。实验表明,即使表现最好的模型最终答案准确率也仅约40%,数据收集是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准主要关注答案层面的准确性,且通常假设相关数据已直接提供,忽视了对指标构建中间过程的评估。此外,缺乏专门针对金融指标构建的基准,现有基准要么覆盖有限,要么将评估局限于最终答案正确性,无法揭示模型在金融推理过程中的具体局限性。
AI.method: 1. 提出四阶段过程级评估框架:公式规范、数据收集、指标计算、答案生成。2. 构建金融指标分类法,包含3大类(基本面、技术面、宏观经济)、21个子类、共234个指标。3. 采用模板化QA生成方法,通过三阶段流水线(指标收集、模板设计、QA生成)产出3,350个QA对,并设三档难度(简单/中等/困难)。4. 使用LLM解析响应为结构化组件,采用LLM-as-Judge评估公式语义等价性,对数据表格和数值采用容差感知匹配。5. 评估了7个搜索增强LLM和基于ReAct范式的DR智能体。
AI.result: 1. 所有方法端到端构建能力有限:最佳模型最终答案准确率仅约40%,而公式准确率普遍超过70%。2. 智能体相比搜索LLM有显著但模型依赖性的提升。3. 数据收集是主要瓶颈,从公式规范到数据收集阶段准确率下降约40%。4. 中美市场存在模型依赖性的差异,某些模型在美股表现优于A股。5. 宏观经济指标最具挑战性,多数模型准确率低于30%。6. 错误分析显示数据错误占87.7%,其中错误数据检索占50.1%、缺失关键字段占19.8%、时间窗口错误占10.2%。7. 直接提供数据后,基本和宏观指标性能可超过80%,但技术指标仍存在挑战。
AI.conclusion: FinDeepIndicator作为首个端到端金融指标构建基准,揭示了当前搜索增强LLM和DR智能体在金融分析中的局限性,特别是数据收集环节是核心瓶颈,而非金融知识理解。研究为开发更准确、透明、可信的金融智能体提供了方向,强调未来需重点提升跨异构数据源的信息检索、整合与计算能力。

title: Measurement Without Validity: The Compounding Reliability Problem in Agentic AI Evaluation
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to a peer-reviewed journal
summary: Agentic AI systems are evaluated using automated benchmarks whose scores justify deployment decisions, safety certifications, and regulatory compliance claims. We present an empirical analysis demonstrating that these scores are systematically less trustworthy than current practice acknowledges. The problem operates at three compounding layers. First, tasks are increasingly generated by language models: audits of ten popular benchmarks found validity flaws in seven and reporting gaps in all ten. Second, human users are replaced by LLM simulators, but calibration studies document inter-simulator variance up to 9 percentage points and systematic directional miscalibration, particularly for non-Standard American English speakers. Third, our structured survey of 55 papers finds that approximately 82% apply structurally mismatched, incomplete, or absent inter-rater reliability (IRR) metrics. These failures compound multiplicatively rather than additively. Under independence, a pipeline retaining 70% of valid signal at task generation, 80% at simulation, and 65% at judgment is at most 36% valid against the intended construct; the bound spans 0.22--0.54 across the empirical estimate range. We formalize this as $V_{\text{total}} \leq V_1 \times V_2 \times V_3$ and show it tightens further under correlated failures when the same model family operates across all three layers. We derive eight prescriptions grounded in psychometric science: a simulation calibration floor of $\text{ICC}(A,1) \geq 0.70$; domain-stratified reliability thresholds ($\alpha \geq 0.67$ / $0.70$ / $0.80$ by consequence level); structured IRR metric selection rules based on pipeline design; and IRR as a mandatory reporting field. The measurement tools exist; the field's task is to apply them.

AI.tldr: 本文针对智能体（agentic）AI 评估中由三层层叠失效导致的有效性（validity）系统性被高估问题，提出形式化复合模型 V_total ≤ V₁ × V₂ × V₃。基于实证文献与对 55 篇论文的结构化调研，证明在温和的单层效度损失下（V₁ ≈ 0.70, V₂ ≈ 0.80, V₃ ≈ 0.65），整体效度仅约 0.36（区间 0.22–0.54），并据此提出八条基于心理测量学的可操作规范。
AI.motivation: 智能体 AI 的基准分数被直接用于部署决策、安全认证与合规声明，但当前评估实践在任务生成、用户/世界模拟、评分判断三个层面均存在已发表、同行评审的具体效度失效证据，且这些失效以乘法而非加法方式复合。领域尚未量化这种复合效应，也未从心理测量学角度给出可执行的报告与阈值标准。
AI.method: 1) 任务生成层：引用并综合 Zhu et al. (2025) 对 10 个主流智能体基准的审计结果；2) 模拟校准层：综合 Seshadri et al. (2026) 在 τ-Bench 零售任务上对真实用户 vs. LLM 模拟用户的跨人群（美国/印度/肯尼亚/尼日利亚，含 AAVE 与印度英语）校准实验；3) 评分判断层：按四维编码方案（IRR 指标、评分者设计、测量尺度、结构匹配性）对 55 篇论文（2022–2026，覆盖 ACL/EMNLP/NeurIPS/ICLR 等）进行目的性分层抽样调查；4) 形式化三层层叠效度上界 V_total ≤ V₁ × V₂ × V₃，并在附录 B 给出独立性与相关失效两种情形的推导及估计协议。
AI.result: 1) 任务生成：10 个基准中 7 个存在任务或结果效度缺陷，10 个均存在报告缺口；2) 模拟校准：跨 LLM 模拟器成功率差异可达 9 个百分点，对非美式标准英语（尤其 AAVE、印度英语）用户存在系统性方向性失校准；3) 评分判断：55 篇论文中仅约 18%（10 篇）使用结构正确且有明确依据的 IRR 指标，11% 完全无 IRR，16% 存在结构性指标错配，31% 指标错误或仅报告百分比，24% 未报告任何指标；4) 复合结果：经验中点 V_total ≈ 0.36（上限 0.54，下限 0.225），非 SAE 人群降至 ≤ 0.30；同模型族跨三层操作时相关失效使上界进一步收紧。
AI.conclusion: 提出八条基于心理测量学的实践规范：① 模拟校准底线 ICC(A,1) ≥ 0.70；② 按评分管道结构而非惯例选择 IRR 指标（2 固定评分者用 Cohen's κ，≥3 完整矩阵名义尺度用 Fleiss' κ，缺失/轮换/有序/连续尺度用 Krippendorff's α）；③ 对有序/区间尺度同时报告 Fleiss' κ 与 Krippendorff's α 以暴露分布性失配；④ 跨模型族评审团以削弱自偏好偏差；⑤ 按后果分级阈值（探索性 α ≥ 0.67，安全/公平 α ≥ 0.70，部署/合规闸门 α ≥ 0.80）；⑥ 动态生成任务需以专家参考集做分布验证；⑦ 按人口与语言群体分层校准；⑧ 将 IRR 作为评测报告卡（EvalCards）的必填字段。核心结论：测量工具已存在，领域任务在于真正应用——形式化表述为「无有效性证据的分数不是测量，只是一个数字」。

title: AgentSLABench: Evaluating and Benchmarking Agentic Systems Under Resource Constraints
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Code, sealed test sets, and profiling artifacts available at: this https URL
summary: We present AgentSLABench, a resource-aware evaluation framework for autonomous AI agents that measures correctness alongside latency, cost, compute, memory, and network usage under declared resource budgets. Unlike standard benchmarks that report only accuracy, AgentSLABench produces a multi-dimensional profile per agent per task - the same way systems profilers (perf, pprof, cProfile) measure resource consumption of code, but extended with task correctness as a first-class dimension. AgentSLABench provides 16 task environments across 6 categories (5 core: multi-hop QA, retail substitution, code generation, web shopping, travel planning; 11 extended) with isolated Docker containers, declared CPU/memory/time/network budgets, sealed test sets with SHA256 hashes, and a standardized profiling protocol. We profile 5 general-purpose baseline agents (ReAct, PlanAndSolve, Reflexion, CoT, Random) plus 4 task-specialized agents, finding that specialized agents achieve 100% success on 3/5 core tasks (fact_qa, web_shopping, travel_planning) and 66.7-83.3% on retail and code_gen, while general baselines fail entirely on 4/5 domain tasks. Crucially, we report the Efficiency-Adjusted Success Rate (EASR) - success weighted by resource consumption relative to declared budgets - revealing that high accuracy at unbounded cost is not production-viable. We release the full infrastructure, sealed test sets, and profiling results to enable reproducible, resource-aware agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: AgentSLABench 是一个面向自主 AI 智能体的资源感知评估框架，将系统级 profiling 思路迁移到智能体评估中，在声明的 CPU/内存/时间/网络预算下，以正确性、延迟、成本、计算、内存和网络六大维度对智能体进行多维画像，并提出 Efficiency-Adjusted Success Rate (EASR) 指标。基准覆盖 16 个任务、3500 个测试样本，对 5 个通用基线和 4 个领域专用智能体进行 profiling，发现专用智能体在 3/5 核心任务上达到 100% 成功率且全部在预算内，而通用基线在 4/5 领域任务上完全失败（0%）。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准（如 WebShop、ALFWorld、SWE-bench、GAIA、AgentBench、ToolBench）仅报告任务正确性（accuracy/success rate），完全忽略生产环境中的延迟 SLA、成本预算、内存限制、API 速率限制等硬约束。这导致"排行榜冠军"在实际部署中因违反 SLA 而失败，造成昂贵的重新工程。论文以零售替代场景为例：一个 ReAct+GPT-4 智能体在无约束评估中准确率 78%，但延迟 3.2s、成本 $0.12、内存 1.2GB，无法满足 P99 <200ms、<$0.005、<512MB 的生产 SLA；而专用 RetailAgent 以 83% 准确率在 142ms/$0.002/180MB 下满足所有约束。核心动机是填补"任务成功"与"可生产部署"之间的评估鸿沟。
AI.method: 方法上提出"agent profiling"概念，将系统级 profiler（perf、pprof、cProfile）的资源测量范式扩展到智能体，将正确性作为与延迟、成本、计算、内存、网络并列的一类维度。具体设计包括：(1) 16 个 Docker 隔离的任务环境，每个任务声明 CPU/内存/壁时间/网络预算并通过 Docker 参数强制执行；(2) 标准化 profiling 协议（Algorithm 1），每个 episode 在三个种子（42/123/456）下执行，通过 /reset、/step REST 接口交互；(3) SHA256 密封的 test/challenge 集合防止数据污染；(4) EASR 指标定义为 success × min(1, budget_lat/actual_lat) × min(1, budget_cost/actual_cost) × min(1, budget_mem/actual_mem)，对超支成功的 episode 施加惩罚；(5) 每 episode JSONL profile 输出 6 大维度（correctness、latency、cost、compute、network、safety）；(6) 评估 5 个通用基线（ReAct、PlanAndSolve、Reflexion、CoT、Random）和 4 个领域专用智能体（RetailAgent、WebShoppingAgent、TravelPlanningAgent、CodeGenAgent）。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 成功率：专用智能体在 fact_qa、web_shop、travel_planning 上达到 100%，在 retail（83.3%）和 code_gen（66.7%）上部分成功；通用基线在 4/5 领域任务上完全失败（0%），仅在 fact_qa 上达到 100%。(2) 资源画像：所有专用智能体均在预算内运行，例如 retail 任务预算 180s/8GB，实际 142ms/180MB；travel 任务预算 600s/8GB，实际 4.1s/380MB。(3) 失败模式：CodeGenAgent 45% 失败源自 API 签名幻觉、30% 来自多文件生成超时；RetailAgent 60% 失败为捆绑替代的利润计算错误；TravelAgent 55% 为约束冲突。(4) 扩展任务：专用智能体在相关领域有一定迁移能力（42%–75%），通用基线仍为 0%。(5) 统计检验：仅 web_shop 和 travel 在 p<0.05 下显著，N=3 种子的 bootstrap CI 较宽，作者承认这是局限性，需 N≥10。(6) Judge 校准：Nemotron Ultra 在 100 个校准样本上 100% 有效 JSON 输出，人工抽查 20 样本 100% 一致。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张智能体评估必须从"是否成功"转向"在何种资源消耗下成功"，EASR 可作为部署前的"gate metric"，类似 MLPerf 驱动模型服务优化的角色。专用智能体通过编码领域 schema、工具约束和优化逻辑而非仅依靠 prompt engineering，在领域任务上显著优于通用推理基线，揭示了"专业化差距"（specialization gap）。框架通过 Docker 隔离、密封测试集、多种子 profiling 和完整工件发布实现可复现性。局限性包括：当前预算为启发式（应源自生产 SLA）、未强制 GPU 预算、内存预算未区分 RSS 与 swap、N=3 种子统计功效不足。作者定位 AgentSLABench 与 LangSmith/LangFuse 等生产可观测性工具互补，作为部署前的 profiling 标准而非替代运行时监控。

title: Large language models improve physician accuracy but lead to false reliance
summary: Retrieval-augmented large language models (LLMs) promise source-linked clinical support, but their value depends on whether displayed evidence guides rather than distorts physician reliance. We developed CORA, an agentic retrieval-augmented LLM, to investigate how source-linked assistance affects physician decision-making. CORA maintained benchmark performance and achieved larger gains on cases published after the models' training-data cutoffs. In a study of 46 physicians, accuracy increased from 70.8% unaided to 82.6% with CORA. Supporting citations predicted correct answers (87.7% vs 65.5%), but citations created an important asymmetry: perceived support increased adoption of correct advice from 34% to 76.9% but when an incorrect LLM answer appeared citation-supported, physician resistance to it fell from 92% to 34.8%. These findings show that source-linked LLM assistance can improve physician accuracy while introducing a grounding-dependent safety risk.

AI.tldr: CORA是一款具备智能体特性的检索增强大语言模型，旨在为临床决策提供有溯源的辅助。研究通过46名医生的实验表明，引用链接机制虽提升整体准确率（70.8%→82.6%），但也带来显著的"接地依赖性安全风险"：当错误建议附带看似可信的引用时，医生拒绝率从92%骤降至34.8%，凸显了来源链接既能助力也能误导的双刃剑效应。
AI.motivation: 随着检索增强大语言模型（RAG-LLMs）在临床场景中的应用增多，其显示的证据来源是否会引导而非扭曲医生对此类工具的依赖，成为亟待验证的核心问题。论文旨在探究"有来源链接的LLM辅助"对医生诊疗决策的实际影响，特别是证据引用在正确与错误建议情境下的差异化作用。
AI.method: 研究开发了一个名为CORA的智能体式检索增强LLM系统，并在46名医生中开展对照实验设计。医生在有/无CORA辅助的条件下完成临床病例判断，系统记录四个关键指标：(1)基线准确率 vs 辅助后准确率；(2)引用支撑与答案正确性的关联；(3)正确建议的被采纳率；(4)错误建议的被抵抗率。同时在模型训练数据截止日期前后发布的案例上评估性能增益。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1)基准性能维持稳定，且在训练截止日期后的新发案例上获得更大增益，验证了检索增强的时效性价值；(2)整体准确率从无辅助的70.8%提升至CORA辅助下的82.6%；(3)支撑性引用与正确答案高度相关（87.7%支持引用对应正确，65.5%无支持引用对应正确）；(4)关键非对称效应——感知到的引用支持使正确建议的采纳率从34%升至76.9%，但同时使错误LLM答案在"有引用支撑"假象下的医生抵抗率从92%降至34.8%。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论：来源链接的LLM辅助能够有效提升医生诊断准确率，但同时引入了一种"接地依赖性安全风险"（grounding-dependent safety risk）。当错误建议以引用佐证的形式出现时，医生的批判性审视能力被显著削弱，揭示了临床RAG系统设计必须在证据呈现可信度与认知误导防护之间寻求平衡，强调需要针对"伪支撑性引用"建立专门的防御机制。

title: The Scaling Paradox in Human-AI Collaboration
summary: The discovery of scaling laws has highlighted the extraordinary potential of AI systems with a striking empirical pattern: as AI systems scale, their capabilities tend to improve predictably. Yet, in real-world applications, AI rarely operates in isolation; instead, it often works alongside humans, raising the question of whether these gains persist in human-AI collaboration. In this work, we develop an analytical model to examine when the empirical scaling benefits of AI translate into improved human-AI joint system performance. We demonstrate that the performance of a human-AI system can scale positively as the AI scales up-provided that humans have an accurate perception of the AI's capabilities. Human misperception, however, can fundamentally alter this relationship: i) when humans over-perceive the AI's capabilities, a scaling paradox may arise, in which greater AI scale reduces overall system performance and amplifies firm-level profit losses, and (ii) when humans under-perceive the AI's capabilities, performance still improves with scale but at a substantially slower rate. We further show that firms can actively manage these distortions through operational policies such as cost internalization and perception alignment, whose effectiveness depends on the economics of AI deployment and the direction of human misperception. These findings suggest that organizations may benefit more from managing the human-AI interface than from simply investing in larger, more expensive AI systems. More broadly, our results suggest that AI scaling should be viewed not only as a technological challenge, but also as a behavioral and operational one, and caution against the view that larger AI systems will automatically lead to better operational outcomes. Whether AI scaling creates value ultimately depends on how increased AI capabilities shape human beliefs and collaborative efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析模型研究了AI规模化（scaling）效益在人类与AI协作场景中的传递条件，发现人类对AI能力的准确认知是关键：当人类高估AI能力时会出现"规模化悖论"，导致系统性能下降；低估时性能虽提升但速度放缓。组织应优先管理人机交互界面，而非单纯追求更大规模的AI系统。
AI.motivation: 现有AI规模化定律（scaling laws）研究主要关注AI系统独立性能提升，但现实应用中AI通常与人类协同工作。规模化带来的能力提升能否在Human-AI联合系统中延续尚不明确，亟需理解人类认知偏差如何调节AI规模化收益的传导机制，以指导组织的AI投资与运营决策。
AI.method: 构建分析模型（analytical model），将人类对AI能力的感知作为关键变量纳入Human-AI联合系统框架，推导AI规模化与系统绩效的函数关系；并分析企业通过运营策略（如成本内部化 cost internalization、感知校准 perception alignment）对认知扭曲进行管理的有效性。
AI.result: 1. AI规模化对联合系统性能的提升以人类对AI能力的准确感知为前提；2. 当人类高估AI能力时，出现"规模化悖论"——AI规模越大，系统整体绩效越低，企业利润损失越大；3. 当人类低估AI能力时，性能仍随规模化提升，但增速显著放缓；4. 成本内部化与感知校准等运营策略可缓解认知扭曲，但其效果取决于AI部署的经济性与认知偏差方向。
AI.conclusion: AI规模化不仅是技术问题，更是行为与运营问题；更大的AI系统并不自动带来更优运营结果。组织从人机交互界面管理中获得的收益，可能超过单纯投资更大、更昂贵的AI系统。AI规模化能否创造价值，最终取决于其能力提升如何塑造人类信念与协作行为。

title: Isotropy Cliffs: The Geometric Signature of Decision-Making in Large Language Models
summary: We investigate the geometry of decision-making in Multiple Choice Question Answering (MCQA) through the lens of isotropy. Analyzing five open-weight models across diverse datasets, we identify decision-critical transition layers characterized by a shift in isotropy, coinciding with a major representational change and the emergence of task-relevant clusters. We demonstrate that this synchronized geometric behavior is strongly correlated with downstream accuracy ($r\approx0.84$), displaying its relevance for successful decision-making. Furthermore, we show that this transition is robust to prompt variations, suggesting that it reflects a general mechanism of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型在多选题问答(MCQA)任务中的决策几何特性,发现模型在中后层存在一种"各向同性悬崖"(Isotropy Cliff)现象——即各向同性指标(IsoScore)在临界层突然急剧下降,同时伴随任务相关聚类的涌现。该悬崖的陡峭程度与下游任务准确率高度相关(全局 Spearman ρ=-0.84,Mistral-7B 上高达 -0.92),且对提示词变化和上下文学习具有鲁棒性,表明这是解码器架构的内在处理机制。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 表征几何研究多集中于局部本征维度估计(TwoNN),缺乏对表征空间全局组织方式及其与决策过程联系的深入理解;同时各向同性(isotropy)在层间演化中的作用及其与性能的关系尚不清晰,且已有方法未系统考虑提示策略对模型行为的影响。
AI.method: 在五个开源模型(Qwen2.5-3B、Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B、Mistral-7B-v0.3)和四个 MCQA 数据集(ARC-Easy、OpenBookQA、Head-QA、MMLU-Pro)上,提取每个输入最终 token 的隐藏状态,构建 (N, L, D) 激活张量;采用 IsoScore 测量全局各向同性、k-NN Score(k=5)评估类别聚类纯度、TwoNN 估计本征维度、CKA 度量相邻层表征相似度,并系统变化四种提示格式与上下文学习样本数(0/2/4-shot),通过 t-SNE 可视化验证聚类涌现。
AI.result: 所有五个模型在中后层均呈现一致的"各向同性悬崖"模式:IsoScore 先逐步上升至峰值 L,随后在 L+1 层骤降;悬崖出现时,代表表征显著重构的 CKA 低谷与 k-NN 聚类分数的急升同步发生;对数 IsoScore 变化量 ΔLI 与准确率的 Spearman 相关性达到 -0.78 至 -0.92(全局 -0.84),显著优于本征维度(ΔID-Acc 仅 -0.10);该现象在四种提示格式与 ICL 设置下稳定保持。
AI.conclusion: 各向同性悬崖是解码器架构 LLM 的一种普适几何签名,标志着模型"牺牲"表征均匀性以压缩信息至低维任务相关流形并形成判别性聚类;这一发现为基于激活工程的模型干预提供了战略路线图——在悬崖前的高各向同性阶段进行引导可能更有效;未来工作需拓展至更广层级跨度、更多架构及开放式生成任务。

title: Similarity Weighted Aggregation with Global Differential Privacy for Federated Brain Lesion Segmentation
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of machine learning models across multiple institutions without sharing sensitive data, making it particularly suitable for medical imaging applications. However, heterogeneous data distributions across institutions and potential information leakage through model updates remain important challenges. In this work, we propose DP-SimAgg, a privacy-preserving federated learning framework that integrates similarity-weighted aggregation with a server-side differential privacy mechanism. The proposed method applies L2 clipping to bound collaborator updates, computes similarity-based aggregation weights to mitigate the effects of non-IID data distributions, and injects calibrated Gaussian noise at the central server, providing per-round privacy guarantees under the assumed sensitivity bound. The framework is implemented using Intel's OpenFL platform and evaluated on the FeTS 2022 dataset consisting of 1251 multi-modal MRI scans for brain tumor segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that DP-SimAgg maintains competitive segmentation performance while providing privacy protection. Under a strict per-round privacy budget (epsilon = 1, cumulative epsilon_total = 20 over 20 rounds), the method achieves Dice scores of 0.6357, 0.5305, and 0.5274 for the enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC), and whole tumor (WT) regions, respectively. With a more relaxed per-round budget (epsilon = 10, cumulative epsilon_total = 200), performance approaches that of the non-private baseline while incorporating a central Gaussian mechanism with per-round (epsilon, delta)-DP accounting under the assumed sensitivity bound. These results highlight the potential of DP-SimAgg for enabling privacy-preserving collaborative learning in medical imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP-SimAgg框架,将相似性加权聚合(SimAgg)与服务端差分隐私机制相结合,用于联邦脑肿瘤分割。该框架在Intel OpenFL平台上实现,在FeTS 2022数据集(1251例多模态MRI,33个机构)上评估,证明了在严格隐私预算下仍能保持具有竞争力的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在医疗影像应用中面临两大核心挑战:(1)统计异质性——不同机构间的患者群体、成像协议和标注规范差异导致非IID数据分布,引发客户端漂移(client drift),使标准FedAvg性能下降;(2)隐私泄露——梯度反演攻击和成员推断攻击表明模型更新本身可泄露敏感信息,标准FL无法提供形式化隐私保证。该研究旨在同时解决这两个问题,在保护隐私的同时缓解非IID带来的性能损失。
AI.method: DP-SimAgg框架采用完全服务端设计(无需修改客户端训练),包含四个关键阶段:(1)L2范数裁剪——将每个协作方更新投影到半径为C=100的L2球内,约束敏感度;(2)相似性加权聚合——计算各更新与全局均值的L2距离,距离越近权重越高,公式为s_i = total_dist/(ε_safe + d_i),组合数据量权重后归一化;(3)经验敏感度估计——通过模拟相邻数据集(将一个协作方更新替换为裁剪阈值内的对抗张量)计算L2敏感度Δf;(4)高斯噪声注入——按Gaussian机制σ = (Δf/ε₀)√(2ln(1.25/δ₀))校准噪声。此外,采用滑动窗口选择策略保证33个机构间公平参与(每轮ρ=0.2即6个客户端,共20轮)。使用3D残差U-Net(约3300万参数)在NVIDIA Tesla V100上训练,基础序列组合下20轮累积隐私预算分别为ε_total=20(ε₀=1)和ε_total=200(ε₀=10)。
AI.result: 在FeTS 2022数据集上的实验表明:严格隐私预算下(ε₀=1,ε_total=20),背景Dice=0.9967,ET=0.6357,TC=0.5305,WT=0.5274,较非隐私SimAgg下降约10-15个百分点;宽松预算下(ε₀=10,ε_total=200),性能接近非隐私基线,ET=0.7962,TC=0.6872,WT=0.6757,与SimAgg的Dice差距小于1个百分点。计算开销方面,DP-SimAgg与SimAgg的墙钟时间(16-18小时)、内存(~305GB)、能耗(~3400Wh)差异小于5%,所有方法在约10轮内收敛。附录提供了理论敏感度上界证明(Δf≤4C),但算法实际使用更紧的经验估计值。
AI.conclusion: DP-SimAgg是首个将服务端相似性加权聚合与服务端中心化高斯差分隐私相结合用于多机构医学图像分割的联邦聚合框架,在无需修改客户端训练的前提下同时解决非IID鲁棒性和形式化隐私保障两个问题。实验验证了该框架在医疗联邦学习中的实用可行性。未来方向包括:推导更紧的解析敏感度界、通过安全聚合扩展至不可信聚合者场景、应用Rényi差分隐私等更紧的组合会计方法降低累积隐私成本,以及在更广泛的临床影像任务和协作规模上验证。

title: Assuming You Knew: Fixing an Epistemic Semantics for Flow Policies Using Agentic AI
summary: Many high-level security requirements are about the allowed flow of information in programs and are difficult to make precise because they involve selective downgrading. Notions from epistemic logic have emerged as a good approach to policy semantics but a robust general framework remains elusive. A paper appearing in CSF 2018, entitled ``Assuming You Know: Epistemic Semantics of Relational Annotations for Expressive Flow Policies'', attempted to provide a unifying framework---but the formalization was sketchy and a correction was announced during the conference presentation. With aid from an agentic AI coding assistant, a corrected formalization has been machine checked in the Rocq proof assistant. The simplicity and generality of the framework may help compare different policy specification styles and enforce them by leveraging existing techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文针对CSF 2018论文《Assuming You Know》中信息流策略的认识论语义框架进行了修正与机器化验证。利用Rocq证明助手和AI编程助手Claude Code，作者完成了修正形式化的完整机器检查证明，确立了"安全蕴含安全"（safety implies security）这一核心定理。
AI.motivation: 高安全级别的信息流策略往往涉及"选择性降级"（selective downgrading），难以精确刻画。虽然基于认识逻辑（epistemic logic）的策略语义方法已较为成熟，但缺乏一个统一的通用框架。CSF 2018的CN论文尝试提供该统一框架，但其形式化过于粗略且证明存在缺陷，限制了该框架的可用性与可信度。本文旨在修正该形式化缺陷并通过机器化证明增强其可信度。
AI.method: 方法包含以下核心技术要素：(1) 反应式命令式语言模型，含输入处理器、标注（assert/assume）和关系公式（ℭ-和ℬ-形式的二元关系）；(2) 基于"对齐"（alignment）的双运行（major/minor）语义，将策略规约与程序行为解耦；(3) 安全（security）定义采用知识k^ℓ与进度知识k→^ℓ刻画"观察者在ℓ层级能够学习什么"；(4) 释放策略RP^ℓ通过半一致性（SC^ℓ）和覆盖率条件表达降级语义；(5) 安全性条件（safety）将一致性分为五类（conformance、assertion failure、alignment failure、assumption fiat、divergence fiat）并证明互斥且穷尽；(6) 在Rocq证明助手中通过Claude Code实现完整机器检查。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 在Rocq中完成了9747行非空代码与1057行注释的完整机器检查证明；(2) 定理5.1证明了对齐前置运行对的五分类具有互斥性与穷尽性；(3) 定理5.2（主定理）证明了安全性蕴含安全，即对于任意层级ℓ，安全的前置运行在ℓ层级是安全的；(4) 机器检查发现并修正了CN原版中的若干细节缺陷，包括divergence failure定义不必要限制、引理4(b)和5(b)对输出的不必要限制、安全定义中对可见输入的冗余排除假设；(5) 修正后的知识定义k^ℓ和k→^ℓ使用前缀关系取代CN中的相等关系，使语义更自然且证明更简洁。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功修正了CN论文中的认识论信息流策略语义框架，并提供了完全机器检查的证明，验证了"安全蕴含安全"的核心结论。该工作表明：即使在理想化理论层面，谨慎的形式化工作也可能存在错误，机器检查对于高保障安全研究不可或缺；agentic AI编码助手（Claude Code）虽能显著加速形式化进程，但仍需人类专家的判断与监督；统一的认识论语义框架有助于比较不同策略规约风格并利用现有技术进行强制实施。论文以向David Basin致敬结尾，表彰其对机器检查安全形式化领域的开创性贡献。开放问题包括为安全条件开发组合式证明规则。

title: Neuro-Evolved Heuristics for Variable Gapped Common Subsequence Identification
summary: This study addresses the Variable Gapped Longest Common Subsequence Problem (VGLCSP), a variant of the classical longest common subsequence problem with additional gap constraints and applications in sequence alignment and time-series analysis. While the two-sequence version has been widely studied using dynamic programming, the generalized multi-sequence form is usually solved with beam search-based heuristics, whose hand-crafted designs often lack robustness. To overcome this limitation, we propose a learning-based approach for automatically designing more effective data-driven heuristics. The heuristics are represented by a neural network with predefined architecture, whose weights are optimized by a genetic algorithm within a neuro-evolutionary framework. The learning process alternates between weight optimization and evaluation within an iterative multi-source beam search procedure, a state-of-the-art method for the problem. Rather than constructing solutions directly, the neural network learns to guide the search process, producing a neuro-evolved heuristic. We further introduce an ensemble heuristic that combines the scores of learned and the best-performing hand-crafted heuristic. Integrated into the iterative multi-source beam search framework, the resulting hybrid approach outperforms existing methods on both synthetic benchmark instances and newly introduced real-world instances with data-driven gap constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可变间隔最长公共子序列问题(VGLCSP)，提出了一种基于神经进化框架的学习型启发式方法。通过遗传算法(BRKGA)优化神经网络权重来引导迭代多源束搜索(IMSBS)，并结合学习与手工启发式构建集成启发式，在合成和真实基准实例上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 经典的动态规划方法仅适用于两序列场景；对于多序列VGLCSP（NP难问题），现有唯一的可扩展方法是基于手工设计启发式的迭代多源束搜索(IMSBS)。然而，手工启发式在序列数m增大或字母表|Σ|变小时性能下降明显，且缺乏对真实生物数据的评估。这是本文的核心动机。
AI.method: 1) 将启发式建模为多层感知机(MLP)，通过11维特征向量（含归一化位置统计、间隔约束统计、字母表大小等）描述每个搜索节点；2) 使用有偏随机密钥遗传算法(BRKGA)优化网络权重，种群中的每个个体代表一组NN参数，通过在训练集上运行IMSBS计算适应度；3) 采用基于排名的集成策略，将学习到的神经网络得分与现有UB启发式得分按权重α加权组合；4) 引入基于dinucleotide热力学稳定性的新型生物学间隔约束生成机制，构建真实基准集(Rat/Virus)。
AI.result: 在Random基准集(320实例)上，Limsbs-ensemble在32个实例组中有20组优于基线Imsbs，仅4组劣于基线(Wilcoxon检验p=0.009，统计显著)；在Real基准集(20实例，生物序列)上，20组中有12组优于基线，7组持平，仅1组劣于基线。两种方法运行时间相当，差距不具一致性。改进在m值较大、间隔结构复杂的困难实例上尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明将神经进化与束搜索相结合可有效提升组合优化问题的求解质量，集成启发式策略增强了鲁棒性。未来工作将扩展到蛋白质序列与更大规模实例，探索进化策略、适应度评估准则及过拟合控制机制的改进，并验证真实间隔约束的生物学意义。

title: CADIR: A Cross-Backend Editable Intermediate Representation for Agentic CAD Generation
summary: Large language models have made it possible to generate executable computer-aided design (CAD) programs from natural-language descriptions or images. However, existing methods represent modeling processes as backend-specific sequential scripts with implicit dependencies or as static geometry, making it difficult to simultaneously preserve construction history, stable topological references, and feature-level editability across different CAD systems. We present CADIR, an agent-friendly executable intermediate representation for CAD generation and cross-backend editing. Built on the OCCT geometry kernel via OCP, CADIR provides explicit, compositional modeling operations and fine-grained execution diagnostics. During program execution, CADIR records modeling operations, parameter dependencies, constraints, and topology selections in a construction graph. To enable reliable cross-backend reconstruction, we introduce Geometric Signature Matching, which identifies corresponding edges and faces despite parameter changes and backend differences, allowing adapters to reconstruct native editable feature histories in FreeCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion 360. Building on this representation, we further propose a construction-graph retrieval method for text and image queries that supports both full-graph and subgraph retrieval, enabling agents to leverage complete models and modeling substructures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CADIR achieves higher geometric fidelity and execution reliability than existing CAD representations, that construction-graph retrieval further improves model generation quality, and that cross-backend editing enables reliable model reconstruction and post-reconstruction editing across multiple CAD environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CADIR，一种面向智能体（agent）CAD 生成与跨后端编辑的可执行中间表示。它基于 OCCT 几何内核（通过 OCP 封装），以构造图（construction graph）为核心记录建模操作、参数依赖、约束与拓扑选择；并通过几何签名匹配（Geometric Signature Matching, GSM）实现 FreeCAD、SolidWorks、Fusion 360 之间的可靠可编辑重建；同时支持文本/图像查询的全图与子图检索，以辅助智能体生成。
AI.motivation: 现有 CAD 生成方法存在三类局限：（1）B-Rep/网格方法（如 BrepGen、AutoBrep）仅输出静态几何，无法参数化编辑；（2）序列式方法（如 DeepCAD、Text2CAD）建模历史受限，多限于草图-拉伸序列；（3）CAD 代码方法（如 FutureCAD、Cad-coder）依赖后端特定的扁平脚本，缺乏显式依赖、约束与稳定拓扑引用；agent 框架（如 CAD-Assistant、ProCAD）虽引入执行反馈与迭代修复，但仍绑定特定 CAD 环境，缺乏跨后端重建与可检索的构造结构。核心问题是难以同时保留构造历史、稳定的拓扑引用与特征级可编辑性。
AI.method: （1）**CADIR 建模 API**：基于 OCP/OCCT 内核，暴露 115 个显式组合式建模操作，提供语义化拓扑选择器（TS: ⟨τ, ρ, π, ϕ, o, k, c⟩）和装配约束（固定、棱柱、旋转、齿轮、齿形带、齿条-齿轮）；（2）**构造图 G=(V, E, 𝒪, ℛ)**：在程序执行时记录规范操作节点、依赖边、结构化操作记录（op, role, params, tags, context, Δ）与结果节点；（3）**几何签名匹配 GSM**：为每个拓扑实体计算签名 σ，用加权几何差异 D(σ_s, σ_c) 匹配候选（含分/合并边组处理），唯一性阈值 τ_e/τ_m 与间距阈值 δ 保证鲁棒；（4）**跨后端适配器**：按拓扑顺序回放构造图，调用各后端原生 API；（5）**检索增强**：双塔结构，文本（Qwen3-Embedding-4B）与图像（gme-Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct）分支独立训练，使用门控消息传递+Graph Transformer 编码构造图，全图与子图（沿依赖边回溯的 3D 特征局部子图）共享编码器实现零样本子图检索；（6）**五智能体架构**：A_m 协调、A_r 需求分析、A_c 代码生成与修复、A_v 视觉验证、A_e 经验整合。
AI.result: **中间表示对比（Table 1，200 模型）**：CADIR 在 IoU=0.2702、CD=18.36、HD=0.2272、Suc.=1.0000 上全面超越 CQ、build123d、HistCAD、ForgeCAD、ECIP，IoU 较最强基线提升 4.9%。**检索（Table 2）**：构造图索引（CG）显著优于程序索引（CP），N=1000 时文本查询 CG 在 R@5/R@10 上分别超 CP 0.4762/0.4008。**生成消融（Table 3）**：图像输入下全图+子图检索将 IoU 从 0.2613 提升至 0.3852。**Text-to-CAD（Table 4）**：CADIR IoU=0.3064，较 CADDesigner 提升 30.5%，CD/HD 降低 43.0%/21.8%，Suc.=1.0000。**跨后端（Table 5，100 测试程序，30466 节点）**：GSM 在 FreeCAD、Fusion 360、SolidWorks 上 NRR 均达 1.0000，IoU 分别为 0.9374/0.9762/0.9449；294 编辑任务 ESR 分别达 1.0000/0.9796/0.9184，显著优于基于索引与点采样的基线。
AI.conclusion: CADIR 通过构造图、几何签名匹配与基于图的检索三者结合，实现了可靠的 CAD 生成、可复用建模结构与跨后端的原生可编辑模型重建；为智能体驱动的 CAD 建模提供了具备历史保持与跨平台迁移能力的基础设施。未来工作将引入基于仿真的验证（运动学仿真、动力学分析）以及领域知识，进一步提升生成模型的工程可用性，并探索 CAD 智能体在实际工程场景中的应用部署。

title: Modeling Social Dynamics with an LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) Model
summary: Social dynamics encode the process in which individual network and discourse interactions aggregate into collective influence, narrative dominance and coordinate behavior. This paper uses the the GhostField architecture, a hybrid LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) model as a social simulation framework to build the AuraSight scenario. In the AuraSight scenario, 314,244 heterogeneous cyber social agents and human actors exchange 529,327 messages over 30 days surrounding a fictional international song-writing contest. We methodologically examine emergent social dynamics across four analytical layers: ego-network topology, semantic network evolution, coordination dynamics and influence dynamics. Our results show how generated social simulations do also produce social dynamics, and how the dynamics of coordination and influence emerge not from individual agents but from the recursive interaction between network topology and narrative exchange.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合LLM-使能的智能体网络动态（LAND）模型框架GhostField，通过构建虚构国际歌曲比赛AuraSight场景（314,244个智能体在30天内交换529,327条消息），从自我网络拓扑、语义网络演化、协调动态和影响动态四个分析层面证明了社交动态源于网络拓扑与叙事交换的递归交互，而非单个智能体认知。
AI.motivation: 传统社交媒体研究依赖观察性方法难以进行反事实实验；传统ABM缺乏语言真实性，而现有LLM仿真缺乏网络约束的交互动态。本文旨在通过混合方法结合ABM的可扩展性与LLM的对话真实性，构建可控的社交仿真环境以研究协调与影响动态。
AI.method: 1）GhostField架构包含两个子系统：AESOP（基于剧情线生成场景模板，参数化事件、话题、立场、叙事种子和智能体角色）和SynTelX（基于几何分布的智能体激活规则，使用LLM为每条消息生成文本）。2）AuraSight场景模拟四周虚构AuraSight歌唱比赛，含三种智能体类型（人类、网络社交机器人15种原型、dredger）。3）四层分析：自我网络拓扑演化（中心性指标+QAP检验）、语义网络（hashtag共现+QAP）、协调动态（Combined Synchronization Index，5分钟滑动窗口）、影响动态（BEND框架16种操控手段+卡方检验）。
AI.result: 1）网络拓扑：Oliver始终保持高特征向量中心性（0.70）和介数中心性（0.98），符合马太效应；Ella/Ezekiel的中心性在叙事焦点转向他们时才会飙升。2）语义网络：节点从85增长至181，边从238增长至730，QAP相关性在Week3-4出现最大结构断裂（r=0.41），对应从竞争到法律框架的转变。3）协调动态：机器人-机器人对在语义协调中权重最高；机器人主导语义协调网络核心，人类主导社会协调网络；协调强度在高显著性事件时达到峰值。4）影响动态：五个BEND操控显著变化，Dismay增幅最显著（χ²=59.03, p<0.001），Neglect是基础操控（约28-30%）。5）通过九项风格化事实验证仿真与现实社交动态一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了网络拓扑和叙事内容的递归交互产生了协调与影响动态，这些动态不能简化为单个智能体认知；混合LLM-ABM LAND模型为社交网络安全研究提供了可控、可扩展的测试平台，可用于反事实实验和干预测试。未来工作需要纳入更精细的认知因素（注意力、疲劳恢复）以及差异化事件影响分析。

title: PMMC: Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation for Long-Term LVLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for LVLM agents to maintain consistency and integrate information across extended multimodal interactions. Existing agent memory systems, however, often reduce visual experiences into textual summaries or rely on static retrieve-then-reason pipelines, which are inefficient at query time and brittle when questions require image-text binding, temporal updates, or visual details. We propose Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation, a framework that shifts part of the memory reasoning process from query time to memory consolidation time. Given accumulated multimodal interactions, a Questioner predicts future question candidates, a Planner compiles question-conditioned multimodal memory programs, and a Doubter verifies whether the planned evidence path can support the predicted answer. The verified question-program pairs form a structured question bank for efficient query-time routing and evidence retrieval. Experiments on multimodal long-term memory benchmarks show that our method improves answer quality and visual evidence recall while reducing query-time token and latency costs. Extensive ablations analyze the effects of self-feedback, dynamic planning, raw-image access, and question bank coverage.

AI.tldr: PMMC提出了一种"前瞻性多模态记忆编译"框架,将长时记忆LVLM代理的记忆推理过程从查询时转移到记忆整合时,通过Questioner-Planner-Doubter三阶段流水线将未来可能的问题预编译为类型化的多模态记忆程序,并以执行验证保证可靠性,从而构建一个可高效路由的Question Bank,显著提升回答质量并降低查询时开销。
AI.motivation: 现有代理记忆系统主要存在两类缺陷:(1)将视觉体验压缩为文本摘要,永久丢失视觉细节或图像-文本绑定;(2)采用静态的"先检索后推理"流程,在查询时效率低,且难以应对需要图像-文本绑定、时间更新或视觉细节的查询。此外,单一表征(对比编码器、字幕存储等)难以同时满足事实、实体、视觉细节与多跳推理等异构信息需求。核心动机在于:若能在记忆整合阶段预测未来可能的信息需求并提前编译访问策略,则查询时只需执行已验证的程序,既保留多模态证据,又降低在线开销。
AI.result:
在MEMLENS(N=699)与Mem-Gallery(N=1446)上跨GPT-5-mini、Claude Haiku 4.5、Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.5-27B四个骨干进行评测:
• 主结果(表1):PMMC在8个骨干-基准设置中6项第一,Macro-Average HJ=49.9,较最强基线Caption-Text RAG(46.7)提升3.2点,在Mem-Gallery所有四个骨干上均居首。
• 消融(表2):去除Doubter使程序成功率从92.1降至82.7;去除动态Planner导致证据召回下降8.3、原始图像命中下降10.6、程序成功率下降15.2;去除原始图像访问在Mem-Gallery上下降4.9点。
• 自反馈轮数(表3):r从0增至2时,HJ从54.0升至57.0,程序成功率从82.7%升至92.1%,查询时token下降15.8%;r=3边际收益仅0.2点但写时token再增21.1%,故部署r=2。
• Question Bank覆盖(表4):Macro Cover@5=82.1%、Match@5=75.2%,Oracle选择可达HJ=65.4(尚有8.4点提升空间),回退率仅12.6%。
• 效率(图4):PMMC的r=2工作点位于固定检索基线的左上(高质量+低查询时成本),分摊后仅需约2/12/18次查询即可分别收回相对M3-Agent、Native MM-RAG、Caption-Text RAG的写时开销。
AI.conclusion: PMMC通过将自适应多模态记忆访问规划前移至记忆整合阶段,验证了"前瞻式问题条件编译"比单一长上下文或固定检索策略更具鲁棒性,能在异构多模态信息需求下稳定提升回答质量与视觉证据召回,同时降低查询时token与延迟。主要局限在于前瞻问题覆盖不完整(存在6.9点的Cover@5与Match@5差距及8.4点Oracle差距)以及额外的写时计算开销,因此收益在"整合后被多次访问"的场景中最显著。未来工作方向包括:持续Question Bank维护、程序策略学习、以及向更丰富模态与交互环境的扩展。

title: TrajWiki: Source-Grounded Memory Trajectories for Long-Horizon Dialogue Agents
summary: Large language model agents have shown strong capabilities in generating coherent and contextually appropriate responses, yet robust long-horizon dialogue remains limited by the lack of external memory that is traceable, updatable, and diagnostically transparent. Existing memory-augmented agents often store memories as isolated records or overwritable states, making it difficult to preserve how information originates, evolves, conflicts, or becomes obsolete over time. We propose TrajWiki, a trajectory-based memory framework for long-horizon conversational agents. Instead of treating memory as static entries, TrajWiki represents each memory as a source-grounded evolution trajectory, maintained through immutable episodic snapshots and claim-level operations such as ADD, REVISE, and DEPRECATE. To reduce fragmentation and retrieval cost, TrajWiki further introduces Memory Wiki, a persistent intermediate layer that incrementally compiles dialogue history into structured and interlinked wiki pages capturing salient entities, events, quantities, topics, and conflicts. At inference time, queries are routed hierarchically from relevant wiki pages to linked memory trajectories, then to corresponding snapshots and source messages for evidence-grounded answer synthesis. Experiments on LoCoMo and MedMT show that TrajWiki improves long-horizon dialogue performance across both open-source and closed-source LLM backbones, while providing greater interpretability and diagnostic visibility into memory evolution, retrieval failures, and answer generation.
