AI.method: DyRetriever包含两个阶段：(1) 入口点选择——LLM基于仓库树形结构和目标函数签名，从文件级到函数级识别若干相关函数作为推理入口；(2) 基于部分图的多跳推理——采用select-visit-expand三步循环，由LLM选择候选函数、访问其源码，并通过函数源码和import语句由LLM动态识别其依赖（仅限call和lazy import两类关系），实现按需扩展部分依赖图，使用后即丢弃。DyCoder将DyRetriever与基于embedding的相似度检索相结合，去重后作为LLM生成目标函数的上下文。后处理步骤包括对依赖图进行真实性校验（消除幻觉和标准库误识别）以及代码缩进修正。
AI.result: 在CoderEval和DevEval两个基准上，使用Qwen3-Coder-30B、DeepSeek-v3.2和GPT-4o-mini三种模型进行评估：DyCoder在Pass@1上相对现有RAG方法分别获得25.63%和59.73%的相对提升，比基于静态依赖图的RepoScope快7.4倍；消融实验验证了DyRetriever、相似度检索和多跳推理各自的贡献（分别去掉导致14.80%、15.85%和6.55%的平均性能下降）；DyRetriever可作为即插即用模块，与BM25、RLCoder、AlignCoder等不同相似度方法结合时获得7.5%-30.99%的提升；人工检查60个expand操作表明LLM构建依赖图的准确率达93.22%，与静态分析工具相当。
AI.conclusion: DyRetriever通过模拟人类开发者的上下文收集行为，打破了传统图检索方法对手工规则的依赖，并通过按需构建部分依赖图显著降低了构建与维护成本；DyCoder在有效性和效率上均优于现有RAG方法，展现出良好的通用性和即插即用特性；未来工作将扩展至更多编程语言与更复杂的代码生成场景，并进一步提升LLM构建代码依赖图的准确性。

title: Automatic Annotation of Ancient Greek Vowel Length
summary: Prior work in Ancient Greek NLP relies on corpora that do not disambiguate the phonemic vowel length of alpha, iota, and ypsilon, together known as the dichrona. Depending on lexeme, morphology, sandhi, syntax, and conventions of period, genre, and verse form, each of these letters can represent either a long or a short vowel. Deciding and marking the correct length is known as "macronizing", a long-tail problem given the sheer mass of word forms and the context dependency of individual instances. No macronized corpus of Ancient Greek is publicly available at scale, so a stand-alone macronizer is needed. While previous work has shown how to build a static, corpus-bespoke vowel-length dictionary, the present paper constructs the first general-purpose macronizer for arbitrary Ancient Greek input. Given input carrying lemma, part-of-speech, and morphological annotation in the standard CoNLL-U format, a set of recursive modules lets less common word forms inherit markup from more common forms of the same lexical word. The macronizer's chief application is generating training data for machine learning: we show that a small character-level transformer trained on the macronizer's own output learns to generalize past the cases the rule-based system leaves unmarked, matching or exceeding its accuracy on a gold-standard, manually annotated benchmark of verse and prose. We also show that macronization can improve downstream prosodical NLP tasks like verse scansion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向任意古希腊语输入的通用元音长度标注器（macronizer），通过基于规则的流水线为字符级Transformer生成银标准训练数据，显著提升了元音长度判定的准确率与覆盖率，并证明该任务对下游韵律分析（诗行格律扫描）具有实际增益。
AI.motivation: 古希腊语的正字法不区分α、ι、υ（合称dichrona）的长短音，而元音长度对诗歌格律分析（scansion）及散文中的语义消歧至关重要。由于词位、形态、语流、句法、方言、时期、文体与韵律等复杂因素相互交织，元音长度的判定（即"macronization"）呈现典型的长尾分布。现有公开语料库缺乏大规模的长音标注，且此前研究仅限于针对单一语料库的静态字典方案，无法满足通用需求。论文提出三个研究问题：(RQ1) 仅靠算法与数据库能从大规模语料中解析多少歧义；(RQ2) 在规则标注的语料上训练神经分类器能否进一步改善覆盖与质量；(RQ3) 元音长度标注能否提升下游古希腊语NLP任务（如自动格律扫描）的表现。
AI.method: 系统包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于规则的macronizer。输入为带lemma、POS与形态标注的CoNLL-U格式文本（由Trankit与odyCy预标注）。规则集由13个模块按依赖顺序执行：①数据库模块（424,823个屈折形式词典、34,229个词头条目来自Liddell–Scott–Jones、60,660行扫描诗行、567条人工例外数据库）；②算法模块（古Attic重音规则、名词动词词尾规则、前缀分析）；③递归模块（通过形态变体回溯、恢复省略主格、移除次重音、撤销elision等）。同一形态标签下歧义形式统一采用古Attic长度，约为70%的二合元音默认为短音。(2) 字符级Transformer。基于规则系统的输出训练，参数量约0.87M（4层、隐藏128、4头、中间512）；字符嵌入分为"字母平面"与"变音符号平面"两个通道；采用三分类（短/长/无歧义），训练时对未歧义位置使用ignore-index屏蔽以避免隐式短音偏置。评估基准为新构建的金标准数据集Norma Syllabarum Graecarum（1,916个来自14位作者的手工标注位置）。
AI.result: (1) 规则系统：在4千万词符的OGA语料上解决69.2%的开放音节二合元音；在Norma基准上混合准确率66.7%，混合F1为78.7%。(2) Transformer：相同基准上混合准确率达92.0%、混合F1达92.2%，覆盖率提升至99.7%；长音标签的F1提升6.3分，相比"全短音"基线混合F1提升9.1分（结果在另一随机种子下完全可复现）。(3) 下游扫描任务：使用相同架构的DistilBert分类器识别31种六音步格律模式，macronization使扫描准确率平均提升5.8%±1.5%（95% t置信区间，跨3个种子）。所有数据、模型与训练脚本均开源发布（HuggingFace与GitHub）。
AI.conclusion: 本文构建了首个通用的古希腊语元音长度自动标注系统，并证明神经模型可在规则系统的银标准输出上显著泛化，超越规则系统本身的精度与覆盖率，同时改善下游韵律任务。作者公开了macronized语料、两个模型及金标准基准，为后续古希腊语NLP（如风格计量学、形态标注）研究奠定基础。主要局限包括：系统将所有歧义统一归一化为古Attic长度，对荷马、多立克、希腊化及拜占庭文本存在系统性偏差；未进行Transformer超参数搜索；性能强烈依赖上游Trankit与odyCy标注质量，错误通过管道向下传播，且学生模型的错误与其教师系统的错误高度相关，需要大量人工校正数据进行微调。

title: TALSC: Timeliness-Aware Large-Small VLM Collaboration for Infrastructure-Assisted Autonomous Driving
comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE GLOBECOM 2026
summary: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in autonomous driving (AD) systems is constrained by on-board computing power, restricting vehicles to small VLMs (SVLMs) with limited perception and reasoning capabilities. Infrastructure-assisted AD alleviates this resource constraint by enabling collaboration with large VLMs (LVLMs) at edge servers. However, in dynamic vehicular environments, the utility of sensory data for downstream tasks decays rapidly, making timeliness of information a critical concern. To balance the accuracy gains of LVLMs with their latency-induced timeliness degradation, we develop a Timeliness-Aware Large-Small VLM Collaboration (TALSC) framework. Specifically, we first model the Age of Information (AoI) evolution for VLM inference and characterize the coupling among AoI, token length, and task performance to formulate a general timeliness metric. Building on this, we propose the TALSC online scheduling algorithm. Since scheduling decisions have a delayed impact on future timeliness metric and the output token number is unknown at scheduling time, we design a Lyapunov drift-plus-estimated-penalty algorithm and provides a guaranteed performance. In simulation, we first conduct a case study to derive a fitted timeliness metric based on nuScenes dataset, and further show that TALSC outperforms baselines under various communication and computing settings, achieving up to a 12.6\% normalized improvement in Micro-F1 score compared with the best-performing baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TALSC框架，针对基础设施辅助自动驾驶中车载小VLM与边缘大VLM的协作场景，通过建模信息年龄（AoI）演化与时延-精度耦合关系，设计基于Lyapunov漂移加惩罚的在线调度算法，联合优化协作策略、token长度与带宽分配，在带宽和时延约束下最大化长期时效性指标。
AI.motivation: 车载算力受限使车辆只能部署小VLM（SVLM），感知与推理能力有限；基础设施辅助可借助边缘服务器的大VLM（LVLM）提升精度，但传输与推理延迟显著。动态车辆环境中感知数据价值随时间快速衰减，信息时效性至关重要。核心挑战在于：1）如何刻画AoI、token粒度与任务性能之间的非线性耦合关系；2）如何在带宽和任务截止时间约束下，动态决定何时调用LVLM及如何分配带宽与token长度。
AI.method: 1）系统建模：建立感知-传输-计算延迟模型，其中传输延迟由香农公式给出，计算延迟分解为TTFT与自回归解码TPOT两部分；2）时效性度量建模：将时效性指标Φ(h,L)建模为关于AoI h与token长度L的双指数衰减函数，基于nuScenes数据集（Qwen2.5-VL-3B/72B）拟合参数；3）问题构建：最大化长期平均时效性，受长期平均带宽预算与每任务硬截止时间约束；4）算法设计：采用Lyapunov优化框架，定义带宽虚拟队列，通过Taylor展开处理未知输出token数与下一任务延迟（估计误差δ_m、ε_m、ζ_m），提出漂移加估计惩罚（drift-plus-estimated-penalty）在线调度算法，分两种情形（LVLM/SVLM）枚举决策变量；5）性能分析：证明算法相对离线最优的O(1/V)性能保证与队列稳定性界。
AI.result: 基于nuScenes数据集与Qwen2.5-VL-3B/72B模型进行仿真验证。相比Raw（无token弹性）、Local-Only（全本地）、Edge-Only（全边缘）、edgeVLM四种基线：1）在不同带宽预算下，TALSC始终满足带宽约束且性能最优；2）边缘-本地延迟比越低，本地处理占比越高，性能差距越显著；3）低SNR下TALSC自适应降低token长度并偏向本地推理，高SNR下切换至边缘推理；在SNR=10dB时取得最佳基线12.6%的归一化Micro-F1提升。
AI.conclusion: TALSC首次系统刻画了VLM推理中AoI演化与token粒度-任务性能的耦合关系，提出具有理论性能保证的在线调度算法，有效平衡了LVLM精度增益与延迟导致的时效性损失。未来工作将扩展至多用户车联网场景，探索语义感知的token选择与多车协同VLM感知。

title: CompanionBench: A Theory-Anchored, Real-World-Grounded Benchmark for AI Emotional Companionship
comment: 33 pages, 6 figures, 19 tables, 13 appendices. Bilingual (Chinese/English) interactive benchmark; 28 evaluated agents
summary: LLM companions are deployed at scale in personally consequential settings, yet poorly evaluated. Existing benchmarks use hand-authored scenarios and prompted simulators, aggregate empathy into one score, and overlook judge biases such as same-family favoritism and scale drift. We introduce CompanionBench, an interactive bilingual benchmark. To our knowledge, it is the first companion benchmark to ground both its scenarios and a trained user simulator in de-identified real-world data. A hidden disclosure gate branches each persona's trajectory on the agent's own behavior, controlling the interaction state space without scripting dialogue. We operationalize ten capabilities derived from 25 theories across psychology and counseling, four of them not graded explicitly by prior work: holding ambiguity, selfobject responsiveness, positive resonance and calibrated challenge. Agents are assessed on two complementary axes: a subjective ten-capability rubric and a deterministic measure of whether deeper disclosure was earned. A cross-family panel dilutes same-family favoritism; an Item Response Theory model separates agent quality from judge severity. Theory fixes what to measure and how personas are structured; real data supply events, history, and profiles -- coverage from theory, authenticity from data. Rankings are reproducible in both languages (rho = 0.996 ZH / 0.953 EN). Evaluating 28 agents reveals capability-level differences obscured by aggregate scores. Emotion regulation and calibrated challenge remain common weaknesses; holding ambiguity discriminates most. Role-play agents rank near the bottom: immersion does not imply relational competence. Across agents, the dominant failure mode is substituting surface warmth for substantive relational support. We will release 500 Chinese-English parallel pairs and the evaluation code.

AI.tldr: CompanionBench 是一个理论锚定、真实数据驱动的双语交互式基准，用于评估 LLM 情感陪伴能力。它通过 25 个心理学理论派系定义 10 项核心能力，使用真实用户数据训练的模拟器配合隐藏披露门控机制，并在 28 个 SUT 上验证，揭示出"以表面温暖替代实质关系支持"是主流失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有情感陪伴评估基准存在四大缺陷：使用单一聚合共情分数混淆了语气与实质；单轮或无语境设计遗漏了关系过程；静态案例和提示式模拟器不会因被测代理而分支；单一 LLM 评判者的自偏好污染排名。作者认为情感陪伴的关键不在于"答对"或"表现温暖"，而在于"逐步赢得关系信任"，需要分离实质性关系支持与温暖表演。
AI.method: 方法采用四阶段管道：(1) 构建——自上而下由 25 个心理学/咨询理论构成能力、场景与人格三层，自下而上由脱敏真实对话提供事件、历史和画像；(2) 滚动——在真实用户轮次上 SFT 训练的用户模拟器，其隐藏披露门控机制依据 SUT 行为驱动对话分支；(3) 评判——双轴评估：轴一为 10 项能力的主观评分（1-10 分制），轴二为披露深度门控的确定性重放；(4) 报告——跨家族评判者面板配合 Rasch IRT 模型消除评分者严苛度偏差。能力分两组：六项已确立能力（C1-C4, C9-C10）与四项新评分能力（C5 容忍模糊性、C6 自体客体回应、C7 积极共振、C8 校准挑战）。
AI.result: 评估 28 个 SUT、每语言 500 人格 × 14,000 次对话后：(1) 顶部三模型（gpt-5.5、opus、gpt-5.4）英文不可区分，底部角色扮演模型（doubao-character、minimax-m2-her）即便沉浸感强仍垫底；(2) 双语排名相关系数 ρ=0.951，但 22/28 SUT 显著偏移；(3) C10 安全底线普遍高，C4 情绪调节与 C8 校准挑战为常见弱项，C5 容忍模糊性区分度最大（5.67 分跨度）；(4) 主导失败模式为"用表面温暖替代实质"——empty_encouragement（空鼓励）与 forced_positivity（强行积极）占 T2 反模式事件 83.6%，overpromise 占 T1 红色线 98.8%；(5) 在 20 轮单次会话中无 SUT 能赢得核心层信任（最深 qwen3.7-max 仅 1.30，2% 轮次达核心深度），表明深层信任存在单会话天花板；(6) 轴一能力评分与轴二披露深度在 max_depth 上相关性仅 0.21，证实两轴发散；(7) IRT θ 与手动 β 调整排名一致（ρ≈0.99），验证去偏差可靠性（ρ=0.996 ZH/0.953 EN 测试-重测）。
AI.conclusion: 情感陪伴应被独立、诚实地测量，而非用单一聚合温暖分数衡量。CompanionBench 通过理论锚定+数据驱动的双层混合、真实用户训练的模拟器（其披露门控同时充当确定性第二轴）、以及 IRT 校正的跨家族评判面板，将"温暖"与"实质"分离。28 个模型普遍存在以温暖替代实质的失败，角色扮演模型虽最大化沉浸感但排名垫底正是此失败最锐利的体现。两轴发散且无模型在 20 轮内赢得最深信任，此结论在两种语言中稳健。论文将发布 500 对中英平行人格数据与评估代码，为情感健康这一高风险领域提供透明可复现的基准。

title: TextNCA: Neural Cellular Automata for Language Modeling via Hierarchical Local Attention
summary: Can a strictly local, iterated, weight-shared computation primitive support language modelling, and which of those three properties actually drives the model's behaviour? We define \textsc{TextNCA}, a 1D causal windowed-attention realisation of the Neural Cellular Automaton primitive, and study a hierarchical variant that cascades three stages with windows $w \in \{8, 32, 128\}$ and $T_s$ shared-weight iterations per stage, all on WikiText-103 at roughly 30M parameters and 60k training steps. The model does not match a parameter-matched Transformer at this scale (Hier-TextNCA $60.3$ vs.\ Transformer-6L $52.8$ and Transformer-12L $44.7$ PPL), so we treat it as an analytical probe rather than a proposed alternative. The behaviour we observe is largely explained by the staged narrow-to-wide schedule: a non-iterating sliding-window Transformer that reuses the same schedule comes within $+4.1$ PPL of the iterated model, while reversing, flattening, or breaking the monotonic ordering of the schedule costs between $+16.7$ and $+70.8$ PPL. Iteration adds a smaller bounded benefit on top of the schedule, with a clear optimum at $T_s{=}4$ and a U-shaped degradation beyond it. The GRU gate and learned per-step embeddings are required for that benefit to appear, and training with random $T_s$ yields an inference-time iteration-count knob at the cost of substantially higher absolute PPL. We position the work as a controlled reading of which parts of NCA-style computation carry the weight in language modelling.

AI.tldr: TextNCA将神经细胞自动机(NCA)原语映射到一维因果语言建模,提出分层变体Hier-TextNCA(窗口[8,32,128]级联,每阶段Ts=4次共享权重迭代)。核心发现:模型PPL(60.3)未超越Transformer基线(52.8/44.7),但作为分析探针揭示其行为主要由"窄到宽"分阶段窗口调度驱动(调度扰动代价+16.7至+70.8 PPL),而非迭代本身(非迭代对照仅+4.1 PPL差距)。迭代呈U形,最优Ts=4,GRU门控和可学习步嵌入为必要条件。
AI.motivation: 探究NCA风格计算(严格局部、权重共享迭代、门控原地更新)能否支持语言建模,以及这三个属性中哪个真正驱动模型行为。现有语言模型(Universal Transformer、ALBERT、滑动窗口Transformer)均未同时具备全部三个NCA特性。
AI.method: 1)架构:将NCA原语实例化为1D因果窗口注意力+FFN+GRU门控的循环单元,以可学习步嵌入st区分迭代步。2)分层变体:3个级联阶段,窗口w∈{8,32,128}单调递增,每阶段参数θk独立但阶段内Ts次迭代共享权重,共12个NCA步。3)训练:WikiText-103(实为SlimPajama+Mistral 32K BPE分词),60k步,~30M参数,bfloat16+AdamW+梯度检查点。4)系统消融:7个轴(感知核、门控、步嵌入、编排、阶段数K、窗口调度、迭代数Ts),下游评估涵盖IMDb/AG News/SST-2分类及SQuAD v1.1。
AI.result: 主要结果:1)窗口调度是主导架构因素:前向[8,32,128]达60.3 PPL,反向[128,32,8]为131.1,均匀[32,32,32]为119.7,非单调[8,128,32]为77.0——"起始窄"比严格单调更重要。非迭代SWin-TF-Staged对照达64.5 PPL(仅+4.1差距)。2)迭代Ts呈U形:Ts=2/4/6/8对应PPL 80.3/60.3/73.9/117.9,最优Ts=4。3)GRU门控为关键:换为residual门控PPL升至76.6(+16.3);移除步嵌入升至82.7,正弦步嵌入崩溃至119.5。4)分层感知的"准备-然后-解码"机制:阶段1-2构建线性可分离表示但不降低next-token损失,阶段3(5.8 nats降幅)完成跨从句关联(如Germany→France 7-token距离需w=128)。5)下有可解释性:per-step CKA显示S1.1和S3.4为离群点,S1.4-S3.1形成>0.85相似性紧密簇;GRU门呈现"积累-巩固-重写"模式。6)随机Ts训练恢复推理时迭代数控制旋钮(101-108 PPL),代价为绝对PPL显著上升。7)分类任务与Transformer基线统计平局(91.2% vs 90.5%/90.8%),SQuAD F1=26.3低于Transformer(28.6/33.2),失败模式归因于局部注意而非迭代本身。计算匹配下差距扩大:FLOP匹配时70.6 vs 52.8,墙钟匹配时80.1 vs 52.8。
AI.conclusion: NCA风格计算可在语言建模中运行,但其行为主要由"窄到宽"分层窗口调度解释(+59.4至+70.8 PPL调度扰动代价 vs 仅+4.1 PPL迭代收益)。迭代作为有效深度旋钮,Ts=4为最优,超出后呈U形恶化。GRU门控和可学习步嵌入是迭代收益的必要条件。本文定位为受控分析探针而非性能竞争者:Transformer在匹配计算下仍显著占优,TextNCA不具计算Pareto优越性。贡献在于精确隔离了NCA风格计算中各组件在语言建模中的实际权重——窗口调度的顺序结构而非迭代或权重共享本身。

title: Geometry-Guided Layerwise FFN Width Allocation in Transformers
summary: Feed-forward networks (FFNs) account for a large fraction of Transformer parameters, yet their hidden width is usually constant across depth. We ask whether this capacity can instead be allocated from a forward-pass measurement of layer behavior. We view each FFN as transporting a cloud of token representations and quantify the induced geometric change using correspondence-preserving shift, Gromov-Wasserstein distortion, and degree-one persistent homology under raw and scale-normalized metrics. A layerwise approximation surrogate yields an exact fixed-budget optimizer. Across seven pretrained language models, raw Euclidean work largely tracks residual-norm growth, whereas normalized work is predominantly front-loaded. Gromov-Wasserstein work is more consistently associated with perturbation-based layer sensitivity than the finite-sample topological estimate. In paired 128M and 256M training runs, several normalized-work schedules reduce mean validation loss relative to both uniform width and a hand-designed cosine taper. With the amplified paired differences at 440M, the best geometry-based allocations improve over uniform substantially larger than the cosine taper, while the anti-topological raw control is worse than uniform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于前向传播几何测量的Transformer FFN宽度逐层分配方法，将每个FFN视为token表示云的传输，通过对应保持位移、Gromov-Wasserstein失真和一阶持续同调三种统计量在原始/球面/双曲三种几何下量化"几何功"，结合内在维度近似代理推导出固定预算下的最优宽度分配。在128M、256M和440M规模的配对训练实验中，几何驱动的分配方案（特别是拓扑/双曲组合）的平均验证损失降幅显著优于均匀宽度和TLM余弦锥形分配。
AI.motivation: Transformer中FFN通常占据参数主体，但隐层宽度在所有层中保持一致，这一设计假设各层的非线性容量需求相同。然而表征和层功能随深度变化，已有TLM工作证明余弦锥形分配可改善性能，但余弦形状和端点仍是手工设计的超参数，缺乏逐层自适应。本研究旨在直接从参考模型激活中提取数据驱动的宽度分配规则。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三部分：(1) 将FFN视为token云的传输，定义几何功 $\widehat{W}_\ell = D(\pi(Z_\ell), \pi(H_\ell))$，在三种几何（原始欧氏、球面角距离、固定半径Poincaré球）下计算三种统计量（位移功、Gromov-Wasserstein功、拓扑功）；(2) 建立近似代理：假设加性损失 $\Delta\mathcal{L} \approx \sum_\ell \lambda_\ell \epsilon_\ell$，误差宽度律 $\epsilon_\ell(w) \approx C_\ell w^{-a_\ell}$，$a_\ell = s/d_{\text{int}}(\ell)$（使用TwoNN估计内在维度，固定$s=3$），将功作为$C_\ell$的代理；(3) 推导带下界的凸优化封闭解 $w_\ell^* = \max\{w_{\min}, (a_\ell c_\ell/\mu^*)^{1/(a_\ell+1)}\}$，通过一维二分法求解共享乘子$\mu^*$，后舍入到硬件兼容倍数。诊断实验覆盖七个预训练模型（Llama 3.1/3.2、Gemma 2/3、Mistral 7B），扰动实验评估加性假设与灵敏度$\lambda_\ell$，并通过配对种子训练对比分配效果。
AI.result: (1) 标度敏感性：原始欧氏Gromov和拓扑功随深度尾端上升（追踪残差范数），而归一化功以前端加载为主，跨模型族一致；(2) 诊断：联合扰动与单层扰动和正相关（$R^2\approx0.72$），小秩去除近似线性，TwoNN内在维度远低于环境维数（中间层4–5），Gromov功与灵敏度关联强于拓扑功（7个模型中5个占优）；(3) 128M/256M：三配对种子筛选中，多数归一化几何方案的均值差为负，拓扑/双曲最优，余弦接近均匀，反拓扑/原始控制近零或为正；(4) 440M五配对种子聚焦对比：拓扑/双曲均差$-0.019$，Gromov/球面$-0.016$，约为余弦锥形$-0.003$的6.3倍，反拓扑/原始控制$+0.066$劣于均匀。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明FFN容量不应假定均匀，激活驱动的几何分配可恢复早期加权形态并保留模型/层特有结构。归一化几何变化是有效的设计原则，但无单一通用最优几何/统计量：Gromov功与灵敏度关联更强，拓扑功获得最佳训练均值，反映$C_\ell$与$\lambda_\ell$的角色不同。主要局限是缺乏逐层宽度扫描直接校准$C_\ell = \widehat{W}_\ell$，配对差不确定性尚未充分报告，五颗种子的440M均值差异尚无法确立统计显著性。整体上，几何功分配被视为锥形分配的实用扩展，激励进一步将几何功与逐层近似需求直接校准。

title: An AI-Based Decision-Support Pipeline for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Forecasting
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the UK AI Conference (UK-AI 2026)
summary: Reliable photovoltaic (PV) forecasts are needed for low-carbon energy systems, but newly deployed sites often have short, imperfect records. This makes standard day-ahead forecasting difficult: persistence and physical baselines can be sensitive to calibration and timestamp alignment, while single machine-learning models may capture only one structure in the data and overstate skill under non-temporal validation. We study this problem at a United Kingdom charging-station site, where PV forecast errors affect charging availability, storage scheduling, and downstream control. Using measured inverter output and publicly available meteorological inputs, we develop a deployment-oriented environmental-AI pipeline for day-ahead hourly PV forecasting. The pipeline corrects timestamp conventions, constructs leakage-safe solar-geometry and clearness-index features, adds short-term atmospheric context, and combines complementary predictors through validation-learned stacking. Against smart persistence, a clear-sky baseline that adjusts recent PV output using expected clear-sky irradiance, the best ensemble reduces daylight normalised RMSE by about 32% under random day-blocked evaluation and 9% under the stricter rolling-origin protocol. It also reduces daylight RMSE relative to the strongest individual machine-learning baseline by 6.6% and 6.4%, respectively. The results show that physics-aware stacking can support PV forecasts from limited site data, but its value depends on model class, evaluation protocol, and deployment context.

AI.tldr: 本文针对英国FEVER充电站新部署场景（仅约一年且含缺失值的有限数据），提出了一套面向部署的"物理感知"环境AI光伏日前预测流水线。通过修正时间戳错位、构建无泄漏的太阳几何与晴空指数特征、加入短期大气上下文，并融合五种结构互补的基学习器（线性Ridge、GBM、晴空指数GBM、逐小时GBM、CNN），在随机日折交叉验证下相比智能持续性基线降低日间归一化RMSE约32%，相比最优单模型降低6.6%；在更严格的滚动起点（rolling-origin）协议下分别降低9%和6.4%。研究表明，物理结构应通过归一化目标注入而非原始协变量，短期天气上下文对分布偏移最关键，且评估协议对性能结论有决定性影响。
AI.motivation: 随着低碳能源系统（充电站、储能调度）日益依赖光伏发电，新部署站点常面临历史记录短（约一年）、观测缺失的问题，导致日前小时级PV预测极具挑战：参数化/物理基线对标定和时间戳对齐敏感；单一机器学习模型仅捕获数据中的一种结构，且在非时序验证下可能高估技能。PV预测误差直接影响充电可用性、储能与备用调度，故研究面向部署决策支持的有限数据预测方法具有重要实际意义。
AI.method: 构建端到端AI决策支持流水线：（1）数据预处理——将逆变器测量与Open-Meteo ERA5再分析气象数据对齐UTC小时网格，识别并修正1小时时间戳错位（PV标签为积分区间结束时刻，气象为起始），用99.9%分位数估计装机容量C_PV≈1664 kW；（2）特征工程——用pvlib/NREL SPA计算太阳天顶角、高度角、相对大气质量、外太空辐照度、阵列入射角与平面阵列（POA）辐照度，构建晴空指数kt；引入11个气象变量的±1小时滞后/超前及3小时滚动均值作为短期大气上下文，加上day-of-year的正弦余弦编码，得到60维特征向量；（3）基学习器——Ridge回归、直方图GBM、晴空指数GBM（用POA归一化目标，仅训练于日间）、逐小时GBM（每小时独立建模）、二维CNN（8×24张量输入，3个卷积块+GroupNorm+GELU+Dropout，光照时段加权4倍MSE）；（4）集成融合——采用非负最小二乘（NNLS）堆叠、Ridge堆叠、反向RMSE加权、简单平均四种融合方式，权重仅在验证集上拟合；（5）双协议评估——随机日折（5折）与滚动起点（前120天初始训练池+4个连续测试窗口，保留时序），指标包括R²、MAE、RMSE、nMAE、nRMSE，分全部小时与几何日光（太阳高度角>5°）子集。
AI.result: 核心结果：（1）随机日折下NNLS堆叠日间R²=0.769、nRMSE=12.32%，全小时R²=0.861；最优单模型GBM日间R²=0.735；（2）滚动起点下Ridge堆叠日间R²=0.567、nRMSE=16.94%，CNN次之；两协议间日间R²下降0.20、nRMSE上升约4.6个百分点，揭示显著的时序分布偏移；（3）相对智能持续性基线的技能分数：随机日折s≈0.32，滚动起点s≈0.09；相对最优单模型RMSE降幅分别为6.6%与6.4%，DM检验强烈拒绝等精度假设（p<10⁻⁸）；（4）NNLS权重分析：随机日折下CNN获最大权重（≈0.45）因其残差与其它模型相关性最低（ρ≈0.71–0.74），滚动起点下权重转向晴空指数GBM（≈0.41）；（5）消融实验：时间戳修正使无参数晴空代理日间R²从0.42升至0.60，但对学习集成几乎无影响；移除太阳几何/晴空特征意外提升滚动起点技能（nRMSE从16.94%降至14.07%）——因强季节性协变量在短训练历史下外推差；去除时间上下文则使滚动起点nRMSE升至17.83%（R²从0.567降至0.520），表明短期大气上下文对分布偏移下的部署最关键。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明物理感知堆叠可在有限站点数据下支持实用的PV日前预测，但价值高度依赖模型类别与评估协议：物理结构应通过稳定的归一化目标（如晴空指数）而非强季节性原始协变量注入；时间戳对齐对物理可解释性至关重要但被灵活学习器吸收；短期天气上下文是分布偏移下性能的关键支撑。环境AI应"以流水线为中心、对协议敏感"：诊断对齐、注入物理采用平稳归一化表示、保留短期天气上下文，并以更严格的滚动起点协议作为部署技能的主要估计。滚动起点结果同时表明有限历史会加剧分布偏移敏感性，技能应随新季节数据积累而更新。未来工作包括概率预测、跨站点/气候区验证，以及将预测改善量化为充电调度、储能分配与备用管理的实际运行价值。

title: How Much Does a Reasoning Summary Reveal? An Observability Ladder for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models often show users a final response and a short reasoning summary while the full reasoning trace stays hidden. We introduce an observability ladder that holds each completed run fixed and varies only what a reader inspects to judge whether the answer is correct: the response, a self-summary the model writes from the trace, the trace itself, and internal signals, each with and without the prompt. Across three benchmarks and five open-weight Qwen3 and gpt-oss models, we train matched linear correctness predictors on each access level. Without the prompt, summaries carry most of the trace's ranking signal (mean AUROC 0.774 versus 0.813) and add +0.156 over the response alone. With the prompt visible, the summary's gain collapses to +0.019, while the trace still adds +0.041. Even at equal length, the trace's last words predict correctness as well as summaries, or slightly better, and carry denser and more discriminative uncertainty and self-correction cues. On MMLU-Pro questions with both correct and incorrect runs, linear summary readers are near chance and trace readers retain only modest signal, both with and without the prompt (prompt-withheld AUROC 0.503-0.545 versus 0.544-0.590). With the prompt withheld, a GPT-5-mini reader recovers substantially more signal from both summaries and traces on gpt-oss-20b, and even then the trace keeps a small +0.034 advantage. Much of the linear readers' trace signal is associated with length. In the common case where users already hold the prompt, summaries are less helpful than the full trace for monitoring correctness. Monitorability is thus a joint property of the display and the reader, so any monitorability claim, including for faithfulness, should specify both.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可观测性阶梯"(observability ladder)框架，将 LLM 推理过程的可观测访问层级分为响应、自总结、完整思维链和内部信号，并联合提示词可见性进行系统研究，发现监控准确性是显示方式与读者能力的联合属性。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型通常只向用户展示最终响应和简短推理总结，而隐藏完整思维链。这使得用户难以判断模型输出的正确性。现有研究缺乏对不同可观测层级下推理信号有效性的系统比较，且未考虑提示词可见性与读者能力这两个关键因素的交互作用，导致可监控性(monitorability)声明缺乏严谨性。
AI.method: 构建"可观测性阶梯"框架，固定每次完成的运行，仅变化读者可检查的内容：(1)响应、(2)模型自生成的总结、(3)完整思维链、(4)内部信号，每种层级分别配合/不配合提示词使用。在三个基准测试和五个开源权重模型（Qwen3 与 gpt-oss 系列）上，为每个访问层级训练匹配（matched）的线性正确性预测器，并对比 GPT-5-mini 作为读者时的信号恢复能力。
AI.result: (1) 无提示词时，总结承载了思维链大部分排序信号（平均 AUROC 0.774 对比 0.813），相较单独使用响应提升 +0.156；(2) 有提示词时，总结增益骤降至 +0.019，而思维链仍贡献 +0.041；(3) 等长度条件下，思维链末尾内容预测正确性的能力与总结相当甚至更优，且蕴含更密集、更具判别性的不确定性信号与自我纠错线索；(4) 在同一问题同时具有正确与错误运行的 MMLU-Pro 子集上，线性总结读者接近随机水平（AUROC 0.503-0.545），而思维链读者保留适度信号（0.544-0.590）；(5) GPT-5-mini 读者在 gpt-oss-20b 上能恢复更多信号，但思维链仍保持 +0.034 优势；(6) 线性读者所获的思维链信号在很大程度上与输出长度相关。
AI.conclusion: 在用户已掌握提示词的常见场景下，总结对监控正确性的帮助远小于完整思维链；可监控性是"显示方式"与"读者能力"的联合属性。因此，任何关于可监控性的主张（包括推理忠实性 faithfulness）都必须同时明确指定显示层级与读者类型。

title: IACM-RL: Intent-Aware Context Management and Reinforcement Learning for Complex Tool Invocation under Dynamic Intent Fluctuations
summary: Executing long-horizon tool invocations in real-world environments is severely challenged by dynamic user intent noise. Existing methods attempt robustness via implicit history scanning or text compression, yet predominantly assume perfect instructions in simplistic scenarios. Inevitably, under fluctuating contexts, obsolete constraints dilute model attention, triggering catastrophic intent deviation and infinite API loops. To resolve this, we propose IACM-RL, a comprehensive framework for robust tool invocation. First, we introduce the DynamicIntent pipeline, synthesizing trajectories across 13 fine-grained fluctuation scenarios, paired with a five-dimensional diagnostic metric suite. Second, IACM-RL deploys a BeliefState-based Self-Generated Context Manager that proactively tracks shifting goals and isolates overwritten parameters using structural stale flags. To autonomously internalize this state-tracking capability, we optimize the policy using a hierarchical intent-driven reward alongside three auxiliary losses (action calibration, CM extraction, and state distillation). Experiments on DynamicIntent, BFCL-V3, and $\mathrm{\tau}^2$-Bench demonstrate that IACM-RL significantly outperforms baselines, reducing infinite loops and stale context errors while enhancing out-of-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IACM-RL 框架，针对动态意图波动下的长链路工具调用问题，通过 BeliefState 驱动的自生成上下文管理器（Context Manager）显式解耦状态追踪与动作生成，并结合分层意图驱动奖励与三项辅助损失，使智能体在噪声意图下自我内化状态追踪能力，在 DynamicIntent、BFCL-V3 和 τ²-Bench 上取得最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体在长链路工具调用中普遍假设"完美静态指令"，但真实场景中用户频繁修改任务、插入无关闲聊或提出模糊约束。历史噪声的累积会稀释模型对关键 token 的注意力，引发灾难性意图偏离与无限 API 循环。现有方法（隐式历史扫描、文本压缩、长上下文微调等）仅在简单场景下具备鲁棒性，无法应对长链路、多工具、并行任务下的意图波动。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：① **DynamicIntent 数据管线**：通过工具抽象、依赖图构建、轨迹增强（覆盖 13 种细粒度意图波动场景，归为 Modification/Interruption/Clarification/Accumulation/Chaining 五大模式）、多维过滤与 LLM 仿真执行，生成多轮训练轨迹，并配套五维评测指标（JGA、SCRR、RIR、DTCR、ISSR）；② **基于 BeliefState 的自生成上下文管理器**：在每轮先解码一个包含 9 个 XML 子块、五大字段（C_slots、G_current、A_last、Q_pending、I_signal）的紧凑状态块，对被覆盖的参数加结构性 stale 标志，将动作生成与显式状态追踪解耦；③ **分层意图驱动 RL 优化**：采用 PPO+G AE，奖励分为认知（R_belief）、行为（R_action）、结果（R_outcome）三层，并叠加三项辅助损失：动作校准损失 L_cal、CM 提取损失 L_ext（以轨迹优势直接优化 CM token）、状态蒸馏损失 L_dist（前向 KL 将 CM 条件教师策略蒸馏到无 CM 学生策略，使能力内化到参数中）。训练分两阶段：单步预训练 + 多轮微调。
AI.result: 在 DynamicIntent（ID/OOD）、BFCL-V3 与 τ²-Bench 三个基准上，IACM-RL 取得最高整体平均分（64.0），且 ID 与 OOD 认知得分接近（36.5 vs 36.3），显著优于 PPO-noCM、PPO-noCM + CM、FIFO-k、Prompt-Comp、LLMLingua、ACON、MEM1、RL-STA 等基线。关键发现：① 在超长对话（>16k tokens）上 PPO-noCM 完全失效（0.0），而 IACM-RL 仍达 34.8；② OOD 场景下 Modification 提升 +4.7、Clarification 提升 +4.2；③ 对抗干扰 L3（3 假任务+5 闲聊）下仍保持 36.8% 准确率，优于 PPO-noCM 的 25.6%；④ 消融实验证实 L_ext、L_dist、各奖励层均不可替代；⑤ 1.7B 小模型上仍保持最优平均（54.2），验证方法可迁移。
AI.conclusion: IACM-RL 通过显式解耦状态追踪与动作生成，为动态意图波动下的鲁棒工具调用提供了实用路径。BeliefState 中的 stale 标志机制有效防止模型回退到被覆盖的旧值；分层奖励与三项辅助损失共同将显式状态追踪能力内化到模型参数中，即使推理阶段移除 CM 块也能受益。实验证明该框架在长链路、OOD 场景和对抗干扰下均显著优于压缩式与隐式记忆方法，为构建可靠的真实世界智能体代理奠定了基础。

title: Self-Improving Large Language Models via Progressive Experience Evolution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) capable of self-improvement require not only effective policy optimization, but also a principled mechanism for transforming transient interaction experience into persistent model capabilities. Existing self-improvement paradigms remain fragmented: test-time methods can explicitly extract experience but cannot internalize it into model parameters, whereas training-time optimization methods can update model parameters but lack an explicit mechanism for accumulating transferable experience. Bridging these two paradigms requires a critical intermediate stage that remains underexplored, namely \emph{experience distillation}. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{SPEE} (\textbf{S}elf-\textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{E}xperience \textbf{E}volution), a unified post-training framework that sequentially performs explicit experience evolution followed by implicit policy optimization. During explicit experience evolution, SPEE reflects on trajectories collected from multiple interactions to extract, verify, and progressively evolve transferable experience, which is subsequently internalized into the policy through privilege-guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). During implicit policy optimization, reward-driven reinforcement learning leverages these internalized priors to explore novel solution strategies. In the experience evolution stage, a continuously evolving global experience pool consolidates knowledge from both successful and failed trajectories, filters out low-utility experience, and mitigates post-hoc rationalization induced by individual trajectories. Experiments on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SPEE consistently outperforms both test-time and training-time self-evolution baselines across three model scales. The source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SPEE（Self-Progressive Experience Evolution）框架，通过显式经验演化与隐式策略优化两个阶段，将LLM的瞬时交互经验转化为持久模型能力。该方法在五个数学推理基准上显著优于现有的测试时和训练时自演化基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自改进方法存在明显缺陷：测试时方法虽能显式提取经验但无法将其内化为模型参数；训练时方法（特别是强化学习）虽能更新参数但缺乏积累可迁移经验的机制。二者之间存在一个关键但被忽视的中间环节——经验蒸馏（experience distillation），即将文本经验显式提取并通过密集监督内化到模型中，从而为强化学习提供更强的初始化，解决稀疏奖励信号和探索效率低下的问题。
AI.method: SPEE是一个统一的后训练框架，包含两阶段：(1) 显式经验演化阶段——维护一个全局经验池，从成功和失败轨迹中提取可迁移经验项，通过演化算子Φ合并去重、抽象泛化，并通过探针集评估边际效用进行两阶段过滤筛选，最后采用特权引导的On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)将经验作为特权信息蒸馏到学生策略中，最小化学生与教师策略的逆KL散度；(2) 隐式策略优化阶段——使用GRPO算法在已蒸馏的策略基础上进行奖励驱动的探索，通过组内相对优势计算策略梯度。整体形成自强化循环：累积的经验改进策略，增强的策略生成更丰富的经验供下一轮演化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B三个模型规模、五个数学推理基准（AIME24/25、GSM8K、MATH500、Minerva Math）上的实验表明，SPEE平均准确率均优于Base、Domain Prompt、GRPO和SDPO基线。qwen3-4b-base上取得最高6.96个百分点提升。消融实验验证了两阶段和共享经验池的必要性。Stage I减少了全错响应组的比例同时保持策略熵；SPEE比GRPO节省约28%训练数据即可达到可比性能；经验演化迭代次数从0增至4时采样准确率持续提升（+3.83个百分点，相对提升约20.34%）。
AI.conclusion: SPEE为LLM自演化提供了有效的闭环机制，通过显式经验演化与隐式策略优化的协同，实现了持续自我改进。实验证明该框架在多个模型规模和基准上具有一致性优势。未来工作可将经验演化范式扩展至更广泛的任务领域、稀疏或复杂反馈的场景，并探索多轮迭代方法。

title: RamanPFN: learning from Raman spectral structure with a tabular foundation model
summary: Raman spectroscopy enables non-destructive, label-free molecular characterization across materials science, biomedicine and process monitoring. Predictive Raman datasets often contain few labelled spectra and thousands of ordered wavenumbers, with informative variation within bands and across distant spectral regions. Latent-variable chemometrics accommodates collinear small-sample data but can obscure fine peak morphology, whereas deep spectral networks resolve this structure only after task-specific training. TabPFN avoids task-specific parameter fitting through pretrained in-context inference, but processes very wide inputs as feature-subsampled views that do not preserve joint visibility of related bands. We present RamanPFN, a spectral representation framework that encodes these dependencies before TabPFN inference. Global Compositional Unmixing constructs non-negative coordinates over the complete spectrum so that distant bands with shared latent variation occupy a common predictive axis. Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding represents contiguous wavenumber regions with multiple orthogonal modes that retain independent changes in peak shape, intensity and position. The representations are evaluated separately and combined at the prediction level. Evaluation covered 150 tasks from 74 public Raman datasets. RamanPFN reduced root-mean-square error by 19.6% on average across 129 regression targets relative to direct TabPFN inference and further reduced the remaining classification error by 9.0% across 21 classification tasks. These results establish explicit spectral representation as an effective interface between high-dimensional Raman measurements and reusable tabular inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RamanPFN，一种面向拉曼光谱的双尺度表征框架。它通过全局成分解混（GCU）和局部振动子空间编码（LVSE）将高维有序拉曼光谱转化为紧凑表示，再馈送至冻结参数的 TabPFN 进行上下文推理。在 74 个公开数据集的 150 个任务（129 回归 + 21 分类）上，回归 RMSE 平均降低 19.6%，分类错误率再降低 9.0%，全面优于 26 种回归基线和 28 种分类基线。
AI.motivation: 拉曼光谱数据具有"高维小样本"特性：每条光谱包含上千个有序波数通道，但标注样本往往只有几十到几百条。现有方法存在两类局限：(1) 传统化学计量学（如 PLS）虽适配小样本共线性数据，但会模糊局部峰形细节；(2) 深度谱网络虽能学习非线性局部模式，但每个数据集都需重新训练，难以在小标注条件下分离化学信号与仪器/样本噪声。而 TabPFN 等表格基础模型虽在小数据上表现出色，但其将列视为可交换变量，对超宽输入采用 500 特征子采样视图，导致相距较远但共享潜变量的谱带无法在同一推理上下文中共同出现——"覆盖率≠上下文"。因此需要在送入基础模型前，显式编码拉曼谱的两个物理组织尺度：跨全谱的成分协变结构与局部振动形态结构。
AI.method:
RamanPFN 框架包含两个互补表征模块与一个集成步骤：
(1) **全局成分解混（GCU）**：对非负变换后的训练谱进行非负矩阵分解（NMF），使用 NNDSVD 初始化与分层交替最小二乘法求解；保留中间迭代状态形成多分辨率族，得到跨完整波数轴的丰度型坐标，使远距离谱带可共享同一预测轴。测试谱通过固定组分 H 进行非负投影。
(2) **局部振动子谱编码（LVSE）**：将变换后的波数轴划分为 S 个连续区间（如 32 路分区），在每个区间内做中心化 SVD，保留前 kₛ 个右奇异向量，拼接为局部坐标。该编码保留峰强、肩形、邻带比及微小位移的独立变化方向。
(3) **符号三元组集成**：同一冻结 TabPFN 分别对 GCU 与 LVSE 表示做推理；训练 OOF 证据选出参考预测 p_ref，并通过固定策略将候选分配为负向、局部与锚点角色，构造 p_triplet = -λp₋ + λpₗ + p_h（λ∈{1, 0.75, 0.5}）；保留 8 个三元组并以均值/中位数/对称截尾均值聚合为最终预测。
两表征分支均可独立运行、组合使用或启用集成，形成 5 档消融配置。
AI.result:
在 RamanBench 的 74 个公开数据集的 150 个任务上三重复评估：
- **回归（129 目标，53 数据集）**：相对直接 TabPFN 基线，RMSE 平均降低 19.6%（95% CI 15.8%–23.5%），109/129 目标改善，49/53 数据集改善；对 26 种外部基线（含 TabPFN v2/v2.5、TabICL v2、MITRA、TabDPT、RamanNet、RamanFormer、CatBoost、XGBoost、PLS 等）取得最低 RMSE，Holm 校正后所有配对对比 p≤1.43×10⁻⁸；Score 0.920、Elo 1808，均为最优。
- **分类（21 任务）**：加权 F1 由 0.833 提升至 0.848，相对剩余错误降低 9.0%，16/21 任务改善；对 28 种基线同样全面领先。
- **消融**：GCU 单独 RMSE ↓10.2%，LVSE 单独 ↓10.7%，二者直接组合 ↓13.3%，完整 RamanPFN ↓19.6%；73 目标由两分支共同改善，20 仅受益于 GCU，24 仅受益于 LVSE，12 个无改善。
- **机制分析**：宽谱下 TabPFN 特征对/三元组的同现覆盖率随谱宽单调下降，11 689 通道时仅 4.4% 随机对与 0.19% 随机三元组同时出现在某次前向传递中，定量证实了"覆盖率≠上下文"假设。
AI.conclusion: 工作证明显式光谱表征可作为高维拉曼测量与可复用表格推理之间的有效接口。GCU 提供全谱感受野以耦合远距离谱带，LVSE 在连续区间内保留多模局部变化，符号三元组集成在预测层面融合两尺度信息；二者各自独立贡献并互补，共同支撑回归与分类两类预测范式。论文核心结论"coverage is not context"将表格基础模型的成功条件从"每个特征被看到"提升到"相关特征在同一上下文中被共同看到"。该表征即接口的设计原则有望推广到近红外、红外、高光谱、色谱及衍射等同时具有局部结构与长程协变的有序信号模态。

title: Lossless Tensor Compression as Program Synthesis
summary: Model checkpoints are growing in both number and size, which makes archival, transfer, and deployment increasingly costly. General-purpose compressors can reduce storage requirements but ignore tensor structure, whereas existing tensor-specific compressors rely on fixed and format-specific pipelines. We present Brevis, which formulates lossless tensor compression as program synthesis. We design a typed domain-specific language (DSL) that captures recurring tensor structures, such as repeated regions and floating-point fields, through a set of reversible operators. Given a tensor, Brevis synthesizes a self-contained DSL program that reconstructs it bit-exactly. A checkpoint-specific production prior, learned from a small representative sample of tensors, guides a bounded A* search to synthesize compact programs, which can later be executed directly for bit-exact decompression. On 10 public checkpoints spanning language, audio, and image generation models, Brevis reduces 2.13 TB of checkpoint data to 1.41 TB, a 33.93% storage reduction. It produces archives up to 30.87% smaller than those of four general-purpose compressors, including zstd and gzip, and smaller archives than the tensor-specific compressors ZipNN and DFloat11. Under a practical concurrency configuration, Brevis achieves 3.60 GB/s compression and 6.61 GB/s decompression while preserving every source byte.

AI.tldr: Brevis将无损张量压缩重新定义为程序合成问题，通过设计一个类型化的领域特定语言(DSL)来捕捉张量中的重复区域、浮点字段等结构，并使用有界A*搜索合成能够逐位精确重建张量的紧凑程序。在10个公开模型检查点上，Brevis将2.13 TB数据压缩至1.41 TB(减少33.93%)，优于zstd、gzip、ZipNN和DFloat11等基线，并达到3.60 GB/s压缩和6.61 GB/s解压缩吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 随着Hugging Face等平台上的模型仓库快速增长(从2020年的425个增至295万个，托管超15 PB数据)，模型检查点的存储、传输和部署成本急剧上升。现有通用压缩器(如gzip、zstd)将张量视为通用字节流，忽略了张量的内部结构；而现有的张量专用压缩器(如ZipNN、DFloat11)依赖固定且与格式相关的压缩流水线，无法捕捉张量特有的模式（如重复值、元素关系）。因此，亟需一种能够针对每个张量定制压缩方案的方法，以实现更高效的无损检查点归档。
AI.method: Brevis的核心方法包含三个关键组件：(1) 类型化DSL：定义了7个可逆算子(Lit、Const、Concat、Repeat、Map、Scan、Merge)，通过类型规则保证位精确重建，Lit作为通用后备编码器支持原始字、固定宽度比特打包、Huffman和rANS编码；(2) 目标导向的有界A*搜索：从目标张量反向分解，每个孔都与其必须生成的精确流配对，仅当子程序的输出重组等于目标时才算有效分解，通过精确序列化大小L(P)评估候选程序；(3) 检查点特定的产生式先验：从少量张量样本中学习DSL产生式的概率分布，按孔类型、父算子、深度、dtype等上下文信息索引，用于引导搜索顺序但不影响正确性。分解通过构造保证正确性，无需反复执行完整程序。
AI.result: 在涵盖语言、音频、图像生成模型的10个公开检查点(共2.13 TB、420个分片)上，Brevis将数据压缩至1.41 TB，实现33.93%的存储减少(节省722.79 GB)。在所有10个检查点上均产生最小归档：相对四个通用压缩器平均节省12.94%-30.87%；比张量专用基线ZipNN在所有检查点上更小(总节省10.21 GB)；在Llama-3.1-8B上比DFloat11小2.90%。所有配对比较经Holm校正后均统计显著(p_H=0.0098, r_rb=1.0)。吞吐量方面，Brevis达到3.60 GB/s压缩和6.61 GB/s解压缩，位于存储-吞吐量的Pareto前沿。消融实验表明有界A*提供主要压缩增益(去除后增加约2.87 MB)，而学习先验进一步改善搜索效率。
AI.conclusion: Brevis成功将无损张量压缩形式化为程序合成问题，通过类型化DSL、目标导向有界A*搜索和检查点特定产生式先验，在保持位精确重建的同时显著优于现有压缩器。该工作证明了程序合成范式在张量压缩中的有效性，为高效模型检查点归档提供了新途径。未来工作方向包括跨张量合成、更广泛的语料库评估以及加速器感知的解码。

title: Assessing the Impacts of Imperfect Datasets on Client Selections in Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a popular distributed learning framework where multiple clients perform local training and a server aggregates the locally updated models. FL enables decentralized training while preserving the privacy of clients' datasets. However, non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) or noisy datasets can lead to low model accuracy or high convergence latency. Precluding these clients through client selection may mitigate the problem, but heavily biased client selections may also degrade the learning performance. In this study, we first experimentally measure the impact of non-IID data (including skews in data quantity and label distribution), noisy data, and fairness in client selection on model accuracy and convergence. We then propose a privacy-preserving scoring method to assess each client's contribution in FL, with experiments conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究联邦学习（FL）中的客户端贡献评估问题，针对非独立同分布（non-IID）数据、噪声数据以及客户端选择公平性对模型精度和收敛性的影响，提出一种隐私保护的客户端贡献评分方法。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在实际应用中面临两大核心挑战：一是客户端数据往往呈现非独立同分布（non-IID）特性，包括数据量倾斜和标签分布倾斜；二是数据可能存在噪声。此外，若在客户端选择过程中过度排除某些客户端或选择偏差过大，也会进一步降低模型性能并引发公平性问题。因此，如何在不侵犯客户端数据隐私的前提下，准确评估每个客户端对全局模型的贡献，成为提升FL系统性能的关键。
AI.method: 1. 实验测量：通过控制变量实验，定量分析非IID数据（数据量倾斜与标签分布倾斜）、噪声数据以及客户端选择公平性对模型精度与收敛延迟的影响；2. 隐私保护评分方法：提出一种隐私保护的客户端贡献评估机制（具体算法细节未在所提供内容中详述），对各客户端贡献进行打分；3. 效果验证：通过实验证明所提出的贡献评估方法的有效性。
AI.result: 所提供内容为摘要级别，未给出具体数值结果。但摘要承诺：实验结果将展示该评分方法能够有效评估客户端贡献，从而缓解非IID与噪声数据带来的负面影响，并在客户端选择中兼顾性能与公平性。
AI.conclusion: 论文强调了在联邦学习中综合考虑数据异质性、噪声以及选择公平性的重要性，所提出的隐私保护评分方法为客户端贡献评估提供了一种可行方案，有助于在保护隐私的前提下优化FL系统的训练效果。

title: BRiG-AFA: Bellman Risk-to-Go Learning for Non-Myopic Active Feature Acquisition
summary: Active feature acquisition (AFA) asks which unobserved feature to measure next for each test instance under a budget. Greedy rules are easy to train but can overlook context features whose value is realized only through later acquisitions, while reinforcement-learning and generative approaches introduce difficult optimization or conditional-density estimation. We introduce \method, a deployable, supervised alternative that learns a separate candidate-conditioned risk-to-go function for every remaining budget. Starting from the one-step terminal classification risk, the functions are fitted backward with Bellman targets; inference greedily minimizes the learned terminal risk using only observed values, the mask, candidate identity, and remaining budget. A controlled non-myopic benchmark shows the expected mechanism: at budgets two and three, \method improves accuracy over its one-step ablation by $4.84\pm2.17$ and $4.39\pm1.10$ percentage points (mean $\pm$ standard error over five seeds). On Fashion-MNIST with 20 candidate pixels, it improves accuracy at every nontrivial reported budget on average, including $10.20\pm0.74$ points at four acquisitions; its mean paired gain across budgets $\{2,4,8,12,16\}$ is $3.50\pm0.37$ points. A three-seed MiniBooNE study is mixed at small budgets but positive at 8 and 16 acquisitions, identifying a current boundary rather than supporting a universal claim. These results establish a reproducible mechanism-level case for direct Bellman risk regression and delimit the experiments still needed for state-of-the-art comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRiG-AFA，一种用于非短视主动特征获取（AFA）的监督学习方法。该方法为每个剩余预算学习一个候选条件风险函数，利用Bellman目标从一步终端分类风险向后拟合。推理时贪心地最小化学到的终端风险。在CUBE-NM合成任务和Fashion-MNIST上验证了非短视机制的有效性，但在MiniBooNE上呈现混合结果，表明该机制并非普遍适用。
AI.motivation: 主动特征获取（AFA）需要在预算约束下决定下一步测量哪些未观察特征。贪心策略训练简单但可能忽略那些价值只有在后续获取中才能实现的上下文特征；而强化学习和生成式方法引入了困难的优化或条件密度估计问题。因此需要一个既简单又可部署、又能捕捉非短视（即具有前瞻性）依赖关系的替代方案。
AI.method: BRiG-AFA冻结一个在部分输入上预训练的掩码感知预测器，然后为每个剩余预算r∈{1,…,B}学习一个候选条件动作价值网络Q_r(x_m, m, a)。具体而言，Q_1以一步终端分类风险（交叉熵损失）作为目标；r>1时通过Bellman目标向后拟合：T_r = min_{a'} Q_{r-1}(x⊙m⁺, m⁺, a')，即利用已冻结的Q_{r-1}最小值作为目标。这属于拟合动态规划而非同步时序差分学习。训练采用通用状态采样器（混合空掩码与随机前缀），不依赖标签或任务元数据。推理时贪心选择使Q_{B-t}最小的候选特征，输入仅为已观测值、掩码、候选身份与剩余预算。核心消融对照"短视Q"在每步均使用Q_1，从而隔离Bellman递归本身的价值。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上进行配对评估（相同种子）。(1) CUBE-NM（12维合成门控任务，5种子）：预算2和3时BRiG-AFA比短视Q分别提升4.84±2.17和4.39±1.10个百分点（5种子均正收益于预算3），与"先获取上下文再特化"的预期机制一致；预算5和8时增益收敛。(2) Fashion-MNIST-20（5种子）：在所有非平凡报告预算上均优于短视Q，预算4时取得49.78% vs 39.58%，配对增益10.20±0.74个百分点（5/5种子正收益）；跨预算{2,4,8,12,16}平均增益3.50±0.37个百分点。(3) MiniBooNE（3种子，应力测试）：预算2和4时为负收益（-0.78±0.73、-0.98±0.36），但预算8和16时为正收益（0.93±1.33、0.93±0.27，3/3种子正收益），呈现混合曲线，表明长视距自举风险回归在一步排序已捕获大部分信号时不一定有益。
AI.conclusion: BRiG-AFA建立了直接、可部署的Bellman风险回归作为AFA非短视规划可行中间方案的可复现、机制层面证据。在预测器、状态采样器和评估协议固定的前提下，预算特定的风险函数可优于重复应用一步动作价值。但该方法并非普遍优于现代AFA系统：MiniBooNE揭示了自举误差累积和一步信号已充分时的局限性。未来工作需要在匹配协议下与SEFA、ACO、DIME、GDFS等方法进行基准对比，并扩展至成本感知Bellman公式、停止动作以及回顾性领域的策略诱导分布偏移问题。

title: Diffusion Policy with Behavioral Advantage Correction for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: In offline reinforcement learning (RL), the distribution shift between behavioral data and the learned policy can lead to erroneous \emph{Q}-value estimation, thereby misguiding the direction of policy optimization. To address this issue, we develop a behavioral advantage corrected policy evaluation (BAC-PE) approach, which utilizes the \emph{Q}-function of the behavior policy to correct the learned policy's \emph{Q}-function, thus mitigating pessimistic conservatism and overestimation bias. Furthermore, the convergence of BAC-PE is analyzed theoretically, and an upper bound on the difference between the learned \emph{Q}-function and the true \emph{Q}-function is derived. To alleviate distribution shift, this work employs diffusion models to represent both the behavior policy and the learned policy, performing distribution matching for accurate policy regularization. Additionally, \emph{Q}-value guidance is incorporated into the training process to achieve effective policy improvement. By combining BAC-PE with diffusion policy modeling, we propose the diffusion policy with behavioral advantage correction (DPBAC) algorithm. Compared to existing offline methods, DPBAC demonstrates stronger policy representation capabilities and effectively mitigates the bias in \emph{Q}-value estimation. Experimental results on multiple domains of D4RL tasks show that DPBAC achieves superior performance, with notable advantages over state-of-the-art (SOTA) algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPBAC（基于扩散策略与行为优势修正的离线强化学习算法），通过引入行为优势修正的策略评估（BAC-PE）机制与扩散策略建模相结合，解决了离线RL中因分布偏移导致的Q值估计偏差问题。该方法利用行为策略的Q函数作为自适应参考来修正学习策略的Q函数，同时采用扩散模型表示行为策略和学习策略以准确捕捉多模态分布。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习面临两大核心挑战：（1）分布偏移导致Q值估计出现错误的高估或过度悲观偏差；（2）现有方法存在局限性：值正则化方法（如CQL、IQL、SCORE、SVR）易过度保守而限制策略改进；策略正则化方法（如BC、BCQ、DOGE）要么继承行为策略的次优性，要么因简单高斯策略无法准确建模多模态行为分布而失效；现有扩散策略方法（如DQL、SRPO）缺乏对critic偏差的理论分析。论文识别出三大关键挑战：Q值估计机制改进、适度的策略正则化、以及具有表达力的策略表示。
AI.method: （1）**BAC-PE机制**：定义行为优势A^μ_Q = Q^μ - Q，构造修正Bellman算子T̂^π Q = B̂^π Q + ηÂ^μ_Q，其中η为修正系数；（2）**理论分析**：证明T̂^π为压缩映射且迭代收敛（定理1），推导不动点关系（定理2），并给出Q函数误差上界（定理3、4），证明误差与策略间TV散度及转移概率估计偏差正相关；（3）**扩散策略建模**：使用扩散模型同时表示行为策略和学习策略，通过前向加噪和反向去噪过程捕捉多模态分布，采用DPM-Solver加速采样；（4）**网络训练**：包含行为策略扩散损失、行为critic损失、修正critic损失（包含行为优势修正项的TD目标）以及加权组合的策略改进损失L_π = L_μ + ς̄·L_g；（5）**双Q网络+目标网络+软更新**的稳定训练机制。
AI.result: 在D4RL四个任务域（Gym-MuJoCo、AntMaze、FrankaKitchen、Adroit）共20个任务上与9个基线方法（CQL、SVR、IQL、SCORE、BC、BCQ、DOGE、DQL、SRPO）对比，8个随机种子下DPBAC取得全面领先：Gym-MuJoCo平均分87.4（最优），AntMaze平均分62.9（最优，复杂大型迷宫提升显著），FrankaKitchen平均分59.7（最优），Adroit平均分62.2（最优）。在Maze2D稀疏奖励任务中表现稳定。敏感度分析表明η=0.35为最优修正系数，扩散步数增加持续提升性能。Q值偏差实验验证了修正机制有效缓解了过估计和欠估计。t-SNE可视化证明学习策略紧密覆盖行为策略分布且具有更高Q值。
AI.conclusion: DPBAC通过将行为优势修正机制与扩散策略建模有机结合，有效缓解了离线RL中Q值估计的过估计偏差和过度悲观问题。理论分析为策略评估的收敛性和误差界提供了严格保证，误差界显示其依赖于学习策略与行为策略间的分布差异以及转移概率估计偏差。在D4RL基准多个任务域的广泛实验验证了DPBAC相较于现有SOTA方法在任务性能、策略表达力、稀疏奖励处理和Q值估计准确性方面的优越性。

title: Can AI Agents Simulate A/B Test Outcomes? A Validation Framework for Agentic Experimentation
comment: Accepted as a workshop paper at this https URL
summary: A/B testing remains the standard for rolling out new features in the technology industry. Each experiment, however, consumes real traffic, engineering effort, and weeks of wall-clock time. Can AI agents---conditioned on behavioral profiles and contextual descriptions of the intervention---simulate outcomes accurately enough to vet candidate treatments before committing live traffic? We formalize this question as a \emph{Simulated Randomized Controlled Trial} (S-RCT) and derive a two-layer error decomposition that separates agent approximation error from subsampling error, enabling targeted improvements to each. The framework is agent-agnostic: any behavioral model---from a fine-tuned specialist to a general-purpose foundation model---can serve as the simulation engine. Validated on 67 historical marketing A/B tests, a baseline S-RCT using an off-the-shelf foundation model captures directional signal (sign overlap 0.70) but systematically overshoots effect magnitudes. A two-phase pre-period calibration protocol reduces the squared prediction error (after removing irreducible measurement noise) by ${\sim}77\times$; a within-subject design---where each agent is exposed to both arms---reduces standard errors by ${\sim}2.4\times$. We discuss limitations of the current approach and identify applications where experimenters stand to benefit from agentic signals.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为"模拟随机对照试验"（S-RCT）的框架，用于评估AI智能体能否在消耗真实流量之前准确模拟A/B测试结果。研究在67个历史营销A/B测试上进行验证，发现基线模型能捕捉方向信号（符号重叠度0.70）但系统性高估效应幅度，并提出两项关键改进：两阶段预周期校准将平方预测误差降低约77倍；被试内设计将标准误差降低约2.4倍。
AI.motivation: A/B测试虽然是在线实验的标准方法，但每次实验需消耗真实流量、工程资源和数周时间。在大规模组织中，成千上万的实验累积成本巨大。一个足够准确的AI行为模拟器能让团队廉价地筛选候选方案，将真实流量留给最有潜力的方案，从而加速产品迭代并使客户更快受益。现有智能体A/B测试研究缺乏对估计误差的系统分解，难以诊断或减少误差。
AI.method: 1. **形式化框架**：将智能体A/B预测形式化为模拟随机对照试验（S-RCT），用模拟器替代真实流量。2. **双层误差分解**：将总误差分解为近似误差（模拟器预测与真实ATE的差距）和子采样误差（有限样本估计与模拟器总体ATE的差距），实现独立优化。3. **基线验证**：在67个历史营销CTR测试上使用现成通用基础模型进行基线评估。4. **三项改进技术**：（a）原理性子采样——采用Neyman分配按分层比例抽样，对连续指标（如收入）可实现2-5倍效率提升；（b）两阶段预周期校准——第一阶段在预周期数据上拟合Platt缩放校准函数，第二阶段应用于实验期预测；（c）被试内设计——每个智能体同时接受实验组和对照组处理，作为自身对照消除组成差异。4. **评估指标**：包括修正MSE（剔除不可约测量噪声）、符号重叠度、发布对齐度等。
AI.result: 1. **基线结果**（67个实验，1000智能体）：符号重叠度0.70（SE 0.03），修正MSE 0.0222，MAE 0.0893，发布对齐度0.41（接近随机底线0.33）。模型能捕捉方向信号但系统性高估效应幅度。2. **校准效果**：在16个实验中，Platt缩放将平方预测误差压缩约77倍，从系统性幅度过冲降至接近历史噪声水平。3. **被试内设计**：标准误差平均缩减约2.4倍；符号准确率从65%（被试间）提升至70%；发布对齐度从0.33提升至0.41。4. **诊断发现**：智能体表现出"行为放大"现象——对处理差异反应比真实用户更果断。5. **实用价值**：方向性筛选、推理轨迹、翻转者分析等辅助应用可在幅度准确性不可靠时仍提供价值。
AI.conclusion: 该论文建立了智能体A/B预测的形式化验证框架，揭示了当前通用基础模型的方向性潜力与系统性幅度偏差。通过双层误差分解实现针对性改进，校准和被试内设计显著提升准确性。然而，幅度过冲、单一领域基准（营销CTR）、共享模型导致的潜在响应相关性等仍是重要局限。未来工作需解决触发人群预测（部署缺失环节）和智能体行为放大的根本性匹配问题。框架不仅可用于估计ATE，还能支持方向性筛选、异质性分析等实际应用，为实验流水线加速提供近期可行路径。

title: GLAIM: Learning Global and Local Adaptive Inter-Variable Dependency for Multivariate Time Series Imputation
summary: Multivariate time series imputation is fundamental to downstream analysis, yet modeling inter-variable dependencies with incomplete observations remains challenging. Existing methods learn global dependencies across samples or dynamic local dependencies per sample. Global dependencies are stable but adapt poorly to sample variations and temporal non-stationarity, whereas local dependencies are adaptive yet unreliable when observations are insufficient, causing erroneous information propagation. To address these limitations, we propose GLAIM, a Global-Local Adaptive Inter-variable Dependency Modeling framework for multivariate time series imputation. GLAIM comprises two complementary components. The Stable Global Dependency Constructor derives robust global inter-variable dependencies from complementary temporal representations, providing a stable backbone less affected by sample-specific missingness and noise. The Sample-Conditioned Dependency Refiner adapts this backbone to each sample and time step using its temporal state and available observations, enabling reliable local refinement under incomplete observations. Extensive experiments on nine real-world datasets demonstrate that GLAIM achieves state-of-the-art performance under random and block missingness, remains robust to missing-rate shifts, and benefits from its complementary global and local components. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GLAIM提出了一种全局-局部自适应变量间依赖建模框架，用于多元时间序列缺失值填补。该框架由稳定全局依赖构造器（StaGlo）和样本条件依赖精化器（SaCoRef）两个互补组件构成，前者从互补时序表示中构建稳健的跨变量全局依赖，后者根据每个样本的时序状态和可用观测对全局依赖进行样本级精化。在九个真实数据集上的实验表明，GLAIM在随机缺失和块缺失条件下均达到最先进性能，并对缺失率变化具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有变量间依赖建模方法存在两类局限：(1) 全局依赖方法（如MTGNN、ImputeFormer）虽然稳定但难以适应样本变异和时序非平稳性；(2) 局部依赖方法（如iTransformer）虽然自适应但当观测不足时不可靠，会导致错误的信息传播。本文旨在通过结合两种依赖类型的互补优势解决上述问题。
AI.method: 方法包含三个组件：(1) 先验信息嵌入（PriEmb）通过线性插值和多尺度平滑构建缺失感知的时序先验，并通过路由器自适应融合多尺度候选；(2) 全局-局部依赖编码器（GloLoc）堆叠L层，每层先通过StaGlo使用共享关系令牌和层特定生成器构建观测独立的特征级全局依赖矩阵，再通过SaCoRef使用样本特定的关系上下文精化时序依赖交互；(3) 门控特征重构器（GateRecon）通过sigmoid门控进行最终解码。StaGlo利用双尺度时序卷积和共享关系令牌生成不依赖当前观测的稳定依赖结构；SaCoRef通过变量级令牌的注意力池化捕获样本特定的时序状态，并利用特征级动态门控抑制不可靠的上下文增量。
AI.result: 在ETTh1/h2、ETTm1/m2、Weather、PEMS03、Exchange、Illness、Electricity九个真实数据集上：(1) 随机缺失条件下平均MSE为0.030、MAE为0.089，相对最强基线ModernTCN分别降低50.0%和32.1%，在所有18个数据集-指标比较中均排名第一；(2) 块缺失条件下平均MSE和MAE分别为0.050和0.113，降低55.0%和33.9%，同样在所有18个比较中居首；(3) 缺失率迁移实验中，在0.3训练率下测试0.1-0.7均保持最佳性能，0.7未见率下MSE仍降低超50%；(4) 全局依赖矩阵在不同缺失率下表现出高Spearman相关性（0.767-0.892）和低JS散度（0.029-0.074），证明其稳定性；(5) 消融实验表明移除StaGlo导致67.4%的MSE增幅，移除SaCoRef、Prior、Gated分别导致6.5%、13.0%、6.5%的增幅。
AI.conclusion: GLAIM通过统一的全局-局部框架成功结合了稳定的样本间共享依赖和适应单个样本的自适应依赖。StaGlo构建的全局依赖骨干不易受样本特定缺失模式和噪声影响，SaCoRef在此基础上对变量交互进行可靠的样本级精化。实验结果验证了该框架在多种缺失场景下的最先进性能和鲁棒性。未来工作将探索将该框架扩展到更复杂的缺失模式和更广泛的多元时序任务。

title: From fragmented data to actionable design: Physics-calibrated learning for plastic upcycling
summary: Thermochemical upgrading of plastic waste is a key upcycling pathway, yet the experimental literature is fragmented by heterogeneous conditions and incomplete reporting. Complete-case learning would retain only 10.99% of the curated experiments, while target imputation can introduce biased supervision. Here we develop a Physics-Calibrated, Missingness-Gated, and Load-Balanced Mixture-of-Experts (PC-MG-MoE) framework that converts structured missingness into an informative learning signal. PC-MG-MoE learns directly from partially observed experiments without target imputation, reconstructs physically consistent product distributions, accommodates cross-laboratory heterogeneity, and provides interpretable model behaviour rather than black-box prediction alone. Under stringent source-grouped validation, it achieved the lowest aggregate absolute error among the evaluated models, supporting engineering screening under cross-laboratory heterogeneity. Wet-lab experiments provide an external comparison, showing key composition-dependent trends. Implemented as an interactive web-based workflow, PC-MG-MoE enables forward screening, physics-grounded constrained inverse design, targeted experimental planning that supports reduced experimental workload and trial-and-error, and laboratory-specific adaptation with new platform-specific data. This work establishes a transferable framework for converting fragmented literature data into experimentally actionable guidance for model-guided plastic upcycling and broader thermochemical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对塑料废弃物热化学升级领域文献数据碎片化、实验条件异构、报告不完整的问题，提出了物理校准、缺失门控与负载均衡的混合专家框架（PC-MG-MoE），无需目标值插补即可从部分观测实验中学习，重建物理一致的产品分布，并集成至交互式网页工作流以支撑前向筛选、逆向设计与实验规划。
AI.motivation: 塑料废弃物热化学升级是重要的资源化路径，但相关实验文献存在实验条件异构和报告不完整的问题。若采用完整案例学习，仅能保留10.99%的已整理实验数据；而目标值插补则会引入有偏监督信号。因此需要一种能够从含缺失值的部分观测数据中学习、兼顾物理一致性与跨实验室异构性、并具备可解释性的建模方法，以将碎片化文献数据转化为可指导实验的工程工具。
AI.method: 提出PC-MG-MoE（Physics-Calibrated, Missingness-Gated, and Load-Balanced Mixture-of-Experts）框架，其核心思路是将结构化缺失模式本身转化为信息性学习信号。该方法在不进行目标值插补的前提下直接从部分观测实验中进行学习；通过物理校准重建物理一致的产品分布；利用混合专家机制与缺失门控、负载均衡策略适应跨实验室条件异构性；并提供模型行为的可解释性。框架被实现为交互式网页工作流，支持前向筛选、物理约束的逆向设计、目标导向的实验规划以及基于新平台数据的实验室适配。
AI.result: 在严格的按来源分组的验证策略下，PC-MG-MoE在所对比模型中取得了最低的聚合绝对误差，表明其在跨实验室异构条件下具有优越的工程筛选性能。外部湿实验对比验证了该模型能够复现关键的组分依赖性变化趋势。交互式网页工作流成功支撑了前向预测、物理约束的逆向设计与目标实验规划等应用场景。
AI.conclusion: PC-MG-MoE建立了将碎片化文献数据转化为可指导实验的行动方案的通用框架。该方法不仅适用于模型引导的塑料废弃物升级，还具备推广至更广泛热化学体系的潜力，为数据稀缺且异构条件下的机器学习辅助实验研究提供了可迁移的方法论范式。

title: Syntax Meets Semantics: Understanding Scientific Formulae
summary: Scientific formulae are a fundamental component of scholarly communication, yet their dual nature -- as structured syntax and carriers of semantics -- remains underexplored in scholarly information retrieval. Although prior studies show that jointly modeling syntactic and semantic modalities improves retrieval performance, the relationship between their underlying representations has not been systematically investigated. In this work, we empirically study cross-modal correspondence between formula syntax and semantics. We find that their native representation spaces exhibit extremely weak observable correspondence despite strong latent correlation, indicating a substantial representation mismatch between the two modalities. We further evaluate whether this mismatch can be reduced using standard representation learning and alignment techniques. We represent syntactic structure using graph-based encoders and semantic information using text-based encoders, then apply contrastive learning to induce a shared representation space. Results show that the learned alignment substantially improves cross-modal retrieval, suggesting that explicit representation learning can recover correspondence absent from the original representation spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了科学公式的句法表示（基于运算符树/OPT的图结构）与语义表示（基于文本描述的Transformer嵌入）之间的跨模态对应关系。研究发现，两种模态在原生表示空间中呈现极弱的可观测对应（R@10<0.02），但通过CCA揭示出强潜在相关性（Top-10 CCA=0.85-0.91），表明存在显著的表示错位。通过对比学习（InfoNCE）进行显式对齐后，跨模态检索性能大幅提升（最高+0.52 R@10），证明可通过学习恢复隐藏的对应关系。
AI.motivation: 科学公式具有句法（结构化符号）和语义（概念含义）的双重特性，尽管已有研究表明联合建模两者可提升检索性能，但两种表示之间的关系缺乏系统研究。学术信息检索中普遍假设句法相似性近似语义相似性，但这一假设的内在机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 1) 构建数据集：从Wikidata提取2,405个科学公式及其关联概念描述（P2534定义公式、P7235被定义公式属性）；2) 句法表示：从MathML构建规范化运算符树（OPT），采用GINE图神经网络编码（含节点类型嵌入与角色/位置感知的边特征）；3) 语义表示：聚合所有文本注释，用SentenceTransformer编码；4) 量化分析：使用余弦相似度、正交Procrustes对齐、RSA、CKA、CCA多层级测量对应关系；5) 对齐学习：采用CLIP风格的对称InfoNCE对比损失，学习共享嵌入空间，使用5折交叉验证评估跨模态检索（R@1/5/10、MRR），对比BM25、双编码器（SBERT/MathBERT）有/无CL、图-文本编码器CL等方法。
AI.result: 原始对齐分析显示：平均余弦相似度仅0.085，R@10=0.0125（极弱直接对应），Procrustes误差0.83，但Top-10 CCA达0.85-0.91（强潜在相关），RSA ρ=0.12，CKA=0.16（中等全局相似）。对比学习对齐后：Graph-Text Encoder CL表现最佳（Syntax→Semantic：R@10=0.574，MRR=0.345；Semantic→Syntax：R@10=0.580，MRR=0.355），相对BM25基线提升达+0.52 R@10，相对无CL的神经基线提升+0.47 R@10，所有改进统计显著（p<0.005）。检索性能在两个方向上对称，表明学习到的对齐支持双向检索。图基编码器略优于Transformer双编码器，但均显著优于基线，提示结构显式建模对跨模态对齐有益。
AI.conclusion: 科学公式的句法与语义表示在原生嵌入空间中虽共享强潜在结构，但呈现几何错位（信息组织方式不同），导致直接对应性极弱。然而通过标准对比学习技术可有效恢复这种跨模态对应，显著提升检索性能。这表明：(1) 句法相似近似语义相似的隐含假设需要谨慎对待，原生空间中的相似度并非衡量跨模态一致性的可靠指标；(2) 显式的表示对齐目标对于桥接模态差距至关重要；(3) 研究为科学公式的多模态整合提供了实证基础，未来可拓展至更大规模语料及神经符号推理、科学知识发现等下游任务。

title: SWE-Touch: Benchmarking Coding Agents When Users Touch the Code
comment: Preprint. Our code is available at this https URL
summary: Real-world software development requires coding agents to operate in shared workspaces where users may inspect and modify code during an ongoing task, yet existing repository-level benchmarks typically evaluate agents working alone or restrict user participation to messages. This leads us to ask: how do coding agents understand and respond to code changes in a shared workspace? We introduce SWE-Touch, a framework that stress-tests this setting through validated Counter-Edits: plausible edits to task-relevant code that conflict with task completion. SWE-Touch mines task-critical regions from multiple repair trajectories, uses a separate User Patch Generator to construct the edits, and injects them with contextual user messages when agents reach the relevant code. We evaluate nine coding models on SWE-bench Verified, with additional experiments on longer-horizon tasks from SWE-Bench Pro and DeepSWE. Counter-Edit lowers average resolve rate by 7.7 percentage points on SWE-bench Verified, with degradation also persisting on both longer-horizon benchmarks. Trajectory analysis links these failures to limited awareness of the evolving workspace: agents may retain conflicting code or replace it without sufficiently re-inspecting the repository and validating the revised code with targeted tests. These findings show that strong autonomous performance does not yet ensure the state awareness and adaptive behavior needed for shared-workspace collaboration, and point to detecting workspace changes, reconciling conflicting edits with the task, and verifying the affected behavior as key capabilities for future optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SWE-Touch框架,通过注入"反编辑"(Counter-Edits)测试编码智能体在共享工作空间中应对用户代码修改的能力。实验表明,即使在SWE-bench Verified等基准上表现优异的模型,在面对用户中途修改代码时,解决率平均下降7.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库级代码生成基准通常评估智能体独立工作或仅通过消息与用户交互,而忽略了真实开发中用户会在共享工作空间中直接修改代码的场景。论文旨在探究编码智能体在共享工作空间中能否感知并响应代码变更,弥补现有评估范式与真实协作开发之间的差距。
AI.method: 1)提出SWE-Touch评估框架,通过"反编辑"(Counter-Edit)压力测试编码智能体;2)从多条修复轨迹中挖掘任务关键代码区域;3)使用独立的User Patch Generator构造与任务完成相冲突的合理代码编辑;4)在智能体访问相关代码时,结合上下文用户消息注入反编辑;5)在SWE-bench Verified上评估9个编码模型,并在SWE-Bench Pro和DeepSWE长周期任务上进行额外实验。
AI.result: 反编辑使SWE-bench Verified上的平均解决率下降7.7个百分点;在SWE-Bench Pro和DeepSWE两个长周期基准上性能下降仍然存在;轨迹分析表明失败源于智能体对工作空间演化的感知有限——智能体可能保留冲突代码,或在未充分重新检查仓库并使用针对性测试验证修改代码的情况下直接替换。
AI.conclusion: 强大的自主性能尚不能确保共享工作空间协作所需的状态感知和自适应行为。未来的优化方向应聚焦于三大关键能力:检测工作空间变化、协调冲突编辑与任务目标、以及验证受影响代码行为的正确性。

title: Analytic Planning under Uncertainty with Moment Closure
comment: To appear in Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026), PMLR
summary: Effective model-based reinforcement learning in stochastic environments requires planning that accounts for predictive uncertainty. Propagating full state distributions analytically offers a principled way to do this, but has traditionally required restrictive policy or reward structures to remain tractable. Consequently, modern deep reinforcement learning has largely retreated to either stochastic sampling, which introduces significant target variance, or deterministic point estimates that ignore predictive covariance entirely. We investigate whether distribution-aware planning is possible without these constraints. Using a quadratic action-value parameterization, we first reduce the Bellman backup to an expectation over the state-value function alone; the key idea is then a compatibility principle between the predictive transition distribution and the value function class, under which this expectation is analytic in the distribution's moments. We instantiate this principle with a Gaussian transition model paired with a radial-basis value function, yielding a closed-form backup that propagates both predictive mean and covariance. Empirically, our approach reduces target variance and yields well-calibrated predictive uncertainty under stochastic observations in continuous control, providing a principled framework for planning with learned distribution models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoCA（Moment-Compatible Analytic Planning）方法，通过将二次型动作值参数化（BNAF）与高斯转移模型和径向基值函数相结合，实现闭式Bellman备份，无需蒙特卡洛采样即可解析传播预测均值和协方差，在含噪观测下降低目标方差并提供校准良好的预测不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）方法面临两难：随机采样引入显著的目标方差，确定性点估计忽略预测协方差，而解析的全分布传播通常需要限制性策略或奖励结构。本文旨在探索是否存在一种无需这些约束的分布感知规划方法。
AI.method: 1) 采用BNAF二次型Q函数参数化，将Bellman备份中的内部最大化消去，仅保留对状态值函数的期望；2) 学习异方差高斯转移模型集成，通过矩匹配聚合偶发不确定性（aleatoric）和认知不确定性（epistemic）；3) 值函数参数化为高斯RBF混合，其在高斯分布下的期望具有闭式解（公式7），通过"矩相容性"原理实现解析期望；4) 使用双Q网络和裁剪双估计的TD3风格目标构建。
AI.result: 在Cartpole和Pendulum控制任务上：1) 在同方差和异方差高斯观测噪声下，MoCA始终优于SAC、BNAF和确定性等价基线（MoCA-CE），且噪声越大优势越明显；2) 在Pendulum上，解析MoCA优于蒙特卡洛变体（K=4和K=16），收敛更快、渐近性能更高；3) 经验1σ覆盖率稳定在标称68%附近，认知不确定性标准差随训练收敛，预测不确定性校准良好。
AI.conclusion: 通过矩相容性设计原则，解析Bellman期望在基于模型的深度强化学习中是可行的。该方法为使用学习分布模型进行规划提供了一个原则性框架，能够在保持预测不确定性传播的同时消除蒙特卡洛采样噪声，但受限于RBF值表示在高维中的维度灾难问题。

title: Who Should Be Generated? Justifying Demographic Targets in Open-Ended Generation
comment: 39 pages, 13 figures, 29 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Fairness evaluation concerns not only what a model produces, but also what its outputs ought to be compared against. When a model generates "a CEO in the United States," the prompt leaves demographic realization to the model. Existing group fairness definitions assume that sensitive attributes are given on the input side. Generative audits instead examine output-side demographic composition, yet the targets they compare it against are typically supplied rather than justified. The upstream question is what the target distribution should be. We formalize this missing-target problem for demographic-value-unspecified generation and decompose target construction into four commitments: the evaluative object, prior admissibility, allocation, and operationalization. In this framework, we admit the geographic prior under a geographic-membership interpretation for the declared public-world use. The occupational prior, under an incumbency interpretation, requires an independently defended objective such as workforce-composition fidelity. Instantiating this construction in AP-Bench, we find substantial distribution divergence from geography-derived targets, ranging from 0.508 to 0.606 on a 0-to-1 scale. Replacing each geography-derived target with an equal-category comparator, while holding generations and measurement fixed, produces model-specific mean absolute cell-level $\mathrm{JSD}_2$ changes ranging from 0.279 to 0.355. Target construction is therefore not a preliminary to fairness evaluation but a component of it. What we supply is not a universal target, but a framework that makes explicit the justification required before a distribution can serve as a fairness standard.

AI.tldr: 本文针对生成式AI中"人口统计学价值未指定"的开放式生成任务,提出了"缺失目标问题"(missing-target problem),系统地将目标分布的构建分解为四个规范性承诺:评估对象、先验可接受性、分配规则和操作化。作者构建了AP-Bench基准,在六个前沿语言模型、12个地理语境和6种角色上进行测试,发现模型生成的人口组成与地理派生目标之间存在0.508-0.606的JSD₂差异,替换为平等类别比较器时,各模型的平均绝对单元格层面变化达0.279-0.355,表明目标构建本身就是公平性评估的组成部分,而非其前置步骤。
AI.motivation: 当语言模型生成类似"美国的一位CEO"这样的角色时,人口统计学细节留由模型决定。现有的群体公平性定义假设敏感属性在输入端给出,而生成式审计关注输出端的人口组成,但用作比较基准的目标分布往往是直接给定的,缺乏规范性论证。该论文旨在解决"应该生成谁"这一上游问题,即在评估生成公平性之前,如何证明某个目标分布有资格成为公平标准。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"缺失目标问题",区分参考(refs)、比较器(comparator)和目标(target);2) 提出四承诺目标构建框架:评估对象与用途、输出单元;先验可接受性(关系识别与辩护);分配规则(从可接受先验到份额);操作化(从抽象规则到数值目标);3) 引入"桥梁前提"区分操作性得分与公平性判断;4) 通过AP-Bench实例化:51,840个生成样本,6个模型(GPT-5.6、Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Kimi K3、Llama 4 Maverick、Qwen3.7-Max),12个地理语境,6种角色,4个冻结提示模板,使用base-2 JSD₂度量,采用228个共同支持单元格进行公平比较;5) 进行等类别比较器替换的消融实验及多项敏感性分析。
AI.result: 联合引出条件下,三模块复合JSD₂范围为0.508-0.606(Gemini 3.5 Flash最低,Qwen3.7-Max最高)。在精确对齐目标下,有限样本中心99%参考区间上限为0.031-0.033,表明有限样本波动无法解释观察到的差异量级。将地理派生目标替换为等类别比较器后,各模型的层次化平均绝对单元格层面JSD₂变化范围为0.279-0.355(Gemini最低,GPT-5.6最高)。隐式提示下,仅性别-性别诊断可报告,JSD₂范围为0.116-0.291。在诊断容差τ∈{0.1,0.2,0.3}下,12.8%-40.0%的层级加权单元格改变分类。地理先验在地理成员关系解释下被接受,职业先验在任职解释下需要独立的劳动力组成保真目标才能被接受。
AI.conclusion: 1) 论文提供的不是通用目标,而是证明责任——任何目标相对评估必须回答四个问题:重复生成分布什么;哪个先验在何种关系下识别谁的表征值得计入;在域内如何分配表征质量;哪个来源使结果目标可操作化;2) 地理先验在公共世界用途的"被代表公众前提"下可被接受;3) 任职解释下的职业先验需要独立的劳动力组成保真目标,而非作为默认目标;4) 等人分配是带承诺的条件性构建,而非中性后备;5) 目标构建本身是公平性评估的组成部分,公平性评估的进步需要先能论证分布为何有资格成为标准。局限包括六个模型、十二个语境、单语种、边际而非交叉组合,以及离散度而非伤害的衡量。

title: Structured Memory for Edge Language Models: Persistent Context and Corpus Retrieval via O(1) SSM State Injection
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) imposes a prefill cost proportional to retrieved context length, and -- with Transformer backbones -- a KV-cache that grows with each generated token. State-Space Models (SSMs) avoid the second cost by construction; we eliminate the first, collapsing prefill from $O(L_{context})$ to $O(1)$ per query. We introduce PRECOG (Pre-Computed Context Injection), a retrieval mechanism that exploits a property unique to SSMs: the fixed-size, position-agnostic recurrent hidden state is a complete summary of everything the model has read. PRECOG pre-encodes document corpora offline as SSM hidden states and injects the best-matching state directly at query time, bypassing in-context re-ingestion entirely. The same state-injection mechanism enables SMC (Structured Memory Consolidation): a hierarchical persistent memory with cognitive-domain clustering, an adjustable fidelity-vs-storage dial, and $O(1)$ session initialization, which consolidates short-term episodic states into long-term semantic memory and fuses both with retrieved corpus states at query time. We demonstrate the system on TENNs-LLM, a 1.2B-parameter gated-SSM language model with a 192 KB hidden state. PRECOG matches in-context RAG answer quality, reducing prefill latency from $\sim$27 s to $<$6 ms on edge hardware -- a $\sim$4500$\times$ speedup that crosses the threshold from unusable to interactive. The mechanism is architecturally impossible for Transformer KV-caches, which are position-entangled and grow linearly with context length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRECOG（Pre-Computed Context Injection）机制，利用SSM固定大小、与位置无关的隐状态的充分统计量特性，将RAG的prefill成本从O(L_context)降至O(1)，在边缘硬件上实现约4500倍的加速（从~27秒降至<6毫秒），同时匹配上下文RAG的答案质量。并扩展为SMC（结构化记忆整合），实现持久化设备记忆管理。该机制在Transformer架构上因KV缓存的位置耦合与线性增长而不可实现。
AI.motivation: 针对Transformer在RAG中存在的两大结构性缺陷：(1) KV缓存随上下文长度线性增长，记忆带宽随序列扩展；(2) 缓存与位置编码纠缠，无法跨上下文任意复用，导致长上下文效率低下且缓存复用僵化。这些特性使得Transformer解码器对长上下文不友好，且无法实现上下文令牌摄取的消除。
AI.method: 核心方法基于SSM的时移不变性（time-translation invariance）：由于SSM更新映射Φ(h,x)仅依赖于(h,x)而与位置无关，预编码文档块得到的隐藏状态与查询时实时摄取产生的状态数学等价（Theorem 1）。具体流程：离线将语料库分块编码为192 KB固定大小的24层隐藏状态，以轻量级句子编码器建立检索索引；查询时通过FAISS检索top-k匹配块，以softmax加权组成初始状态注入SSM循环状态，跳过上下文摄取。扩展SMC通过认知域分层聚类、忠实度-存储调节旋钮（K=N_c/K=N_c/k/K=1三档）以及O(1)会话初始化实现持久记忆整合。模型为TENNs-LLM（1.2B参数门控SSM，d=2048，N=4096，24层，192 KB总状态）。
AI.result: 在SQuAD v1.1开发集1000题子集上：上下文RAG EM=58.2/F1=73.6，PRECOG top-1 EM=58.0/F1=73.4（匹配至FP16量化误差范围内），PRECOG top-3 EM=56.4/F1=71.8（小幅下降反映组合启发式的非精确性）。边缘硬件TTFT从~27秒降至<6毫秒（约4500倍加速）。存储对比：每块KV缓存约16 MB vs PRECOG状态192 KB（85倍优势），10K块语料库1.9 GB vs 160 GB。注入深度消融显示底层12层保留99% F1质量。HotpotQA上top-k最优为k=3（+7.5 F1）。Natural Questions显示PRECOG与上下文RAG在L<600 token内基本一致，超过后SSM记忆衰减导致差距扩大。SMC在Harry Potter对话语料上的聚类分离比均>1.5。
AI.conclusion: PRECOG证明了对于具有位置无关固定大小状态的SSM，RAG上下文摄取成本可从O(L_context)严格降至O(1)，通过代数重构而非近似实现。其核心定理保证了与上下文RAG的精确等价性，并由FP16量化误差界定。SMC将该机制扩展到持久记忆管理，统一语料库检索与设备长期记忆于单一状态注入基底。Transformer因KV缓存的位置纠缠与O(L)存储增长而无法实现类似机制。这是SSM区别于Transformer的结构性设计原则的具体体现：当SSM持续缩小与Transformer的质量差距时，其独特的结构性属性将释放出基于注意力架构无法企及的检索、缓存与记忆扩展算法。局限性包括继承SSM的有限有效记忆长度、top-k组合的非精确性（无类似定理保证）、约200倍于原始文本RAG的存储开销以及神经形态部署数字有待流片验证。

title: A Portable and Versatile Limited-Memory BFGS Implementation in PETSc/TAO
summary: The limited-memory BFGS (L-BFGS) Hessian update scheme is the critical kernel in many quasi-Newton optimization algorithms. The most common approach to implementing L-BFGS uses $2m$ sequential rank-1 updates as part of solving a linear system when there are $m$ history steps. The performance of this approach suffers when the latency of synchronization is significant, and its poor temporal locality increases the memory traffic when vectors do not fit in cache. The compact dense representation of L-BFGS results in an approach that has minimal synchronization latency and better temporal locality, but it requires an additional pass over the basis vectors and an additional basis that must be recomputed when the $B_0$ matrix changes as in variable-metric methods. In the Portable Extensible Toolkit for Scientific Computation and the Toolkit for Advanced Optimization (PETSc/TAO), we have implemented an intermediate dense formulation of BFGS that retains most of the good characteristics of both the recursive and compact dense approaches. We report single-node performance tests of these implementations on the U.S. Department of Energy's Polaris and Frontier machines, testing both GPU-based and CPU-based computations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对科学计算中广泛使用的L-BFGS拟牛顿优化算法的Hessian更新机制，对比分析了传统的基于2m次序贯秩1更新的递归实现与紧凑密集表示两种方案，并在PETSc/TAO中实现了一种兼具两者优点的中间型密集BFGS公式，最后在DOE的Polaris和Frontier超级计算机上完成了GPU与CPU的单节点性能评测。
AI.motivation: L-BFGS是众多拟牛顿优化算法的核心组件。传统递归实现采用2m次序贯秩1更新求解线性系统，在同步延迟显著或向量无法装入缓存时性能急剧下降（同步开销与内存流量成为瓶颈）；而紧凑密集表示虽具有低同步延迟和良好的时间局部性，但需要对基向量进行额外遍历，并且当B0矩阵变化（如可变度量方法）时必须重新计算基向量。因此需要一种在并行/缓存友好性、灵活性与计算效率之间取得更好平衡的折中方案。
AI.method: 在PETSc/TAO中实现并比较三种L-BFGS Hessian更新实现方式：(1) 基于2m次序贯秩1更新的递归实现；(2) 紧凑密集表示；(3) 一种保留前述两者大部分优良特性的"中间型"密集BFGS公式。评测平台为美国能源部的Polaris和Frontier两台HPC系统，覆盖CPU与GPU两种计算后端，进行单节点性能测试。
AI.result: 文中报告了在Polaris（基于GPU）和Frontier（CPU+GPU）上的单节点性能测试结果，比较了递归、紧凑密集与中间密集三种实现在不同同步/缓存条件下的性能差异，但具体数值结果未在所提供文本中给出。
AI.conclusion: 通过在PETSc/TAO中引入一种中间型密集BFGS公式，可在保留紧凑密集表示低同步延迟与良好时间局部性的同时，规避其需要额外基向量遍历及B0变化时基向量重计算的代价，为高性能科学计算环境下的拟牛顿优化提供了更实用的实现路径。

title: Design and Implementation of Schwarz Information Criterion-Aided Intelligent Decentralized Resource Allocation in Dynamic LoRa Networks
summary: This paper proposes a lightweight distributed learning method for selecting transmission parameters in Long-Range (LoRa) networks that adapts to dynamically changing communication environments. In the proposed method, the Thompson Sampling (TS) is adopted for transmission parameter selection, whereas the Schwarz Information Criterion (SIC) is employed for environmental change detection. TS is a reinforcement learning approach that effectively balances exploration and exploitation by updating parameters based on probability distributions. Additionally, it demonstrates stable performance even with a small number of trials, thereby making it well-suited for LoRa end devices (EDs) with limited memory capacity and computational resources. Furthermore, to address the issue that TS-based methods strongly depend on past learning histories and therefore adapt slowly to abrupt changes in communication environments, a statistical change detection mechanism based on the SIC is integrated into our proposed method. SIC is adopted because it can detect environmental changes with low computational cost and is suitable for implementation on resource-constrained LoRa EDs. When a change in the communication environment is detected by SIC, the learning history of TS is reset, thereby enabling rapid re-learning under new environmental conditions. Moreover, to achieve fully distributed communication parameter selection while enhancing transmission reliability and energy efficiency, the proposed method relies solely on Acknowledgment (ACK) feedback and the selected transmission parameters. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves the transmission success rate from 64.0% to 71.1% and increases energy efficiency from 293.9 bit/J to 328.3 bit/J compared with the conventional Upper Confidence Bound (UCB)1-tuned scheme under high-density dynamic LoRa networks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对动态LoRa网络提出了一种轻量级的分布式资源分配方法（SIC-TS），将汤普森采样（TS）与施瓦茨信息准则（SIC）相结合。TS基于Beta后验分布进行传输参数（信道、发射功率、带宽）的概率性选择，SIC基于ACK历史检测环境突变并重置学习历史。在40个终端的高密度动态场景下，相比传统UCB1-tuned方法，传输成功率从64.0%提升至71.1%，能效从293.9 bit/J提升至328.3 bit/J。
AI.motivation: 1) 集中式资源分配方法存在可扩展性瓶颈，且依赖下行控制消息，增加时延和能耗；2) 现有分布式多臂老虎机（MAB）方法（如UCB1-tuned）严重依赖历史统计，在通信环境突变时旧的历史信息会阻碍快速适应；3) 现有MAB方法大多未考虑能效优化；4) 现有SIC增强方法依赖全信道频谱感知，难以实时应用于IoT设备。
AI.method: 1) **基于TS的传输参数选择**：每个LoRa终端（ED）为每个参数组合（CH×TP×BW）维护Beta(α,β)后验分布，每次传输时采样并选择最大者；2) **能效加权奖励更新**：奖励ΔR = Payload/E_ToA，成功时更新α，失败时更新β，使高能效参数组合更易被选中；3) **能量先验偏置**：选择指标θ = (1-γ)θ̃ + γw_k，其中w_k为基于能耗的归一化偏置，γ控制权衡；4) **SIC变化检测**：对每个信道的ACK序列按滑动窗口划分，比较单概率模型（H0）与分段概率模型（H1）的SIC值，差值超过阈值η时判定环境变化；5) **变化时重置**：检测到变化后清空α、β及历史缓冲区Ω_c，重新学习。计算复杂度O(|K|+l_max)，内存O(|K|+N_c·l_max)。
AI.result: 1) 40个ED高密度动态场景下：SIC-TS成功率71.08%，SIC-UCB1-tuned为69.27%，UCB1-tuned为64.00%；2) 能效：SIC-TS达328.27 bit/J，SIC-UCB1-tuned为318.65 bit/J，UCB1-tuned为293.94 bit/J；3) 在不同终端数量（5/10/20/30/40）下SIC-TS均保持最优；4) γ=0.2时性能最佳，过大γ（0.4/0.5）导致性能下降；5) 真实LoRa设备（ES920LR模块 + Arduino Pro Mini）实测验证。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种面向动态LoRa网络的轻量级、完全分布式资源分配方案，通过SIC与TS的协同，实现了快速环境感知与能量感知的参数选择。SIC使系统能及时检测环境突变并重置学习历史，TS的概率探索机制结合能效偏置在无需穷举初始探索的前提下，从学习初期即倾向于选择高能效参数。实测证明该方法在高密度动态IoT部署中显著优于传统UCB1-tuned和SIC-UCB1-tuned基线，是大规模动态IoT场景下一种实用、自适应、节能的去中心化资源控制解决方案。

title: Cache-Consistent Dynamic Load Balancing for Kubernetes Controllers
summary: As Kubernetes clusters grow, the scalability of controllers can become a bottleneck for the performance of the system. Distributing the load dynamically across multiple controller instances, however, raises the following two problems, and a controller can therefore be run only as a single instance today. The first problem is the cost of reassignment. A controller retrieves objects on the basis of the Labels attached to them, so in a naive design in which the assigned instance is recorded in a Label on every object, the Labels must be rewritten in proportion to the total number of objects whenever instances are added or removed. The second problem is cache consistency. A controller consults only its own cache when it reads an object and never refers to the actual data, so the cache has to be updated explicitly at the time of a reassignment. Furthermore, a controller manages a cache independently for each kind of object, so cache updates have to be synchronized across the kinds of objects. We propose a method for scaling Kubernetes controllers horizontally that combines lightweight load balancing with cache synchronization. A two-level Hash maps objects to Virtual Nodes, records their identifiers in Labels, and assigns Virtual Nodes to instances by Consistent Hashing. Whenever instances are added or removed, it therefore suffices to update the Label value specified when objects are retrieved, and no Label on an object has to be rewritten. The cache is also locked until the reassignment has completed, which prevents any reference to a stale cache. The version identifier of the data store is used to synchronize the kinds of objects with one another. We implemented the proposed method on Kubernetes and evaluated it: the processing throughput rises with the number of instances, and the time required for reassignment remains within an acceptable range.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 Kubernetes 控制器只能单实例运行的扩展性瓶颈问题，提出了一种结合两级 Hash 轻量级负载均衡与 Barrier 机制缓存同步的水平扩展方法，通过将对象映射到固定数量的虚拟节点（Virtual Nodes）并使用一致性哈希环将虚拟节点分配给控制器实例，在实例增减时无需重写对象 Label，并利用 etcd Revision 同步多资源间的缓存一致性。
AI.motivation: 随着 Kubernetes 集群规模扩大，控制器（Controller）成为系统性能瓶颈，因为现有机制下控制器通常只能以单实例运行。已有方案（如 Flux CD、Argo CD、KubeVela、Ebert 的 Controller Sharding 等）存在两类问题：（1）**重分配代价高**：基于 Label Selector 过滤对象时，若将负责实例直接写入 Label，则每次实例增减都需按对象数量比例重写 Label，对 API Server 和数据存储造成巨大负载；（2）**缓存一致性问题**：控制器只读自身缓存不查询 API Server，且每个资源（Kind）独立维护缓存并并行处理，重分配时可能出现部分资源缓存已更新而其他资源仍为陈旧数据的情况，导致基于过期数据的 Reconcile 处理产生不一致。本文旨在解决这两大难题，实现 Kubernetes 控制器的动态水平扩展。
AI.method:
本文提出了一种结合两级 Hash 与 Barrier 机制的 Kubernetes 控制器水平扩展方案，核心设计如下：

1. **两级 Hash（Two-Level Hash）负载均衡**：
   - 在对象与控制器实例之间引入**虚拟节点（Virtual Nodes）**作为中间层。
   - 第一级：通过对对象 Key 的哈希值取模（mod V，V 为固定虚拟节点数，本实现中为 200）将对象映射到固定虚拟节点，该映射终身不变。
   - 第二级：通过**一致性哈希环（Consistent Hash Ring）**将虚拟节点映射到控制器实例，每个实例放置多个副本节点以保证负载均匀。
   - 对象 Label 中只存储虚拟节点编号而非负责实例，因此实例增减时无需重写任何对象 Label，重分配计算成本为 O(V)，与对象总数 M 无关。

2. **Barrier 缓存一致性机制**：
   - 当检测到虚拟节点分配变更时，实例立即阻塞（Block）相关资源的缓存 Get 操作，防止访问陈旧缓存。
   - 仅对新分配虚拟节点的对象执行 List 并加入缓存，完成后释放阻塞。
   - 利用 **etcd Revision**（数据存储的全局单调递增版本号）作为变更事件 ID，通过 `pendingRVs` 集合管理阻塞状态：接收到分配变更通知时将 Revision 加入 `pendingRVs`，List 完成时移除 ≤ 完成 Revision 的所有条目，确保处理连续重分配时缓存一致性。
   - 依赖资源同时阻塞：当某资源的分配变更通知到达时，不仅阻塞该资源，也阻塞所有依赖于它的资源，避免父资源处理时引用到子资源的过期缓存。

3. **父-子对象一致性分配**：通过 Annotation（`loadbalance.k8s.io/hash-key`）指定父-子对象使用相同的 Hash Key，使其在第一级映射到同一虚拟节点。

4. **实现细节**：分叉 Kubernetes（commit 6e753bd）和 controller-runtime（commit 6210f84），修改包括：
   - API Server：新增 `/virtualnodeslices` 端点，使用 Mutating Admission Webhook 附加虚拟节点 Label，通过 etcd Lease（30 秒 TTL）管理成员条目。
   - client-go Reflector：监控虚拟节点分配，添加专用 `Rebalanced` 事件传递 etcd Revision。
   - Informer：处理 `Rebalanced` 事件时更新 Indexer 并通知 Barrier Manager。
   - controller-runtime：从 `For().Owns()` 声明构建资源依赖图，Reconcile 前校验虚拟节点归属。
   - 使用 CRC32 作为哈希函数，使用 `AtomicFIFO` 和 `InOrderInformers` Feature Gate。
AI.result:
基于搭建的 Kubernetes 集群（1 个 etcd 节点、3 个 master、8 个 worker VM，分布在 3 台物理机上）进行了两项实验评估：

1. **实验 1：Pod 数量与 Reconcile 吞吐量的关系**（虚拟节点数设为 1000，每 Pod 内部并发度为 5）
   - 创建 100,000 个 Parent 对象，测量创建对应 Child 对象完成的总时间。
   - 结果：Reconcile 吞吐量随 Pod 数量增加而显著提升，从 1 个 Pod 时的约 100 resources/s 增长到 9 个 Pod 时的约 450 resources/s，验证了水平扩展的有效性。
   - 各轮次间的性能波动归因于一致性哈希环的分布特性。

2. **实验 2：虚拟节点数量与重分配时长的关系**（10,000 个 Parent 对象）
   - 重复注册/注销成员条目 100 次，测量每次从成员变更到 Barrier 阻塞结束的时长。
   - 结果：当虚拟节点数在 100～10,000 之间时，平均重分配时长稳定在约 0.37～0.56 秒；虚拟节点数达到 100,000 时，时长急剧上升至约 1.57 秒。
   - 结论：在合理虚拟节点数量（100～1,000）下，重分配时长处于 Kubernetes 控制器可接受范围内。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功解决了 Ebert 方法中存在的两大问题：通过两级 Hash 设计（对象→虚拟节点→实例，第一级映射固定）彻底消除了重分配时对象 Label 的重写；通过基于 etcd Revision 的 Barrier 机制，在重分配期间阻塞相关资源的缓存访问，阻塞持续时间由所有相关资源的 List 完成状态决定（`pendingRVs` 非空即阻塞），从而保证了并行处理的多个资源间的缓存一致性，并妥善处理了连续重分配场景。主要局限包括：（1）不同实例接收分配变更通知存在毫秒级时差，可能短暂出现同一对象被多个实例同时处理，依赖 Kubernetes 的最终一致性收敛；（2）未分配给本实例的对象的 Get 请求无法返回正确结果，需控制器开发者谨慎处理。未来工作计划将该方法正式提交为 Kubernetes 增强提案（KEP），纳入 Kubernetes 标准功能。

title: AReaL-DTE: Sparse Policy-Weight Transfer for Online Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Online agentic reinforcement learning implemented with micro-services separates policy training from rollout generation, improving scalability and modularity while potentially making frequent policy-weight synchronization a critical systems overhead. Shared storage naturally connects these services across clusters, but vanilla dense policy weight synchronization could incur model-scale construction, transfer, and application costs. Sparse synchronization reduces transferred data, yet checkpoint-oriented approaches can still retain a previous model and materialize complete intermediates to bridge heterogeneous training and inference layouts. We present AReaL-DTE, a snapshot-free Delta Transfer Engine that translates inference-visible weight sparsity into end-to-end system efficiency. Across our evaluated workloads, fewer than 2% of BF16 weight elements change between consecutive policy versions. AReaL-DTE reconstructs overwritten weights on demand by inverting AdamW updates, streams reconstructed and current parameters through converter-aligned BF16 change detection, and remaps changed elements directly into receiver-local coordinates. AReaL-DTE supports manifest-committed sparse transfer through shared storage across clusters and a deadlock-safe two-round protocol within a cluster, followed by direct application to inference shards. We evaluate AReaL-DTE on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B across four online RL workloads. AReaL-DTE achieves speedups of up to 19.9x over ByteCheckpoint and 3.2x over PULSE across clusters, and up to 7.6x and 7.4x, respectively, within a cluster. In the same-cluster Qwen3-30B-A3B experiments, it reduces peak GPU memory by approximately 41% and peak CPU memory by at least 87%.

AI.tldr: AReaL-DTE 是一个无快照的稀疏策略权重传输引擎，用于在线智能体强化学习中训练和推理微服务之间的策略权重同步。它通过反转AdamW更新重构历史权重、利用转换器对齐的BF16变化检测以及将变化元素直接映射到接收方本地坐标，将权重稀疏性转化为端到端的系统效率。
AI.motivation: 在线智能体强化学习将策略训练与rollout生成分解为独立的微服务，这种架构虽然提高了可扩展性和模块化程度，但频繁的策略权重同步成为关键的系统开销。密集权重同步会产生与模型规模成正比的构建、传输和应用成本，而现有的稀疏同步方法（如PULSE、SparrowRL）虽然减少了传输数据量，但仍需要保留历史模型快照并物化完整的中间表示来弥合训练和推理布局的差异，未能实现端到端的稀疏性。
AI.method: AReaL-DTE 包含三个协调阶段：(1) 通过解析反转AdamW更新公式，利用当前FP32主权重、一阶和二阶矩状态及超参数，按需重构被覆盖的先前权重，避免持久化历史快照；(2) 将重构和当前参数通过相同的MCore-to-HuggingFace转换器，在BF16位模式层面对齐比较，并将变化索引直接映射到接收方本地坐标，避免完整模型重建和重分片；(3) 通过共享存储的manifest-committed稀疏传输（跨集群）或无死锁的两轮协议（同集群内P2P通信）传递接收方就绪的稀疏更新。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-30B-A3B上，针对GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH-500和LogiQA四个在线RL工作负载的评估显示：(1) 同集群内，相较ByteCheckpoint-NCCL最高加速7.6倍，相较PULSE-NCCL最高加速7.4倍，峰值GPU内存降低约41%，峰值CPU内存降低至少87%；(2) 跨集群，相较ByteCheckpoint最高加速19.9倍，相较PULSE最高加速3.2倍，压缩后稀疏文件仅2.53-2.87 GB，比密集检查点平均小16.3倍；(3) 在10 Gbps带宽下，同步开销仅占训练时间的0.68-0.99倍，而ByteCheckpoint和PULSE分别为5.75-7.02倍和2.14-2.37倍。
AI.conclusion: AReaL-DTE 通过在构造、布局转换、传输和应用的全数据路径中消除模型规模的历史快照和中间状态，实现了稀疏策略同步的端到端系统效率提升。它证明了更新稀疏性只有在构造、布局转换、传输和应用各环节均避免模型规模工作时才能带来完整的系统效益，并将权重同步从训练循环的主要瓶颈转变为与剩余训练步骤相当甚至更低的成本。

title: Collaborative Orbital Edge Intelligence: A Decentralized Paradigm for Energy-Efficient Computing in Space
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for publication in IEEE Network
summary: In recent years, Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites have been increasingly deployed to enable connectivity in remote and disaster-prone areas. Researchers have proposed Orbital Edge Computing, which adds computational intelligence to LEO satellites to process data on orbit, providing edge intelligence close to space data sources. Existing work on Orbital Edge Computing typically assumes centralized control without collaboration among satellites from different providers, leading to limited connectivity, higher latency, and increased satellite battery depletion. They have not fully explored decentralized inter-satellite collaboration for energy-efficient intelligence under heterogeneous LEO constellations.
