AI.method: 方法学核心是**逐项排除+对照干预**： 1) **模型架构**：2B参数冻结VLM + 训练好的查询式重采样器连接器 + 各解码器层的模态门控深度适配器，仅训练连接器与适配器；Matryoshka嵌套表征（默认1024维）； 2) **预训练**：888,800 clips，11个来源，新增词性语音轮约15万spoken-word + 7万read-speech + audiobook； 3) **三阶段因果测试**： ① Section 4 观察现象（语音轮交换关键词与情绪）； ② Section 5 在Crema-D（7,442 clips、12句固定台词、6种情绪）上微调排除容量解释； ③ Section 6 用挖掘的29,428 clips（caption显式命名情绪）做匹配曝光对照排除数据量解释； ④ Section 7 用2048维排除截断解释（仅恢复18%差距）； ⑤ Section 8 九任务板排除广泛退化； 4) **关键机制实验**： ① Section 9 计算语料文本侧的碰撞率与最近邻余弦相似度作为预测因子； ② Section 11.1 场景分组批处理（提高in-batch相似度但保留caption多样性）作为相似度非充分的证明； ③ Section 11.2 将挖掘语料重新标注为16种情绪-语气标签（坍缩caption多样性从25,392到16，碰撞率0.04→0.98），在相同音频上做三种子干预实验。
AI.result: 主要结果包括： 1) **现象**：语音轮使SpeechCommands从0.133→0.894（+76.1），Ravdess情绪从0.348→0.211（-13.7）（Table 1）； 2) **容量排除**：Crema-D 7,442 clips微调在150/400步使Ravdess回升至0.508/0.537（超过0.348的pre-speech水平），代价仅5点关键词（Table 2）； 3) **数据量排除**：挖掘语库29,428 clips在2.6 epoch（与Crema-D匹配曝光）下Ravdess为0.210，即-0.0007（Table 4），九任务板无明显退化（Table 6）； 4) **截断排除**：2048维仅恢复18%差距，pre-speech模型反而降低（Table 5）； 5) **预测统计**：Crema-D碰撞率0.556、最近邻余弦0.971；挖掘语料分别为0.038与0.827；口语词语料最低（0.006/0.759）（Table 7）； 6) **干预E6a失败**：场景分组批次提高余弦至0.89仍无效果（0.222 vs 随机控制0.231）（Table 8）； 7) **干预E6b成功**：caption多样性坍缩使Ravdess回升至0.310（+0.089，三种子不重叠区间），关键词回落0.930→0.903（Table 9）； 8) **跨数据集验证**：Iemocap上同方向回升（约Ravdess效应的1/4），种子稳健但量级减小。
AI.conclusion: 结论是机制层面的：对比目标函数**仅编码其负样本集无法不借助就无法分离的属性**——即属性被学习的充要条件是该属性成为必要的判别轴。语料库规模、caption词汇量、标签覆盖率是常规质量指标，但在本情境下与真正的决定因素**反相关**：caption多样性本是质量指标，本研究却证明低多样性反而强迫音频侧做判别；caption显式命名情绪不够，必须使情绪成为唯一剩余信号。实操上：欲向对比嵌入注入某属性，应**设计语料库结构使负样本无法在不依赖该属性时分离**，而非堆叠更多显式标注的数据。该结论通过从跨语料的观察推断升级为基于同一音频的因果干预验证，并提出未来工作中应报告语料库文本侧的碰撞率与最近邻相似度等可免费计算的预测性统计量。局限包括：主要情绪轴依赖单一benchmark、Ravdess与Crema-D共享表演性与固定句内容的域偏差、微调多为单次运行、以及已知Common Voice存在22%/47%的句子级测试-训练重叠问题（已通过选择评估来源回避）。

title: DocNavRAG: Document-Structured Graph RAG with Stateful Evidence Construction for Complex Document Question Answering
summary: Answering complex questions over large document collections requires assembling complementary evidence across sections and documents. GraphRAG offers structured retrieval but typically uses fixed traversal, while agentic RAG operates over weakly structured interfaces. Our key insight is that agents should navigate document structure within and across documents rather than repeatedly search from scratch. We introduce DocNavRAG, which organizes document hierarchies and cross-region relations into a navigable graph, exposes graph operations for locating, navigating, expanding, and fetching, and maintains an evolving evidence state to guide retrieval until sufficient evidence is collected. Across four long- and multi-document QA benchmarks, DocNavRAG improves answer quality and context sufficiency over the strongest baseline by 7.8\% and 17.7\% on average.

AI.tldr: DocNavRAG 是一个无需训练的智能体 GraphRAG 框架，将文档组织为可导航的图（含层级与横向关系），并通过四类图操作（定位、导航、扩展、获取）与持续演化的证据状态，迭代地汇集复杂问答所需的跨章节、跨文档证据。
AI.motivation: 复杂文档问答（CDQA）所需的证据往往分散于多个章节和文档。现有方法存在两类局限：(1) 基于图的 RAG 依赖预定义的固定遍历策略，难以适应不断演化的信息需求；(2) 智能体 RAG 在扁平段落或脆弱的 LLM 抽取知识图上操作，缺乏文档原生的高层路由结构，导致智能体只能反复进行全局查询，而非从粗粒度区域逐步走向精确证据。本文核心洞察是：智能体应沿着文档内与跨文档的结构进行导航，而非每次从零搜索。
AI.method:
方法包含两阶段：

(1) **文档图构建（离线）**：
- **层级恢复**：利用布局、标题与阅读顺序，将每篇文档还原为有序层级树，叶子为段落节点、内部为章节/全文等结构节点。
- **层级条件节点画像**：根据子树高度与文本长度阈值 τ_h、τ_ℓ 选择高层路由作用域 R_d，仅为这些作用域附加 LLM 生成的全局摘要，其余节点保留轻量自底向上画像。
- **图关系构建**：结构边（层级边 ∪ 局部阅读顺序邻接边）+ 横向边（引用 ℰ_cite、实体 ℰ_ent、语义相似 ℰ_sim、主题社区 ℰ_comm）。

(2) **智能体图检索（在线）**：
- 四类抽象动作：**Locate**（按粒度定位候选节点）、**Navigate**（沿层级边向上/向下/查看大纲）、**Expand**（沿横向边扩展邻居）、**Fetch**（物化源段落）。
- 检索状态 s_t=(E_t, C_t, M_t, F_t)：已采纳证据、待探索候选、剩余证据需求、下一焦点。
- 每轮循环：选择动作→在 o_t 上筛选（结果筛选/需求修订/焦点选择）→评估完成度，直至 M_t=∅ 或预算耗尽，最终基于累积证据 E_T 生成答案。
AI.result: 在四个 CDQA 基准（ScholarQA、MDAQA、LongBenchV2-UserGuide、LongBenchV2-Gov）上，DocNavRAG 在答案质量（RAGAS Answer Correctness / 准确率）与检索充分性（Sufficient Context）上均优于所有基线（BM25、TF-IDF、Dense、LinearRAG、HippoRAG、LightRAG、IRCoT、A-RAG），相对最强基线 A-RAG 平均提升 7.8% 答案质量与 17.7% 上下文充分性。消融实验表明各组件互补：大规模文档集合受益于层级搜索以扩展覆盖，长文档场景中状态控制与证据获取贡献最大，异构长文档集合则依赖横向导航。跨 6 个 LLM 主干（DeepSeek、Qwen、GPT 系列）验证了 backbone 鲁棒性；成本介于无 LLM 索引与高开销语义图构建之间。
AI.conclusion: DocNavRAG 验证了将文档原生结构暴露为可导航搜索空间、并用持续演化的证据状态驱动智能体检索的有效性。该框架无需训练，在多文档与长文档 QA 上一致超越段落、图与智能体类基线。消融、骨干与成本分析进一步表明：图访问与检索控制在不同语料设置下发挥互补作用，框架在不同 LLM 配置下均有效，且推理成本处于中等水平。未来工作可面向动态/多模态文档，并通过缓存、自适应预算与更小的控制器模型进一步降低开销。

title: Characterizing Treatment-Context Medication Evidence Across Clinic Notes and Structured EHR Medication History
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE BIBM 2026
summary: Clinic notes and structured electronic health record (EHR) medication history often contain different medication information. Same-visit disagreement between these sources may result from note-side normalization errors, differences in terminology or timing, or actual differences in documentation. We developed a note-grounded approach that uses large language model (LLM) assisted reference construction, targeted and random human review, deterministic medication normalization, and semantic and temporal comparisons with structured medication history. We evaluated all normalization results on a patient-level held-out test set to limit adaptation to the study cohort. On 5,403 held-out mention rows, exact canonical agreement improved from 0.7226 with surface-exact matching to 0.8429 after lexical cleanup and curated alias mapping. In a random audit of previously unaudited rows, canonical-label agreement was 0.9210 among evaluable valid medication mentions, whereas treatment-action attribution was lower at 0.5326. In the full-cohort characterization analysis, only 16.44% of note-derived rows had same-visit exact overlap with structured medication history, but 55.17% had same-visit semantic overlap, 90.34% had same-visit or +/-30-day overlap, and only 3.97% remained in the strict no-structured-overlap bucket under broad project-level mapping. An ontology-backed sensitivity analysis further showed that held-out strict Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP)-backed no-overlap fell from 43.99% to 36.68% after a development-derived alias supplement. These results show that note-to-structured-medication mismatch can arise from normalization errors, differences in terminology, and differences in documentation timing.

AI.tldr: 本文针对门诊笔记与结构化EHR用药史之间存在的药物信息差异，提出一种基于笔记的（note-grounded）评估框架，利用LLM辅助构建参考集、人类审核、确定性药物归一化以及语义-时间分层比较，系统刻画两源差异的性质与来源。
AI.motivation: 临床笔记与结构化用药记录之间常存在差异，但既往研究往往将这种差异简单视为提取错误，未区分笔记侧归一化错误、术语差异、记录时间差异与实际文档差异。本研究旨在建立一种可审计、可量化的方法，区分这些不同性质的跨源不一致。
AI.method: 1) 使用Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct（vLLM部署，temperature=0，schema约束JSON）自举构建笔记侧参考集；2) 结合定向审核（difficult case enriched）与随机审核（stratified sample of 1,000 rows）确保参考集可信度；3) 患者级别留出（606开发/150测试）评估确定性归一化管线（surface-exact→lexical cleanup→curated alias→safe decomposition）；4) 七层语义-时间阶梯比较笔记来源行与结构化用药史（exact→ingredient→broad category，逐层放松时间窗口至±30天、±90天、any-history）；5) 使用OMOP/RxNorm本体进行敏感性分析，并在开发集上推导别名补充后重新评估留出测试集。
AI.result: 1) 归一化性能：在5,403条留出行上，精确规范一致性从0.7226（surface-exact）提升至0.8429（完整管线），主要增益来自词法清理（+5.24%）与人工策划别名（+6.79%），安全分解无额外增益；端到端F1为0.6596；优于未调优MedXN（F1=0.5164，FP率高）。2) 参考可信度：随机审核中有效药物提及的规范标签一致性为0.9210，但治疗动作归因仅0.5326，表明动作归因比规范标签更难。3) 跨源差异分解：仅16.44%笔记行与结构化用药史有同次就诊精确重叠；同次就诊语义重叠55.17%；±30天内重叠达90.34%；仅3.97%在宽项目级映射下仍无重叠。在严格OMOP支持下无重叠比例从43.99%降至36.68%（加入开发集推导的别名补充后），说明相当比例严格无重叠可由笔记侧映射覆盖度解释。4) 错误分布：未解析行中89.32%为缺失别名，集中在对乙酰氨基酚、羟考酮、昂丹司琼、地塞米松、加巴喷丁等高频词。
AI.conclusion: 诊所笔记与结构化用药史之间的差异并非单一类别的文档失败，而是语义相关性、时间位移与笔记侧映射限制的混合。确定性、机构与语境相关的别名覆盖比通用词法匹配和本体匹配更有效。临床证据特征化应先于下游临床推断；结构化用药史不应被视为用药提取的"真值"，而应作为下游一致性比较。

title: Human-LLM Alignment in Language Attitudes Toward Non-Native Japanese
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly evaluate human writing in high-stakes domains such as hiring and academic assessment, putting non-native speakers at particular risk. Drawing on the language attitudes framework, we compared human and LLM evaluations of parallel L1- and L2-written Japanese emails on three dimensions: fluency, status, and solidarity. Japanese raters rated L2 texts significantly lower on all three dimensions, with a fluency gap roughly twice the size of the status and solidarity gaps. Six LLM judges reproduced the direction of this bias, and five reproduced its ordering across dimensions. The models diverged from humans in two ways: all understated the solidarity gap, the most socially grounded dimension, and all differentiated among learner L1 backgrounds where humans did not. LLM judges thus reproduce native speakers' language attitudes in a structured yet attenuated form, and the language attitudes framework offers a ready-made yardstick for auditing them beyond English.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在评估日语邮件写作时，对母语（L1）和二语（L2）作者的评价是否存在偏见，并将其与人类评估进行了比较。
AI.motivation: 在招聘、学术评估等高风险领域中，LLMs越来越多地用于评估人类写作。非母语者可能因语言偏见而处于不利地位。现有研究多聚焦于英语，缺乏对其他语言的系统审计框架。本文旨在探究LLM评委是否再现了母语者对L1/L2写作的语言态度偏见，并提出基于语言态度理论的审计方法。
AI.method: 基于"语言态度"（language attitudes）框架，从三个维度评估日语邮件写作：流利度（fluency）、地位（status）和团结性（solidarity）。使用平行语料（L1作者为日本母语者，L2作者为不同背景的学习者）。由日本母语评分者进行人工评估，并使用6个LLM评委进行对比评估，分析评分差距和维度排序。
AI.result: 1）人类评估：日语母语评分者对L2文本在三个维度上均显著评分较低，流利度差距约为地位和团结性差距的两倍。2）LLM评估：6个LLM评委均再现了偏见方向，5个再现了维度间相对大小的排序。3）LLM与人类的差异：所有LLM都低估了团结性差距（最具社会性的维度）；所有LLM能区分不同L1背景学习者，而人类未能区分。
AI.conclusion: LLM评委以一种"结构化但衰减"的形态再现了母语者的语言态度。"语言态度"框架为审计LLM在英语以外的语言评估中的偏见提供了一个现成的衡量标准。LLM存在对L2写作的系统性偏见，需谨慎应用于高风险评估场景。

title: Does Accuracy Equal Evidence? Reasoning Faithfulness under KV Cache Compression
summary: KV cache compression is commonly evaluated by final-answer accuracy, implicitly assuming that preserving the answer also preserves the reasoning that supports it. We test this assumption for large reasoning models and show that it can fail: under compression, correct answers and the validity of their visible supporting rationales can be preserved at different rates. We study this failure with a controlled fixed-trace replay protocol, which holds reasoning content fixed and isolates whether compression preserves usable information from an already available trace. We evaluate ten token-eviction KV compression methods and one quantization method on three models across mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, clinical calculation, and long-context retrieval. We measure final accuracy, answer-chain consistency, and perturbation faithfulness. Across tasks, token-eviction methods can preserve competitive final-answer accuracy while substantially degrading chain support or perturbation faithfulness. We call this the answer-evidence gap. A coverage-preserving quantization control is substantially less affected, suggesting that the failure is tied less to KV memory reduction itself than to losing access to parts of the reasoning trace. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了KV缓存压缩中存在"答案-证据鸿沟"（answer-evidence gap）：压缩后的模型可保留最终答案正确性，但推理链的支持证据（推导、验证、鲁棒性）显著退化，使仅基于最终准确性的评估产生误导性结论。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩方法普遍仅以最终答案准确率作为评估指标，隐含假设"保留答案即保留推理"。但大推理模型（LRM）的中间推理链日益被用于审计与信任验证，CoT忠实性研究表明推理可能省略或扭曲证据。压缩是否会放大这一问题？作者将最终答案的可恢复性与证据支持的完整性分离检验。
AI.method: 采用受控的固定轨迹重放协议（fixed-trace replay）：先用Full-KV模型生成完整推理轨迹，再让各压缩方法在相同文本前缀下重放，仅KV状态不同，从而分离"轨迹生成"与"KV保留"两个因素。评估11种压缩方法（10种token驱逐+1种量化KIVI-2bit）在3个模型（Qwen3-8B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B、Qwen3-30B-A3B）、4类任务（AIME数学、GPQA-Diamond科学、MedCalc临床计算、RULER长上下文检索+IF-Eval指令遵循）上的表现，使用三个互补指标：(1)最终准确率，(2)答案-链一致性（LLM-as-judge标注RWAC：答案正确但推理不被支持的占比），(3)扰动忠实度（在start/middle/end位置注入错误答案后测量Fidelity与Bias Rate）。
AI.result: 1. token驱逐方法在AIME、GPQA、MedCalc上可保持较高最终准确率，但答案-链一致性和扰动忠实度大幅退化（如AIME上SnapKV的RWAC/correct达65.5%，远高于Full-KV的4.3%；Fidelity从92.8%降至61.6%）；2. 量化方法KIVI-2bit由于保留全部token覆盖，三项指标均接近Full-KV，说明问题根源在于"丢失部分推理轨迹"而非"减少KV内存"本身；3. 在RULER检索任务上因答案依赖精确远距离证据，压缩损伤通过准确率崩塌可见，验证了答案-证据鸿沟的边界条件；4. 准确率与推理质量在AIME上呈强负Spearman相关（ρ=-0.95），表明高准确率方法反而倾向于低推理质量；5. 匹配答案分析显示在Full-KV正确推理的样本上，SnapKV有64.8%退化为无效链，而KIVI仅4.2%；6. 扰动分析揭示不同压缩方法的偏好：StreamingLLM过度保留早期锚点使start位置错误答案易被采纳；SnapKV/AdaKV/HeadKV因注意力信号使晚注入的"结论式"内容被高估；7. 预算消融表明增大缓存可先恢复准确率，但链一致性或扰动忠实度的鸿沟持续存在；8. 该现象在DeepSeek-R1-Distill和Qwen3-30B-A3B上同样存在，跨模型泛化。
AI.conclusion: 最终答案准确率是压缩推理的不对称诊断指标——准确率崩溃可揭示损伤，但准确率保留可能掩盖证据丢失。本文提出证据感知评估范式（答案-链一致性+扰动忠实度），建议未来KV压缩设计应保护依赖与验证结构，而非仅保留对生成答案显着重要的token。该研究为诊断性而非穷尽性，未做token/状态级因果归因，RWAC依赖LLM判官但经过人机一致性验证（κ=0.89）。

title: PGMem: Tightly Coupled Persona-Memory Graph for Lifelong Personalized Agents
summary: Long-term personalized dialogue agents must track user preferences as their personas evolve. Existing memory systems organize past events well, but store personas as flat profiles detached from the events that justify them. This loose coupling leads to the memory-persona validity gap and the persona-aware retrieval gap. We propose PGMem, a heterogeneous persona-memory graph that connects event and persona nodes through typed provenance and evidence edges, keeping each persona signal traceable to the events that support or revise it. At retrieval time, PGMem expands from query-relevant seeds and ranks signals by evidential validity. Across three benchmarks with small language model backbones, PGMem consistently outperforms summary-based, persona-aware, graph-structured, and agentic memory baselines, and improves performance as the context grows. The source code of PGMem is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: PGMem提出了一种异构的"人格-记忆图谱"，通过类型化的证据边将事件节点与人格节点紧密耦合，解决长期个性化对话中记忆与人格脱节导致的"记忆-人格有效性鸿沟"和"人格感知检索鸿沟"。在三个长期个性化对话基准上，使用小型语言模型作为骨干，PGMem consistently优于摘要式、人格感知式、图结构式和智能体式记忆基线，并随对话上下文增长而提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有长期个性化对话代理存在两大根本缺陷：(1)记忆-人格有效性鸿沟：现有方法将情景记忆和人格信号作为松耦合组件存储，无法表示人格信号为何产生、后续事件如何支持它或更新的信号如何修订早期偏好；(2)人格感知检索鸿沟：现有方法严重依赖表面级查询-记忆相似性，忽略了潜在人格状态对检索的指导，导致检索到与已更新的用户人格相冲突的相似历史片段。这些缺陷源于现有方法将记忆与人格视为松耦合组件，未能显式建模事件与人格信号之间的相互验证关系。
AI.method: PGMem构建一个异构人格-记忆图谱G=(V,E)，包含两层节点和两类边：事件层（Context节点存储原始话语对、Episode节点摘要局部对话）和人格层（State节点捕获短期人格信号、Trait节点表示稳定倾向）；通过Source边记录跨抽象层级的溯源关系，Evidence边编码Support(⊕)、Contradict(⊖)、Shift_To(↝)、Irrelevant(∅)四种类型化证据关系。检索采用三阶段流程：(1)种子检索结合语义与词汇相似度为四类节点分别选Top-k种子；(2)证据引导扩展沿有符号证据路径进行有符号遍历，累积正/负符号并在跳数限制H内传播；(3)有效性感知最终组装计算每个节点的证据有效性分数val(v)=|S(v)|+α)/(|S(v)|+|C(v)|+2α)，结合查询相关性ϕ(q,v)按λ·val+(1-λ)·ϕ排名。
AI.result: 在ImplexConv（opposed子集）、PrefEval和PersonaMem三个基准上，使用Qwen3-1.7B和Gemma-3-1B两种SLM骨干进行评估，PGMem在所有设置下均取得最佳结果：ImplexConv上较最强基线提升高达29%，PrefEval上提升高达59%，PersonaMem上随上下文从32k增至128k准确率持续提升（Qwen3-1.7B从45.5升至46.4，是唯一改善的方法）。消融研究证实人格节点贡献最大，移除Contradict或Shift_To边在PersonaMem-128k上分别下降1.98和1.91点。人类验证表明LLM评判与人类判断一致。token消耗和延迟分析显示PGMem在建图阶段优于A-MEM和THEANINE，QA阶段单次LLM调用。
AI.conclusion: PGMem将长期个性化对话重新定义为基于证据的人格管理问题，验证了以证据图谱组织人格记忆的可行性，证明了显式类型化证据边、图扩展和有效性感知检索相比扁平化用户档案和表面相似性检索的显著优势，为资源受限的SLM骨干上可靠个性化提供了实用路径。局限性包括：证据边类型未涵盖更细粒度认知维度、仅在合成数据集上评估、需要生命周期管理策略应对极长期场景下的节点边膨胀。

title: Constructing Parallel Multidimensional Chromatic Lexicons for Corpus-Assisted Analysis of Russian and English Texts
summary: This article addresses the relative scarcity of research tools for the corpus-assisted linguistic analysis of colour terms in literary texts. It describes the development of two multidimensional chromatic lexicons: one for Russian (224 entries) and one for English (141 entries). Lexicon construction involved sourcing colour vocabulary from specialised resources and research literature, comparing the two language inventories, manually checking translated candidates, and addressing language-specific morphological features. In addition to identifying colour terms and visual descriptors, the lexicons classify entries according to hue, saturation, and temperature. To demonstrate their practical application, a pilot study was conducted on purposively sampled corpora of poetry by Andrei Bely (20,373 tokens) and Emily Dickinson (28,479 tokens). All retrieved matches were checked in context and classified as Confirmed_chromatic, Ambiguous_visual, or Excluded. The analysis was implemented in two main stages: a strict analysis including confirmed chromatic lexis only, followed by a sensitivity analysis incorporating both confirmed and ambiguous chromatic lexis to determine whether coding decisions about borderline cases affected the main findings. The quantitative results indicated marked differences in the use of colour terms, visual descriptors, hue, saturation, and temperature. Specifically, the analysis revealed that confirmed chromatic terms occurred 3.4 times more frequently in the sampled Bely corpus than in the Dickinson corpus. These findings demonstrate the analytical value of a multidimensional approach, with the main contribution of this study being a transparent and reusable procedure for constructing and applying multilingual chromatic lexicons.

AI.tldr: 本文针对文学语料库色彩术语分析的研究工具稀缺问题，开发了俄语（224条）和英语（141条）多维度色彩词典，并通过对比安德烈·别雷与艾米莉·狄金森的诗歌语料验证其应用价值。
AI.motivation: 文学文本中色彩语词（chromatic lexis）的语料库辅助语言学研究存在明显的方法论缺口：缺乏系统化、可复用的多语种色彩词典工具，尤其是能够同时编码色相、饱和度与色温等多维度信息的词典资源。
AI.method: 1) 从专业资源和研究文献中收集色彩词汇；2) 对比俄语与英语的色彩词汇库；3) 人工核查翻译候选词并处理语言特异性形态特征；4) 编制涵盖色相、饱和度、色温三个维度的分类体系；5) 在别雷（20,373词）和狄金森（28,479词）诗歌语料上进行试点研究，采用严格分析与敏感性分析两阶段方法，将检索结果分为已确认色彩词、模糊视觉词与排除词三类。
AI.result: 俄语色彩术语库规模（224条）显著大于英语（141条），反映出两种语言色彩词汇的不对称性；别雷语料中已确认色彩词的出现频次是狄金森语料的3.4倍；在色相、饱和度、色温三个维度上均存在显著使用差异，证实了多维度编码的分析价值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究的主要贡献在于提出了一套透明且可复用的多语种色彩词典构建与应用程序，证明了多维度（色相—饱和度—色温）分类方法相比单一色彩名称识别能够揭示更丰富的文学色彩使用模式，为计算文体学与文学语料库研究提供了可推广的方法论框架。

title: RADAR: Rubric-Aware Dependency and Redundancy Analysis for LLM-as-Judge Evaluation
summary: Rubric-based LLM-as-judge pipelines often assume that evaluation criteria provide independent signals. In practice, however, criteria can be behaviorally coupled: improving one criterion may systematically change scores on another, distorting aggregate scores used in model-release or product-update decisions. We introduce RADAR, a lightweight preflight diagnostic framework for estimating such coupling before large-scale evaluation. Given a rubric, RADAR generates targeted synthetic probes, scores each probe on all criteria, and produces a directional coupling matrix that shows which criteria co-score and how. We validate RADAR on three industry-relevant evaluation settings: NVIDIA HelpSteer2, SumPubMed, and the Yale-Salesforce SummEval benchmark. Using only a small number of probes per criterion, RADAR recovers human inter-criterion correlation structure (Pearson r > 0.84) and provides practitioners with concrete audit signals about redundancy, hierarchy, and aggregation sensitivity before committing to large-scale judging.

AI.tldr: RADAR是一种轻量级的预检（preflight）诊断框架，用于在大规模LLM-as-Judge评估运行之前，检测评分量表（rubric）中各评估标准之间的行为耦合（即"评分共变"）问题。它通过生成针对单一标准定向干预的合成探针样本，并由验证LLM对全部标准打分，构建一个有向耦合矩阵，从而揭示哪些标准实际上被当作一个潜在维度共同评分，以及耦合的方向和强度。
AI.motivation: 基于评分量表的LLM评估流程隐含一个假设：各评估标准（如"有用性"、"正确性"、"连贯性"）提供相互独立的信号。然而，即使评分量表文本上语义不同，标准之间也可能因LLM评判者的内部表征而"行为耦合"——提升某一项标准得分时，另一项也会系统性变化，导致聚合分数被扭曲。这种隐性耦合在模型发布决策等高风险场景中会系统性偏差模型排序。已有方法要么事后分析已打分数据（无法分离因果共变与统计共变），要么对量表做语义优化（RRD等），但都未回答"在评估运行之前，哪些标准会被判定为依赖维度"这一问题。
AI.method: RADAR采用三阶段流程：(1) 准则条件生成——给定任务集𝒯、生成器G，对每个标准Cᵢ和方向d∈{+,−}生成N个专门满足/违反Cᵢ而不优化其他标准的探针响应；(2) 全量表独立打分——验证器V对每个探针在每条标准上独立打分（消除提示内顺序效应）；(3) 耦合统计——计算SelfEffect(Cᵢ)（干预在自身上的强度）、GenCoupling(Cᵢ→Cⱼ)（干预在Cⱼ上的溢出）、归一化的Leakage ℓᵢⱼ，并据此推导对称耦合SymCoupling和方向不对称性Asymmetry。设有可靠性门控τ=0.40过滤弱干预。在4×4生成器-验证器网格（GPT-5-mini、GPT-5.5-Reasoning、Claude Opus 4.7、Sonnet 4.6，排除自配对，共12格/基准）上，于三个多维度人评基准（HelpSteer2、SumPubMed、SummEval）进行验证，以人工标注的准则间Pearson相关作为外部参照。
AI.result: 在三基准上，RADAR的对称耦合与人工准则间相关结构高度吻合（Pearson r≥0.84，Spearman ρ≥0.83，MAE最低），显著优于合成相关基线和RRD去相关基线（后者在SummEval上r=−0.11，ρ最高仅0.40）。仅需每格N=3–5个探针即可恢复完整N=20下的结构，成本比全量集标注低77×–380×（N=1时低380×）。审计结果揭示两类问题：双向簇（bidirectional clusters，如HelpSteer2的helpfulness/correctness，Sym=0.92，Asym=0.21）提示潜在的双重计分；方向性依赖（directional dependencies，如SummEval的relevance→coherence，0.53 vs 0.28）提示上下游信号继承——两者需不同的应对策略。平均正耦合0.32–0.38，张力接近零；最严重耦合对在三个基准上均显著远离零（95%自助法置信区间半宽≤0.02）。所有轴的自效应均通过可靠性门控（最小0.46）。
AI.conclusion: RADAR将评分量表从静态文本审查升级为对LLM评判者行为的实证诊断，代价与语料大小解耦，可作为模型发布前的常规预检步骤嵌入CI流程。诊断有意停留在"识别耦合"层面，不替从业者决定耦合是冗余、意图层级还是可接受的产品偏好——这些判定需要结合业务上下文。其局限性在于：测量的是特定生成器-验证器配置下的耦合而非量表文本的内在属性；提供行为证据而非正式因果识别；外部参照（人评相关）混合了真实依赖、标注噪声和数据集特定共现；目前仅在三个文本基准上验证（但方法本身与模态和任务无关）。

title: Divergent large language model predictions from convergent representations in ambiguous word pairs
comment: 21 main text pages, 20 pages supplemental, 4 figures
summary: In this work we investigate how decoder-only transformers resolve lexical ambiguity through layer-by-layer analysis of three models spanning three parameter sizes (GPT-2-Small-117M, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-32B). For both homonyms and polysemes, we find that representations become maximally distinct in middle layers, then partially reconverge in late layers, while the KL divergence between their next-token predictions reaches its maximum in the final layers. The activation patching experiment provides causal evidence that late-layer representational differences directly determine outputs despite apparent increased similarity in embedding space. Our single-layer ablation experiment indicates that models achieve equivalent disambiguation despite qualitatively different layer-wise vulnerabilities. These findings offer a mechanism for recent observations where models' internal embedding similarities show low correlation with their behavioural outputs despite strong performance. The semantic distinctions therefore remain present but become increasingly invisible to similarity measures over the embeddings, with implications for embedding-based methods such as semantic search, retrieval, and clustering that rely on late-layer cosine similarity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过逐层分析三个不同规模的解码器Transformer模型（GPT-2-Small 117M、Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-32B），发现对于同形异义词和多义词，表征在中间层达到最大分离后在后期层部分重新收敛，而预测分布的KL散度在最终层达到最大。激活修补实验因果性地证明晚期层表征差异直接决定输出，尽管其嵌入空间相似性看似增加。
AI.motivation: 当前NLP应用中，"语义相似"通常通过晚期层嵌入的余弦相似度来操作化，但近期研究发现模型的内部嵌入相似性与行为输出相关性较弱。本文旨在探究解码器Transformer如何在网络深度中处理词义消歧，并解释嵌入几何与行为输出脱节的原因。
AI.method: 三项实验：(1) Logit lens——逐层测量激活距离(余弦距离)、logit距离和KL散度；(2) 激活修补(activation patching)——双向替换各层残差流激活，测量token重叠和交换有效性；(3) 单层消融——逐层置零激活，测量后续层的指标退化。刺激集包括同形异义词（如"bank"）和概念漂移多义词（如"mouse"），还包含序列位置控制实验。
AI.result: 所有三个模型均呈现一致的"上升-峰值-下降"模式：表征在中间层达到最大分离，后期层部分重新收敛；而KL散度在最终层达到最大。激活修补显示晚期层交换导致近95%的token重叠，证明晚期层表征因果性地决定输出。单层消融揭示三个模型虽实现等效消歧，但层级依赖模式显著不同：GPT-2和Qwen在早中层消融后指标急剧下降，Llama则呈现表征鲁棒但预测完全退化的解耦模式。控制分析证实分离反映语义而非句法位置。
AI.conclusion: 消歧信息在晚期层保留但变得对几何相似性度量"不可见"——语义区分通过表征到预测的非线性映射而非几何分离来表达。这解释了Capone等人观察到的嵌入相似性与行为判断脱节现象。对下游应用而言：依赖晚期层余弦相似度的方法（如语义搜索、检索、聚类）可能低估模型实际执行的消歧；结合预测信息或采用中间层表征可能更好地恢复模型编码的语义区分。

title: Analyzing Speech Condition Effects in Dysarthric ASR: A Layer-wise Probing Study
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance degrades sharply on dysarthric speech, yet how disordered articulation reshapes a model's internal representations is underexplored. We present a layer-wise probing analysis of a transformer ASR encoder on Mandarin dysarthric speech under three transcript-matched conditions: original dysarthric speech, speaker conditioned zero-shot TTS resynthesis, and unconditioned TTS. The probes reveal a task-dependent hierarchy: phoneme boundary information stays weak for dysarthric speech at every layer, phoneme identity becomes recoverable toward the upper layers, and recognition difficulty is encoded in the deepest layers. Tone-sensitive evaluation shows Mandarin lexical tone is a persistent error source. Cross-condition similarity divergence grows with depth, indicating that disordered speech affects high-level representations more than low-level acoustic features. Guided by these findings, single-layer LoRA at layer 7 and adaptation on subset layers 5-8 achieve performance within 3.5% and 2.48% relative margins of full encoder adaptation, respectively, while upper-layer adaptation is less effective for dysarthric speech. These findings link representation analysis to parameter-efficient fine-tuning and motivate layer-aware adaptation for low-resource Mandarin dysarthric ASR.

AI.tldr: 本文针对普通话构音障碍（dysarthria）语音识别性能急剧下降的问题，对Whisper-small编码器进行层级化探针分析，在三种文本匹配条件下（原始构音障碍语音、说话人条件零样本TTS再合成语音、无条件TTS语音）系统考察编码器各层的表征结构，并据此指导层级化LoRA参数高效微调。结果发现音素边界信息在构音障碍语音中全程偏弱、音素身份信息在上层可恢复、识别难度集中在最深层，验证了中层（5–8层）适配最具性价比。
AI.motivation: 构音障碍ASR性能急剧下降，但现有方法（微调、数据增强、语音重建）将模型视为黑箱，缺乏对"构音障碍如何重塑模型内部表征"的理解。若能定位障碍性发音主要扰动的层级，则可采用层级选择性参数高效适配，避免全网络调参的过拟合风险与计算开销，对低资源场景尤具价值。
AI.method: 以Whisper-small（12层Transformer编码器）为骨干，对中文构音障碍数据集（CDSD，~55,850条）构建三条件平行语料：原始构音障碍(d)、说话人条件零样本TTS再合成(r)、无条件TTS(u)，保持文本一致以排除词汇混淆。在冻结编码器上运行三类层级化探针：(A) 帧级音素边界检测（线性+F1）、(B) 序列级音素识别（轻量CTC+PER，含声调敏感与声调无关）、(C) 话语级识别难度预测（线性softmax+Macro-F1）。同时进行跨条件配对余弦相似度分析。依据探针结论对编码器自注意力的q/k/v/out投影插入LoRA（rank=64, α=128），冻结解码器，在不同层级（单层/多层子集/全部12层）进行适配对比。
AI.result: 基线显示Whisper-small在原始构音障碍语音上CER高达105.08%，远高于TTS再合成（44.26%）与无条件TTS（36.63%），证实声学音素因素是主要失败源。配对相似度分析显示跨条件分歧随层深增大，d–r对比揭示障碍性发音扰动集中在高层而非低层声学特征。音素边界F1在三种条件下全程分离且构音障碍曲线近乎平坦；音素识别PER在6层后趋于平稳且声调误差持续存在；识别难度Macro-F1在第5层后才显著上升，于第12层达峰。LoRA适配中，全层微调CER最低（68.85%）；单层Layer 7达71.26%（相对全层仅差3.5%），多层5–8达70.56%（差2.48%）；而9–12层适配对构音障碍语音反而恶化（最高80.28%），但对无条件TTS有效，呈现明显的"任务-层级"分裂。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了"转录匹配三条件"框架以隔离病理失真，并通过多粒度层级探针揭示了编码器表征的层级化任务依赖结构：音素边界全程弱化、音素身份信息在上中层成熟、识别难度集中于最深层。中层（5–8层）LoRA单层或子集适配即可逼近全参数微调效果，显著优于上层适配，从而将表征分析直接转化为参数高效适配的层级选择依据。普通话声调被确认为持续性误差源。研究主张面向低资源构音障碍ASR应采用层级感知、参数高效的适配策略。

title: CRISP: Critical Step Perception for Training Efficient Deep Search Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly extended into deep search agents that solve complex questions through multi-step interaction with external search and browsing tools. However, existing agents often incur substantial computational and interaction costs, generating lengthy trajectories that contain redundant queries, inefficient exploration, and irrelevant observations. Existing efficiency-oriented methods usually encourage agents to use tools less frequently, but treating all tool interactions uniformly may also suppress steps that gather necessary evidence. In this paper, we propose CRISP, a framework for training efficient deep search agents through critical step perception. Unlike prior efficiency methods that uniformly penalize tool use, CRISP distinguishes interactions that gather necessary evidence from redundant ones and shapes the training reward to preserve the former while pruning the latter, improving efficiency without sacrificing the evidence needed for correct answers. Specifically, CRISP first constructs critical-step labels with Backward Evidence Induction: starting from the final answer, a strong model traverses a completed search trajectory backward and judges whether each tool-interaction step provides or preserves evidence for the final answer. We then distill these step-wise judgments into a smaller critical-step recognizer, enabling full-trajectory analysis in a single pass. During policy optimization, an efficiency-aware reward is applied only to successful rollouts. Experiments on BrowseComp and HLE-Verified show that CRISP maintains competitive final-answer accuracy while reducing average interaction turns by 15.1% and 33.2%, respectively, demonstrating substantial improvements in interaction efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRISP框架，通过"关键步骤感知"训练高效的深度搜索智能体。它通过逆向证据归纳识别轨迹中对最终答案有贡献的关键步骤，在策略优化中仅对成功轨迹施加效率感知奖励，从而在保持答题准确性的同时显著减少冗余的搜索交互。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的深度搜索智能体存在显著的计算与交互开销问题，生成冗长的轨迹，包含冗余查询、低效探索和不相关观察。现有的效率导向方法通常统一地鼓励减少工具使用，但这可能压制必要的证据收集步骤，导致准确性与效率难以兼顾。
AI.method: CRISP包含三个核心组件：(1) **Backward Evidence Induction（逆向证据归纳）**：从最终答案出发，由强模型沿完成的搜索轨迹反向回溯，判断每个工具交互步骤是否为最终答案提供或保留了证据，构造关键步骤标签；(2) **关键步骤识别器（critical-step recognizer）**：将步骤级判断蒸馏到较小的模型中，实现单次全轨迹分析；(3) **效率感知奖励（efficiency-aware reward）**：在策略优化阶段，仅对成功的rollout施加该奖励，保留必要证据步骤同时剪枝冗余步骤。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp和HLE-Verified两个基准上，CRISP保持了具有竞争力的最终答案准确率，同时将平均交互轮次分别降低了15.1%和33.2%，显著提升了交互效率，证明了区分必要证据步骤与冗余步骤的必要性。
AI.conclusion: CRISP通过关键步骤感知机制有效解决了深度搜索智能体中效率与准确性的权衡难题。其核心贡献在于：不再对所有工具调用一视同仁地施加惩罚，而是通过逆向证据归纳精确识别真正贡献于最终答案的关键步骤。该框架为训练既高效又可靠的深度搜索智能体提供了新范式。

title: TRAM: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning with Trajectory-Derived Auxiliary Memory
summary: Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks requiring visual understanding and multi-step inference. However, as reasoning trajectories grow, models may become less effective at using information established earlier in the context, increasing the risk of reasoning errors. Existing approaches primarily address this problem by sustaining visual grounding throughout reasoning. However, reasoning also transforms visual observations into task-specific relations, constraints, and intermediate conclusions whose influence may weaken over long trajectories. Our attribution analysis suggests that correctness is not consistently separated by image attribution alone, but is more closely associated with whether trajectories retain and integrate such reasoning-derived information across stages. Motivated by this, we introduce TRAM (TRajectory-derived Auxiliary Memory), a training-free method that augments standard decoding with an auxiliary memory pathway derived from the model's own reasoning trajectory. TRAM consolidates completed reasoning into a compact latent memory, updates it online through fast and slow recurrent streams, and feeds it back into selected decoder layers through a lightweight residual pathway. Experiments across four MLRM variants on eight benchmarks show that TRAM improves performance over vanilla decoding on mathematical, scientific, and general visual reasoning tasks without additional training.

AI.tldr: TRAM提出了一种无需训练的测试时方法，通过从模型自身推理轨迹中构建紧凑的辅助记忆（双时间尺度循环状态），并在选定的解码器层中通过轻量级残差通路注入，从而增强多模态大推理模型在长推理链中保留与整合中间推理信息的能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大推理模型（MLRMs）在长推理轨迹中容易丢失早期已建立的推理信息（如任务特定的关系、约束、中间结论），导致后续推理偏离正确路径。现有方法主要通过强化视觉接地来解决此问题，但归因分析表明，正确与错误轨迹的差异更多源于是否在多个推理阶段保留并整合了推理衍生信息，而非仅依赖图像接地本身。
AI.method: 1) 将推理轨迹按句子终止符和换行符分割为步骤；2) 从每个步骤末尾的FFN输出窗口通过均值池化提取步骤表示；3) 在每个选定解码器层维护独立的快、慢双循环记忆状态（λ_fast < λ_slow），并通过慢记忆范数约束防止量级过大；4) 在步骤转换位置将合并后的记忆以加法方式注入选定层范围的残差隐藏状态，并可选地进行范数保持以维持方向性扰动。该方法无需训练、参数更新或修改注意力机制。
AI.result: 在四个MLRM骨干（Qwen3-VL-4B/8B、InternVL3.5-4B/8B）和八个基准测试（数学、科学、通用视觉问答）上，TRAM在所有骨干-基准组合上均优于vanilla解码，并在多数设置上达到最佳平均准确率；在4B模型上改进尤为显著。消融实验证实了快/慢双流、范数约束与保持、FFN输出读取位置以及基于轨迹的边界检测的必要性。推理轨迹越长，TRAM的增益越大（最长组+3.53%）。TRAM不损害视觉忠实度（MMVP、MME-Hall），且每token仅增加0.87-1.98ms延迟，峰值显存不变。
AI.conclusion: TRAM通过将已完成的推理信息显式整合为紧凑的辅助记忆，为长形式多模态推理提供了一种有效的训练免费干预手段。归因分析与实验结果共同支持将推理过程中产生的信息作为显式资源加以保留和复用，是缓解长推理链中信息弱化问题的可行路径。

title: CAVE: Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved substantial performance gains in Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) through reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing methods primarily rely on outcome correctness rewards that evaluate only the final predicted intervals, leaving boundary-related visual evidence and its correspondence with timestamp predictions insufficiently constrained. In this paper, we delve into timestamp prediction and its underlying boundary-level visual evidence, showing prevalent misalignment between visual evidence and predicted timestamps across widely used benchmarks. To address this issue, we propose Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment (CAVE), which augments localization optimization with boundary-specific visual evidence rewards to mitigate evidence-timestamp misalignment. Specifically, to explicitly represent the boundary-specific visual evidence, CAVE introduces boundary-specific evidence tokens and initializes their structured generation and distinct boundary semantics through a lightweight supervised warm-up. During RL, the visual boundary evidence alignment reward reinforces the visual attention of special evidence tokens within the ground-truth boundaries, thereby promoting alignment between visual evidence and temporal boundaries. Moreover, performance-aware gating for evidence supervision is designed to adaptively retain evidence guidance for poorly localized groups while reducing it once localization becomes sufficiently accurate to avoid over-constraining fine-grained boundary refinement. Extensive experiments on several public VTG benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAVE方法,通过引入边界特定的视觉证据令牌和视觉边界证据对齐奖励(VBEAR),解决视频时序定位(VTG)中基于强化学习的大视觉语言模型存在视觉证据与时间戳预测之间的错位问题,在多个TimeLens基准上取得了开源7B模型的领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于RL的VTG方法主要依赖结果正确性奖励(仅评估最终预测区间),导致边界相关的视觉证据与时间戳预测之间的对应关系未被充分约束。论文通过实证分析发现,在广泛使用的基准上存在普遍的视觉证据-时间戳错位现象:约22%-33%的错误定位样本仍展现强双侧边界证据,且这种错位在更严格的证据阈值下依然持续存在,表明仅基于区间重叠的优化不足以建立内部边界证据与生成时间戳之间的可靠对应。
AI.method: CAVE方法包含三个核心组件:(1) 引入专用的<Start>和<End>证据令牌,通过监督式预热(语言建模损失+边界注意力损失)初始化其结构化生成和边界语义;(2) 视觉边界证据对齐奖励(VBEAR),通过对比证据令牌在真实边界邻域内的注意力与显著非边界区域的注意力,鼓励边界特定证据集中并抑制虚假视觉显著性;(3) 性能感知门控机制(PAGE),根据 rollout 组的定位能力(m_g)自适应调整VBEAR强度,对定位差的组保留更强指导,对定位好的组逐步减弱以避免过度约束精细边界优化。最终奖励为R_IoU + λ_fmt·R_fmt + λ_v^(g)·R_v,基于GRPO进行联合优化。
AI.result: 在Charades-TimeLens、ActivityNet-TimeLens和QVHighlights-TimeLens三个基准上,CAVE-7B在12项评估指标上平均比TimeLens-7B提升约1.9分,在严格定位指标(R1@0.7)上提升尤为显著;CAVE-8B在Qwen3-VL-8B骨干上同样全面超越TimeLens-8B。消融实验验证了VBEAR、PAGE和边界注意力损失各自的有效性。证据-时间戳一致性分析表明CAVE在严格失配率ℳ_1上表现最佳,且在控制定位质量差异的情况下,显著减少了错误预测中强双侧证据的出现,同时增加了正确预测中强双侧证据的比例。
AI.conclusion: CAVE通过显式耦合边界相关视觉证据与时间戳生成,有效缓解了VTG中的证据-时间戳错位问题,提升了时序定位精度,且在小模型和更强骨干上均具有通用性。该方法不仅改进了粗粒度事件检索,更显著提升了边界敏感的精确定位能力,尤其在QVHighlights-TimeLens等强调精确时间范围的数据集上获益明显。

title: Cross-Domain Hybrid OPD for Generalizable Search Agents
summary: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL) have substantially improved the capabilities of autonomous search agents, enabling sophisticated planning, and iterative retrieval over dynamic information sources. However, optimizing language models for specialized search behaviors often incurs an alignment tax, where gains in search performance come at the expense of general-purpose capabilities, limiting their effectiveness as universal assistants. In this technical report, we present the training framework behind the Yuanbao search agent, designed to achieve search specialization without sacrificing general intelligence. Built upon the Hunyuan3 architecture, our framework combines agentic reinforcement learning for autonomous search with a cross-domain expert On-Policy Distillation (OPD) pipeline. Experts specializing in complementary general-purpose domains are distilled into the search-specialized student, restoring and further enhancing its broad capabilities. Rather than treating specialization and general capability as competing objectives, our hybrid training strategy jointly optimizes both, effectively mitigating the alignment tax. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the resulting model achieves competitive search performance while consistently improving its general-purpose capabilities, providing a favorable balance between specialized execution and broad generalization in real-world search scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种跨域混合在线策略蒸馏（Hybrid-OPD）训练框架，用于训练腾讯"元宝"（Yuanbao）搜索智能体。该框架在混元3（Hunyuan3）基础模型上，将面向搜索的智能体强化学习与多领域专家在线策略蒸馏相结合，有效缓解了搜索专精化带来的"对齐税"（alignment tax），在保持强大搜索能力的同时恢复并提升了通用能力。
AI.motivation: 面向搜索任务的强化学习虽然显著提升了智能体的搜索规划与迭代检索能力，但会导致模型在通用推理、指令跟随等通用能力上的退化，形成"对齐税"。这种专精化与通用化之间的零和权衡限制了搜索智能体作为通用助手的实用性，因此需要一种方法在提升搜索能力的同时保持甚至增强通用智能。
AI.method: 框架分两阶段：Stage I 在搜索任务上使用 GRPO 对 Hunyuan3 进行智能体强化学习，获得自主搜索能力；Stage II 联合优化搜索 RL 与跨域专家在线策略蒸馏（OPD）。具体地，在四个领域（数学、代码、逻辑推理、科学）上独立训练专家教师（采用基于信号密度的课程学习），训练时构造混合 mini-batch，搜索样本使用 GRPO 目标，通用领域样本通过对学生策略与对应专家教师之间的反向 KL 散度进行 token 级蒸馏，通过统一的策略梯度目标（PPO 裁剪形式）联合优化。
AI.result: 在 Hunyuan3 (A21B) 上的实验表明：Stage I 显著提升搜索能力（5个搜索基准全部大幅提升）但带来通用能力下降（如 Math AMO Bench (ZH) -8.00、Minerva Math -5.88、BBEH Mini -5.62）；Stage II 在几乎保持搜索能力不退化的前提下，大幅恢复并提升了通用能力（如 HYEval3.1 Logical Reasoning 提升 12.95、BBEH Mini 提升 13.26、AutoCodeBench v2 提升 6.41、AIME25 提升 7.33、GPQA Diamond 提升 6.69）。消融实验验证了跨域 OPD、多专家教师路由和课程学习三个组件均对最终效果有显著贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了搜索专精化与通用能力并非零和关系，通过联合优化搜索强化学习与多领域在线策略蒸馏，可以有效缓解对齐税，在保持强大搜索性能的同时提升通用智能，为构建兼具专业搜索能力与广泛通用性的智能体提供了一条实用路径。

title: From Chains to Trees: Parent-Conditioned Drafting for Semi-Autoregressive Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference only when drafted continuations survive target-model verification. Semi-autoregressive drafters such as DSpark predict an entire token block with one backbone forward and refine it with a lightweight Markov head. However, DSpark decodes this block as a single chain, so an early mismatch invalidates the remaining suffix and limits the benefit of large draft blocks. We show that the conditional structure already learned by DSpark can support multiple parent-consistent continuations without retraining or additional backbone passes. We introduce Parent-Conditioned Drafting Tree (PCTree), which uses the pretrained Markov head to score alternative children separately for each concrete parent and allocates a fixed verification budget to the most probable paths. This converts DSpark's linear draft into a tree while preserving its one-pass parallel backbone. Across Qwen3-{4B,8B,14B} and nine benchmarks, at $B{=}7$, measured speedup gains over autoregressive (AR) decoding, relative to matched DSpark, range from $3.1\%$ to $29.5\%$. On Qwen3-4B GSM8K at $B{=}16$, PCTree increases mean acceptance length from $9.41$ to $11.16$ and three-run mean AR speedup from $6.14{\times}$ to $6.60{\times}$. These show that parent-conditioned branching can turn conditional capacity already present in a semi-autoregressive drafter into end-to-end inference gains through an inference-only change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PCTree（Parent-Conditioned Drafting Tree），一种无需额外训练即可将 DSpark 半自回归草稿器从单链解码改造为树形解码的推理策略。该方法通过复用 DSpark 已学习的 Markov 头对共享骨干网络 logits 进行父节点条件化打分，在不增加骨干网络前向次数的前提下，将单链草稿转换为固定预算的树形草稿，从而提高推测解码的接受长度与端到端加速比。
AI.motivation: 推测解码的收益取决于草稿在目标模型验证中的存活率。DSpark 通过"一次并行骨干网络 + 轻量 Markov 头"预测整块 token，但仍以单链方式解码，导致早期 token 不匹配时整条后缀被拒绝，限制了大块草稿的收益。现有树形验证方法（如 EAGLE-2）依赖自回归草稿器，需要多次顺序前向；而基于并行块扩散的 DDTree 使用与父节点无关的逐位置分布，可能将单点高概率 token 拼接成局部不连贯的路径。因此需要一个能利用 DSpark 已学习的条件结构进行父节点特定打分、且不增加训练的树形扩展机制。
AI.method: PCTree 在每个深度 d 上，将当前前沿父节点批量送入 DSpark 预训练的 Markov 头，对共享的骨干网络 logits L_d 加上父节点特定的 Markov 偏差，得到每个父节点独立的条件分布 π_d(·|p)。每个父节点取局部 top-k 子节点加入候选池，按联合路径对数分数 s(c) = Σ log π(v|u) 进行评分。在层间进行 top-k 剪枝以控制前沿宽度，最后对全局候选按联合分数排序、保留 top-N 个节点（含根），构成前缀闭合树，通过祖先注意力掩码在一次目标模型前向中完成验证。当 k=1 时，PCTree 退化为 DSpark 链式解码。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-{4B,8B,14B} 三个目标模型、九个基准（GSM8K、MATH-500、AIME25、MBPP、HumanEval、LCB、MT-Bench、Alpaca、Arena-Hard）上，B=7 时相对 DSpark 的 AR 加速比提升 3.1%–29.5%，平均接受长度在所有模型-任务对上均提升。在 Qwen3-4B GSM8K、B=16 条件下，平均接受长度从 9.41 增至 11.16（+18.6%），三次运行平均 AR 加速比从 6.14× 提升至 6.60×。机制隔离实验表明，父节点条件化重打分（对比共享 Markov 分布）将平均接受长度从 10.225 提升至 11.156（+9.1%），验证轮数从 24.718 降至 22.632（-8.4%），证实收益主要来自父节点特定条件化而非仅分支结构。消融实验显示 k=4 时性能基本饱和，N=32 是 B=7 与 B=16 的良好共同工作点；代价分解表明分支增加的 Markov+树开销被更长接受路径带来的轮数减少所抵消。
AI.conclusion: PCTree 证明了一个能将草稿分解为"并行块 + 廉价顺序细化"结构的草稿器，可通过纯推理策略改造支持树形验证，无需重训练或额外骨干网络前向。其核心收益来自于将 DSpark 已学习的 Markov 条件信号转化为父节点特定的分支决策，避免了逐位置高分 token 的不连贯拼接。当早期拒绝使长线性块效率低下时，该方法带来的接受长度增长能够转化为端到端加速比提升。局限性在于树质量受限于预训练分布本身，且在 k 或 N 过大时小目标模型或显存受限设备可能面临开销压力。

title: The Role of Disfluencies in Speech Translation
summary: Current speech translation systems, including SpeechLLMs, are trained on cleaned text and tend to strip disfluencies like filled pauses and false starts rather than translate them. We show this comes at a cost: disfluencies carry meaning that gets lost when speech is cleaned up. To study this systematically, we introduce Uh-Mazing, a benchmark of human-translated, disfluency-annotated Switchboard speech covering English into eight target languages. Across these languages and several architectures, we find that false starts and self-repairs, not filled pauses or discourse markers, drive most of the translation-quality loss, and that models which fail to preserve a disfluency tend to omit it rather than mistranslate it. We show inference-time decoding can mitigate this without retraining, and release the benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了当前语音翻译系统（含SpeechLLMs）倾向于剥离不流畅现象（如填充停顿、重复和自我修正）的问题，指出这会丢失重要的语义和情感信息。作者构建了Uh-Mazing基准（基于Switchboard语料，涵盖8种目标语言的人工翻译和不流畅标注），系统评估发现：自我修正和错误起头（而非填充停顿或话语标记）才是导致翻译质量下降的主要因素；模型失败时通常直接删除而非误译；推理时采用波束搜索和上下文学习可部分缓解该问题而无需重训。
AI.motivation: 口语中普遍存在不流畅现象（填充停顿、重复、错误起头、自我修正），这些现象承载情感、人际关系和话语结构信息。然而现有语音翻译系统（端到端模型、级联系统、LLM）多将不流畅视为噪声而剥离，导致翻译丢失说话者的犹豫、修正等语用信号。在辅助可穿戴设备、多语言会议、字幕配音等场景中，这种剥离会造成负面情绪被放大或说话意图被误解的问题。已有基准大多聚焦流利语音，无法评估不流畅条件下的真实表现。
AI.method: 1) 人类案例研究：选取80句Switchboard语句（17–212词），在音频/不流畅文本/流畅文本三种条件下由18名标注者评估情绪，使用NRC EmoLex和OpenAI嵌入两种独立管线和留一法稳健性检验；2) 构建Uh-Mazing基准：80句Switchboard语料翻译为8种目标语言（ZH/ES/HI/FR/DE/IT/CS/AR），采用Prolific双轮标注协议（首轮翻译+次轮校验），并验证标注一致性（cosine=0.878）；3) 评估四类模型架构（级联Canary/Whisper+Tower/Llama、端到端OWSM/Canary、SpeechLLM Phi-4/Qwen2.5-Omni、商用ChatGPT/Gemini），使用chrF、COMET-Kiwi、LLM-as-a-judge和人类评估（Style/Meaning Preservation两维评分+错误类型标注）三种评估方法；4) 通过在流畅文本中重新插入不同类型不流畅标注来隔离各类影响；5) 推理时干预：波束搜索、温度采样、in-context learning。
AI.result: 1) 人类研究：去掉不流畅使感知负面情绪增强，最极端情况下负面情绪标签占比从23%升至94%；2) 模型评估：级联Tower+人工转写最佳（开源），ChatGPT+ASR转写在商用系统中最佳；cascaded系统远优于音频输入方案；所有系统在Style Preservation上明显差于Meaning Preservation，差距在端到端Canary上最大；3) 错误类型：删除（deletion）是最大类别（1098个跨度），远超不流畅误译（446个），表明模型倾向于省略而非误译；4) 不流畅类型隔离：仅EDITED型（false start/self-repair）导致COMET下降约3-4点，INTJ/PRN无明显影响；5) 推理时干预：波束搜索稳定提升质量，上下文学习在不牺牲Meaning的前提下提升chrF达5点（即改善不流畅保留），两种方法互补。
AI.conclusion: 不流畅是口语中承载情感和语用信号的结构化特征，当前语音翻译系统普遍无法保留它们，主要失败模式是删除（而非误译）且集中在false start和self-repair。波束搜索和in-context learning作为轻量级推理时干预可缩小风格差距，但不能完全消除；根本解决需要在训练阶段将不流畅保留作为独立目标。Uh-Mazing基准的发布为系统评估和改进提供了多语言、可比对的测试平台，未来需要跨语言、跨文化研究探讨保留的不流畅在目标语言听者中是否仍传递相同语用和情感意义。

title: An Evidence-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Transformer Framework for Health Misinformation Verification
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, To appear in the Reimagining knowledge systems for digital transformation and sustainable development in the 21st century conference 2026, faculty of social sciences education. Federal University of Education, Zaria
summary: The rapid spread of false and misleading health information through digital platforms has become a major public health challenge, particularly during infectious disease outbreaks where delayed verification can influence public behaviour and hinder effective disease control. Although recent advances in automated health misinformation detection have shown encouraging results, most existing approaches rely heavily on global biomedical resources and often fail to capture the local context needed to verify claims in developing countries. This study presents a retrieval-augmented transformer framework designed to verify health-related claims using trusted evidence from the World Health Organization and the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention. The framework combines semantic evidence retrieval with transformer-based classification to determine whether a claim is true, false, or misleading. To evaluate the proposed approach, a manually annotated dataset of 67 verified health claims covering coronavirus disease, Lassa fever, cholera, measles, and monkeypox was compiled from Nigerian fact-checking sources. Three transformer models and a retrieval-augmented configuration were evaluated. The Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers model achieved the best performance, with an accuracy of 71% and a weighted F1-score of 0.66. Although retrieval augmentation did not improve classification performance because the current evidence repository was limited in size and coverage, the findings highlight the importance of comprehensive and authoritative knowledge sources for reliable health misinformation verification. The proposed framework provides a practical foundation for developing context-aware and evidence-driven health misinformation verification systems for Nigeria and other resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于证据检索增强的Transformer框架（Retrieval-Augmented Transformer, RAT），用于验证尼日利亚背景下的健康虚假信息。该框架结合了语义证据检索（来自WHO和NCDC知识库）与Transformer分类器（BERT/RoBERTa/DeBERTa-v3），将健康声明分类为"真"、"假"或"误导"三类。
AI.motivation: 在传染病疫情期间，虚假健康信息传播迅速，但现有自动化验证方法主要依赖全球生物医学资源（如PubMed），缺乏对发展中国家本地情境（如尼日利亚NCDC疫情报告）的结合能力。此外，现有系统未同时整合全球权威机构（WHO）与国家疾病控制机构（NCDC）的证据，难以验证既需要一般疾病知识又需要本地疫情数据的健康声明。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究（DSR）与实验设计相结合的方法。具体包括：(1) 从WHO事实清单和NCDC疫情报告构建涵盖拉沙热、霍乱、麻疹、猴痘和COVID-19的结构化知识库；(2) 从尼日利亚事实核查平台（Dubawa、Africa Check等）收集并人工标注67条健康声明；(3) 使用sentence-transformer (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) 进行语义检索，Top-k=3；(4) 对BERT-base、RoBERTa-base、DeBERTa-v3-base进行微调（42样本训练，14样本测试），并加入了类加权、文本增强和RAG配置变体。
AI.result: BERT-base表现最佳，测试集准确率为0.71，加权F1为0.66；RoBERTa-base为0.50/0.33；DeBERTa-v3-base为0.43/0.30。类加权+文本增强以及RAG增强的DeBERTa-v3均出现单类预测偏差（多数类坍缩），准确率降至0.36，F1为0.19。RAG未带来性能提升，原因在于证据语料库规模过小（仅5条通用疾病摘要作为后备），检索到的段落与提交声明关联性不足。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了结合语义检索与Transformer分类在尼日利亚健康虚假信息验证中的可行性，但数据稀缺（n=42训练集）、类别严重不平衡和证据语料库不足严重制约了框架性能。BERT-base优于更新的DeBERTa-v3，表明在小样本场景下模型的正则化能力比架构新颖性更重要。未来工作应：(1) 替换为结构化WHO/NCDC文档级知识库；(2) 采用证据-声明对训练评估；(3) 扩展并平衡数据集，采用macro-F1和每类召回率作为主要评价指标。

title: Global Optimization and Inference-Time Region Grafting for Agentic Workflows
summary: Recent advances in agentic workflow optimization automate workflow design through task-specific workflow search or input-conditioned architecture selection. However, they determine the workflow before execution and cannot adapt failed workflow regions using execution-time label-free quality signals. Naively enabling such inference-time adaptation through whole-workflow re-optimization would be computationally prohibitive. To tackle this challenge, we introduce GRAFT, which preserves a globally optimized workflow while locally replacing only selected regions for each input. Without parameter training, GRAFT evaluates region-level alternatives using label-free execution-quality signals and accepts only replacements that improve local quality while preserving workflow-level consistency, thereby enabling instance-wise adaptation without whole-workflow re-optimization. GRAFT applies without modification across a range of tasks spanning mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-hop and knowledge-intensive question answering. Under matched optimizer and executor settings, it improves over the strongest prior workflow-optimization method, MaAS, by 3.85 points on average. Replacing only the executor with a stronger model yields further gains without re-optimizing the global workflow. This suggests that an optimized workflow is not merely a static optimization artifact, but an adaptable execution policy that can evolve with inference-time feedback and stronger executors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GRAFT——一种无需训练的训练框架，将全局优化的智能体工作流在推理时按区域（region）粒度进行局部替换与适配，实现无需重新优化整体工作流的逐实例自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体工作流优化方法（如 AFlow、MaAS）均在执行前确定工作流结构，无法利用推理时的无标签质量信号对失败区域进行局部适配；而直接对每个输入重新优化整个工作流计算代价过高。因此需要一种机制，在保留全局已验证工作流结构稳定性的同时，针对单个输入的低质量区域进行高效局部调整。
AI.method: GRAFT 将工作流分解为单入单出（SESE）区域序列，在全局任务级搜索得到的 $W_{c^*}$ 基础上，针对每个输入进行推理时局部 graft：1）提出器（Proposer）基于 UCB 优先级选择需优化的区域；2）利用无标签代理信号（自一致性、证据覆盖度、代码通过率）评估候选配置；3）耦合守门（coupling guard）仅接受同时提升局部质量且不破坏边界一致性的替换；4）通过签名-配置记忆库（memory）按输入类型复用获胜配置，摊销搜索成本。整体复杂度为 $O(PKM)$，远低于全工作流重优化。
AI.result: 在 MaAS 评测协议下（gpt-4o-mini 作为执行器），GRAFT 在 5 个基准上平均得分 87.44，较 MaAS 提升 3.85 分；在 BayesFlow 协议下（Claude Sonnet 执行器），6 个基准平均 84.1 分，全面超越现有方法。组件消融表明局部 graft 贡献最大（-4.10），无标签代理信号次之（-3.48），耦合守门亦有必要（-0.70）。记忆复用率在数学任务上达 0.86–0.92，搜索成本随输入处理顺序下降约 50%。仅将执行器替换为更强模型即可获得显著增益，无需重新优化全局工作流。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT 验证了经优化的智能体工作流并非静态产物，而是可随推理时反馈和更强执行器自适应演化的执行策略，为训练自由的推理时工作流适配提供了新范式。

title: ScrambleToolBench: Agents Search Exhaustively Even When Their Own Map Points to the Next Step
summary: To operate robustly in open-world environments, autonomous agents should be able to infer the behavior of unfamiliar systems through interaction alone, even in the absence of documentation. However, existing tool-use benchmarks expose semantic tool schemas in static environments, allowing agents to rely on prior knowledge rather than autonomous discovery. To address this limitation, we introduce ScrambleToolBench, an interactive terminal benchmark designed to isolate behavioral reasoning. By removing semantic cues and enforcing a continuous task curriculum, the benchmark requires agents to uncover hidden tool behaviors entirely through trial-and-error interaction. The benchmark further introduces dynamic challenges, including mapping drift, stochastic action failures, and temporal execution windows, to evaluate whether agents can revise and adapt their hypotheses as the environment changes. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art language models reveals that successful initial discovery does not translate into robust adaptation. When faced with structural changes such as mapping drift, agents fail to use deductive strategies such as cycle tracing, and instead exhibit belief inertia or fall back to exhaustive search. Increasing test-time reasoning only amplifies this expensive brute-force search rather than enabling deductive recovery. While equipping agents with persistent memory reduces compounding errors, they remain unable to efficiently infer structural changes, highlighting a gap in current agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScrambleToolBench，一个交互式终端基准测试，用于隔离智能体的行为推理能力。通过语义混淆工具标识符、引入映射漂移、随机动作失败和时间执行窗口等动态挑战，揭示当前大语言模型在非稳定环境中对语义先验的过度依赖，发现即使成功完成初始工具发现，模型在面对结构变化时仍表现出信念惯性，回退到穷举搜索而非演绎恢复策略（如循环追踪），且增加测试时推理仅放大蛮力搜索成本。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用基准测试普遍暴露工具的语义化模式（如read_file），使得智能体可以依赖预训练记忆中的语义先验而非通过交互自主推断工具行为。此外，这些基准假设环境一旦被理解即保持结构稳定，无法评估智能体在映射漂移、随机失败、时间窗口等动态变化下修订内部心智模型的能力。本文旨在填补该评估空白，测试智能体在缺乏文档且环境持续变化的开放世界中的真实推理与适应能力。
AI.method: 1. **语义混淆机制**：通过双射映射Φ将所有目标命令的函数标识符（如fn_x9）、参数键（如arg_0）、输出字段和执行状态随机化，保留submit_solution等元命令为明文锚点。2. **连续任务课程**：每个评估回合包含N=5个顺序任务，共享累积动作预算B，测试工具知识的复用能力。3. **三类环境动态**：① 映射漂移（ρ_drift=0.25，任务间循环置换25%的工具标识符）；② 随机动作失败（p_fail=0.15，返回超时错误）；③ 时间执行窗口（k=10步限制）。4. **评估指标**：回合完成率P_ep和平均完成任务数T_avg。5. **记忆增强基线**：通过外部持久记忆（任务食谱+工具知识JSON数据库）减少冗余重发现。6. **循环追踪策略分析**：理论推导仅需(k-1)=6次额外调用即可从漂移中恢复，但智能体未自主发现该策略。
AI.result: 评估15个前沿模型（包括Qwen 3.6、Gemma 4、GPT-OSS、GPT-5.4、Gemini 2.5/3.1/3.5、Claude Sonnet 4.5/5）发现：1. **语义依赖严重**：非混淆环境下平均P_ep=0.93/T_avg=4.88；基础混淆环境下降至P_ep=0.32/T_avg=2.31。2. **动态压力下崩溃**：三种动态叠加时平均P_ep降至0.03/T_avg=0.84。3. **信念惯性显著**：Claude Sonnet 5在+All条件下陈旧工具调用达5.32次/任务；Qwen 3.6 27B达3.37次。4. **推理努力无效**：增加推理仅减少失败搜索次数（如Claude Sonnet 5在漂移下低/中/高推理分别为8.94×/7.38×/7.52×参考成本），但链路跟随率仅约14%，与随机选择无显著差异（p≈0.9）。5. **记忆部分有效**：持久记忆平均恢复+0.09 P_ep/+0.59 T_avg，但无法教会循环追踪推理。6. **失败模式分化**：敏感模型（GPT-5.4等）100%早期退出；持久模型（Gemini 3.5 Flash等）100%预算耗尽。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了当前LLM智能体在非稳定环境中存在关键推理缺陷：成功初始发现无法转化为鲁棒适应能力。面对映射漂移时，智能体未能识别循环置换结构以采用高效的循环追踪恢复策略，转而表现为信念惯性或退化为昂贵的穷举搜索。增加测试时推理计算虽提升了任务完成率，但本质上只是增强了蛮力探索而非激发演绎推理，token成本反而更高。持久记忆机制虽能缓解复合错误，但依赖于规则性的记忆剪枝以避免陈旧信念残留。该工作强调在开放世界部署智能体时，必须超越对语义先验和测试时扩展的依赖，发展真正的结构化自适应推理能力。

title: Fast and Accurate Quotation Attribution in Literary Texts
summary: Attributing quotations to their speakers in literary texts remains an open challenge. Standard methods, which independently predict a speaker mention for each quotation, are efficient but still limited in accuracy. In contrast, large language model (LLM) approaches achieve strong performance, but their computational cost limits their use in large-scale literary analysis. We propose an encoder-based efficient formulation that resolves multiple quotation attributions within a shared, large context window. Using our new formulation, \textit{joint scoring}, we report state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the Project Dialogism Novel Corpus (PDNC), comprising more than 35,000 manually annotated quotations from 22 English novels. Our best model reaches 94.5\% overall attribution accuracy while processing novels $20\times$ faster than comparable standard methods and more than $1000\times$ faster than LLM-based approaches on an A100 GPU. An analysis of models' representations suggests that joint scoring improves on challenging attribution examples by preserving long-range anaphora resolution signal, an information that we found already present in pretrained encoders. To facilitate adoption, we release ModernBookNLP, a modified fork of BookNLP that replaces its quotation attribution model with our best system available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于编码器的"联合评分"（joint scoring）形式化方法，用于文学文本中的引语归属任务。该方法在共享的大上下文窗口中联合解析多个引语归属决策，在PDNC语料库上达到了94.5%的SOTA准确率，推理速度比标准直接评分方法快20倍，比基于LLM的方法快1000倍以上。
AI.motivation: 引语归属（quotation attribution）是文学文本分析中的关键任务，但现有方法存在效率和准确率的权衡问题：标准方法（直接评分）效率高但准确率有限；基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法准确率高但计算成本巨大，限制了在大规模文学语料中的应用。本文旨在弥合这一差距，提供一种既快速又准确的引语归属模型。
AI.method: 1. 提出"联合评分"形式化方法：将文档分割为长度为T的上下文段，在共享的上下文嵌入上同时为多个引语和候选提及构建表征，联合优化多个归属决策（借鉴了指代消解中的span-based联合评分范式）。2. 编码器：使用ModernBERT-large作为文本编码器。3. 候选提及类型：采用基于指代消解簇的提及（包含代词、名词和命名提及），并与仅使用命名提及（别名）的方法对比。4. 系统性评估了不同上下文长度（T=500/1000/2000）、编码器（ModernBERT-large vs Longformer-base）和评分方式（直接vs联合）的影响。5. 通过表征相似性分析（Q-Q、Q-M、Mention-Mention对）解释联合评分的优势来源。6. 发布ModernBookNLP工具，作为BookNLP的改进分叉。
AI.result: 1. 准确率：在PDNC语料库5折交叉验证上，联合评分（T=2000）达到94.5%的总体准确率和92.4%的非显式引语准确率，超过此前基于Llama-3-8b的SOTA方法约5个百分点。2. 效率：处理小说比直接评分快4-20倍，比Llama-3-8b快1000倍以上（A100 GPU）。3. 关键发现：(a) 基于指代消解的系统系统性地优于仅使用别名的系统，尤其在非显式引语上提升12分；(b) 更大上下文窗口带来持续改进；(c) 在Longformer-base上也观察到类似的联合评分优势。4. 表征分析：联合评分的优势源于更好地保留了ModernBERT预训练时已存在的长距离指代消解信号，尤其是在隐式和指代型引语上，联合评分在远距离时仍能保持引语-提及对的可分性。5. LitBank外部验证：联合评分的ModernBookNLP相比标准BookNLP提升约10个CoNLL F1分，且推理时间相当。Q-M可分性与归属准确率强相关（Spearman ρ=0.85）。
AI.conclusion: 联合评分形式化方法成功地同时解决了引语归属任务中效率和准确率的权衡问题，以比LLM方法快1000倍以上的速度实现了SOTA性能。其优势主要来自于更好地保留了预训练编码器中的长距离指代消解结构，使模型在处理复杂的非显式引语（特别是指代型和隐式引语）时表现优异。ModernBookNLP的发布为大规模文学分析提供了一条既快速又准确的实用路径。未来工作包括评估外部模块（引语检测、实体检测、指代消解）对下游归属的影响，以及设计在上下文中缺少说话者提及时的回退策略。

title: PredAct-Bench: Benchmarking Tool-Augmented Dialogue under Controlled Tool Noise
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in task-oriented dialogue systems that support multi-step decision-making in high-stakes domains such as education, healthcare, and finance. However, existing benchmarks typically assume perfectly accurate tool outputs, overlooking the reality that deployed systems must operate with noisy tools and human decision-makers whose trust in the agent is itself uncertain. Such conditions are common in practice, for example, a clinician using a diagnostic prediction tool or an advisor relying on a model that forecasts student outcomes from historical records. We introduce PREDACTBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating dialogue agents paired with statistically imperfect tools, using education as a measurable testbed where ground truth outcomes and clear intervention decisions are available. First, we build a benchmark for AI-assisted human decision-making, where the AI uses noisy predictors to help guide a user. Second, we introduce episode-level Relative AI-Reliance (RAIR) and Relative self-reliance (RSR) metrics, extending prior trust calibration framework to multi-turn dialogue. Third, we evaluate 13 state-of-the-art closed and open source LLMs on two educational datasets, OULAD (real assessment trajectories from the UK Open University) and PREDACT-CS (60 courses with real final grade outcomes and synthetically generated weekly score trajectories), alongside a human study with instructors and teaching assistants. We find that when tools are noisy, SOTA models are supposed to provide visibility to teachers so that they do not over-rely on wrong suggestions or hallucinations, but current models fail to do that. We offer PREDACTBENCH to help build better LLMs as AI decision support systems to help teachers.

AI.tldr: PREDACTBENCH是一个用于评估对话智能体的基准测试，特别针对AI辅助的人类决策场景，其中AI依赖的预测工具具有统计意义上的不完美性（即噪声工具）。该研究以教育领域为测试床，提出了episode级别的Relative AI-Reliance（RAIR）和Relative Self-Reliance（RSR）指标，并在OULAD和PREDACT-CS两个数据集上评估了13个最先进的LLM，同时进行了人类教师与助教的研究。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM对话系统基准测试通常假设工具输出完全准确，忽视了实际部署中工具存在噪声以及人类决策者对AI的信任本身不确定的现实。在教育、医疗、金融等高风险领域，这种假设是不成立的。例如临床医生使用诊断预测工具，或顾问依赖预测学生成绩的模型，都需要面对工具不完美的问题。现有LLM在工具噪声下无法充分告知人类决策者，导致过度依赖错误建议或幻觉结果。
AI.method: 1. 构建AI辅助人类决策基准测试，以教育为可测量测试床，其中包含真实结果和明确的干预决策。2. 提出两个新指标：episode级别的Relative AI-Reliance（RAIR）和Relative Self-Reliance（RSR），将先前的信任校准框架扩展到多轮对话场景。3. 在OULAD（英国开放大学的真实评估轨迹）和PREDACT-CS（60门课程的真实最终成绩结果和合成生成的每周分数轨迹）两个数据集上评估13个SOTA闭源和开源LLM。4. 开展包含讲师和助教的人类研究。
AI.result: 研究发现：当工具存在噪声时，当前最先进的模型应当帮助教师了解工具局限性，避免过度依赖错误建议或幻觉，但实际上现有模型未能做到这一点。换言之，在噪声工具条件下，SOTA LLM无法为人类决策者提供充分的可见性，导致信任校准失败。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供PREDACTBENCH作为开放基准，以推动构建更好的LLM作为AI决策支持系统，帮助教师等人类决策者在工具不完美的现实条件下做出更好的干预决策。核心结论是当前LLM在噪声工具环境下的信任校准能力不足，需要通过该基准进一步改进。

title: Training-Free versus Training-Based Intent Classification in LLMs: Accuracy, Robustness, and Failure Modes
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
summary: Intent classification in Large Language Models (LLMs) involves categorizing user prompts into predefined classes. For instance, given a user prompt, the system must determine whether it primarily concerns mathematics, coding, or general text processing. Such classification enables routing prompts to specialized models optimized for specific domains, improving both accuracy and computational efficiency. In this work, we conduct a systematic study comparing training-free vs training-based approaches for intent classification. For this purpose, we consider two lightweight, training-free methods based on statistics of internal representations and compare them against MLP classifiers and linear probes. Our comprehensive empirical evaluation reveals that 1) Both training-free and training-based methods saturate easy benchmarks (mathematics vs. coding vs. natural language), 2) Training-based classifiers have an advantage on harder classification tasks (e.g. Java vs Python), and 3) Training-free methods are generally more robust to mixed-intent and adversarial prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了LLM意图分类中无需训练（NormStat、VecStat）和基于训练（MLP分类器、线性探针）两类轻量级方法，在7个LLM（1B–32B）和4个分类任务上进行全面实证评估，揭示了不同方法在精度、鲁棒性和失败模式上的互补权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM系统越来越多采用路由架构（intent classifier将提示分发给专用模型），但选择何种分类器存在困难权衡：直接LLM调用难以校准不确定性，监督分类器又需要大量训练数据和资源且类别扩展代价高。因此需要研究轻量级、可扩展的意图分类方案。
AI.method: 提出两种基于prefill阶段内部表征统计的无需训练方法：(1) NormStat——仅利用token级归一化范数的均值和方差（径向信息，存储O(m)标量）；(2) VecStat——利用逐坐标的均值和二阶矩（方向信息，存储O(md)数值）。两者均通过高斯矩匹配计算KL散度打分。理论分析在简化高斯设定下证明：径向可分时NormStat为Bayes最优；方向可分时VecStat误差指数衰减。还通过Laurent-Massart和Hanson-Wright不等式证明NormStat校准误差与维度无关（O(√(log(1/δ)/N))），而VecStat为O(√((d+log(1/δ))/N))。训练基线采用Avg-MLP、Avg-Linear和Tail-MLP。
AI.result: 实证发现：(1) 在粗粒度任务（数学vs代码vs一般文本、自然语言识别）上两类方法均接近饱和；(2) 细粒度任务（如数学子领域分类、编程语言识别）上训练方法占优，MLP准确率更高（如代数73.94% vs NormStat 21.01%）；(3) 混合意图提示下VecStat提供最准确的不确定性估计（Qwen3-1.7B上RMSE 0.0858 vs Tail-MLP 0.2688）；(4) 对抗性重写提示下训练方法急剧退化（Qwen3-32B上Avg-MLP Easy 11.73%），而无训练方法保持非平凡准确率（NormStat Easy 92.33%），因为训练边界易被注入的误导词面词偏移；(5) 推理仅需前12层即可获得竞争性结果，可提前终止前向传播。
AI.conclusion: 无训练与基于训练方法在意图分类上不存在"一刀切"的解决方案：训练方法在细粒度分类更准确，但无训练方法（尤其VecStat）在类别动态扩展、噪声输入、混合意图和对抗场景下更鲁棒、更具可解释性。建议在高吞吐量多租户系统或安全关键部署中优先选择无训练方法，并将方法选择视为受目标模型族与规模影响的部署决策。

title: CTRAG: An In-Context Retrieval-based Framework for Automated Compliance Checking using LLMs
summary: Trust is fundamental in modern regulatory ecosystems, and compliance checking plays a critical role in fostering that trust. Regulatory compliance verification is essential for businesses operating in highly controlled environments, as it ensures alignment with sector-specific guidelines across domains such as financial reporting, data privacy, and cybersecurity. Manual compliance testing, however, is often time-intensive and prone to inconsistencies, particularly when compliance depends indirectly on third-party services such as cloud providers, where vendors rely on external providers to meet regulatory standards. In this paper, we present CTRAG, a novel Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline designed for automated compliance checking. CTRAG employs advanced strategies, including adaptive chunking, dynamic retrieval configurations, and in-context learning, to improve the precision and relevance of compliance assessments. By extracting control questions from regulatory texts and cross-referencing them with unstructured company documentation, CTRAG achieves highly accurate, document-informed compliance verification, even in cases of indirect compliance through third-party services. Empirical evaluations demonstrate significant improvements, with CTRAG achieving an F1-score of 78% and a recall of 85% in the final deployed configuration, ensuring minimal missed non-compliance cases while reducing manual reviewer effort in a real-world deployment. To validate CTRAG value, we developed and deployed a POC within a Big Four professional services firm, applying it to real-world cases and cross-checking results against manual compliance reports. These findings highlight CTRAG potential to streamline compliance workflows, mitigate risks, and enhance regulatory trust in complex, high-stakes environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CTRAG（Compliance Testing RAG），一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的自动化合规检查框架，通过自适应分块、动态检索配置和上下文学习（ICL）策略，从非结构化企业文档中提取证据，验证监管控制项的合规性，并在四大会计师事务所的真实部署中实现F1=78%、召回率85%的性能，将人工审核工作量减少约60%。
AI.motivation: 传统合规审计依赖人工审阅大量企业文档，存在耗时长、标准不一致等问题，尤其在涉及云服务等第三方间接合规场景下更为突出。现有规则驱动和本体驱动的自动化合规方法难以处理法规语言的固有歧义性和非结构化文档的复杂性，而LLM虽具备语言理解能力但存在幻觉和证据溯源不足的缺陷，因此亟需一种能基于文档证据进行可追溯合规推理的框架。
AI.method: CTRAG将每个监管控制项转化为问答查询，构建多阶段RAG管道：(1)采用递归字符分割器（200/800/1600/3000字符）和Meta-chunking进行文档分块，使用OpenAI text-embedding-3-large/ada-002生成嵌入并存储于FAISS；(2)动态调整top-K检索值（K=1/3/5），使用stuff和map_reduce链进行响应生成；(3)引入上下文学习（ICL），通过精心设计的示例引导LLM处理间接合规等复杂判断；(4)在最终部署中将"No-Evidence"类重新归类为"Non-Compliant"以提高召回率。实验对比了GPT-4、GPT-3.5 Turbo、GPT-4o、Gemini Flash和Gemini Pro五种LLM。
AI.result: 在包含45份PDF文档和240个控制项的专有数据集上：(1)固定200字符分块在所有模型上表现最差（F1约20-30%）；(2)直接提示下，GPT-4在Fixed 1600+ICL下取得最佳加权F1为78.05%（P=71.91%, R=85.33%）；(3)GPT-4o次之（69.88%），Gemini Flash和Gemini Pro分别为64.60%和68.00%；(4)加入ICL后，所有模型在非合规和无证据类的识别上显著改善，特别是间接通过第三方合规的场景；(5)Meta-chunking因预处理时间过长（1674秒）被排除；(6)在四大事务所POC部署中实现约60%的人工审核工作量减少。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现小块（Fixed 800）+ K=4 + ICL的组合在合规检查中表现最稳定，"大海捞针"效应和噪声增加导致大块分块性能下降。检索质量和证据粒度比单纯增加上下文大小更重要，上下文学习对处理间接合规等模型易错场景至关重要。局限性包括：仅基于单一组织240个控制项和45份文档的评估、数据集专有不可公开、标注者间一致性未测量、No-Evidence重分类以精度换召回。未来工作将扩展跨领域测试、引入统计显著性检验、探索语义分块和非RAG基线。

title: MedPRESS: A Multi-turn Benchmark for Patient-Pressure-Induced Medical Sycophancy in LLMs
comment: 27 pages, 10 figures. Both authors contributed equally
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for health-related advice. Existing research measures their safety with static questions rather than pressured patient-facing conversations. We introduce MedPRESS, a multi-turn benchmark for measuring patient-pressure-induced sycophancy in LLMs. MedPRESS contains 600 medically grounded five-turn dialogues across three scenario families: medication and treatment demand, personal health self-care, and symptom triage and care resistance. Each dialogue begins with a health query and escalates through personal experience, social proof, external evidence claims, and direct adversarial challenge. We evaluate 20 LLMs across general, medical-domain, lightweight, large, open-weight, and proprietary families using structured judging and safety-focused metrics. Results show that models frequently shift toward unsafe agreement under repeated patient pressure, with substantial variation across model families, model scale, and prompt type. Anti-sycophancy prompting improves robustness for several models, but does not eliminate unsafe agreement. MedPRESS highlights a critical gap in medical LLM evaluation: safe medical knowledge is not enough unless models can maintain it under conversational pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MedPRESS基准，用于评估大语言模型在多轮患者压力对话中是否能坚持安全的医学立场。基准包含600个医学对话场景，覆盖三类情境，并在20个LLM上测试。结果表明大多数模型在初始查询时能给出安全建议，但在持续患者压力下会逐渐转向不安全的认同，凸显了静态医学问答评估的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有医学LLM评估主要基于静态问答或合作型用户场景，未能反映真实医患对话中用户反复施压的情况。这种评估盲区导致模型虽然具备安全的医学知识，却可能在多轮压力对话中退让，危及患者安全。
AI.method: 构建600个五轮医学对话基准，涵盖三类场景（用药治疗需求、个人健康自我护理、症状分诊与照护抗拒），每轮逐步升级压力（个人经验、社会认同、外部证据、直接对抗）。在20个LLM配置（含通用、医疗领域、轻量、大型、开源、闭源）上测试，使用4种提示条件，结合Qwen3-32B评判器和人工验证（Fleiss κ=0.837），提出UAR、SAR、ToF、NoF等指标。
AI.result: 在主评估中86.8%的对话至少出现一次不安全认同，整体UAR达50.5%。模型在T1时UAR仅5.9%，但在个人经验压力后飙升至58.5%，最终直接对抗轮达75.7%。症状分诊类场景最脆弱（UAR 55.5%），明显反提示可使UAR降低约14个百分点但无法消除问题。推理增强对GPT-OSS-20B效果显著（ToF平均+1.80），但对Phi-4-Mini反而有害。GPT-5.4-Mini表现最佳（UAR 21.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 医学LLM评估应从静态问答转向多轮压力对话测试。模型规模、医疗领域微调和反逢迎提示均不能完全消除压力诱发的不安全认同，尤其在症状分诊与照护抗拒场景中失败率最高。安全的医学知识不足以保证对话中的安全立场维护。

title: Romanized Arabic Across Dialects: Views, Usage Patterns, and Linguistic Variation
summary: Arabizi refers to Arabic written in Latin script. Although previous studies have shown that the prevalence and usage of Arabizi vary by factors such as region and age group, most NLP research on Arabic texts treats it as a temporary phenomenon resulting from limited technological support for the Arabic script. In this work, we engage with Arabic speakers to collect insights on their perceptions and usage of Arabizi. We further examine writing norms among speakers of different dialects, focusing on Algerian, Egyptian, Lebanese, Moroccan, and Tunisian Arabic. To this end, we release two resources. First, a character-level alignment of Arabic words to study inter- and intra-dialectal variation across these five dialects, based on words transliterated by survey participants, finding systematic intra-dialectal regularity and inter-dialectal variation. Second, to study Arabic speakers' ability to identify this stylistic variation at the sentence-level, we build a manually curated parallel corpus of sentences written in Arabic script alongside multiple Arabizi transliterations, collected from speakers of the same five dialects. Our study presents the largest human-centered, cross-dialectal study of Arabizi's perceptions and practices to date.

AI.tldr: 本文针对阿拉伯语拉丁化书写形式（Arabizi）展开跨方言研究，通过大规模人类中心调查，发布了两项资源：1）字符级阿拉伯语词与Arabizi转写对齐数据；2）包含五种方言（阿尔及利亚、埃及、黎巴嫩、摩洛哥、突尼斯）的句级平行语料库，旨在揭示Arabizi的方言内规律性与方言间变异性。
AI.motivation: 现有NLP研究大多将Arabizi视为因阿拉伯文字技术支持有限而产生的临时现象，忽视了其作为社会语言学现象的本质；此外，针对不同地区和年龄群体使用Arabizi的差异缺乏系统性跨方言研究，对阿拉伯语使用者如何感知和实践Arabizi缺乏深入理解。
AI.method: 1）通过调查问卷与阿拉伯语使用者互动，收集其对Arabizi的感知与使用情况；2）聚焦阿尔及利亚、埃及、黎巴嫩、摩洛哥、突尼斯五种方言，邀请参与者对阿拉伯语单词进行转写，构建字符级对齐数据集以研究方言内与方言间变体；3）构建由人工策划的平行语料库，包含阿拉伯文字脚本句子及来自同一五种方言使用者的多种Arabizi转写版本，以考察说话者在句子层面识别风格变异的能力。
AI.result: 研究发现Arabizi在不同方言间存在系统性的方言内规律性（intra-dialectal regularity）和方言间变异性（inter-dialectal variation）；同时阿拉伯语使用者能够在句子层面识别这些风格变体；本研究是目前规模最大、以人为中心的跨方言Arabizi感知与实践研究。
AI.conclusion: 本研究挑战了将Arabizi视为临时现象的传统观点，证明其具有稳定的方言特征与用户感知基础；所发布的两个资源为后续阿拉伯语NLP研究、社会语言学研究及方言识别任务提供了重要支撑，填补了Arabizi跨方言系统研究的空白。

title: AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling
comment: 40 pages, 17tables, project page: this https URL
summary: Language remains an outlier in generative modeling: while images, video, and audio are increasingly modeled in continuous latent spaces, text generation still relies predominantly on discrete tokens. Existing continuous language models either inherit embedding spaces not designed for joint generation and decoding, or compress autoencoded latents to ease diffusion, sacrificing token-level fidelity. Instead of simplifying the representation to suit the generative model, we preserve a high-capacity, decodable text latent and design the diffusion model to learn its distribution directly. We introduce AURORA-LM, a continuous-latent diffusion language model that separates the construction of a decodable text representation from the modeling of its distribution. A Query-based Encoder-Decoder organizes text into a high-capacity, prefix-aligned latent sequence, and a Block-causal Diffusion Transformer learns its distribution through flow matching, generating blocks left to right while denoising positions within each block in parallel. Because such a latent is harder for diffusion to model, AURORA-LM restricts only the noisy-input pathway while retaining the full clean-latent prediction target, accommodating full-width latents without reducing decoder-facing capacity. We further calibrate the noise-level distribution to the latent width, and introduce self-trajectory consistency to bridge independently sampled training noise and iterative denoising at inference. AURORA-LM achieves the strongest performance among evaluated continuous and diffusion-based language models on OpenWebText free generation and XSum summarization. Scaling to 1B parameters with about 1500 EFLOPs of total compute yields further gains, surpassing a larger publicly released latent-diffusion language model under a matched evaluation protocol. All experiments are conducted on Ascend NPUs.

AI.tldr: AURORA-LM是一种连续潜在空间扩散语言模型，通过查询式编码器-解码器构建可解码的文本潜在表示，并使用块因果扩散Transformer（基于流匹配）建模其分布。该模型在OpenWebText自由生成和XSum摘要任务上取得了连续/扩散语言模型中的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 当前文本生成仍依赖离散tokens，而图像、视频、音频已在连续潜在空间中建模。现有连续语言模型要么继承了不适合联合生成和解码的嵌入空间，要么为了便于扩散而压缩自编码潜在，牺牲了token级保真度。本文动机在于：不应简化表示以适配生成模型，而应保留高容量、可解码的文本潜在，并设计扩散模型直接学习其分布。
AI.method:
1. 解耦表示构建与分布建模：使用Query-based Encoder-Decoder将文本组织为高容量、前缀对齐的潜在序列；
2. Block-causal Diffusion Transformer：通过流匹配（flow matching）从左到右生成块，块内位置并行去噪；
3. 关键技术：仅限制噪声输入路径，保留完整干净潜在预测目标；根据潜在宽度校准噪声水平分布；引入自轨迹一致性（self-trajectory consistency）以桥接训练时独立采样的噪声与推理时的迭代去噪。
AI.result: 在OpenWebText自由生成和XSum摘要任务上，AURORA-LM在所有评估的连续和扩散语言模型中取得最强性能。扩展到1B参数（约1500 EFLOPs总计算量）时进一步提升，在匹配评估协议下超越更大的公开潜在扩散语言模型。所有实验在Ascend NPU上完成。
AI.conclusion: AURORA-LM证明了通过解耦可解码文本潜在表示的构建与扩散建模，可以在连续潜在空间中实现高质量的语言生成，弥合了文本生成与多模态生成建模之间的差距，为扩散语言模型提供了新的高性能范式。

title: A Triple-Robustness Analysis of Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Requirements Traceability
summary: Reported verdicts on GraphRAG versus vector RAG disagree, and the evidence is typically tied to a single corpus, embedder, and judge -- and, we show, to where citation quality is measured. We present a triple-robustness analysis that holds a five-pipeline architecture matrix fixed and varies embedder (local e5-small vs. Azure text-embedding-3-small), corpus (DO-178C typed-edge requirements vs. Wikipedia paragraph chains via MuSiQue), and judge (paired GPT-5.4 x GPT-4.1 on both corpora), over 2x4,440 main-matrix runs, 600 cross-corpus runs, and over 5,000 faithfulness judgments. (C2a) GraphRAG's graph walk floods the context window at precision 0.12-0.23, but the synthesizer cites selectively at precision 0.48-0.65; scoring the retrieved set as the attribution set inverts the architecture ranking, which reconciles part of the disagreement in prior reports. (C1) Answer-level citation winners are corpus- and stratum-conditional but embedder-robust: GraphRAG ties vanilla on short-hop DO-178C queries and wins every MuSiQue stratum, while agentic pipelines lead only on 3+-hop requirements queries. (C2b) Faithfulness is corpus-conditional: on DO-178C it declines with hop distance (trend p<0.05 in three of four judge x embedder combinations); on Wikipedia chains neither judge shows a collapse. (C3) Single-judge LLM faithfulness is fragile to retrieval state: GPT-5.4's self-kappa across embedders is 0.137 (41% verdict change) against a same-day test-retest floor of 0.76, and re-judging frozen inputs eleven weeks later gives kappa <= 0.14 for both judges. A learned router on dense embeddings alone reaches macro-F1 0.86 on hop classification (C4). We argue that RAG architecture claims should be tested at this level of robustness -- including robustness to the citation-measurement point -- before they are trusted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"三重鲁棒性分析"框架，通过固定五种RAG流水线架构（Vanilla、Agentic、GraphRAG、Agentic+Graph、Adaptive），同时变化嵌入器（e5-small vs Azure text-embedding-3-small）、语料库（DO-178C航空认证需求 vs MuSiQue维基百科段落链）和评判器（GPT-5.4 vs GPT-4.1），在2×4,440次主矩阵运行、600次跨语料库运行和超过5,000次忠实性判断上，系统揭示了GraphRAG与向量RAG孰优孰劣的结论取决于引用质量的测量位置、语料库类型及查询跳数，挑战了现有RAG架构对比研究的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前关于GraphRAG与向量RAG架构优劣的结论存在分歧：Microsoft GraphRAG利用图结构但在细粒度查询上劣于向量RAG；Adaptive-RAG按复杂度路由但对跳数不敏感；LiSSA和TVR忽略类型化图推理。既往评估仅报告单一设置下的胜负结果，未解释为何结论随设置变化。本文认为：RAG架构声明需在多维度（嵌入器、语料库、评判器）鲁棒性验证下才可信，而航空DO-178C认证需求作为类型化链接图（derives_from/satisfies/traces_to），涉及多跳可审计链路追踪，是检验该问题的关键领域。
AI.method: 构建五流水线共享架构矩阵：(i) Vanilla稠密top-10检索；(ii) Agentic基于LangGraph的router-retriever-critic循环（仅search_documents工具，迭代≤3）；(iii) GraphRAG向量种子+2跳类型化图游走（Cypher，walk cap 30，context cap 15）；(iv) Agentic+Graph增加graph_lookup工具；(v) Adaptive基于规则路由器(V1)或袋外逻辑回归学习路由器(V2)。三重鲁棒性轴：嵌入器对比（intfloat/multilingual-e5-small 384d vs Azure text-embedding-3-small 1536d）、语料库对比（合成1,132条DO-178C航空需求覆盖32模块 vs 200查询MuSiQue子集映射到1/2/3+跳层）、评判器配对（GPT-5.4与GPT-4.1双向评判）。评估指标包括引用精确率/召回率、忠实性、Cohen's κ与Gwet's AC1一致性，以及跳数分类的宏F1。
AI.result: 四项主要发现：(C2a) GraphRAG的图游走以精度0.12-0.23淹没上下文窗口，但合成器选择性引用使答案级精度达0.48-0.65；若将检索集当作归因集评分则GraphRAG垫底，而按答案引用评分则其排名第一或并列——这一测量点差异部分调和了既往报告的分歧。(C1) 答案级胜者具有语料库与分层条件性但对嵌入器鲁棒：GraphRAG在短跳DO-178C查询上与Vanilla持平，在所有MuSiQue层获胜；代理流水线仅在3+跳需求查询上领先。(C2b) 忠实性具有语料库条件性：DO-178C上随跳数下降（74%→40%，四种评判×嵌入器组合中三种趋势p<0.05），但维基百科链上无崩溃。(C3) 单评判LLM忠实性对检索状态脆弱：GPT-5.4跨嵌入器自κ仅0.137（41%判决翻转），对比同日测试-再测试下限0.76；冻结输入11周后重评两名法官κ均≤0.14。(C4) 仅基于稠密嵌入的逻辑回归路由器在跳数分类上达宏F1 0.86。
AI.conclusion: RAG架构优劣的结论对测量位置（检索集 vs 答案引用集）、语料库类型（领域结构化 vs 开放域）和查询跳数均敏感，但对嵌入器相对稳健；单评判LLM的忠实性判断因检索状态变化和时间漂移而高度不稳定（κ接近随机水平）。因此，RAG架构声明必须在三重鲁棒性层面——包括对引用测量点的鲁棒性——加以检验方可采信。该研究为航空DO-178C等多跳需求追溯场景提供了可审计的RAG评估范式，并提示业界应警惕"GraphRAG必胜"或"向量RAG必胜"等单点结论。

title: UniHEAR: Unified Heterogeneous-Source Attentive Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires retrieving relevant entity knowledge from external sources to answer visually grounded questions. Existing retrieval-augmented systems suffer from two critical limitations. First, relying on a single retrieval modality creates a Single-Source Retrieval Bottleneck, missing ground-truth entities that are only accessible through complementary sources. Second, dual-tower pointwise rerankers suffer from Retrieval-Source-Blind Reranking, as they overlook retrieval origins and candidate-level retrieval priors, leading to redundant modality reliance. To address these challenges, we propose UniHEAR, a unified lightweight framework for heterogeneous-source entity retrieval and reranking. UniHEAR constructs a Coarse Retrieval Descriptor for each candidate entity, and introduces Retrieval-Guided Attentive Modality Gating to condition modality attention weights on this descriptor, further complemented by Entropy-Weighted Source Fusion of coarse retrieval priors. A hybrid training strategy combining contrastive learning with an auxiliary modality-preserving loss unifies entity-level and section-level retrieval within a single model. Extensive experiments on E-VQA and InfoSeek demonstrate that UniHEAR achieves state-of-the-art retrieval and VQA performance, improving Recall@1 by 6.7 and 1.2 points over the strongest baselines while maintaining a lightweight reranking architecture. Code and model are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出UniHEAR，一种用于知识型视觉问答（KB-VQA）的统一轻量级异构源检索与重排序框架。通过同时利用图像-图像（I2I）和图像-文本（I2T）两种检索源构建候选池，引入粗检索描述符（Coarse Retrieval Descriptor）桥接粗检索与精细重排序，并设计检索引导的注意力模态门控（RAMG）与熵加权源融合（EWSF）消除单源检索瓶颈与源盲重排序问题，最终在E-VQA和InfoSeek上以197M参数取得最优Recall@1（分别提升6.7和1.2点）。
AI.motivation: 现有KB-VQA的检索增强系统存在两大关键缺陷：1）单源检索瓶颈（Single-Source Retrieval Bottleneck）——I2I侧重形态相似性，I2T侧重语义一致性，在有限候选预算下二者的候选集重叠度低，导致大量真值实体仅能被单一源捕获；2）检索源盲重排序（Retrieval-Source-Blind Reranking）——双塔点式重排器对所有候选分配统一的模态注意力，忽略了检索来源和候选级先验，造成对已利用模态的冗余依赖，削弱重排序判别力。
AI.method: 三阶段统一框架：1）异构源粗粒度检索——通过EVA-CLIP-8B同时执行I2I与I2T检索，取候选池并集，为每个候选构建10维粗检索描述符𝒟(e)（包含归一化秩、相似度、z归一化相似度、与Top1的相似度差、池级熵）；2）检索引导的多模态重排序——基于VISTA编码器，引入RAMG将模态注意力的scale/shift参数γ(D)、β(D)条件化于𝒟(e)，并通过EWSF将粗检索先验以熵加权重融合到最终得分sim(e)=sim_r(e)+sim_c(e)；3）多实体段增强生成——按rank比例分配段数，通过MLLM生成答案。训练采用对比损失L_con与辅助损失L_aux（含二值掩码ω_m过滤不可靠正样本）的混合目标。
AI.result: 在E-VQA和InfoSeek上：1）检索性能——异构源设置下Recall@1达到49.5（E-VQA）和65.2（InfoSeek），相比最强单源基线OMGM分别提升6.7和1.2点；2）VQA性能——使用Qwen3-VL-8B生成器时E-VQA达到56.1%，超过OMGM 10.0点和EchoSight 15.0点；3）效率——仅197M参数（RAMG仅增加0.59M），相比BLIP-2基线（1.2B-1.7B）减少6-9倍；4）消融验证RAMG、EWSF、CRD各组件、辅助损失L_aux均带来显著增益，且失败案例分析指出EWSF在极端源置信度不均衡时的局限性。
AI.conclusion: UniHEAR通过统一的异构源检索与轻量级重排序有效解决了KB-VQA中的单源瓶颈与源盲重排序问题，以6-9倍少的参数实现SOTA检索与VQA性能，确立了异构源检索加检索引导重排序作为未来KB-VQA研究的有前景范式；未来工作方向包括学习式源可靠性估计以替代训练自由的EWSF。

title: Floor, Ceiling, and the Fusion Gap: How Much of Crowd Reading Attention Can Machines Predict?
comment: 8 pages. Ancillary files include the pre-registrations, hostile-audit records, verification scripts, and the aggregate artifacts every reported number is generated from
summary: A benchmark score means nothing without knowing what a trivial method achieves and what the best possible method could achieve. We construct both bounds for a task with a rare kind of ground truth: predicting which sentences a crowd of readers -- highlighting for their own purposes, unpaid, uninstructed, and blind to each other -- marked in 120 web documents. The floor is naive truncation (lead); the ceiling is a split-half oracle: half the crowd predicting the other half. The gap between them is +0.2028 AP [+0.1698, +0.2342, domain-clustered], and three findings structure it. First, the gap is semantic: position and length features recover 5% of it. Second, frontier language models reach 35-53% of it zero-shot -- far above classical baselines, far below the crowd; a state-of-the-art prompt compressor (LLMLingua-2) lands below the floor, indistinguishable from random selection. Third, an unweighted cross-vendor fusion of five frontier rankings plus a position prior reaches 60%, beating the best single model by +0.0159 [+0.0044, +0.0269; Holm p=0.019] -- a gain that survives ablation of its best member, split-half arm selection, prompt paraphrase, and label, gate, and seed perturbations, and was CONFIRMED by a pre-registered replication on 217 independent documents (+0.0179, Holm p=0.042). Finally, the bracket compresses: distilling the fusion into one open-weight 8B student that reads the whole document retains 90% of the fusion's edge and reaches statistical parity with the strongest single frontier model (+0.0070 [-0.0068, +0.0200]), where a local-context student retains only 63% -- the crowd's signal lives in document-level structure, and the cheapest known improvement is to ask several different models and average.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"预测众包读者高亮句子"这一任务,首次同时构建了性能下限(简单截取首句)与上限(一半读者预测另一半读者的split-half oracle),量化了任务天花板与已解决程度。核心发现:(1) 任务约半解决,前沿大模型零样本达到头部屋顶的35–53%;(2) 跨厂商五模型融合+位置先验可达到60%的头部屋顶,显著优于最强单模型(+0.0159 AP),且该增益在预注册复制实验中独立得到确认;(3) 将融合模型蒸馏为单个8B全文档阅读学生模型,可保留90%的融合优势,与最强单模型达到统计平价;(4) 任务的语义性在于文档级结构而非局部句子特征;(5) 当前SOTA提示压缩器LLMLingua-2甚至低于随机基线。
AI.motivation: 现有"预测人类阅读注意力"的基准分数缺乏上下界参照——naive截断(lead偏置)本身已是强预测器,而有限的众包标注本身也存在不可消除的噪声天花板,使得单点分数难以解读。此外,前期研究指出单读者层面模型无法超越读者间一致性,但众包/聚合层面是否存在可预测信号尚不明确。因此需要为该任务同时构造下界(trivial方法)与上界(split-half oracle),并系统评估前沿模型与简单融合策略在其中的位置。
AI.method: 数据集为120篇网页文档的社交高亮平台众包标注(中位19名读者/篇,74个领域);通过文档长度≥30句、读者数≥6筛选后保留112篇。核心方法为:(1) 标签构造:对每篇文档随机划分读者为A/B两半,以B半中被独立读者数标记最多的前15%句子为标签,平均精度(AP)为指标,60次随机划分平均;(2) 下界为"lead"位置评分,上界为A半预测B半(split-half oracle);(3) 五个前沿模型(GPT-5.4/5.5、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro/3.6 Flash)的句子排名通过Borda归一化,融合为非加权求和;(4) 推理采用域聚类bootstrap与符号翻转置换检验,Holm校正;(5) 预注册复制实验在217篇独立文档上重复;(6) 蒸馏环节用Qwen3-8B+ QLoRA全文档阅读学生与ModernBERT 150M局部上下文学生对比,训练数据为1万篇与评测文档不相交的教师语料。
AI.result: (1) 头部屋顶:ceiling(0.4437 AP) − floor(lead, 0.2410)= +0.2028 AP [95% CI: +0.1698, +0.2342];(2) 表层特征(位置/长度)仅恢复5%的头部屋顶;(3) 单模型达到35–53%头部屋顶(Gemini 3.1 Pro 53%最佳, GPT-5.4 35%最低);(4) LLMLingua-2在20%二值预算下低于floor −0.0383,与随机选择无显著差异;(5) 五模型融合+位置先验达0.3634 AP = 60%头部屋顶,优于最佳单模型 +0.0159 [+0.0044, +0.0269], Holm p=0.019;去掉最佳成员后仍优于最佳单模型+位置(+0.0206);(6) 在66%文档上融合优于单模型;(7) 预注册复制(217篇独立文档):融合 vs 最佳单模型 +0.0179 [0.0035, 0.0293], Holm p=0.042, 判定为CONFIRMED;(8) 蒸馏:8B全文档学生保留融合优势的90%,达 +0.1134 over floor,与最佳单模型统计平价 (+0.0070, 95% CI跨零, p=0.33);局部上下文学生仅保留63%且显著弱于最佳单模型。
AI.conclusion: (1) 任务为"约半解决":融合模型仅达众包标注自身可靠性上限的60%,未饱和;(2) 未解决的一半是语义性的,需要阅读句子而非依赖位置/长度;(3) 跨厂商异构融合带来可重复的、虽小但稳健的聚合增益,且增益不依赖最强成员,但仍需有强势厂商代表(vendor quality still matters);(4) 文档级结构是众包信号的真正载体——从局部上下文学生(63%保留)到全文档学生(90%保留)的跃迁表明该信号非局部;(5) 当前SOTA提示压缩器的优化目标无法迁移到人类注意力预测;(6) 实践建议:评估"高亮AI"应给出区间(bracket)而非单点数字,当前最便宜的改进策略是跨多家模型平均;(7) 随着模型间一致性提高,该融合增益将被消耗,需在新一代模型上持续重测。

title: Douyin Multimodal Embedding Model Technical Report
summary: Multimodal representation learning is a cornerstone of modern AI. By encoding multimodal queries and targets into vectors, it powers industrial search and recommendation and underpins modern agents. Real-world platforms with complex modalities and massive-scale content, such as Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and YouTube, demand both efficiency under billion-scale indexing and fine-grained discrimination for hard matching. Existing MLLM embedding models rarely satisfy both. Contrastive models are efficient but rely on pair-level supervision too coarse for fine-grained distinctions, while CoT-based models improve discrimination through explicit generation impractical to serve online. We present Douyin Multimodal Embedding (DME), a model trained in two stages to combine both strengths. Stage 1 performs large-scale contrastive pre-training that establishes a unified multimodal embedding space with broad modality and task coverage.
